-- LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE fallback shim (per Luarmor docs).
-- Keeps the UNOBFUSCATED source runnable: the macro becomes an identity
-- function. When this file is obfuscated by Luarmor/Luraph, the macro
-- calls are processed at obfuscation time and this shim is not needed.
loadstring([[
    function LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(f) return f end;
]])();

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Events2 = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Events2")

local clientWarn = Events2:FindFirstChild("ClientWarn")
if clientWarn and clientWarn:IsA("BindableEvent") then
    clientWarn.Event:Connect(function() end)
end

local snapshot = Events2:FindFirstChild("ConfirmSnapshot")
if snapshot then
    snapshot.Event:Connect(function() end)
end


-- Adonis anti-cheat bypass — must load BEFORE the script body so any
-- hooks Adonis installs are already neutralised by the time our script
-- starts touching Instance properties / remotes.
-- Safe to leave on for non-Adonis games (the module no-ops when not detected).
pcall(function()
    loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pixeluted/adoniscries/main/Source.lua'))()
end);

-- ============================================================
-- GAME-AWARE CONFIG FOLDER ROUTING
-- Routes config files to game-specific subfolders under frequency.lol/configs/
-- so configs don't leak between games (Criminality vs Rivals vs others).
-- ============================================================
local _GAME_FOLDER = "default"
do
    local _gid = tonumber(game.GameId)
    if _gid == 4588604953 then
        _GAME_FOLDER = "criminality"
    elseif _gid == 17625359962 then
        _GAME_FOLDER = "rivals"
    else
        -- Fallback: try to detect Criminality by its remotes (more reliable
        -- than game-id alone since universe IDs sometimes differ from place IDs).
        local _rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
        local _ev = _rs:FindFirstChild("Events")
        if _ev and (_ev:FindFirstChild("GNX_S") or _ev:FindFirstChild("ZFKLF__H")) then
            _GAME_FOLDER = "criminality"
        end
    end
end
-- Exposed globally so the configs UI section + startup autoload both see it.
_G.FrequencyGameFolder = _GAME_FOLDER
-- Make sure the per-game folder exists.
pcall(function()
    local _base = "frequency.lol/configs"
    if not isfolder(_base) then makefolder(_base) end
    local _sub = _base .. "/" .. _GAME_FOLDER
    if not isfolder(_sub) then makefolder(_sub) end
end)

task.spawn(function()
local _captured_key = script_key or "";
local _autoload_enabled = (autoload == true);
pcall(function()
    if not isfolder("frequency.lol") then makefolder("frequency.lol") end;
    if _autoload_enabled and _captured_key ~= "" then
        local _loader = 'script_key="' .. _captured_key .. '";autoload=true;loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://api.luarmor.net/files/v4/loaders/8baa45859e3a600f4ccbaed52a008d2c.lua"))()';
        writefile("frequency.lol/loader.txt", _loader);
        if not isfolder("autoexec") then makefolder("autoexec") end;
        writefile("autoexec/frequency.lua", _loader);
        if type(queue_on_teleport) == "function" then
            game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.OnTeleport:Connect(function(state)
                if state == Enum.TeleportState.InProgress then
                    queue_on_teleport(_loader);
                end
            end)
        end
    end;
end);

local function UpdateLoadingProgress(current, total, status)
        if not _LoadingGui then return end;
        task.defer(function()
        if total <= 0 then return end;
        local pct = current / total;
        if _LoadingBar then
                _LoadingBar.Size = UDim2.new(pct, 0, 1, 0);
        end;
        if _LoadingText then
                _LoadingText.Text = current .. " / " .. total;
        end;
        if _LoadingStatus and status then
                _LoadingStatus.Text = status;
        end;
        end)
end;

local function SetLoadingLogo(assetPath)
        if not _LoadingLogo then return end;
        if assetPath and assetPath ~= "" then
                local Ok, Asset = pcall(getcustomasset, assetPath);
                if Ok and Asset then
                        _LoadingLogo.Image = Asset;
                end;
        end;
end;

local function HideLoadingScreen()
        if _LoadingGui then
                _LoadingGui:Destroy();
                _LoadingGui = nil;
        end;
end;

local _EarlyIconFolder = "frequency.lol/icons";
local _EarlyIconUrls = {
        ["logo"]     = "https://github.com/j1scxx/bobhook-icons/blob/main/e0813ffd-9195-407a-a49e-e591810a6ec5.png?raw=true";
        ["legit"]    = "https://github.com/j1scxx/bobhook-icons/blob/main/legitbot.png?raw=true";
        ["rage"]     = "https://github.com/j1scxx/bobhook-icons/blob/main/rage.png?raw=true";
        ["esp"]      = "https://github.com/j1scxx/bobhook-icons/blob/main/esp.png?raw=true";
        ["players"]  = "https://github.com/j1scxx/bobhook-icons/blob/main/players.png?raw=true";
        ["misc"]     = "https://github.com/j1scxx/bobhook-icons/blob/main/misc.png?raw=true";
        ["settings"] = "https://github.com/j1scxx/bobhook-icons/blob/main/settings.png?raw=true";
        ["skins"]    = "https://github.com/j1scxx/bobhook-icons/blob/main/skins.png?raw=true";
        ["world"]    = "https://github.com/j1scxx/bobhook-icons/blob/main/world.png?raw=true";
        ["visuals"]  = "https://github.com/j1scxx/bobhook-icons/blob/main/f64ec140-9057-4038-8fc1-dec46b68fd92.png?raw=true";
};
do
        pcall(makefolder, _EarlyIconFolder);
        local _LogoMarker = _EarlyIconFolder .. "/logo.url.txt";
        local _CachedUrl = "";
        if isfile(_LogoMarker) then
                local Ok, Data = pcall(readfile, _LogoMarker);
                if Ok and Data then _CachedUrl = Data end;
        end;
        if _CachedUrl ~= _EarlyIconUrls["logo"] then
                pcall(delfile, _EarlyIconFolder .. "/logo.png");
        end;
        local missing = 0;
        for Name, _ in _EarlyIconUrls do
                if not isfile(_EarlyIconFolder .. "/" .. Name .. ".png") then
                        missing = missing + 1;
                end;
        end;
        if missing > 0 then
                -- Helper: fetch a URL with a hard 4-second timeout. Uses
                -- request() if available (most executors expose it with
                -- Timeout support), falls back to game:HttpGet with a watchdog.
                local function _fetchWithTimeout(url)
                        local result = nil
                        local done = false
                        -- Try request() with explicit Timeout (preferred path)
                        if type(request) == "function" then
                                local ok, res = pcall(function()
                                        return request({
                                                Url = url,
                                                Method = "GET",
                                                Timeout = 4000,
                                        })
                                end)
                                if ok and res and res.Success and res.Body then
                                        return res.Body
                                end
                                if ok and res and res.StatusCode == 200 and res.Body then
                                        return res.Body
                                end
                        end
                        -- Fallback: spawn game:HttpGet in a thread, race against
                        -- a 4-second watchdog. If watchdog fires first, the
                        -- fetch thread is abandoned (still running in the
                        -- background) but we proceed without the icon.
                        local fetchThread = task.spawn(function()
                                local ok, data = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(url) end)
                                if ok and data then
                                        result = data
                                end
                                done = true
                        end)
                        task.delay(4, function() done = true end)
                        -- Spin-wait until either the fetch completes or the
                        -- watchdog fires. Cap at 4.5 seconds to be safe.
                        local start = tick()
                        while not done and (tick() - start) < 4.5 do
                                task.wait(0.05)
                        end
                        return result
                end

                local logoPath = _EarlyIconFolder .. "/logo.png";
                if not isfile(logoPath) then
                        UpdateLoadingProgress(0, 1, "downloading logo.png...");
                        local Data = _fetchWithTimeout(_EarlyIconUrls["logo"]);
                        if Data then
                                pcall(writefile, logoPath, Data);
                                pcall(writefile, _LogoMarker, _EarlyIconUrls["logo"]);
                        end;
                end;
                task.wait()
                ShowLoadingScreen()
                SetLoadingLogo(logoPath);
                local total = 0;
                for _ in _EarlyIconUrls do total = total + 1 end;
                local done = 0;
                for Name, Url in _EarlyIconUrls do
                        local PngPath = _EarlyIconFolder .. "/" .. Name .. ".png";
                        if not isfile(PngPath) then
                                UpdateLoadingProgress(done, total, "downloading " .. Name .. ".png...");
                                local Data = _fetchWithTimeout(Url);
                                if Data then
                                        pcall(writefile, PngPath, Data);
                                end;
                        end;
                        done = done + 1;
                        UpdateLoadingProgress(done, total, "downloading " .. Name .. ".png...");
                end;
                UpdateLoadingProgress(done, total, "done");
                task.wait(0.1);
                HideLoadingScreen();
        end;
end;

local _EarlyTracerFolder = "frequency.lol/tracers";
task.defer(function()
        pcall(makefolder, _EarlyTracerFolder);
        for _, t in ipairs(_EmbeddedTracers) do
                local path = _EarlyTracerFolder .. "/" .. t.name .. ".json";
                if not isfile(path) then
                        pcall(writefile, path, t.rawJson);
                end;
        end;
end);

if ESP and ESP.Unload then
    ESP.Unload()
end

local _G_ESPState

do
local Players, RunService, HttpService, Workspace, Camera, Client
local Instance_new, Color3_fromRGB, Color3_new, Color3_fromHSV, Color3_fromHex
local table_clear, table_insert, table_remove, table_unpack, table_find, table_sort, table_concat
local string_find, string_match, string_format, string_gsub, string_lower, string_upper, string_sub
local task_wait, task_spawn, task_delay, task_defer
local coroutine_wrap, coroutine_close, coroutine_create, coroutine_resume
local os_clock, os_date
local Vector2_new, Vector3_new, Vector3_one, Vector3_zero
local UDim2_new, UDim2_fromScale, UDim2_fromOffset, UDim_new
local CFrame_Angles, CFrame_new
local math_clamp, math_round, math_floor, math_huge, math_sin, math_cos, math_pi, math_min, math_deg, math_max, math_random
local Drawing_new, Rect_new, Font_new, ColorSequence_new, ColorSequenceKeypoint_new, TweenInfo_new, NumberSequence_new, NumberSequenceKeypoint_new
local FindFirstChild, GetChildren, GetDescendants, WaitForChild, FindFirstChildWhichIsA, IsA

do
    local game = game
    local GetService = game.GetService
    local Service = function(Name)
        return cloneref(GetService(game, Name))
    end

    Players = Service("Players")
    RunService = Service("RunService")
    HttpService = Service("HttpService")
    Workspace = Service("Workspace")

    Instance_new = Instance.new
    Color3_fromRGB, Color3_new, Color3_fromHSV, Color3_fromHex = Color3.fromRGB, Color3.new, Color3.fromHSV, Color3.fromHex
    table_clear, table_insert, table_remove, table_unpack, table_find, table_sort, table_concat = table.clear, table.insert, table.remove, table.unpack, table.find, table.sort, table.concat
    string_find, string_match, string_format, string_gsub, string_lower, string_upper, string_sub = string.find, string.match, string.format, string.gsub, string.lower, string.upper, string.sub
    task_wait, task_spawn, task_delay, task_defer = task.wait, task.spawn, task.delay, task.defer
    coroutine_wrap, coroutine_close, coroutine_create, coroutine_resume = coroutine.wrap, coroutine.close, coroutine.create, coroutine.resume
    os_clock, os_date = os.clock, os.date
    Vector2_new, Vector3_new, Vector3_one, Vector3_zero = Vector2.new, Vector3.new, Vector3.one, Vector3.zero
    UDim2_new, UDim2_fromScale, UDim2_fromOffset, UDim_new = UDim2.new, UDim2.fromScale, UDim2.fromOffset, UDim.new
    CFrame_Angles, CFrame_new = CFrame.Angles, CFrame.new
    math_clamp, math_round, math_floor, math_huge, math_sin, math_cos, math_pi, math_min, math_deg, math_max, math_random = math.clamp, math.round, math.floor, math.huge, math.sin, math.cos, math.pi, math.min, math.deg, math.max, math.random
    Drawing_new, Rect_new, Font_new, ColorSequence_new, ColorSequenceKeypoint_new, TweenInfo_new, NumberSequence_new, NumberSequenceKeypoint_new = Drawing.new, Rect.new, Font.new, ColorSequence.new, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new, TweenInfo.new, NumberSequence.new, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new
    FindFirstChild, GetChildren, GetDescendants, WaitForChild, FindFirstChildWhichIsA, IsA = game.FindFirstChild, game.GetChildren, game.GetDescendants, game.WaitForChild, game.FindFirstChildWhichIsA, game.IsA

    Client = Players.LocalPlayer
    Camera = FindFirstChildWhichIsA(Workspace, "Camera")
end

-- ============================================================
-- perf: Central Heartbeat dispatcher.
-- Under Luraph, every RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(fn) creates a
-- separately-wrapped callback. Having 12+ always-on connections
-- means 12+ wrapped callbacks fire every frame (60 Hz), each with
-- Luraph dispatch overhead -- even when the callback immediately
-- returns. This registry collapses them into ONE connection that
-- calls all registered handlers in sequence, each protected by
-- pcall so one failing handler cannot starve the others.
-- Visual/behavioral result is identical; only the dispatch path
-- changes.
-- ============================================================
_HeartbeatHandlers = {};
_HeartbeatConn = nil;
-- NOTE: _RegisterHeartbeat is a GLOBAL (no `local`) because it is defined
-- inside a do-block (line 1429) but called from code OUTSIDE that block
-- (e.g. line 3852, 17499, 4075). A `local` would go out of scope when
-- the enclosing do-block ends, causing "attempt to call a nil value".
function _RegisterHeartbeat(fn)
    local _idx = #_HeartbeatHandlers + 1;
    _HeartbeatHandlers[_idx] = fn;
    if not _HeartbeatConn then
        _HeartbeatConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
            local _tbl = _HeartbeatHandlers;
            local _n = #_tbl;
            local i = 1;
            while i <= _n do
                local _fn = _tbl[i];
                if _fn then _fn(dt); end;
                i = i + 1;
            end;
        end));
    end;
    return {
        Disconnect = function()
            _HeartbeatHandlers[_idx] = nil;
        end;
    };
end;

_RenderSteppedHandlers = {};
_RenderSteppedConn = nil;
function _RegisterRenderStepped(fn)
    local _idx = #_RenderSteppedHandlers + 1;
    _RenderSteppedHandlers[_idx] = fn;
    if not _RenderSteppedConn then
        _RenderSteppedConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
            local _tbl = _RenderSteppedHandlers;
            local _n = #_tbl;
            local i = 1;
            while i <= _n do
                local _fn = _tbl[i];
                if _fn then _fn(dt); end;
                i = i + 1;
            end;
        end));
    end;
    return {
        Disconnect = function()
            _RenderSteppedHandlers[_idx] = nil;
        end;
    };
end;

local Viewport, ConnectionsTable, ObjectsTable, FolderLocation, ESPErrors, ESPSettings, WorldToViewportPoint, ExecutorName
do
    Viewport = Camera.ViewportSize
    ConnectionsTable = ESP.Connections
    ObjectsTable = ESP.Objects
    FolderLocation = ESP.Folder
    ESPErrors = ESP.Errors
    ESPSettings = ESP.Settings
    WorldToViewportPoint = Camera.WorldToViewportPoint
    ExecutorName = getexecutorname()
end

local function P(p)
    return p:gsub("\\", "/")
end

do
    local baseFolder = P(FolderLocation)
    local fontsFolder = P(FolderLocation .. "/fonts")

    if not isfolder(baseFolder) then
        makefolder(baseFolder)
    end

    if not isfolder(fontsFolder) then
        makefolder(fontsFolder)
    end
end

local FontsToDownload = {
    ["Tahoma"]      = {Link = "https://github.com/LuckyHub1/LuckyHub/raw/refs/heads/main/zekton_rg.ttf",      Ext = "ttf"},
    ["Minecraftia"] = {Link = "https://github.com/LuckyHub1/LuckyHub/raw/refs/heads/main/Minecraftia.ttf",    Ext = "ttf"},
    ["Silkscreen"]  = {Link = "https://github.com/LuckyHub1/LuckyHub/raw/refs/heads/main/Silkscreen.ttf",     Ext = "ttf"},
    ["Fortnite"]    = {Link = "https://github.com/nyrus573l/esp-fonts/raw/refs/heads/main/fortnite.otf",      Ext = "otf"},
}

do
    local fontsFolder = P(FolderLocation .. "/fonts")

    -- Phase 1: download any missing font files synchronously so they exist
    -- before we try to register them as custom assets.
    for Name, Table in FontsToDownload do
        local ext     = Table.Ext or "ttf"
        local rawPath = P(fontsFolder .. "/" .. Name .. "." .. ext)
        if not isfile(rawPath) then
            pcall(function()
                local data = game:HttpGet(Table.Link)
                if data and #data > 0 then
                    writefile(rawPath, data)
                end
            end)
        end
    end

    -- Phase 2: now that font files exist, build/rebuild .font descriptors.
    for Name, Table in FontsToDownload do
        local ext      = Table.Ext or "ttf"
        local rawPath  = P(fontsFolder .. "/" .. Name .. "." .. ext)
        local fontPath = P(fontsFolder .. "/" .. Name .. ".font")

        -- If the raw font still doesn't exist after the download attempt, skip
        if not isfile(rawPath) then continue end

        if not isfile(fontPath) or ExecutorName == "Potassium" then
            local ok, asset = pcall(getcustomasset, rawPath)
            if ok and asset and asset ~= "" then
                local Config = {
                    name = Name,
                    faces = {{
                        name = "Regular",
                        weight = 9e9,
                        style = "normal",
                        assetId = asset
                    }}
                }
                pcall(writefile, fontPath, HttpService:JSONEncode(Config))
            end
        end
    end

    if not getgenv().Fonts then
        getgenv().Fonts = {
            Loaded = {}
        }

        for _, FontPath in listfiles(fontsFolder) do
            FontPath = P(FontPath)

           local Name = string_match(FontPath, fontsFolder .. "/(.+)%.font")
              if Name then
    local ok, asset = pcall(getcustomasset, FontPath)

    if ok then
        Fonts.Loaded[Name] = Font_new(asset, Enum.FontWeight.Regular)
    else
        Fonts.Loaded[Name] = Font_new(Enum.Font.SourceSans, Enum.FontWeight.Regular)
    end
end

        end
    end
end

local TabIcons = {}
do
    local iconsFolder = P(FolderLocation .. "/icons")
    if not isfolder(iconsFolder) then makefolder(iconsFolder) end

    local IconUrls = {
        ["legit"]    = "https://github.com/j1scxx/bobhook-icons/blob/main/legitbot.png?raw=true";
        ["rage"]     = "https://github.com/j1scxx/bobhook-icons/blob/main/rage.png?raw=true";
        ["esp"]      = "https://github.com/j1scxx/bobhook-icons/blob/main/esp.png?raw=true";
        ["players"]  = "https://github.com/j1scxx/bobhook-icons/blob/main/players.png?raw=true";
        ["misc"]     = "https://github.com/j1scxx/bobhook-icons/blob/main/misc.png?raw=true";
        ["settings"] = "https://github.com/j1scxx/bobhook-icons/blob/main/settings.png?raw=true";
        ["skins"]    = "https://github.com/j1scxx/bobhook-icons/blob/main/skins.png?raw=true";
        ["world"]    = "https://github.com/j1scxx/bobhook-icons/blob/main/world.png?raw=true";
        ["visuals"]  = "https://github.com/j1scxx/bobhook-icons/blob/main/f64ec140-9057-4038-8fc1-dec46b68fd92.png?raw=true";
    }

    local _downloadThreads = {};
    for Name, Url in IconUrls do
        local PngPath = P(iconsFolder .. "/" .. Name .. ".png")
        if not isfile(PngPath) then
            table.insert(_downloadThreads, task.spawn(function()
                local Ok, Data = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(Url) end)
                if Ok and Data then
                    pcall(writefile, PngPath, Data)
                end
            end));
        end
    end
    -- wait for all downloads to finish
    for _, t in _downloadThreads do
        local ok = pcall(task.wait, 0);
        _ = ok; -- suppress unused
    end
    task.wait(0.1);
    for Name, _ in IconUrls do
        local PngPath = P(iconsFolder .. "/" .. Name .. ".png")
        local Ok2, Asset = pcall(getcustomasset, PngPath)
        if Ok2 and Asset then
            TabIcons[Name] = Asset
        end
    end
end

local Utility = {}; do
    function Utility.AddConnection(Signal, Function)
        local Connection = Signal:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(...)
            local Args = {...}

            local Success, Message = pcall(Function, table_unpack(Args))

            if not Success and not ESPErrors[Message] then
                local ErrorMessage = string_format("[ERROR] | An error has occured:\n%s", Message)

                warn(ErrorMessage)

                ESPErrors[Message] = Message

                if ConnectionsTable[Connection] then
                    ConnectionsTable[Connection] = nil
                end

                return Connection and Connection:Disconnect()
            end
        end))

        if Connection and ConnectionsTable then
            table_insert(ConnectionsTable, Connection)
        end

        return Connection
    end

    Utility.CreateObject = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(Type, Properties, Hidden)
        local Hidden = Hidden or false
        local Object = Instance_new(Type)

        for Index, Value in Properties do
            Object[Index] = Value
        end

        table_insert(ObjectsTable, Object)

        return Object
    end)

    Utility.CalculateBox = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(ESPSettings, Target, RootPart, Parts)
        local MinX, MinY, MaxX, MaxY = 9000, 9000, -9000, -9000
        local BoxWidth, BoxHeight = 0, 0
        local Position, OnScreen = WorldToViewportPoint(Camera, RootPart.Position)

        if ESPSettings.BoundingBox.DynamicBox then
            for _, Part in Parts do
                if IsA(Part, "BasePart") and Part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and Part.Name ~= "Handle" and Part.Transparency ~= 1 then
                    local PartCFrame = Part.CFrame
                    local PartSize = Part.Size
                    local HalfX, HalfY, HalfZ = PartSize.X / 2, PartSize.Y / 2, PartSize.Z / 2
                    local sp
                    sp = WorldToViewportPoint(Camera, PartCFrame * Vector3_new( HalfX,  HalfY,  HalfZ))
                    MinX = math_min(MinX, sp.X); MinY = math_min(MinY, sp.Y)
                    MaxX = math_max(MaxX, sp.X); MaxY = math_max(MaxY, sp.Y)
                    sp = WorldToViewportPoint(Camera, PartCFrame * Vector3_new(-HalfX,  HalfY,  HalfZ))
                    MinX = math_min(MinX, sp.X); MinY = math_min(MinY, sp.Y)
                    MaxX = math_max(MaxX, sp.X); MaxY = math_max(MaxY, sp.Y)
                    sp = WorldToViewportPoint(Camera, PartCFrame * Vector3_new( HalfX, -HalfY,  HalfZ))
                    MinX = math_min(MinX, sp.X); MinY = math_min(MinY, sp.Y)
                    MaxX = math_max(MaxX, sp.X); MaxY = math_max(MaxY, sp.Y)
                    sp = WorldToViewportPoint(Camera, PartCFrame * Vector3_new(-HalfX, -HalfY,  HalfZ))
                    MinX = math_min(MinX, sp.X); MinY = math_min(MinY, sp.Y)
                    MaxX = math_max(MaxX, sp.X); MaxY = math_max(MaxY, sp.Y)
                    sp = WorldToViewportPoint(Camera, PartCFrame * Vector3_new( HalfX,  HalfY, -HalfZ))
                    MinX = math_min(MinX, sp.X); MinY = math_min(MinY, sp.Y)
                    MaxX = math_max(MaxX, sp.X); MaxY = math_max(MaxY, sp.Y)
                    sp = WorldToViewportPoint(Camera, PartCFrame * Vector3_new(-HalfX,  HalfY, -HalfZ))
                    MinX = math_min(MinX, sp.X); MinY = math_min(MinY, sp.Y)
                    MaxX = math_max(MaxX, sp.X); MaxY = math_max(MaxY, sp.Y)
                    sp = WorldToViewportPoint(Camera, PartCFrame * Vector3_new( HalfX, -HalfY, -HalfZ))
                    MinX = math_min(MinX, sp.X); MinY = math_min(MinY, sp.Y)
                    MaxX = math_max(MaxX, sp.X); MaxY = math_max(MaxY, sp.Y)
                    sp = WorldToViewportPoint(Camera, PartCFrame * Vector3_new(-HalfX, -HalfY, -HalfZ))
                    MinX = math_min(MinX, sp.X); MinY = math_min(MinY, sp.Y)
                    MaxX = math_max(MaxX, sp.X); MaxY = math_max(MaxY, sp.Y)
                end
            end

            BoxWidth, BoxHeight = MaxX - MinX, MaxY - MinY
        else
            local Scale = (Camera.ViewportSize.Y) / (Position.Z * 2 * math.tan(math.rad(Camera.FieldOfView / 2)))

            BoxWidth, BoxHeight = 3.5 * Scale, 5.5 * Scale
            MinX, MinY = Position.X - (BoxWidth / 2), Position.Y - (BoxHeight / 2) + (Scale * 0.6)
        end

        return BoxWidth, BoxHeight, MinX, MinY, OnScreen
    end)

    Utility.GetFontType = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(ESPSettings, Text)
        local FontType = string_lower(ESPSettings.FontType)

        if FontType == "uppercase" then
            return string_upper(Text)
        elseif FontType == "lowercase" then
            return string_lower(Text)
        else
            return Text
        end
    end)
end

local PlayerHelper = {}; do
    PlayerHelper.GetCharacter = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(Player)
        if not Player then return nil end

        local Character = Player.Character

        return Character
    end)

    function PlayerHelper.GetChildren(Character)
        if not Character then return {} end

        local Children = Character:GetChildren()

        return Children
    end

    function PlayerHelper.GetDescendants(Character)
        if not Character then return {} end

        local Descendants = Character:GetDescendants()

        return Descendants
    end

    local _RivalsFC;
    local function _GetRivalsFighterController()
        if _RivalsFC then return _RivalsFC end;
        local ok, fc = pcall(function()
            return require(game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
                :WaitForChild("PlayerScripts")
                :WaitForChild("Controllers")
                :WaitForChild("FighterController"));
        end);
        if ok and fc then _RivalsFC = fc; return fc; end;
        return nil;
    end

    function PlayerHelper.GetTool(Player)
        if not Player then return nil end
        local char = Player.Character
        if not char then return nil end
        for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("Tool") then
                return child.Name
            end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local _ItemLibrary;
    local function _GetItemLibrary()
        if _ItemLibrary ~= nil then return _ItemLibrary end;
        local ok, lib = pcall(function()
            return require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.ItemLibrary);
        end);
        _ItemLibrary = ok and lib or false;
        return _ItemLibrary;
    end

    function PlayerHelper.GetKillfeedIcon(weaponName)
        if not weaponName or weaponName == "" then return nil, nil end;

        local lib = _GetItemLibrary();
        if lib and lib.ViewModels then
            local vm = lib.ViewModels[weaponName];
            if vm and vm.EliminationFeedImage then
                return vm.EliminationFeedImage, vm.EliminationFeedImageScale or 1;
            end;
            if lib.Items and lib.Items[weaponName] then
                local baseName = nil;
                pcall(function() baseName = lib.Items[weaponName].Base end);
                if baseName and lib.ViewModels[baseName] and lib.ViewModels[baseName].EliminationFeedImage then
                    return lib.ViewModels[baseName].EliminationFeedImage, lib.ViewModels[baseName].EliminationFeedImageScale or 1;
                end;
            end;
        end;

        local hit = _KillfeedIconFallback[weaponName];
        if hit then return hit.Id, hit.Scale end;

        local lower = string.lower(weaponName):gsub("%s", "");
        for _, hint in ipairs(_SkinBaseHints) do
            if string.find(lower, hint.Pattern, 1, true) then
                local b = _KillfeedIconFallback[hint.Base];
                if b then return b.Id, b.Scale end;
            end;
        end;

        local missing = _KillfeedIconFallback["MISSING_WEAPON"];
        if missing then return missing.Id, missing.Scale end;
        return nil, nil;
    end
end

    function ESP.AddTarget(Target, Type)
        if Target == nil then return end
        if not ESP.Targets[Type] then ESP.Targets[Type] = {} end
        if ESP.Targets[Type][Target] then return end

        local TargetInfo = {
            Objects = {},
            CharacterObjects = {},
            CharacterConnection = nil,
            ToolConnection = {Added = nil, Removed = nil},
            CurrentTool = "none",
            LastTick = os_clock()
        }

        local IsPlayer = IsA(Target, "Player")
        local IsBasePart = IsA(Target, "BasePart")
        local Objects = TargetInfo.Objects
        local LastTick = TargetInfo.LastTick
        local ToolConnection = TargetInfo.ToolConnection
        local CharacterObjects = TargetInfo.CharacterObjects
        local ESPSettings = ESPSettings[Type]
        local ESPFont = Fonts.Loaded[ESPSettings.Font]
        local ESPFontSize = ESPSettings.FontSize
        local ESPHolder = ESP.Holder

do
            CharacterObjects.Character = if IsPlayer then (PlayerHelper.GetCharacter(Target)) else Target
            CharacterObjects.Children = PlayerHelper.GetChildren(CharacterObjects.Character)
            CharacterObjects.Descendants = PlayerHelper.GetDescendants(CharacterObjects.Character)
            if CharacterObjects.Character then
                CharacterObjects.HumanoidRootPart = CharacterObjects.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                CharacterObjects.Humanoid = CharacterObjects.Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid")
                if (not CharacterObjects.HumanoidRootPart or not CharacterObjects.Humanoid) and not IsPlayer then
                    local wrapper = CharacterObjects.Character:FindFirstChild("EnemyHumanoid");
                    if wrapper then
                        if not CharacterObjects.HumanoidRootPart then
                            CharacterObjects.HumanoidRootPart = wrapper:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");
                        end;
                        if not CharacterObjects.Humanoid then
                            if wrapper:IsA("Humanoid") then
                                CharacterObjects.Humanoid = wrapper;
                            else
                                CharacterObjects.Humanoid = wrapper:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid");
                            end;
                        end;
                    end;
                end;
            end
        end

        do
            function TargetInfo.Init()
                if #Objects > 0 then return end

                if IsPlayer then
                    TargetInfo.CharacterConnection = Utility.AddConnection(Target.CharacterAdded, function(Character)
                        CharacterObjects.Character = Character
                        CharacterObjects.HumanoidRootPart = WaitForChild(Character, "HumanoidRootPart", 10)
                        CharacterObjects.Humanoid = WaitForChild(Character, "Humanoid", 10)
                        CharacterObjects.Children = PlayerHelper.GetChildren(Character)
                        CharacterObjects.Descendants = PlayerHelper.GetDescendants(Character)

                        local Highlight = Objects["Highlight"]; do
                            Highlight.Adornee = CharacterObjects.Character
                        end

                        TargetInfo.CurrentTool = "none"
                        if ToolConnection.Added then pcall(function() ToolConnection.Added:Disconnect() end) end
                        if ToolConnection.Removed then pcall(function() ToolConnection.Removed:Disconnect() end) end
                        ToolConnection.Added = Utility.AddConnection(Character.ChildAdded, function(Child)
                            if Child:IsA("Tool") then
                                TargetInfo.CurrentTool = Child.Name
                            end
                        end)
                        ToolConnection.Removed = Utility.AddConnection(Character.ChildRemoved, function(Child)
                            if Child:IsA("Tool") then
                                TargetInfo.CurrentTool = "none"
                            end
                        end)
                    end)

                    if CharacterObjects.Character then
                        ToolConnection.Added = Utility.AddConnection(CharacterObjects.Character.ChildAdded, function(Child)
                            if IsA(Child, "Tool") then
                                TargetInfo.CurrentTool = Child.Name
                            end
                        end)

                        ToolConnection.Removed = Utility.AddConnection(CharacterObjects.Character.ChildRemoved, function(Child)
                            if IsA(Child, "Tool") then
                                TargetInfo.CurrentTool = "none"
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                end

                Objects["Highlight"] = Utility.CreateObject("Highlight", {Parent = CharacterObjects.Character, Adornee = CharacterObjects.Character, Enabled = false})
                Objects["TargetHolder"] = Utility.CreateObject("Frame", {Parent = ESPHolder, Visible = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2_new(0, 0, 0, 0), BorderColor3 = Color3_fromRGB(0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2_new(0, 0, 0, 0), BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundColor3 = Color3_fromRGB(255, 255, 255)})
                Objects["TopHolder"] = Utility.CreateObject("Frame", {Parent = Objects["TargetHolder"], AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, Visible = true, BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2_new(0, 1), Position = UDim2_new(0, -2, 0, -5), BorderColor3 = Color3_fromRGB(0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2_new(1, 4, 0, 0), BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundColor3 = Color3_fromRGB(255, 255, 255)})
