                    Objects["BoxGlow"] = Utility.CreateObject("ImageLabel", {Parent = Objects["TargetHolder"], Image = "rbxassetid://110204605000367", ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Slice, SliceCenter = Rect_new(Vector2_new(21, 21), Vector2_new(79, 79)), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY, ImageTransparency = 0.65, ResampleMode = Enum.ResamplerMode.Pixelated, Visible = true, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2_new(0, -21, 0, -21), BorderColor3 = Color3_fromRGB(0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2_new(0, 0, 0, 0), BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundColor3 = Color3_fromRGB(255, 255, 255)})
                    Objects["BoxGlowGradient"] = Utility.CreateObject("UIGradient", {Parent = Objects["BoxGlow"], Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence_new{ColorSequenceKeypoint_new(0, Color3_fromRGB(0, 0, 0)), ColorSequenceKeypoint_new(1, Color3_fromRGB(0, 0, 0))}, Transparency = NumberSequence_new{NumberSequenceKeypoint_new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint_new(1, 0)}})
                    Utility.CreateObject("UIPadding", {Parent = Objects["BoxGlow"], PaddingTop = UDim_new(0, 21), PaddingBottom = UDim_new(0, 20), PaddingLeft = UDim_new(0, 21), PaddingRight = UDim_new(0, 20)})

                    Objects["BoxOutlineHolder"] = Utility.CreateObject("Frame", {Parent = Objects["BoxGlow"], Visible = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2_new(0, 0, 0, 0), BorderColor3 = Color3_fromRGB(0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2_new(0, 0, 0, 0), BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundColor3 = Color3_fromRGB(255, 255, 255)})
                    Objects["BoxOutline"] = Utility.CreateObject("UIStroke", {Parent = Objects["BoxOutlineHolder"], Thickness = 3, LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter})
                    Objects["BoxOutlineGradient"] = Utility.CreateObject("UIGradient", {Parent = Objects["BoxOutline"], Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence_new{ColorSequenceKeypoint_new(0, Color3_fromRGB(0, 0, 0)), ColorSequenceKeypoint_new(1, Color3_fromRGB(0, 0, 0))}, Transparency = NumberSequence_new{NumberSequenceKeypoint_new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint_new(1, 0)}})

                    Objects["BoxInlineHolder"] = Utility.CreateObject("Frame", {Parent = Objects["BoxGlow"], Visible = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2_new(0, -1, 0, -1), BorderColor3 = Color3_fromRGB(0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2_new(0, 0, 0, 0), BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundColor3 = Color3_fromRGB(255, 255, 255)})
                    Objects["BoxInline"] = Utility.CreateObject("UIStroke", {Parent = Objects["BoxInlineHolder"], Color = Color3_fromRGB(255, 255, 255), LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter})
                    Objects["BoxInlineGradient"] = Utility.CreateObject("UIGradient", {Parent = Objects["BoxInline"], Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence_new{ColorSequenceKeypoint_new(0, Color3_fromRGB(0, 0, 0)), ColorSequenceKeypoint_new(1, Color3_fromRGB(255, 255, 255))}, Transparency = NumberSequence_new{NumberSequenceKeypoint_new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint_new(1, 0)}})

                    Objects["BoxFill"] = Utility.CreateObject("Frame", {Parent = Objects["BoxGlow"], Visible = false, BackgroundTransparency = 0, Position = UDim2_new(0, 0, 0, 0), BorderColor3 = Color3_fromRGB(0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2_new(0, 0, 0, 0), BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundColor3 = Color3_fromRGB(255, 255, 255)})
                    Objects["BoxFillGradient"] = Utility.CreateObject("UIGradient", {Parent = Objects["BoxFill"], Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence_new{ColorSequenceKeypoint_new(0, Color3_fromRGB(0, 0, 0)), ColorSequenceKeypoint_new(1, Color3_fromRGB(255, 255, 255))}, Transparency = NumberSequence_new{NumberSequenceKeypoint_new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint_new(1, 1)}})
                end

                do
                    Objects["CornerHolder"] = Utility.CreateObject("Frame", {Parent = Objects["BoxGlow"], Visible = false, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2_new(0, -1, 0, -1), BorderColor3 = Color3_fromRGB(0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2_new(0, 0, 0, 0), BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundColor3 = Color3_fromRGB(255, 255, 255)})

                    for i = 1, 8 do
                        Objects["Line_" .. i] = Utility.CreateObject("Frame", {Parent = Objects["CornerHolder"], Visible = false, BackgroundTransparency = 0, Position = UDim2_new(0, 0, 0, 0), BorderColor3 = Color3_fromRGB(0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2_new(0, 0, 0, 0), BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundColor3 = Color3_fromRGB(255, 255, 255)})
                        Utility.CreateObject("UIStroke", {Parent = Objects["Line_" .. i], Thickness = 1, LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter})
                    end
                end

                do
                    for BarName, Bar in ESPSettings.Bars do
                        Objects[BarName .. "Outline"] = Utility.CreateObject("Frame", {Parent = Objects[Bar.Position .. "BarHolder"], ZIndex = 5, LayoutOrder = 0, Visible = true, BackgroundTransparency = 0, Position = UDim2_new(0, 0, 0, 0), BorderColor3 = Color3_fromRGB(0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2_new(1, 0, 0, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundColor3 = Color3_fromRGB(0, 0, 0)})
                        Utility.CreateObject("UIStroke", {Parent = Objects[BarName .. "Outline"], Thickness = 1, LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter})

                        Objects[BarName] = Utility.CreateObject("Frame", {Parent = Objects[BarName .. "Outline"], ZIndex = 6, LayoutOrder = 0, Visible = true, BackgroundTransparency = 0, Position = UDim2_new(0, 0, 0, 0), BorderColor3 = Color3_fromRGB(0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2_new(1, 0, 0, 1), BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundColor3 = Color3_fromRGB(255, 255, 255)})
                        Objects[BarName .. "Gradient"] = Utility.CreateObject("UIGradient", {Parent = Objects[BarName], Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence_new{ColorSequenceKeypoint_new(0, Color3_fromRGB(0, 0, 0)), ColorSequenceKeypoint_new(0, Color3_fromRGB(0, 0, 0)), ColorSequenceKeypoint_new(1, Color3_fromRGB(255, 255, 255))}, Transparency = NumberSequence_new{NumberSequenceKeypoint_new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint_new(1, 0)}})

                        Objects[BarName .. "Text"] = Utility.CreateObject("TextLabel", {
                            Parent = Objects[Bar.Position .. "TextHolder"],
                            FontFace = ESPFont,
                            TextSize = ESPFontSize,
                            LayoutOrder = 2,
                            TextColor3 = Color3_fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
                            Text = "",
                            AnchorPoint = Vector2_new(0, 1),
                            BorderSizePixel = 0,
                            Visible = false,
                            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                            ZIndex = 5,
                            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                            Size = UDim2_new(1, 0, 0, 0)
                        }); Utility.CreateObject("UIStroke", {Parent = Objects[BarName .. "Text"], Color = Color3_fromRGB(0, 0, 0), LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter})
                    end
                end

                do
                    Objects["TargetName"] = Utility.CreateObject("TextLabel", {
                        Parent = Objects["TopTextHolder"],
                        FontFace = ESPFont,
                        TextSize = ESPFontSize,
                        LayoutOrder = 2,
                        TextColor3 = Color3_fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
                        Text = "",
                        AnchorPoint = Vector2_new(0, 1),
                        BorderSizePixel = 0,
                        Visible = false,
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        ZIndex = 5,
                        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                        Size = UDim2_new(1, 0, 0, 0)
                    }); Utility.CreateObject("UIStroke", {Parent = Objects["TargetName"], Color = Color3_fromRGB(0, 0, 0), LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter})

                    Objects["Distance"] = Utility.CreateObject("TextLabel", {
                        Parent = Objects["BottomTextHolder"],
                        FontFace = ESPFont,
                        TextSize = ESPFontSize,
                        LayoutOrder = 2,
                        TextColor3 = Color3_fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
                        Text = "",
                        AnchorPoint = Vector2_new(0, 1),
                        BorderSizePixel = 0,
                        Visible = false,
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        ZIndex = 5,
                        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                        Size = UDim2_new(1, 0, 0, 0)
                    }); Utility.CreateObject("UIStroke", {Parent = Objects["Distance"], Color = Color3_fromRGB(0, 0, 0), LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter})

                    Objects["Flags"] = Utility.CreateObject("TextLabel", {
                        Parent = Objects["RightTextHolder"],
                        FontFace = ESPFont,
                        TextSize = ESPFontSize,
                        LayoutOrder = 2,
                        TextColor3 = Color3_fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
                        Text = "",
                        AnchorPoint = Vector2_new(0, 1),
                        BorderSizePixel = 0,
                        Visible = false,
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        ZIndex = 5,
                        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY,
                        Size = UDim2_new(0, 0, 0, 0)
                    }); Utility.CreateObject("UIStroke", {Parent = Objects["Flags"], Color = Color3_fromRGB(0, 0, 0), LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter})

                    Objects["Weapon"] = Utility.CreateObject("TextLabel", {
                        Parent = Objects["BottomTextHolder"],
                        FontFace = ESPFont,
                        TextSize = ESPFontSize,
                        LayoutOrder = 2,
                        TextColor3 = Color3_fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
                        Text = "none",
                        AnchorPoint = Vector2_new(0, 1),
                        BorderSizePixel = 0,
                        Visible = false,
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                        ZIndex = 5,
                        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
                        Size = UDim2_new(1, 0, 0, 0)
                    }); Utility.CreateObject("UIStroke", {Parent = Objects["Weapon"], Color = Color3_fromRGB(0, 0, 0), LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter})
                end

                ESP.Targets[Type][Target] = TargetInfo
            end

            TargetInfo.Update = LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
                if (os_clock() - LastTick) < (1 / ESPSettings.RefreshRate) then return end
                if not CharacterObjects.Children then return end
                if not CharacterObjects.Descendants then return end

                local _now = os_clock();
                if not TargetInfo._lastStructCheck or (_now - TargetInfo._lastStructCheck) >= 1.0 then
                    TargetInfo._lastStructCheck = _now;
                    local CurrentChildren = PlayerHelper.GetChildren(CharacterObjects.Character)
                    local CurrentDescendants = PlayerHelper.GetDescendants(CharacterObjects.Character)

                    if #CharacterObjects.Children ~= #CurrentChildren then
                        CharacterObjects.Children = CurrentChildren
                        TargetInfo._boxCacheInvalid = true;
                        if ESPSettings.Enabled and ESPSettings.Chams.Enabled and CharacterObjects.Character
                           and not (Target == Client and not ESPSettings.LocalPlayer) then
                            local _HL = Objects["Highlight"]
                            if _HL then
                                _HL.Adornee = CharacterObjects.Character
                                _HL.Enabled = true
                                _HL.DepthMode = ESPSettings.Chams.DepthMode
                                _HL.FillColor = ESPSettings.Chams.Fill[1]
                                _HL.FillTransparency = ESPSettings.Chams.Fill[2]
                                _HL.OutlineColor = ESPSettings.Chams.Outline[1]
                                _HL.OutlineTransparency = ESPSettings.Chams.Outline[2]
                            end
                        end
                        return
                    end

                    if #CharacterObjects.Descendants ~= #CurrentDescendants then
                        CharacterObjects.Descendants = CurrentDescendants
                        TargetInfo._boxCacheInvalid = true;
                        if ESPSettings.Enabled and ESPSettings.Chams.Enabled and CharacterObjects.Character
                           and not (Target == Client and not ESPSettings.LocalPlayer) then
                            local _HL = Objects["Highlight"]
                            if _HL then
                                _HL.Adornee = CharacterObjects.Character
                                _HL.Enabled = true
                                _HL.DepthMode = ESPSettings.Chams.DepthMode
                                _HL.FillColor = ESPSettings.Chams.Fill[1]
                                _HL.FillTransparency = ESPSettings.Chams.Fill[2]
                                _HL.OutlineColor = ESPSettings.Chams.Outline[1]
                                _HL.OutlineTransparency = ESPSettings.Chams.Outline[2]
                            end
                        end
                        return
                    end
                end

LastTick = os_clock()
                Objects["TargetHolder"].Visible = false
                Objects["Highlight"].Enabled = false

                if not ESPSettings.Enabled then return end

                if (not ESPSettings.LocalPlayer) and Target == Client then return end
                if ESPSettings.DeadCheck and CharacterObjects.Humanoid then
                    local _hum = CharacterObjects.Humanoid;
                    local _dead = false;
                    if _hum.Health <= 0 then _dead = true end;
                    if not _dead then
                        local _ok, _state = pcall(function() return _hum:GetState() end);
                        if _ok and _state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then _dead = true end;
                    end;
                    if _dead then return end;
                end;
                if not CharacterObjects.Character then return end
                if IsPlayer then
                    if not CharacterObjects.HumanoidRootPart then
                        if CharacterObjects.Character then
                            CharacterObjects.HumanoidRootPart = FindFirstChild(CharacterObjects.Character, "HumanoidRootPart")
                        end

                        return
                    end

                    if not CharacterObjects.Humanoid then
                        if CharacterObjects.Character then
                            CharacterObjects.Humanoid = FindFirstChildWhichIsA(CharacterObjects.Character, "Humanoid")
                        end

                        return
                    end
                else
                    if not CharacterObjects.HumanoidRootPart then
                        local _char = CharacterObjects.Character;
                        if _char then
                            local wrapper = _char:FindFirstChild("EnemyHumanoid");
                            if wrapper then
                                CharacterObjects.HumanoidRootPart = wrapper:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");
                                if not CharacterObjects.Humanoid then
                                    if wrapper:IsA("Humanoid") then
                                        CharacterObjects.Humanoid = wrapper;
                                    else
                                        CharacterObjects.Humanoid = wrapper:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid");
                                    end;
                                end;
                            end;
                        end;
                        if not CharacterObjects.HumanoidRootPart then
                            if IsA(Target, "BasePart") then
                                CharacterObjects.HumanoidRootPart = Target
                            elseif CharacterObjects.Character and CharacterObjects.Character.PrimaryPart then
                                CharacterObjects.HumanoidRootPart = CharacterObjects.Character.PrimaryPart
                            end
                        end

                        return
                    end
                    if not CharacterObjects.Humanoid and CharacterObjects.Character then
                        local wrapper = CharacterObjects.Character:FindFirstChild("EnemyHumanoid");
                        if wrapper then
                            if wrapper:IsA("Humanoid") then
                                CharacterObjects.Humanoid = wrapper;
                            else
                                CharacterObjects.Humanoid = wrapper:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid");
                            end;
                        end;
                    end
                end

                local Distance = (Camera.CFrame.Position - CharacterObjects.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
                if Distance > ESPSettings.MaxDistance then return end

                local _hrpPos = CharacterObjects.HumanoidRootPart.Position;
                local _scrPos, _scrOn = WorldToViewportPoint(Camera, _hrpPos);
                local _now2 = os_clock();
                local _needSizeRecompute = (
                        not TargetInfo._boxCacheW
                        or TargetInfo._boxCacheInvalid
                        or (_now2 - (TargetInfo._boxCacheT or 0)) >= 0.08
                );
                local _boxW, _boxH;
                if _needSizeRecompute then
                    local BodyParts = if ESPSettings.BoundingBox.IncludeAccessories then CharacterObjects.Descendants else CharacterObjects.Children
                    local _fw, _fh, _fx, _fy = Utility.CalculateBox(ESPSettings, Target, CharacterObjects.HumanoidRootPart, (if IsBasePart then {Target} else BodyParts))
                    _boxW = _fw;
                    _boxH = _fh;
                    TargetInfo._boxCacheW = _boxW;
                    TargetInfo._boxCacheH = _boxH;
                    TargetInfo._boxCacheT = _now2;
                    TargetInfo._boxCacheInvalid = false;
                    TargetInfo._boxCacheOffX = _fx - _scrPos.X;
                    TargetInfo._boxCacheOffY = _fy - _scrPos.Y;
                else
                    _boxW = TargetInfo._boxCacheW;
                    _boxH = TargetInfo._boxCacheH;
                end;
                local _offX = TargetInfo._boxCacheOffX or (-_boxW / 2);
                local _offY = TargetInfo._boxCacheOffY or (-_boxH * 0.4);
                local BoxWidth, BoxHeight = _boxW, _boxH;
                local BoxPositionX, BoxPositionY = _scrPos.X + _offX, _scrPos.Y + _offY;
                local OnScreen = _scrOn;

                if not OnScreen then
                    Objects["TargetHolder"].Visible = false
                    if ESPSettings.Chams.Enabled then
                        local _HL = Objects["Highlight"]
                        if _HL then
                            _HL.Enabled = true
                            _HL.DepthMode = ESPSettings.Chams.DepthMode
                            _HL.FillColor = ESPSettings.Chams.Fill[1]
                            _HL.FillTransparency = ESPSettings.Chams.Fill[2]
                            _HL.OutlineColor = ESPSettings.Chams.Outline[1]
                            _HL.OutlineTransparency = ESPSettings.Chams.Outline[2]
                        end
                    else
                        Objects["Highlight"].Enabled = false
                    end
                    return
                end

                local BoxSize, BoxPosition = UDim2_fromOffset(math_floor(BoxWidth), math_floor(BoxHeight)), UDim2_fromOffset(math_floor(BoxPositionX), math_floor(BoxPositionY))
                local TargetHolder = Objects["TargetHolder"]; do
                    TargetHolder.Visible = true
                    if TargetHolder.Position ~= BoxPosition then TargetHolder.Position = BoxPosition end
                    if TargetHolder.Size ~= BoxSize then TargetHolder.Size = BoxSize end
                end

local ImgFill = Objects["ImageFill"]; do
                    local Cfg = _G_ESPImageFill;
if Cfg and Cfg.Enabled and Cfg.Id ~= "" then
                        ImgFill.Visible = true;
                        ImgFill.ImageTransparency = 1 - (Cfg.Alpha or 0.8);
                        if Cfg.UseCustom then
                                ImgFill.Image = Cfg.Id;
                        else
                                ImgFill.Image = "rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=" .. Cfg.Id .. "&w=420&h=420";
                        end;
                    else
                        ImgFill.Visible = false;
                    end;
                end

                local BoxOutline, BoxInline, BoxFill, BoxGlow = Objects["BoxOutline"], Objects["BoxInline"], Objects["BoxFill"], Objects["BoxGlow"]; do
                    local BoxEnabled, BoxColor, BoxTransparency, BoxRotation, BoxType = ESPSettings.BoundingBox.Enabled, ESPSettings.BoundingBox.Color, ESPSettings.BoundingBox.Transparency, ESPSettings.BoundingBox.Rotation, ESPSettings.BoundingBox.Type

                    if BoxEnabled then
                        local BoxGlowGradient = Objects["BoxGlowGradient"]; do
                            local BoxGlowEnabled, BoxGlowColor, BoxGlowTransparency, BoxGlowRotation = ESPSettings.BoundingBox.Glow.Enabled, ESPSettings.BoundingBox.Glow.Color, ESPSettings.BoundingBox.Glow.Transparency, ESPSettings.BoundingBox.Glow.Rotation

                            if BoxGlowEnabled then
                                BoxGlow.ImageTransparency = 0
                                BoxGlowGradient.Rotation = BoxGlowRotation
                                BoxGlowGradient.Color = ColorSequence_new{ColorSequenceKeypoint_new(0, BoxGlowColor[1]), ColorSequenceKeypoint_new(1, BoxGlowColor[2])}
                                BoxGlowGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence_new{NumberSequenceKeypoint_new(0, BoxGlowTransparency[1]), NumberSequenceKeypoint_new(1, BoxGlowTransparency[2])}
                            else
                                BoxGlow.ImageTransparency = 1
                            end
                        end

                        if BoxType == "2D" then
                            BoxOutline.Parent.Visible = true
                            BoxOutline.Parent.Size = UDim2_fromOffset(BoxWidth, BoxHeight)
                            BoxInline.Parent.Visible = true
                            BoxInline.Parent.Size = UDim2_fromOffset(BoxWidth + 2, BoxHeight + 2)

                            local BoxInlineGradient, BoxOutlineGradient = Objects["BoxInlineGradient"], Objects["BoxOutlineGradient"]; do
                                BoxInlineGradient.Color = ColorSequence_new{ColorSequenceKeypoint_new(0, BoxColor[1]), ColorSequenceKeypoint_new(1, BoxColor[2])}
                                BoxInlineGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence_new{NumberSequenceKeypoint_new(0, BoxTransparency[1]), NumberSequenceKeypoint_new(1, BoxTransparency[2])}
                                BoxInlineGradient.Rotation = BoxRotation

                                BoxOutlineGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence_new{NumberSequenceKeypoint_new(0, BoxTransparency[1]), NumberSequenceKeypoint_new(1, BoxTransparency[2])}
                                BoxOutlineGradient.Rotation = BoxRotation
                            end

                            local BoxFillGradient = Objects["BoxFillGradient"]; do
                                local BoxFillColor, BoxFillTransparency, BoxFillRotation = ESPSettings.BoundingBox.Fill.Color, ESPSettings.BoundingBox.Fill.Transparency, ESPSettings.BoundingBox.Fill.Rotation

                                BoxFill.Visible = ESPSettings.BoundingBox.Fill.Enabled
                                BoxFill.Size = UDim2_fromOffset(BoxWidth, BoxHeight)
                                BoxFillGradient.Rotation = BoxFillRotation
                                BoxFillGradient.Color = ColorSequence_new{ColorSequenceKeypoint_new(0, BoxFillColor[1]), ColorSequenceKeypoint_new(1, BoxFillColor[2])}
                                BoxFillGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence_new{NumberSequenceKeypoint_new(0, BoxFillTransparency[1]), NumberSequenceKeypoint_new(1, BoxFillTransparency[2])}
                            end
                        else
                            local CornerHolder = Objects["CornerHolder"]; do
                                CornerHolder.Visible = true
                                CornerHolder.Size = UDim2_fromOffset(BoxWidth + 2, BoxHeight + 2)
                            end

                            -- Box fill: render in Corner mode too, not just 2D.
                            -- (Previously this branch only drew the 8 corner lines and
                            --  skipped the fill entirely, so toggling fill had no
                            --  visible effect when BoxType=Corner.)
                            local BoxFillGradient = Objects["BoxFillGradient"]; do
                                local BoxFillColor, BoxFillTransparency, BoxFillRotation = ESPSettings.BoundingBox.Fill.Color, ESPSettings.BoundingBox.Fill.Transparency, ESPSettings.BoundingBox.Fill.Rotation
                                BoxFill.Visible = ESPSettings.BoundingBox.Fill.Enabled
                                BoxFill.Size = UDim2_fromOffset(BoxWidth, BoxHeight)
                                BoxFillGradient.Rotation = BoxFillRotation
                                BoxFillGradient.Color = ColorSequence_new{ColorSequenceKeypoint_new(0, BoxFillColor[1]), ColorSequenceKeypoint_new(1, BoxFillColor[2])}
                                BoxFillGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence_new{NumberSequenceKeypoint_new(0, BoxFillTransparency[1]), NumberSequenceKeypoint_new(1, BoxFillTransparency[2])}
                            end

                            for i = 1, 8 do
                                local Line = Objects["Line_" .. i]
                                local Stroke = Line.UIStroke
                                local LayoutPosition = Layout[i]
                                local Position, Size, AnchorPoint, Rotation = LayoutPosition[1], LayoutPosition[2], LayoutPosition[3], LayoutPosition[4]

                                Stroke.Transparency = BoxTransparency[1]

                                Line.Position = Position
                                Line.Rotation = Rotation
                                Line.BackgroundColor3 = BoxColor[1]
                                Line.BackgroundTransparency = BoxTransparency[1]
                                Line.Size = Size
                                Line.AnchorPoint = AnchorPoint
                                Line.Visible = true
                            end
                        end
                    else
                        BoxGlow.ImageTransparency = 1
                        BoxOutline.Parent.Visible = false
                        BoxInline.Parent.Visible = false
                        BoxFill.Visible = false

                        for i = 1, 8 do
                            local Line = Objects["Line_" .. i]

                            Line.Visible = false
                        end
                    end
                end

                for BarName, BarInfo in ESPSettings.Bars do
                    local Bar, BarOutline, BarGradient = Objects[BarName], Objects[BarName .. "Outline"], Objects[BarName .. "Gradient"]; do
                        local BarEnabled, BarColor, BarTransparency = BarInfo.Enabled, BarInfo.Color, BarInfo.Transparency
                        local NewParent = Objects[`{BarInfo.Position}BarHolder`]

                        if BarEnabled then
                            local BarValue = BarInfo.Type(Target, CharacterObjects)
                            local _pos = BarInfo.Position;
                            local _isHoriz = (_pos == "Top" or _pos == "Bottom");

                            if BarValue == nil or BarValue == 0 then
                                -- Hide THIS bar's elements only, not the shared holder.
                                -- Otherwise enabling ArmorBar would hide AmmoBar too (and vice versa)
                                -- since both share the BottomBarHolder.
                                -- Note: UIGradient has NO Visible property — only Color/Offset/Rotation/Transparency.
                                -- To "hide" the gradient, we set Transparency to 1 (fully transparent).
                                if Bar then Bar.Visible = false end
                                if BarOutline then BarOutline.Visible = false end
                                if BarGradient then BarGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence_new(1) end
                            else
                                if Bar then Bar.Visible = true end
                                if BarOutline then BarOutline.Visible = true end
                                NewParent.Visible = true

                                Bar.AnchorPoint = _isHoriz and Vector2_new(0, 0) or Vector2_new(0, 1)
                                Bar.Position    = _isHoriz and UDim2_new(0, 0, 0, 0) or UDim2_new(0, 0, 1, 0)
                                Bar.Size        = _isHoriz and UDim2_new(BarValue, 0, 0, 1) or UDim2_new(0, 1, BarValue, 0)

                                BarOutline.Parent = NewParent
                                BarOutline.Size   = _isHoriz and UDim2_new(1, 0, 0, 1) or UDim2_new(0, 1, 1, 0)

                                BarGradient.Rotation = _isHoriz and -180 or 90
                                BarGradient.Offset    = _isHoriz and Vector2_new(1 - BarValue, 0) or Vector2_new(0, BarValue - 1)
                                BarGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence_new(0)
                                BarGradient.Color = ColorSequence_new{ColorSequenceKeypoint_new(0, BarColor[1]), ColorSequenceKeypoint_new(0, BarColor[2]), ColorSequenceKeypoint_new(1, BarColor[3])}
                            end;
                        else
                            -- Bar disabled: hide THIS bar's elements only.
                            if Bar then Bar.Visible = false end
                            if BarOutline then BarOutline.Visible = false end
                            if BarGradient then BarGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence_new(1) end
                        end
                    end

                    local BarText = Objects[BarName .. "Text"]; do
                        local BarTextEnabled, BarTextColor, BarTextTransparency = BarInfo.Text.Enabled, BarInfo.Text.Color, BarInfo.Text.Transparency
                        local _pos2 = BarInfo.Position;
                        local _isHoriz2 = (_pos2 == "Top" or _pos2 == "Bottom");
                        local _anchor  = _isHoriz2 and Vector2.new(0, 0.5) or Vector2.new(0, 0);
                        local _align   = _isHoriz2 and Enum.TextXAlignment.Right or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center;

                        if BarTextEnabled then
                            local TextValue, TextVisible = BarInfo.Text.Type(Target, CharacterObjects)

                            if TextValue == nil then
                                BarText.Visible = false;
                            else
                                BarText.Text = `{tostring(math_floor(TextValue))}{BarInfo.Text.Ending}`
                                BarText.TextColor3 = BarTextColor
                                BarText.TextTransparency = BarTextTransparency
                                BarText.UIStroke.Transparency = BarTextTransparency

                                if BarInfo.Text.FollowBar then
                                    BarText.Visible = TextVisible
                                    BarText.Parent = Bar
                                    BarText.ZIndex = 10
                                    BarText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
                                    BarText.TextXAlignment = _align
                                    BarText.AnchorPoint = _anchor
                                else
                                    BarText.Visible = true
                                    BarText.Parent = Objects[`{BarInfo.Text.Position}TextHolder`]
                                    BarText.TextXAlignment = TextAlignments[BarInfo.Text.Position]
                                    BarText.AnchorPoint = Vector2_new(0, 0)
                                end
                            end
                        else
                            BarText.Visible = false
                        end
                    end
                end

                local Chams = Objects["Highlight"]; do
                    local ChamsEnabled, ChamsFill, ChamsOutline = ESPSettings.Chams.Enabled, ESPSettings.Chams.Fill, ESPSettings.Chams.Outline

                    if ChamsEnabled then
                        Chams.Enabled = true
                        Chams.DepthMode = ESPSettings.Chams.DepthMode
                        Chams.FillColor = ChamsFill[1]
                        Chams.FillTransparency = ChamsFill[2]
                        Chams.OutlineColor = ChamsOutline[1]
                        Chams.OutlineTransparency = ChamsOutline[2]
                    else
                        Chams.Enabled = false
                    end
                end

                local NameText = Objects["TargetName"]; do
                    local NameEnabled, NameColor, NameTransparency = ESPSettings.Name.Enabled, ESPSettings.Name.Color, ESPSettings.Name.Transparency

                    if NameEnabled then
                        local TargetName = if ESPSettings.Name.UseDisplay then (IsPlayer and Target.DisplayName or Target.Name) else Target.Name

                        NameText.Visible = true
                        NameText.Text = Utility.GetFontType(ESPSettings, TargetName)
                        NameText.TextXAlignment = TextAlignments[ESPSettings.Name.Position]
                        NameText.Parent = Objects[`{ESPSettings.Name.Position}TextHolder`]
                        NameText.TextColor3 = NameColor
                        NameText.TextTransparency = NameTransparency
                        NameText.UIStroke.Transparency = NameTransparency
                    else
                        NameText.Visible = false
                    end
                end

                local DistanceText = Objects["Distance"]; do
                    local DistanceEnabled, DistanceColor, DistanceTransparency = ESPSettings.Distance.Enabled, ESPSettings.Distance.Color, ESPSettings.Distance.Transparency

                    if DistanceEnabled then
                        DistanceText.Visible = true
                        DistanceText.TextXAlignment = TextAlignments[ESPSettings.Distance.Position]
                        DistanceText.Parent = Objects[`{ESPSettings.Distance.Position}TextHolder`]
                        DistanceText.TextColor3 = DistanceColor
                        DistanceText.TextTransparency = DistanceTransparency
                        DistanceText.UIStroke.Transparency = DistanceTransparency
                        DistanceText.Text = Utility.GetFontType(ESPSettings, `{tostring(math_floor(Distance))}{ESPSettings.Distance.Ending}`)
                    else
                        DistanceText.Visible = false
                    end
                end

                local WeaponText = Objects["Weapon"]; do
                    local WeaponEnabled, WeaponColor, WeaponTransparency = ESPSettings.Weapon.Enabled, ESPSettings.Weapon.Color, ESPSettings.Weapon.Transparency

                    if WeaponEnabled then
                        local Tool
                        if IsPlayer then
                            Tool = PlayerHelper.GetTool(Target) or TargetInfo.CurrentTool;
                        else
                            Tool = "Assault Rifle";
                        end;

                        if Tool and Tool ~= "" then
                            WeaponText.Visible = true
                            WeaponText.TextXAlignment = TextAlignments[ESPSettings.Weapon.Position]
                            WeaponText.Parent = Objects[`{ESPSettings.Weapon.Position}TextHolder`]
                            WeaponText.TextColor3 = WeaponColor
                            WeaponText.TextTransparency = WeaponTransparency
                            WeaponText.UIStroke.Transparency = WeaponTransparency
                            WeaponText.Text = Utility.GetFontType(ESPSettings, Tool)
                        else
                            WeaponText.Visible = false
                        end;
                    else
                        WeaponText.Visible = false
                    end
                end

                local FlagsText = Objects["Flags"]; do
                    local FlagsEnabled, FlagsColor, FlagsTransparency = ESPSettings.Flags.Enabled, ESPSettings.Flags.Color, ESPSettings.Flags.Transparency

                    if FlagsEnabled then
                        local Flags = ESPSettings.Flags.Type(Target, CharacterObjects)

                        FlagsText.Visible = true
                        FlagsText.TextXAlignment = TextAlignments[ESPSettings.Flags.Position]
                        FlagsText.Parent = Objects[`{ESPSettings.Flags.Position}TextHolder`]
                        FlagsText.TextColor3 = FlagsColor
                        FlagsText.TextTransparency = FlagsTransparency
                        FlagsText.UIStroke.Transparency = FlagsTransparency
                        FlagsText.Text = Flags and table_concat(Flags, "\n") or ""
                    else
                        FlagsText.Visible = false
                    end
                end
            end)

            function TargetInfo.Remove()
                for _, Object in Objects do
                    Object:Destroy()
                end

                if TargetInfo.CharacterConnection then
                    TargetInfo.CharacterConnection:Disconnect()
                    TargetInfo.CharacterConnection = nil
                end

                if ToolConnection.Added then
                    ToolConnection.Added:Disconnect()
                    ToolConnection.Added = nil
                end

                if ToolConnection.Removed then
                    ToolConnection.Removed:Disconnect()
                    ToolConnection.Removed = nil
                end

                ESP.Targets[Type][Target] = nil
            end
        end

        TargetInfo.Init()
    end

    function ESP.RemoveTarget(NewTarget, Type)
        for Type, _ in ESP.Settings do
            for Target, TargetInfo in ESP.Targets[Type] do
                if Target == NewTarget then
                    TargetInfo.Remove()
                end
            end
        end
    end

    function ESP.Init()
        for Type, _ in ESPSettings do
            if not ESP.Targets[Type] then ESP.Targets[Type] = {} end
        end
    end

    function ESP.Unload()
        for _, Connection in ConnectionsTable do
            Connection:Disconnect()
        end

        for _, Object in ObjectsTable do
            Object:Destroy()
        end

        getgenv().Fonts = nil
    end
end

local ImageFillBillboards = {};
local ImageFillImgCache = {};

local _cacheFillId    = "\0";
local _cacheAlpha     = nil;
local _cacheEnabled   = nil;
local _cacheNumId     = nil;
local _cacheFillImg   = nil;

local function SyncImageFillCache()
        local _fillId   = ESPState.ImageFillId or "";
        local _alpha    = ESPState.ImageFillAlpha or 0.8;
        local _enabled  = ESPState.ImageFill;
        if  _fillId  == _cacheFillId
        and _alpha   == _cacheAlpha
        and _enabled == _cacheEnabled then
                return;
        end;
        _cacheFillId   = _fillId;
        _cacheAlpha    = _alpha;
        _cacheEnabled  = _enabled;
        _cacheNumId    = string.match(_fillId, "(%d+)");
        _cacheFillImg  = _cacheNumId and ("rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=" .. _cacheNumId .. "&w=420&h=420") or nil;
end;

local _imgBillboardAcc = 0;
local function UpdateImageBillboards(dt)
        _imgBillboardAcc = (_imgBillboardAcc or 0) + (dt or 0);
        if _imgBillboardAcc < 0.05 then return end;
        _imgBillboardAcc = 0;
        SyncImageFillCache();
        local _enabled  = _cacheEnabled;
        local _numId    = _cacheNumId;
        if not _enabled or not _numId then
                return;
        end;
        local _alpha    = _cacheAlpha;
        local _fillImg  = _cacheFillImg;
        for Player, Billboard in pairs(ImageFillBillboards) do
                local Char = Player and Player.Parent and Player.Character;
                local Hrp  = Char and Char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");
                Billboard.Adornee = Hrp or nil;
                local Img = ImageFillImgCache[Billboard] or Billboard:FindFirstChildOfClass("ImageLabel");
                if Img then
                        Billboard.Enabled     = Hrp ~= nil;
                        Img.ImageTransparency = 1 - _alpha;
                        if _fillImg then
                                Img.Image = _fillImg;
                        end;
                end;
        end;
end;

local function AddImageBillboard(Player)
        if ImageFillBillboards[Player] then return end;
        local Billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui");
        Billboard.Name            = "ESPImageFill";
        Billboard.AlwaysOnTop     = true;
        Billboard.ResetOnSpawn    = false;
        Billboard.ZIndexBehavior  = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Global;
        Billboard.Size            = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 90);
        Billboard.StudsOffset     = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0);
        Billboard.Enabled         = false;
        local Img = Instance.new("ImageLabel", Billboard);
        Img.Size                   = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0);
        Img.BackgroundTransparency = 1;
        Img.ScaleType              = Enum.ScaleType.Crop;
        Img.BorderSizePixel        = 0;
        ImageFillImgCache[Billboard] = Img;
        Billboard.Parent = gethui();
        ImageFillBillboards[Player] = Billboard;
end;

local function RemoveImageBillboard(Player)
        local Billboard = ImageFillBillboards[Player];
        if Billboard then
                ImageFillImgCache[Billboard] = nil;
                Billboard:Destroy();
                ImageFillBillboards[Player] = nil;
        end;
end;

do
    ESP.Init()

for _, Player in Players:GetPlayers() do
        ESP.AddTarget(Player, "Players")
        AddImageBillboard(Player);
    end

;

    Utility.AddConnection(Players.PlayerAdded, function(Player)
        Player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
        AddImageBillboard(Player);
        ESP.AddTarget(Player, "Players")
    end)

    Utility.AddConnection(Players.PlayerRemoving, function(Player)
        RemoveImageBillboard(Player);
        ESP.RemoveTarget(Player, "Players")
    end)
end

local _espAllDisabledCleaned = false;
local _espHeartbeatAcc = 0;
_RegisterHeartbeat(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
        _espHeartbeatAcc = _espHeartbeatAcc + dt;
        if _espHeartbeatAcc < (1/45) then return end;
        _espHeartbeatAcc = 0;
        -- perf: when every ESP type is disabled, skip all per-target Update work.
        -- One final pass runs on the enabled->disabled transition so holders/highlights
        -- get hidden exactly as they were before.
        local _settingsPre = ESP.Settings;
        local _anyEnabled = false;
        for _, S in _settingsPre do
                if S and S.Enabled then _anyEnabled = true; break; end;
        end;
        if not _anyEnabled then
                if not _espAllDisabledCleaned then
                        _espAllDisabledCleaned = true;
                        local _targetsPre = ESP.Targets;
                        for Type, _ in _settingsPre do
                                local _typeTargets = _targetsPre[Type];
                                if _typeTargets then
                                        for _, Target in _typeTargets do
                                                Target.Update()
                                        end
                                end
                        end
                end;
                UpdateImageBillboards(dt);
                return;
        end;
        _espAllDisabledCleaned = false;
UpdateImageBillboards(dt);
        local _settings = ESP.Settings;
        local _targets  = ESP.Targets;
        for Type, _ in _settings do
            local _typeTargets = _targets[Type];
            if _typeTargets then
                for _, Target in _typeTargets do
                    Target.Update()
                end
            end
        end
    end))
end

do
    local GradClock2 = 0;
    local TrackedGrads = {};

    local function GetOrMakeGrad(Lbl, C1, C2)
        if not Lbl or not Lbl.Parent then return end;
        local G = Lbl:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient");
        if not G then
            G = Instance.new("UIGradient");
            G.Rotation = 0;
            G.Parent   = Lbl;
        end;
        local Mid = C1:Lerp(C2, 0.5);
        G.Color = ColorSequence.new({
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,    C1);
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.35, Mid);
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5,  C2);
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.65, Mid);
            ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,    C1);
        });
        return G;
    end;

    local _GradAcc2 = 0;

     _RegisterHeartbeat(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(Dt)
        _GradAcc2 = _GradAcc2 + Dt;
        if _GradAcc2 < 0.05 then return end;
        local RealDt = _GradAcc2;
        _GradAcc2 = 0;
        GradClock2 = (GradClock2 + RealDt * 0.45) % 2;
        local Off  = (GradClock2 % 2) - 1;
        local OffV = Vector2.new(Off, 0);

        local S = _G_ESPState;
        if not S then return end;

        for _, Targets in pairs(ESP.Targets or {}) do
            for _, TargetInfo in pairs(Targets) do
                local Objs = TargetInfo.Objects;
                if not Objs then continue end;

                local NL = Objs["TargetName"];
                if NL and NL.Parent then
                    local G = GetOrMakeGrad(NL, S.NameColor or Color3.new(1,1,1), S.NameColor2 or Color3.new(1,1,1));
                    if G then G.Offset = OffV end;
                end;

                local DL = Objs["Distance"];
                if DL and DL.Parent then
                    local G = GetOrMakeGrad(DL, S.StudsColor or Color3.new(1,1,1), S.StudsColor2 or Color3.new(1,1,1));
                    if G then G.Offset = OffV end;
                end;

                local WL = Objs["Weapon"];
                if WL and WL.Parent then
                    local G = GetOrMakeGrad(WL, S.ToolColor or Color3.new(1,1,1), S.ToolColor2 or Color3.new(1,1,1));
                    if G then G.Offset = OffV end;
                end;

                local FL = Objs["Flags"];
                if FL and FL.Parent then
                    local G = GetOrMakeGrad(FL, S.FlagsColor or Color3.new(1,1,1), S.FlagsColor2 or Color3.new(1,1,1));
                    if G then G.Offset = OffV end;
                end;

                local BO = Objs["HealthBarOutline"];
                local CharObjs = TargetInfo.CharacterObjects;
                if S.HealthText and BO and BO.Parent then
                    local OurLabel = BO:FindFirstChild("_HpTextLabel");
                    if not OurLabel then
                        OurLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel");
                        OurLabel.Name                   = "_HpTextLabel";
                        OurLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1;
                        OurLabel.BorderSizePixel        = 0;
                        OurLabel.AnchorPoint            = Vector2.new(1, 0);
                        OurLabel.Position               = UDim2.new(0, -2, 0, 0);
OurLabel.Size                   = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 12);
                        OurLabel.AutomaticSize          = Enum.AutomaticSize.None;
                        OurLabel.TextSize               = 12;
                        OurLabel.TextScaled             = false;
                        OurLabel.TextXAlignment         = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right;
                        OurLabel.TextColor3             = Color3.new(1, 1, 1);
                        OurLabel.ZIndex                 = 10;
local PF = (getgenv().Fonts and getgenv().Fonts.Loaded and getgenv().Fonts.Loaded["Tahoma"]) or nil;
                        if PF then OurLabel.FontFace = PF end;
                        OurLabel.TextSize = 12;
                        Instance.new("UIStroke", OurLabel).Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0);
                        OurLabel.Parent = BO;
                    end;
                    OurLabel.Visible = true;
                    local Hum = CharObjs and CharObjs.Humanoid;
                    OurLabel.Text = Hum and tostring(math.floor(Hum.Health)) or "";
                    OurLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1);
                    local G = GetOrMakeGrad(OurLabel, S.HealthTextColor or Color3.new(1,1,1), S.HealthTextColor2 or Color3.new(1,1,1));
                    if G then G.Offset = OffV end;
                elseif BO then
                    local OurLabel = BO:FindFirstChild("_HpTextLabel");
                    if OurLabel then OurLabel.Visible = false end;
                end;
            end;
        end;
    end));

function Library:RegisterBackground(Inst, Prop)
        Prop = Prop or "BackgroundColor3";
        table.insert(self.ThemeParts.Background, { Inst = Inst, Prop = Prop });
        Inst[Prop] = self:_BgVariant(self.Theme.Background, 0);
end;

function Library:RegisterSubBackground(Inst, Prop)
        Prop = Prop or "BackgroundColor3";
        table.insert(self.ThemeParts.SubBackground, { Inst = Inst, Prop = Prop });
        Inst[Prop] = self.Theme.SubBackground;
end;

function Library:RegisterOutline(Inst, Prop)
        Prop = Prop or "BackgroundColor3";
        table.insert(self.ThemeParts.Outline, { Inst = Inst, Prop = Prop });
        Inst[Prop] = self.Theme.Outline;
end;

function Library:_BgVariant(C, Amount)
        return C:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255), Amount);
end;

function Library:SetTheme(T)
                if self._SettingTheme then return end;
                self._SettingTheme = true;
                if typeof(T) ~= "table" then self._SettingTheme = false; return end;
                if T.Background    then self.Theme.Background    = T.Background    end;
                if T.SubBackground then self.Theme.SubBackground = T.SubBackground end;
                if T.Outline       then self.Theme.Outline       = T.Outline       end;
                if T.Accent        then self:SetAccent(T.Accent)                   end;

                local Setters = self._ColorpickerSetters or {};
                if T.Accent        and Setters["Accent"]        then Setters["Accent"](T.Accent)               end;
                if T.Background    and Setters["ThemeBg"]       then Setters["ThemeBg"](T.Background)          end;
                if T.SubBackground and Setters["ThemeSubBg"]    then Setters["ThemeSubBg"](T.SubBackground)    end;
                if T.Outline       and Setters["ThemeOutline"]  then Setters["ThemeOutline"](T.Outline)        end;

                local Info = TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out);

                for _, P in self.ThemeParts.Background do
                        if P.Inst and P.Inst.Parent then
                                Library:Tween(P.Inst, Info, { [P.Prop] = self.Theme.Background }):Play();
                        end;
                end;
                for _, P in self.ThemeParts.SubBackground do
                        if P.Inst and P.Inst.Parent then
                                Library:Tween(P.Inst, Info, { [P.Prop] = self.Theme.SubBackground }):Play();
                        end;
                end;
                for _, P in self.ThemeParts.Outline do
                        if P.Inst and P.Inst.Parent then
                                Library:Tween(P.Inst, Info, { [P.Prop] = self.Theme.Outline }):Play();
                        end;
                end;

self:_RefreshGradients();
                self._SettingTheme = false;
        end;

Library._BgGradients = {};
function Library:RegisterBgGradient(Gradient, TopMult, BotMult)
        table.insert(self._BgGradients, { G = Gradient, T = TopMult or 0.06, B = BotMult or 0 });
        self:_ApplyBgGradient(Gradient, TopMult or 0.06, BotMult or 0);
end;

function Library:_ApplyBgGradient(G, T, B)
        if not G or not G.Parent then return end;
        local Base = self.Theme.Background;
        G.Color = NewColorSequence({
                NewColorSequenceKeypoint(0, Base:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255), T));
                NewColorSequenceKeypoint(1, Base:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0), B));
        });
end;

Library._SubGradients = {};
function Library:RegisterSubGradient(Gradient, TopMult, BotMult)
        table.insert(self._SubGradients, { G = Gradient, T = TopMult or 0.06, B = BotMult or 0 });
        self:_ApplySubGradient(Gradient, TopMult or 0.06, BotMult or 0);
end;

function Library:_ApplySubGradient(G, T, B)
        if not G or not G.Parent then return end;
        local Base = self.Theme.SubBackground;
        G.Color = NewColorSequence({
                NewColorSequenceKeypoint(0, Base:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255), T));
                NewColorSequenceKeypoint(1, Base:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0), B));
        });
end;

Library._CrossGradients = {};
function Library:RegisterCrossGradient(Gradient, TopMult, BotMult)
        table.insert(self._CrossGradients, { G = Gradient, T = TopMult or 0.12, B = BotMult or 0.05 });
        self:_ApplyCrossGradient(Gradient, TopMult or 0.12, BotMult or 0.05);
end;

function Library:_ApplyCrossGradient(G, T, B)
        if not G or not G.Parent then return end;
        local TopBase = self.Theme.Background;
        local BotBase = self.Theme.SubBackground;
        G.Color = NewColorSequence({
                NewColorSequenceKeypoint(0, TopBase:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255), T));
                NewColorSequenceKeypoint(1, BotBase:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255), B));
        });
end;

function Library:_RefreshGradients()
        for _, E in self._BgGradients do
                self:_ApplyBgGradient(E.G, E.T, E.B);
        end;
        for _, E in self._SubGradients do
                self:_ApplySubGradient(E.G, E.T, E.B);
        end;
        for _, E in self._CrossGradients do
                self:_ApplyCrossGradient(E.G, E.T, E.B);
        end;
end;

Library._OuterGlows = {};
Library._OuterGlowDefault = 0.42;
Library.GlowOpacity = Library._OuterGlowDefault;

function Library:RegisterOuterGlow(GlowInst, DefaultTransparency)
        table.insert(self._OuterGlows, { Inst = GlowInst, Default = DefaultTransparency or 0.7 });
        self:_ApplyOuterGlow(GlowInst, DefaultTransparency or 0.7);
end;

function Library:_ApplyOuterGlow(GlowInst, DefaultTransparency)
        if not GlowInst then return end;
        local DefaultOpacity = 1 - (DefaultTransparency or 0.7);
        local Scaled = DefaultOpacity * self.GlowOpacity;
        GlowInst.ImageTransparency = 1 - Scaled;
end;

function Library:SetGlowOpacity(Opacity)
        self.GlowOpacity = tonumber(Opacity) or self._OuterGlowDefault;
        for _, E in self._OuterGlows do
                if E.Inst and E.Inst.Parent then
                        self:_ApplyOuterGlow(E.Inst, E.Default);
                end;
        end;
end;

Library.Keybinds         = {};

function Library.EncodeKey(K)
    if K == nil or typeof(K) ~= "EnumItem" then return nil end;
    local E = K.EnumType;
    if E == nil then return nil end;
    local ETName = tostring(E):gsub("^Enum%.", "");
    return ETName .. ":" .. K.Name;
end;
function Library.DecodeKey(S)
    if S == nil or typeof(S) ~= "string" then return nil end;
    local ETName, ItemName = string.match(S, "^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*):([A-Za-z0-9_]+)$");
    if not ETName or not ItemName then return nil end;
    local ok, ET = pcall(function() return Enum[ETName] end);
    if not ok or ET == nil then return nil end;
    local Item;
    local ok2 = pcall(function() Item = ET[ItemName] end);
    if not ok2 or Item == nil or typeof(Item) ~= "EnumItem" then return nil end;
    return Item;
end;

function Library:RegisterKeybind(Entry)
        if typeof(Entry) ~= "table" then return end;
        table.insert(self.Keybinds, Entry);
        self:NotifyKeybind();
        return Entry;
end;

function Library:NotifyKeybind()
        for _, Fn in self.KeybindListeners do Fn() end;
end;

function Library:OnKeybindChange(Fn)
        if typeof(Fn) ~= "function" then return end;
        table.insert(self.KeybindListeners, Fn);
        Fn();
end;

function Library:OnAccent(Fn)
        if typeof(Fn) ~= "function" then return end;
        table.insert(self.AccentCallbacks, Fn);
        Fn(self.Accent);
end;

function Library:SetAccent(C)
        if typeof(C) ~= "Color3" then return end;
        self.Accent = C;
        for _, P in self.AccentParts do
                if P.Inst and P.Inst.Parent then
                        P.Inst[P.Prop] = C;
                end;
        end;
        for _, G in self.AccentGradients do
                if G and G.Parent then
G.Color = NewColorSequence({
                NewColorSequenceKeypoint(0, C);
                NewColorSequenceKeypoint(1, C);
        });
                end;
        end;
        for _, Fn in self.AccentCallbacks do
                Fn(C);
        end;
end;

local LogStart = tick();

function Library:Log(Text)
        local Stamp = string.format("%.3f", tick() - LogStart);
        appendfile(self.LogFile, "[" .. Stamp .. "s] " .. tostring(Text) .. "\n");
end;

-- ============================================================
-- Robust config loader: applies Decoded flags in dependency order
-- and re-syncs toggle callbacks at the end so inter-toggle deps
-- (e.g. SilentAimEnabled vs SilentShowFOV) resolve correctly.
-- ============================================================
function Library:LoadConfigFlags(Decoded, Source)
        Source = Source or "load";
        local result = {
                applied = 0;
                skipped = 0;
                failed  = 0;
                errors  = {};
        };

        -- Pre-log what we're about to do
        pcall(function()
                local count = 0;
                for _ in pairs(Decoded) do count = count + 1 end;
                appendfile(self.LogFile, "[" .. Source .. "] starting: " .. count .. " fields\n");
        end);

        -- Wave 0: Pre-write ALL flags to Library.Flags so any callback
        -- that reads Library.Flags sees the fully-loaded state.
        for K, V in pairs(Decoded) do
                self.Flags[K] = V;
        end;

        -- Categorize flags: toggles (boolean) vs non-toggles (everything else)
        -- Skip _Key and _Mode suffixes (those are keybind metadata, not toggles)
        local nonToggleKeys = {};
        local toggleKeys = {};
        for K, V in pairs(Decoded) do
                if self._FlagSetters[K] then
                        local isToggle = (type(V) == "boolean")
                                and string.sub(K, -4) ~= "_Key"
                                and string.sub(K, -5) ~= "_Mode";
                        if isToggle then
                                table.insert(toggleKeys, K);
                        else
                                table.insert(nonToggleKeys, K);
                        end;
                else
                        result.skipped = result.skipped + 1;
                        pcall(function()
                                appendfile(self.LogFile, "  [" .. Source .. " SKIP] " .. tostring(K) .. " (no _FlagSetters entry)\n");
                        end);
                end;
        end;

        -- Helper to run one setter safely.
        -- COMPAT (CRITICAL): Under Luraph obfuscation, pcall(f, args...) and
        -- xpcall(fn, handler) BOTH create a restricted coroutine that "lacks
        -- capability Plugin" — meaning the setter CANNOT access Roblox Instance
        -- objects (Frame.Visible, Part.Color, etc.). This caused ALL 102 toggle
        -- setters to fail with "The current thread cannot access 'Instance'".
        --
        -- FIX: Call setters DIRECTLY on the calling thread (no pcall wrapper).
        -- The calling thread (from task.spawn in the Load button callback) has
        -- full capabilities, so Instance access works. If a setter throws, it
        -- propagates up — but LoadConfigFlags is wrapped in pcall at the call
        -- site (line ~10117), so the script won't crash. The remaining setters
        -- won't run if one throws, but since all setters were previously failing
        -- anyway, this is a strict improvement.
        local function runSetter(K, V, Force)
                local Setter = self._FlagSetters[K];
                if not Setter then return end;
                Setter(V, Force);
                result.applied = result.applied + 1;
        end;

        -- Wave A: Non-toggle setters first (sliders, dropdowns, colorpickers,
        -- curve editors, keybind _Key/_Mode, multi-lists, textboxes)
        for _, K in ipairs(nonToggleKeys) do
                runSetter(K, Decoded[K], true);
        end;

        -- Wave B: Toggle setters LAST so their callbacks see fully-loaded
        -- non-toggle state. Force=true bypasses the early-return guard.
        for _, K in ipairs(toggleKeys) do
                runSetter(K, Decoded[K], true);
        end;

        -- Wave C: Re-fire every toggle callback once more.
        -- This handles inter-toggle dependencies (e.g. SilentAimEnabled's
        -- callback reads silentAim.showFov, which is set by SilentShowFOV's
        -- callback -- without Wave C, whichever toggle loads first sees
        -- stale state from the other).
        for _, K in ipairs(toggleKeys) do
                local V = self.Flags[K];
                if V ~= nil then
                        local Setter = self._FlagSetters[K];
                        if Setter then
                                Setter(V, true);
                        end;
                end;
        end;

        -- Final summary to log
        pcall(function()
                appendfile(self.LogFile, string.format("[%s] done: %d applied, %d skipped, %d failed\n",
                        Source, result.applied, result.skipped, result.failed));
        end);

        return result;
end;

function Library:Connection(Signal, Callback)
        local Conn;
        if Signal == RunService.Heartbeat then
                Conn = _RegisterHeartbeat(Callback);
        else
                Conn = Signal:Connect(Callback);
        end;
        table.insert(self.Connections, Conn);
        return Conn;
end;

function Library:CreateInstance(ClassName, Properties)
        local Inst = Instance.new(ClassName);
        for K, V in (Properties or {}) do
                Inst[K] = V;
        end;
        if ClassName == "Frame" or ClassName == "TextButton" or ClassName == "TextBox" or ClassName == "ScrollingFrame" then
                local Bg = Properties and Properties.BackgroundColor3;
                if Bg then
                        local Hex = Bg:ToHex();
if Hex == "393939" then
                                table.insert(self.ThemeParts.Outline, { Inst = Inst, Prop = "BackgroundColor3" });
                        elseif Hex == "131313" or Hex == "121212" or Hex == "1b1b1b" or Hex == "1B1B1B" or Hex == "141414" or Hex == "111111" or Hex == "1a1a1a" or Hex == "1A1A1A" or Hex == "161616" or Hex == "151515" or Hex == "181818" or Hex == "1f1f1f" or Hex == "1F1F1F" then
                                table.insert(self.ThemeParts.SubBackground, { Inst = Inst, Prop = "BackgroundColor3" });
                        end;
                end;
elseif ClassName == "UIGradient" then
                local C = Properties and Properties.Color;
                if C and typeof(C) == "ColorSequence" then
                        local K = C.Keypoints;
                        if #K >= 2 then
                                local TopHex = K[1].Value:ToHex();
                                local BotHex = K[#K].Value:ToHex();
                                local isSub = (TopHex == "1b1b1b" or TopHex == "1B1B1B" or TopHex == "121212" or TopHex == "131313" or BotHex == "121212" or BotHex == "131313");
                                local isBg  = (TopHex == "1f1f1f" or TopHex == "1F1F1F" or TopHex == "242424" or TopHex == "1a1a1a" or TopHex == "1A1A1A");
                                if isSub then
                                        table.insert(self._SubGradients, { G = Inst, T = 0.06, B = 0 });
                                        self:_ApplySubGradient(Inst, 0.06, 0);
                                elseif isBg then
                                        table.insert(self._BgGradients, { G = Inst, T = 0.08, B = 0 });
                                        self:_ApplyBgGradient(Inst, 0.08, 0);
                                end;
                        end;
                end;
        end;
        return Inst;
end;

function Library:Tween(Inst, Info, Props)
        local Speed = self.AnimationSpeed or 1;
        if Speed < 0.05 then Speed = 0.05 end;
        local Scale = 1 / Speed;
        local Style = self.EasingStyle      or Info.EasingStyle;
        local Dir   = self.EasingDirection  or Info.EasingDirection;
        if Scale == 1 and Style == Info.EasingStyle and Dir == Info.EasingDirection then
                return TweenService:Create(Inst, Info, Props);
        end;
        local Scaled = TweenInfo.new(Info.Time * Scale, Style, Dir, Info.RepeatCount, Info.Reverses, Info.DelayTime);
        return TweenService:Create(Inst, Scaled, Props);
end;

Library._ActiveDraggers = {};
Library._DragBlockers   = {};

function Library:RegisterDragBlocker(Inst)
        if typeof(Inst) ~= "Instance" then return end;
        table.insert(self._DragBlockers, Inst);
end;

function Library:_IsDragBlocked(Pos)
        for _, Inst in self._DragBlockers do
                if Inst and Inst.Parent then
                        local Ap, Sz = Inst.AbsolutePosition, Inst.AbsoluteSize;
                        if Pos.X >= Ap.X and Pos.X <= Ap.X + Sz.X and Pos.Y >= Ap.Y and Pos.Y <= Ap.Y + Sz.Y then
                                return true;
                        end;
                end;
        end;
        return false;
end;

function Library:_RegisterDragger(Handler)
        if typeof(Handler) ~= "function" then return end;
        local Self = self;
        if not Self._DispatcherConn then
                Self._DispatcherConn = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(Input)
                        local Ut = Input.UserInputType;
                        if Ut ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and Ut ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                                return;
                        end;
                        local List = Self._ActiveDraggers;
                        for I = 1, #List do
                                List[I](Input);
                        end;
                end);
                table.insert(Self.Connections, Self._DispatcherConn);
        end;
        table.insert(Self._ActiveDraggers, Handler);
        return Handler;
end;

function Library:_UnregisterDragger(Handler)
        if not Handler then return end;
        local List = self._ActiveDraggers;
        if not List then return end;
        for I = #List, 1, -1 do
                if List[I] == Handler then
                        List[I] = List[#List];
                        List[#List] = nil;
                        return;
                end;
        end;
end;

function Library:IsEffectivelyVisible(Inst)
        local Cur = Inst;
        while Cur do
                if Cur:IsA("ScreenGui") then return Cur.Enabled end;
                if Cur:IsA("GuiObject") and not Cur.Visible then return false end;
                Cur = Cur.Parent;
        end;
        return false;
end;

function Library:Debounce(Delay, Fn)
        local Token = 0;
        return function(...)
                Token = Token + 1;
                local Mine = Token;
                local Args = { ... };
                task.delay(Delay, function()
                        if Mine == Token then Fn(table.unpack(Args)) end;
                end);
        end;
end;

function Library:RegisterFont(Name, Url, Weight, Style)
        local Folder = self.Directory .. "/Fonts";
        local TtfPath = Folder .. "/" .. Name .. ".ttf";
        local DescPath = Folder .. "/" .. Name .. ".font";

        if not isfile(TtfPath) then
                writefile(TtfPath, game:HttpGet(Url));
        end;
        if isfile(DescPath) then
                delfile(DescPath);
        end;

        writefile(DescPath, HttpService:JSONEncode({
                name = Name;
                faces = {
                        { name = "Regular", weight = Weight or 400, style = Style or "normal", assetId = getcustomasset(TtfPath) };
                };
        }));

        self:Log("Registered font " .. Name);
        return getcustomasset(DescPath);
end;

function Library:Draggable(TargetFrame, DragHandle)
        local Handle = DragHandle or TargetFrame;
        local Dragging = false;
        local DragStart, StartPosition;

        -- Ghost outline shown while dragging instead of moving the real UI
        local Ghost = Instance.new("Frame");
        Ghost.BackgroundTransparency = 1;
        Ghost.BorderSizePixel = 0;
        Ghost.ZIndex = 9999;
        Ghost.Visible = false;
        Ghost.AnchorPoint = TargetFrame.AnchorPoint;
        Ghost.Parent = TargetFrame.Parent;

        local GhostStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke");
        GhostStroke.Thickness = 2;
        GhostStroke.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Miter;
        GhostStroke.Color = Library.Accent or Color3.fromHex("6B7280");
        GhostStroke.Parent = Ghost;

        table.insert(Library.AccentCallbacks, function(C)
                GhostStroke.Color = C;
        end);

        local function UpdateGhost(Input)
                if not DragStart or not StartPosition then return end;
                local Delta = Input.Position - DragStart;
                -- Reuse the exact same position formula as the real snap —
                -- this guarantees the ghost is always pixel-perfect with where the UI will land
                Ghost.Position = UDim2.new(
                        StartPosition.X.Scale,
                        StartPosition.X.Offset + Delta.X,
                        StartPosition.Y.Scale,
                        StartPosition.Y.Offset + Delta.Y
                );
        end;

        self:Connection(Handle.InputBegan, function(Input)
                if
                        Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                        and Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
                then
                        return;
                end;
                if not (Library.CurrentlyOpen and Library.CurrentlyOpen.Visible) then return end;
                if Library:_IsDragBlocked(Input.Position) then return end;
                Dragging      = true;
                DragStart     = Input.Position;
                StartPosition = TargetFrame.Position;
                Ghost.Size     = TargetFrame.Size;
                -- Ghost starts at exactly StartPosition (delta is 0 at click moment)
                Ghost.Position = StartPosition;
                Ghost.Visible  = true;
        end);

        self:Connection(Handle.InputEnded, function(Input)
                if
                        Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                        or Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
                then
                        if Dragging and Ghost.Visible then
                                local Delta = Input.Position - DragStart;
                                TargetFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
                                        StartPosition.X.Scale,
                                        StartPosition.X.Offset + Delta.X,
                                        StartPosition.Y.Scale,
                                        StartPosition.Y.Offset + Delta.Y
                                );
                        end;
                        Dragging      = false;
                        Ghost.Visible = false;
                end;
        end);

        self:Connection(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(Input)
                if
                        Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                        and Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
                then
                        return;
                end;
                if Dragging then UpdateGhost(Input) end;
        end);
end;

function Library:Resizable(TargetFrame, Minimum, Maximum)
        Minimum = Minimum or Vector2.new(TargetFrame.Size.X.Offset, TargetFrame.Size.Y.Offset);

        local Grip = self:CreateInstance("TextButton", {
                Parent                 = TargetFrame;
                AnchorPoint            = Vector2.new(1, 1);
                BorderColor3           = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0);
                Size                   = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10);
                Position               = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0);
                Name                   = "\0";
                BorderSizePixel        = 0;
                BackgroundTransparency = 1;
                AutoButtonColor        = false;
                Visible                = true;
                Text                   = "";
                ZIndex                 = 999;
        });

        local Resizing   = false;
        local StartMouse = Vector2.new();
        local StartSize  = Vector2.new();

        self:Connection(Grip.InputBegan, function(Input)
                if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        Resizing   = true;
                        StartMouse = Vector2.new(Input.Position.X, Input.Position.Y);
                        StartSize  = Vector2.new(TargetFrame.AbsoluteSize.X, TargetFrame.AbsoluteSize.Y);
                end;
        end);

        self:Connection(Grip.InputEnded, function(Input)
                if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        Resizing = false;
                end;
        end);

        self:Connection(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(Input)
                if not Resizing then return end;
                if Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and Input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end;

                local Delta  = Vector2.new(Input.Position.X - StartMouse.X, Input.Position.Y - StartMouse.Y);
                local NewW   = StartSize.X + Delta.X;
                local NewH   = StartSize.Y + Delta.Y;
                local MaxVec = Maximum or Vector2.new(math.huge, math.huge);

                NewW = math.clamp(NewW, Minimum.X, MaxVec.X);
                NewH = math.clamp(NewH, Minimum.Y, MaxVec.Y);

                TargetFrame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(NewW), math.floor(NewH));
        end);

        return Grip;
end;
