                                        Library:Connection(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
                                                if not Dragging then return end;
                                                if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                                                   and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                                                        return;
                                                end;
                                                local absPos = BoxInside.AbsolutePosition;
                                                local absSize = BoxInside.AbsoluteSize;
                                                if absSize.X <= 0 or absSize.Y <= 0 then return end;
                                                local relX = (input.Position.X - absPos.X) / absSize.X;
                                                local relY = (input.Position.Y - absPos.Y) / absSize.Y;
                                                relY = 1 - math.clamp(relY, 0, 1);
                                                if canDragX then
                                                        relX = math.clamp(relX, 0.05, 0.95);
                                                        pt.Position = UDim2.new(relX, 0, 1 - relY, 0);
                                                        P2X = relX;
                                                        P2Y = relY;
                                                else
                                                        pt.Position = UDim2.new(defaultX, 0, 1 - relY, 0);
                                                        if name == "P1" then P1Y = relY;
                                                        elseif name == "P3" then P3Y = relY; end;
                                                end;
                                                Library.Flags[Flag] = { P1Y = P1Y, P2X = P2X, P2Y = P2Y, P3Y = P3Y };
                                                RenderCurve();
                                                Callback({ P1Y = P1Y, P2X = P2X, P2Y = P2Y, P3Y = P3Y, GetAlpha = GetAlpha });
                                        end);

                                        return pt;
                                end;

                                local Point1 = MakePoint("P1", 0.0, P1Y, false);
                                local Point2 = MakePoint("P2", P2X, P2Y, true);
                                local Point3 = MakePoint("P3", 1.0, P3Y, false);

                                Callback({ P1Y = P1Y, P2X = P2X, P2Y = P2Y, P3Y = P3Y, GetAlpha = GetAlpha });

                                if Opts.Tooltip then Library:Tooltip(Box, Opts.Tooltip) end;
                                if Opts.Dependency and typeof(Opts.Dependency.OnChange) == "function" then
                                        Opts.Dependency:OnChange(function(S) Container.Visible = S end);
                                end;

                                local Obj = { Container = Container, Box = Box };
                                function Obj:GetAlpha(t) return GetAlpha(t) end;
                                function Obj:Get() return { P1Y = P1Y, P2X = P2X, P2Y = P2Y, P3Y = P3Y }; end;
                                function Obj:Set(pts)
                                        if type(pts) ~= "table" then return end;
                                        P1Y = tonumber(pts.P1Y) or P1Y;
                                        P2X = tonumber(pts.P2X) or P2X;
                                        P2Y = tonumber(pts.P2Y) or P2Y;
                                        P3Y = tonumber(pts.P3Y) or P3Y;
                                        Point1.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1 - P1Y, 0);
                                        Point2.Position = UDim2.new(P2X, 0, 1 - P2Y, 0);
                                        Point3.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1 - P3Y, 0);
                                        Library.Flags[Flag] = { P1Y = P1Y, P2X = P2X, P2Y = P2Y, P3Y = P3Y };
                                        RenderCurve();
                                        Callback({ P1Y = P1Y, P2X = P2X, P2Y = P2Y, P3Y = P3Y, GetAlpha = GetAlpha });
                                end;
                                if Flag and Flag ~= "" then
                                        Library._FlagSetters[Flag] = function(V)
                                                if type(V) == "table" then Obj:Set(V) end;
                                        end;
                                end;
                                return Obj;
                        end;

                        if not Library._BodyMethods then
                                Library._BodyMethods = {
                                        Toggle       = SecRef.Toggle;
                                        Slider       = SecRef.Slider;
                                        Button       = SecRef.Button;
                                        Colorpicker  = SecRef.Colorpicker;
                                        Viewport     = SecRef.Viewport;
                                        Dropdown     = SecRef.Dropdown;
                                        Textbox      = SecRef.Textbox;
                                        Keybind      = SecRef.Keybind;
                                        List         = SecRef.List;
                                        CurveEditor  = SecRef.CurveEditor;
                                };
                        end;

                        function Library:MakeBody(Body)
                                local ref = {
                                        Body   = Body;
                                        Frame  = nil;
                                        Title  = nil;
                                        Name   = "DialogBody";
                                        Page   = { Parent = { AbsoluteSize = Vector2.new(0, 0) } };
                                };
                                return setmetatable(ref, { __index = Library._BodyMethods });
                        end;

                        return SecRef;
                end;

                local WinRef = self;
                Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                        for _, T in WinRef._Tabs do
                                if T ~= TabRef and T.Active then T:SetActive(false) end;
                        end;
                        TabRef:SetActive(true);
                end);

                table.insert(self._Tabs, TabRef);

                local N = #self._Tabs;
                for I, T in self._Tabs do
                        T.Button.Size = UDim2.new(1 / N, 0, 1, 0);
                        T.IsLeft  = (I == 1);
                        T.IsRight = (I == N);
                        T:SetActive(T.Active);
                end;

                if N == 1 then
                        TabRef:SetActive(true);
                end;

                local SepInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out);
                local function FadePiece(P, T)
                        Library:Tween(P, SepInfo, { BackgroundTransparency = T }):Play();
                end;
                local function RefreshSeparators()
                        for I, T in self._Tabs do
                                local Prev = self._Tabs[I - 1];
                                local Next = self._Tabs[I + 1];
                                if T.Active then
                                        FadePiece(T.Separator,   1);
                                        FadePiece(T.TopBlack,    1);
                                        FadePiece(T.TopGray,     1);
                                        FadePiece(T.BottomBlack, 1);
                                        FadePiece(T.BottomGray,  1);
                                        FadePiece(T.LeftBlack,   1);
                                        FadePiece(T.LeftGray,    1);
                                        FadePiece(T.RightBlack,  1);
                                        FadePiece(T.RightGray,   1);
                                        FadePiece(T.TopGradient, 0);
                                else
                                        FadePiece(T.TopGradient, 1);
                                        local LeftShown  = (Prev ~= nil) and Prev.Active;
                                        local RightShown = (Next ~= nil) and Next.Active;
                                        FadePiece(T.TopBlack,    0);
                                        FadePiece(T.TopGray,     0);
                                        FadePiece(T.BottomBlack, 0);
                                        FadePiece(T.BottomGray,  0);
                                        FadePiece(T.LeftBlack,   LeftShown  and 0 or 1);
                                        FadePiece(T.LeftGray,    LeftShown  and 0 or 1);
                                        FadePiece(T.RightBlack,  RightShown and 0 or 1);
                                        FadePiece(T.RightGray,   RightShown and 0 or 1);
                                        FadePiece(T.Separator,   (Next ~= nil and not Next.Active) and 0 or 1);
                                        local Li = LeftShown and 1 or 0;
                                        local Ri = RightShown and 1 or 0;
                                        T.TopGray.Position    = UDim2.new(0, Li, 0, 1);
                                        T.TopGray.Size        = UDim2.new(1, -Li - Ri, 0, 1);
                                        T.BottomGray.Position = UDim2.new(0, Li, 1, -1);
                                        T.BottomGray.Size     = UDim2.new(1, -Li - Ri, 0, 1);
                                end;
                        end;
                end;
                RefreshSeparators();

                local OrigSetActive = TabRef.SetActive;
                function TabRef:SetActive(State)
                        OrigSetActive(self, State);
                        RefreshSeparators();
                end;

                function TabRef:ApplySettings()
                        -- Use per-game folder so configs don't leak between Criminality and Rivals.
                        local _gf = _G.FrequencyGameFolder or "default"
                        local ConfigDir    = Library.Directory .. "/configs/" .. _gf;
                        local ThemeDir     = Library.Directory .. "/themes";
                        local AutoLoadFile = Library.Directory .. "/configs/" .. _gf .. "/autoload.txt";
                        -- Make sure the per-game folder exists before reading/writing.
                        pcall(function()
                            if not isfolder(ConfigDir) then makefolder(ConfigDir) end
                        end)

                        local function ListConfigs()
                                local Out = {};
                                local _AutoLoadName = "";
                                if isfile and isfile(AutoLoadFile) then
                                        local _ok, _data = pcall(readfile, AutoLoadFile);
                                        if _ok and _data then
                                                _AutoLoadName = (_data:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""));
                                        end;
                                end;
                                if isfolder and isfolder(ConfigDir) then
                                        for _, F in listfiles(ConfigDir) do
                                                if string.find(F, "%.json$") then
                                                        local Nm = string.gsub(F, ".*[/\\]", ""):gsub("%.json$", "");
                                                        if not string.match(string.lower(Nm), "^autoload") then
                                                                if _AutoLoadName ~= "" and Nm == _AutoLoadName then
                                                                        Nm = Nm .. " (autoload)";
                                                                end;
                                                                table.insert(Out, Nm);
                                                        end;
                                                end;
                                        end;
                                end;
                                if #Out == 0 then table.insert(Out, "default") end;
                                return Out;
                        end;

                        local function ListThemes()
                                local Out = {};
                                if isfolder and isfolder(ThemeDir) then
                                        for _, F in listfiles(ThemeDir) do
                                                if string.find(F, "%.json$") then
                                                        local Nm = string.gsub(F, ".*[/\\]", ""):gsub("%.json$", "");
                                                        table.insert(Out, Nm);
                                                end;
                                        end;
                                end;
                                if #Out == 0 then table.insert(Out, "default") end;
                                return Out;
                        end;

                        local SecCfg = self:Section({ Name = "Configuration", Side = "Left" });
                        local ConfigList = SecCfg:List({
                                Name    = "Configs";
                                Options = ListConfigs();
                                Default = "default";
                                Height  = 90;
                        });
                        SecCfg:Textbox({ Name = "Config Name", Flag = "ConfigName", Placeholder = "name..." });
SecCfg:Button({
                                Name = "Save";
                                Callback = function()
                                        task.spawn(function()
                                        local Nm = Library.Flags.ConfigName;
                                        if not Nm or Nm == "" then Library:Notify("Enter a config name first", 3); return end;
                                        local Save = {};
                                        local KeyCount = 0;
                                        for K, V in Library.Flags do
                                                if typeof(V) == "Color3" then
                                                        Save[K] = { _t = "Color3", v = V:ToHex() };
                                                elseif typeof(V) == "table" then
                                                        local Copy = {};
                                                        for Tk, Tv in V do Copy[Tk] = Tv end;
                                                        Save[K] = Copy;
                                                elseif typeof(V) == "boolean" then
                                                        Save[K] = V;
                                                elseif typeof(V) == "number" then
                                                        Save[K] = V;
                                                elseif typeof(V) == "string" then
                                                        Save[K] = V;
                                                        if string.sub(K, -4) == "_Key" or string.sub(K, -5) == "_Mode" then
                                                                KeyCount = KeyCount + 1;
                                                        end;
                                                end;
                                        end;
                                        writefile(ConfigDir .. "/" .. Nm .. ".json", HttpService:JSONEncode(Save));
                                        ConfigList:SetOptions(ListConfigs());
                                        pcall(function()
                                                local _cnt = 0;
                                                for _ in pairs(Save) do _cnt = _cnt + 1 end;
                                                appendfile(Library.LogFile, "[save] " .. Nm .. ": " .. _cnt .. " fields written\n");
                                        end);
                                        Library:Notify("Saved config: " .. Nm .. " (" .. KeyCount .. " keybind fields)", 4);
                                        end);
                                end;
                        }):Button({
                                Name = "Load";
                                Callback = function()
                                        local _win = Library.CurrentlyOpen;
                                        local _wasEnabled = nil;
                                        if _win and _win.Gui then
                                                _wasEnabled = _win.Gui.Enabled;
                                                _win.Gui.Enabled = false;
                                        end;
                                        local Nm = ConfigList:Get();
                                        Nm = (Nm or ""):gsub(" %(autoload%)$", "");
                                        local Path = ConfigDir .. "/" .. Nm .. ".json";
                                        if not (isfile and isfile(Path)) then Library:Notify("Config not found", 3);
                                                if _win and _win.Gui then _win.Gui.Enabled = (_wasEnabled ~= false) end;
                                                return end;
                                        local Ok, Data = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, readfile(Path));
                                        if not Ok then Library:Notify("Failed to decode config", 3);
                                                if _win and _win.Gui then _win.Gui.Enabled = (_wasEnabled ~= false) end;
                                                return end;

                                        local Decoded = {};
                                        for K, V in Data do
                                                if typeof(V) == "table" and V._t == "Color3" then
                                                        Decoded[K] = Color3.fromHex(V.v);
                                                elseif typeof(V) == "table" then
                                                        Decoded[K] = V;
                                                else
                                                        Decoded[K] = V;
                                                end;
                                        end;

                                        local _res;
                                        local _done = false;
                                        Library._Autoloading = true;
                                        task.spawn(function()
                                                _res = Library:LoadConfigFlags(Decoded, "load");
                                                _done = true;
                                        end);
                                        -- Yield until the spawned thread finishes
                                        while not _done do task.wait(0) end;
                                        Library._Autoloading = false;
                                        if not _res then
                                                pcall(function() Library:Notify("Load error", 5); end);
                                                if _win and _win.Gui then _win.Gui.Enabled = (_wasEnabled ~= false) end;
                                                return;
                                        end;
                                        -- Schedule visual refresh on Heartbeat thread.
                                        -- Render() was skipped during autoload (Luraph restricts Instance
                                        -- access on the button-click thread). Heartbeat callbacks have
                                        -- full Plugin capability, so we re-fire all toggle setters here
                                        -- to update the GUI to match the loaded state.
                                        local _refreshed = false;
                                        _RegisterHeartbeat(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
                                                if _refreshed then return end;
                                                _refreshed = true;
                                                Library._ConfigRefreshing = true;
                                                for _flag, _setter in pairs(Library._FlagSetters) do
                                                        local _val = Library.Flags[_flag];
                                                        if type(_val) == "boolean" and type(_setter) == "function" then
                                                                _setter(_val, true);
                                                        end;
                                                end;
                                                Library._ConfigRefreshing = false;
                                        end));
                                        -- Backwards-compat counters for the notification
                                        local AppliedKey = 0;
                                        local AppliedMode = 0;
                                        for K, V in pairs(Decoded) do
                                                if string.sub(K, -4) == "_Key" and V ~= nil then AppliedKey = AppliedKey + 1; end;
                                                if string.sub(K, -5) == "_Mode" then AppliedMode = AppliedMode + 1; end;
                                        end;
                                        local _applied = _res.applied;
                                        local _skipped = _res.skipped;
                                        local _errors = _res.errors;

                                        -- Notify user of any load failures (errors already logged inside LoadConfigFlags)
                                        if #_errors > 0 then
                                                pcall(function() Library:Notify("Load issues: " .. #_errors .. " fields - see log", 5); end);
                                        end;

                                        pcall(function() Library:Notify("Loaded: " .. Nm .. " (" .. _applied .. " fields, " .. AppliedKey .. " keys, " .. #_errors .. " errors)", 4); end);

                                        if _win and _win.Gui then
                                                -- Re-enable GUI directly on the main thread.
                                                -- (Previously used task.spawn+pcall, but under Luraph those
                                                -- create restricted threads that can't access Instance.)
                                                RunService.RenderStepped:Wait();
                                                _win.Gui.Enabled = (_wasEnabled ~= false);
                                        end;
                                end;
                        });
                                                SecCfg:Button({
                                Name = "Overwrite";Confirm = true;
                                Callback = function()
                                        task.spawn(function()
                                        local Nm = ConfigList:Get();
                                        Nm = (Nm or ""):gsub(" %(autoload%)$", "");
                                        if not Nm or Nm == "" then Library:Notify("Select a config to overwrite", 3); return end;
                                        local Path = ConfigDir .. "/" .. Nm .. ".json";
                                        if not (isfile and isfile(Path)) then Library:Notify("Config not found: " .. Nm, 3); return end;

                                        local KeyCount = 0;
                                        for K, V in Library.Flags do
                                                if typeof(V) == "Color3" then
                                                        Save[K] = { _t = "Color3", v = V:ToHex() };
                                                elseif typeof(V) == "table" then
                                                        local Copy = {};
                                                        for Tk, Tv in V do Copy[Tk] = Tv end;
                                                        Save[K] = Copy;
                                                elseif typeof(V) == "boolean" then
                                                        Save[K] = V;
                                                elseif typeof(V) == "number" then
                                                        Save[K] = V;
                                                elseif typeof(V) == "string" then
                                                        Save[K] = V;
                                                        if string.sub(K, -4) == "_Key" or string.sub(K, -5) == "_Mode" then
                                                                KeyCount = KeyCount + 1;
                                                        end;
                                                end;
                                        end;
                                        writefile(Path, HttpService:JSONEncode(Save));
                                        ConfigList:SetOptions(ListConfigs());
                                        Library:Notify("Overwritten: " .. Nm .. " (" .. KeyCount .. " keybind fields)", 4);
                        end);
                                end;
                        });

                                        end;
                                end);

local FadeProps = {
                Frame          = { "BackgroundTransparency" };
                TextLabel      = { "BackgroundTransparency", "TextTransparency", "TextStrokeTransparency" };
                TextButton     = { "BackgroundTransparency", "TextTransparency", "TextStrokeTransparency" };

local function CaptureOriginals()
                local Map = {};
                for _, Inst in Outer:GetDescendants() do
                        if Inst:IsA("CanvasGroup") and string.find(Inst.Name, "^Page_") then
                                continue;
                        end;

                        local Props = FadeProps[Inst.ClassName];
                        if Props then
                                local PMap = {};
                                for _, P in Props do
                                        local Ok, V = pcall(function() return Inst[P] end);
                                        if Ok then PMap[P] = V end;
                                end;
                                Map[Inst] = PMap;
                        end;
                end;
                local OuterProps = FadeProps[Outer.ClassName];
                if OuterProps then
                        local PMap = {};
                        for _, P in OuterProps do
                                local Ok, V = pcall(function() return Outer[P] end);
                                if Ok then PMap[P] = V end;
                        end;
                        Map[Outer] = PMap;
                end;
                return Map;
        end;
function Window:SetVisible(State)
                if self.Visible == State then return end;
                self.Visible = State and true or false;
                self._FadeToken = self._FadeToken + 1;
                Gui.Enabled = State and true or false;
        end;

        function Window:Toggle()
                self:SetVisible(not self.Visible);
        end;

        function Window:Destroy()
                Gui:Destroy();
                if Library.CurrentlyOpen == self then Library.CurrentlyOpen = nil end;
        end;

        return Window;
end;

function Library:KeybindList(Opts)
        Opts = typeof(Opts) == "table" and Opts or {};
        local Title = tostring(Opts.Title or Opts.Text or "Keybinds");
        local Width = tonumber(Opts.Width) or 170;

        local Gui = self:CreateInstance("ScreenGui", {
                Name           = "KeybindList";
                Parent         = (gethui and gethui()) or CoreGui;
                IgnoreGuiInset = true;
                ResetOnSpawn   = false;
                ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling;
        });

        local Frame = self:CreateInstance("Frame", {
                Name             = "Keybinds";
                Parent           = Gui;
                AnchorPoint      = Vector2.new(1, 0);
                Position         = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 210);
                Size             = UDim2.new(0, Width, 0, 0);
                AutomaticSize    = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y;
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHex("FFFFFF");
                BorderSizePixel  = 0;
        });
        self:CreateInstance("UIGradient", {
                Parent   = Frame;
                Rotation = 90;
                Color    = NewColorSequence({
                        NewColorSequenceKeypoint(0, Color3.fromHex("1F1F1F"));
                        NewColorSequenceKeypoint(1, Color3.fromHex("141414"));
                });
        });

        local function Edge(Anchor, Pos, Sz, Color)
                self:CreateInstance("Frame", {
                        Parent           = Frame;
                        AnchorPoint      = Anchor;
                        Position         = Pos;
                        Size             = Sz;
                        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHex(Color);
                        BorderSizePixel  = 0;
                        ZIndex           = 5;
                });
        end;
        Edge(Vector2.new(0, 0), UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),  UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),  "000000");
        local TopLine = self:CreateInstance("Frame", {
                Name             = "TopLine";
                Parent           = Frame;
                Position         = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 1);
                Size             = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1);
                BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHex("FFFFFF");
                BorderSizePixel  = 0;
                ZIndex           = 5;
        });
        local TopGrad = self:CreateInstance("UIGradient", { Parent = TopLine; Rotation = 0 });
        Library:RegisterAccentGradient(TopGrad);
        Edge(Vector2.new(0, 1), UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),  UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),  "000000");
        Edge(Vector2.new(0, 1), UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, -1), UDim2.new(1, -2, 0, 1), "393939");
        Edge(Vector2.new(0, 0), UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),  UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, 0),  "000000");
        Edge(Vector2.new(0, 0), UDim2.new(0, 1, 0, 2),  UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, -3), "393939");
        Edge(Vector2.new(1, 0), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),  UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, 0),  "000000");
        Edge(Vector2.new(1, 0), UDim2.new(1, -1, 0, 2), UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, -3), "393939");

        local Inner = self:CreateInstance("Frame", {
                Name                   = "Inner";
                Parent                 = Frame;
                Position               = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 6);
                Size                   = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 0);
                AutomaticSize          = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y;
                BackgroundTransparency = 1;
                BorderSizePixel        = 0;
        });
        self:CreateInstance("UIListLayout", {
                Parent        = Inner;
                FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical;
                SortOrder     = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder;
                Padding       = UDim.new(0, 2);
        });
        self:CreateInstance("UIPadding", {
                Parent        = Inner;
                PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 8);
        });

        local TitleLbl = self:CreateInstance("TextLabel", {
                Name                   = "Title";
                Parent                 = Inner;
                Position               = UDim2.new(0, -1, 0, 0);
                Size                   = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 13);
                BackgroundTransparency = 1;
                Text                   = Title;
                TextColor3             = Color3.fromHex("FFFFFF");
                TextSize               = 12;
                TextXAlignment         = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left;
                TextYAlignment         = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center;
                LayoutOrder            = 1;
        });
        if ProggyCleanFont then TitleLbl.FontFace = ProggyCleanFont end;

        local Entries = self:CreateInstance("Frame", {
                Name                   = "Entries";
                Parent                 = Inner;
                Size                   = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0);
                AutomaticSize          = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y;
                BackgroundTransparency = 1;
                BorderSizePixel        = 0;
                LayoutOrder            = 2;
        });
        self:CreateInstance("UIListLayout", {
                Parent        = Entries;
                FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical;
                SortOrder     = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder;
                Padding       = UDim.new(0, 2);
        });
        self:CreateInstance("UIPadding", {
                Parent     = Entries;
                PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 5);
        });




        self:Draggable(Frame);

        local function KeyName(Key)
                if Key == nil then return "None" end;
                if typeof(Key) == "EnumItem" then return Library.KeyNames[Key] or Key.Name end;
                return tostring(Key);
        end;

        local Rows = {};
        local function Rebuild()
                for _, R in Rows do R:Destroy() end;
                table.clear(Rows);
                for I, Entry in Library.Keybinds do
                        local Key = Entry.GetKey and Entry.GetKey() or nil;
                        if Key ~= nil then
                                local Row = Library:CreateInstance("Frame", {
                                        Name                   = "Entry";
                                        Parent                 = Entries;
                                        BackgroundTransparency = 1;
                                        BorderSizePixel        = 0;
                                        Size                   = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 13);
                                        LayoutOrder            = I;
                                });
                                local DisplayName = tostring(Entry.Name or "?");
                                local NameLbl = Library:CreateInstance("TextLabel", {
                                        Parent                 = Row;
                                        AnchorPoint            = Vector2.new(0, 0.5);
                                        Position               = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0);
                                        Size                   = UDim2.new(1, -50, 1, 0);
                                        BackgroundTransparency = 1;
                                        Text                   = DisplayName;
                                        RichText               = true;
                                        TextColor3             = Color3.fromHex("BFC4CC");
                                        TextSize               = 12;
                                        TextXAlignment         = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left;
                                        TextYAlignment         = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center;
                                });
                                local KeyLbl = Library:CreateInstance("TextLabel", {
                                        Parent                 = Row;
                                        AnchorPoint            = Vector2.new(1, 0.5);
                                        Position               = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0);
                                        Size                   = UDim2.new(0, 46, 1, 0);
                                        BackgroundTransparency = 1;
                                        Text                   = KeyName(Key);
                                        TextColor3             = Library.Accent;
                                        TextSize               = 12;
                                        TextXAlignment         = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right;
                                        TextYAlignment         = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center;
                                });
                                Library:RegisterAccent(KeyLbl, "TextColor3");
                                if ProggyCleanFont then
                                        NameLbl.FontFace = ProggyCleanFont;
                                        KeyLbl.FontFace  = ProggyCleanFont;
                                end;
                                table.insert(Rows, Row);
                        end;
                end;
        end;
        Library:OnKeybindChange(Rebuild);

        local Obj = { Gui = Gui, Frame = Frame, TitleLabel = TitleLbl };
        function Obj:Refresh() Rebuild() end;
        function Obj:SetTitle(NewTitle) TitleLbl.Text = string.upper(tostring(NewTitle)) end;
        function Obj:Destroy() Gui:Destroy() end;
        Library._KeybindList = Obj;
        return Obj;
end;

function Library:KeystrokeOverlay(Opts)
        Opts = typeof(Opts) == "table" and Opts or {};

        if self._KeystrokeOverlay and self._KeystrokeOverlay.Destroy then
                self._KeystrokeOverlay:Destroy();
                self._KeystrokeOverlay = nil;
        end;

        local KeyCodes = {
                W = Enum.KeyCode.W;
                A = Enum.KeyCode.A;
                S = Enum.KeyCode.S;
                D = Enum.KeyCode.D;
        };

        local Gui = self:CreateInstance("ScreenGui", {
                Name           = "KeystrokeOverlay";
                Parent         = (gethui and gethui()) or CoreGui;
                IgnoreGuiInset = true;
                ResetOnSpawn   = false;
                ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling;
                Enabled        = false;
        });

        local Frame = self:CreateInstance("Frame", {
                Name                   = "KeystrokeOverlay";
                Parent                 = Gui;
                AnchorPoint            = Vector2.new(0, 0);
                Position               = UDim2.fromOffset(200, 420);
                Size                   = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0);
                AutomaticSize          = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY;
                BackgroundTransparency = 1;
                BorderSizePixel        = 0;
        });
        self:CreateInstance("UIPadding", {
                Parent        = Frame;
                PaddingLeft   = UDim.new(0, 4);
                PaddingRight  = UDim.new(0, 4);
                PaddingTop    = UDim.new(0, 4);
                PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 4);
        });

        local Container = self:CreateInstance("Frame", {
                Name                   = "Container";
                Parent                 = Frame;
                Size                   = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0);
                AutomaticSize          = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY;
                BackgroundTransparency = 1;
                BorderSizePixel        = 0;
        });
        self:CreateInstance("UIListLayout", {
                Parent              = Container;
                FillDirection       = Enum.FillDirection.Vertical;
                SortOrder           = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder;
                Padding             = UDim.new(0, 2);
                HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center;
        });

        local KeySize = 36;
        local Keys    = {};

        local function MakeKey(Letter, ParentRow, LayoutOrder)
                local KeyBtn = self:CreateInstance("Frame", {
                        Name                   = "Key_" .. Letter;
                        Parent                 = ParentRow;
                        Size                   = UDim2.fromOffset(KeySize, KeySize);
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1;
                        BorderSizePixel        = 0;
                        LayoutOrder            = LayoutOrder;
                });
                self:AddSubtleGlow(KeyBtn);

                local Black = self:CreateInstance("Frame", {
                        Name             = "Black";
                        Parent           = KeyBtn;
                        Size             = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0);
                        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHex("000000");
                        BorderSizePixel  = 0;
                });
                self:CreateInstance("UIPadding", {
                        Parent        = Black;
                        PaddingLeft   = UDim.new(0, 1);
                        PaddingRight  = UDim.new(0, 1);
                        PaddingTop    = UDim.new(0, 1);
                        PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 1);
                });

                local Gray = self:CreateInstance("Frame", {
                        Name             = "Gray";
                        Parent           = Black;
                        Size             = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0);
                        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHex("393939");
                        BorderSizePixel  = 0;
                });
                self:CreateInstance("UIPadding", {
                        Parent        = Gray;
                        PaddingLeft   = UDim.new(0, 1);
                        PaddingRight  = UDim.new(0, 1);
                        PaddingTop    = UDim.new(0, 1);
                        PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 1);
                });

                local KeyInside = self:CreateInstance("Frame", {
                        Name             = "Inside";
                        Parent           = Gray;
                        Size             = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0);
                        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHex("131313");
                        BorderSizePixel  = 0;
                });

                local Fill = self:CreateInstance("Frame", {
                        Name                   = "Fill";
                        Parent                 = KeyInside;
                        AnchorPoint            = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5);
                        Position               = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0);
                        Size                   = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0);
                        BackgroundColor3       = Library.Accent;
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1;
                        BorderSizePixel        = 0;
                });
                self:RegisterAccent(Fill);

                local Lbl = self:CreateInstance("TextLabel", {
                        Name                   = "Label";
                        Parent                 = KeyInside;
                        AnchorPoint            = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5);
                        Position               = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0);
                        Size                   = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0);
                        BackgroundTransparency = 1;
                        BorderSizePixel        = 0;
                        Text                   = string.upper(Letter);
                        TextColor3             = Color3.fromHex("8C8F99");
                        TextSize               = 14;
                        TextXAlignment         = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center;
                        TextYAlignment         = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center;
                        ZIndex                 = 2;
                });
                if ProggyCleanFont then Lbl.FontFace = ProggyCleanFont end;

                return { Button = KeyBtn, Fill = Fill, Label = Lbl, Pressed = false };
        end

        local Row1 = self:CreateInstance("Frame", {
                Name                   = "Row1";
                Parent                 = Container;
                Size                   = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0);
                AutomaticSize          = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY;
                BackgroundTransparency = 1;
                BorderSizePixel        = 0;
                LayoutOrder            = 1;
        });
        self:CreateInstance("UIListLayout", {
                Parent              = Row1;
                FillDirection       = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal;
                SortOrder           = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder;
                HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center;
        });
        Keys.W = MakeKey("W", Row1, 1);

        local Row2 = self:CreateInstance("Frame", {
                Name                   = "Row2";
                Parent                 = Container;
                Size                   = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0);
                AutomaticSize          = Enum.AutomaticSize.XY;
                BackgroundTransparency = 1;
                BorderSizePixel        = 0;
                LayoutOrder            = 2;
        });
        self:CreateInstance("UIListLayout", {
                Parent        = Row2;
                FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal;
                SortOrder     = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder;
                Padding       = UDim.new(0, 2);
        });
        Keys.A = MakeKey("A", Row2, 1);
        Keys.S = MakeKey("S", Row2, 2);
        Keys.D = MakeKey("D", Row2, 3);

        self:Draggable(Frame);

        local TweenIn  = TweenInfo.new(0.10, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out);
        local TweenOut = TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out);

        local function SetKeyState(Letter, Pressed)
                local K = Keys[Letter];
                if not K or K.Pressed == Pressed then return end;
                K.Pressed = Pressed;
                local Info = Pressed and TweenIn or TweenOut;
                self:Tween(K.Fill, Info, {
                        Size                   = Pressed and UDim2.new(1, -2, 1, -2) or UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0);
                        BackgroundTransparency = Pressed and 0 or 1;
                }):Play();
                self:Tween(K.Label, Info, {
                        TextColor3 = Pressed and Color3.fromHex("FFFFFF") or Color3.fromHex("8C8F99");
                }):Play();
        end

        self:Connection(UserInputService.InputBegan, function(Input, GameProcessed)
                for Letter, Code in KeyCodes do
                        if Input.KeyCode == Code then
                                SetKeyState(Letter, true);
                        end;
                end;
        end);

        self:Connection(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(Input)
                for Letter, Code in KeyCodes do
                        if Input.KeyCode == Code then
                                SetKeyState(Letter, false);
                        end;
                end;
        end);

        local function ResetAll()
                for Letter, _ in KeyCodes do
                        SetKeyState(Letter, false);
                end;
        end;

        local Obj = { Gui = Gui, Frame = Frame, Keys = Keys };
        function Obj:SetVisible(State)
                State = State == true;
                Gui.Enabled = State;
                if not State then
                        ResetAll();
                end;
        end;
        function Obj:Destroy()
                Gui:Destroy();
        end;

        self._KeystrokeOverlay = Obj;
        return Obj;
end;

function Library:TargetHUD(Opts)
        Opts = typeof(Opts) == "table" and Opts or {};

        if self._TargetHUD and self._TargetHUD.Destroy then
                pcall(function() self._TargetHUD:Destroy() end);
                self._TargetHUD = nil;
        end;

        local Gui = self:CreateInstance("ScreenGui", {
                Name           = "TargetHUD";
                Parent         = (gethui and gethui()) or CoreGui;
                IgnoreGuiInset = true;
                ResetOnSpawn   = false;
                ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling;
                Enabled        = false;
        });

        local SAVE_FILE = (self.Directory or "frequency.lol") .. "/targethud.txt";
        local _savedX, _savedY, _savedW, _savedH = 200, 200, 230, 130;
        pcall(function()
                if isfile and isfile(SAVE_FILE) then
                        local data = readfile(SAVE_FILE) or "";
                        local x, y, w, h = data:match("^(%-?%d+),(%-?%d+),(%d+),(%d+)");
                        if x and y and w and h then
                                _savedX = tonumber(x);
                                _savedY = tonumber(y);
                                _savedW = math.clamp(tonumber(w), 200, 600);
                                _savedH = math.clamp(tonumber(h), 110, 400);
                        end;
                end;
        end);
        local function _savePosSize(x, y, w, h)
                pcall(function()
                        writefile(SAVE_FILE, math.floor(x) .. "," .. math.floor(y) .. "," .. math.floor(w) .. "," .. math.floor(h));
                end);
        end;

        local Frame = self:CreateInstance("Frame", {
                Name                   = "TargetHUD";
                Parent                 = Gui;
                AnchorPoint            = Vector2.new(0, 0);
                Position               = UDim2.fromOffset(_savedX, _savedY);
                Size                   = UDim2.fromOffset(_savedW, _savedH);
                BackgroundTransparency = 1;
                BorderSizePixel        = 0;
                ZIndex                 = 1;
        });

                Name                   = "_SubtleGlow";
                Parent                 = Frame;

                Size                   = UDim2.new(1, 24, 1, 24);
                BackgroundTransparency = 1;
                BorderSizePixel        = 0;
                Image                  = "rbxassetid://110204605000367";
                ScaleType              = Enum.ScaleType.Slice;
                SliceCenter            = Rect.new(Vector2.new(21, 21), Vector2.new(79, 79));
                ImageTransparency      = 0.88;
                ImageColor3            = Color3.fromHex("6B7280");
                ZIndex                 = 0;
        });

        local Black = self:CreateInstance("Frame", {
                Name             = "Black";

        ResizeHandle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                if not (self.CurrentlyOpen and self.CurrentlyOpen.Visible) then return end;
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        _rzDragging = true;
                        _rzStartPos = input.Position;
                        _rzStartSize = Vector2.new(Frame.Size.X.Offset, Frame.Size.Y.Offset);
                        _rzMovedSignificantly = false;
                end;
        end);
        ResizeHandle.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        if _rzDragging then
                                _rzDragging = false;
                                if _rzMovedSignificantly then
                                        _savePosSize(Frame.Position.X.Offset, Frame.Position.Y.Offset, Frame.Size.X.Offset, Frame.Size.Y.Offset);
                                end;
                        end;
                end;
        end);
        _UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                if not _rzDragging then return end;
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        local delta = input.Position - _rzStartPos;
                        if delta.X ~= 0 or delta.Y ~= 0 then
                                _rzMovedSignificantly = true;
                        end;
                        local newW = math.clamp(_rzStartSize.X + delta.X, 200, 600);
                        local newH = math.clamp(_rzStartSize.Y + delta.Y, 110, 400);
                        Frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(newW, newH);
                        _rzSaveAcc = _rzSaveAcc + 1;
                        if _rzSaveAcc >= 6 then
                                _rzSaveAcc = 0;
                                _savePosSize(Frame.Position.X.Offset, Frame.Position.Y.Offset, newW, newH);
                        end;
                end;
        end);

        local _lastPos = Vector2.new(Frame.Position.X.Offset, Frame.Position.Y.Offset);
        local _dragSaveConn = _RegisterHeartbeat(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
                _dragSaveAcc = _dragSaveAcc + dt;
                if _dragSaveAcc < 0.5 then return end;
                _dragSaveAcc = 0;
                local curPos = Vector2.new(Frame.Position.X.Offset, Frame.Position.Y.Offset);
                if (curPos - _lastPos).Magnitude > 1 then
                        _lastPos = curPos;
                        _savePosSize(curPos.X, curPos.Y, Frame.Size.X.Offset, Frame.Size.Y.Offset);
                end;
        end));

                Gui.Enabled = Obj._userEnabled and Obj._hasTarget;
        end;

        function Obj:SetVisible(State)
                Obj._userEnabled = (State == true);
                _reconcileVisible();
                if not Obj._userEnabled then self:ClearTarget() end;
        end;

        function Obj:ClearTarget()
                Avatar.Image = "";
                Header.Text = "";
                MetaLine.Text = "";
                StreakBadge.Text = "";
                HealthValue.Text = "";
                HealthBarFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0);
                WeaponIcon.Image = "";
                WeaponValue.Text = "";
                AmmoValue.Text = "";
                StudsValue.Text = "";
                Obj._hasTarget = false;
                _reconcileVisible();
        end;

        function Obj:SetTarget()
                Obj._hasTarget = true;
                _reconcileVisible();
        end;

        function Obj:Destroy()
                pcall(function() _rzVisConn:Disconnect() end);
                pcall(function() _dragSaveConn:Disconnect() end);
                pcall(function() Gui:Destroy() end);
        end;

        self._TargetHUD = Obj;
        return Obj;
end;

function Library:Unload()
        self:Log("Unload requested");
        for _, Conn in self.Connections do
                if Conn ~= nil then
                        Conn:Disconnect();
                end;
        end;
        self.Connections = {};

        local Win = self.CurrentlyOpen;
        if typeof(Win) == "table" and typeof(Win.Gui) == "Instance" and Win.Gui.Parent then
                Win.Gui:Destroy();
        end;
        self.CurrentlyOpen = nil;

        self.Flags = {};
        self.Toggles = {};
        self.Options = {};
        self:Log("Unload complete");
end;

local function removeTracer(t)
                        if t.beam then pcall(function() t.beam:Destroy() end) end;
                        if t.att0 then pcall(function() t.att0:Destroy() end) end;
                        if t.att1 then pcall(function() t.att1:Destroy() end) end;
                end;

                local function applyStyleToBeam(beam, style, color)
                        beam.Texture = style.texture or "";
                        beam.TextureMode = Enum.TextureMode[style.textureMode] or Enum.TextureMode.Stretch;
                        beam.TextureLength = 1;
                        beam.Width0 = (style.width0 or 0.25) * 3;
                        beam.Width1 = (style.width1 or 0.55) * 3;
                        beam.CurveSize0 = style.curveSize0 or 0;
                        beam.CurveSize1 = style.curveSize1 or 0;
                        beam.LightInfluence = math.clamp(style.lightInfluence or 0, 0, 0);
                        beam.LightEmission = math.clamp(style.lightEmission or 1, 0.5, 1);
                        beam.FaceCamera = style.faceCamera ~= false;
                        beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(color);
                        beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0);
                        beam.Enabled = true;
                end;

local function createTracer(startPos, endPos)
    if not V.tracers.enabled then return end
    -- "no bullet tracers" weapon mod: skip ALL tracer drawing when the
    -- toggle is on. This catches every call site (game's GN_S call,
    -- script's redirected silent-aim call, triggerbot's explicit call,
    -- Visualize listener) so the user sees zero bullet beams regardless
    -- of which code path spawned them.
    local _wm = _G.WMState;
    if _wm and _wm.tracers < 0.5 then return end
    if not startPos or not endPos then return end
    if (endPos - startPos).Magnitude < 0.1 then return end
    local _now = tick();
    _tracerLastShotTime = _now;

    local styleName = V.tracers.style
    local style = V.tracerStyles[styleName] or V.tracerStyles["new_laser"]
    if not style then return end

    local now = tick()
    local isHit = false
    if _recentDamageGuiPos ~= nil
        and (now - _recentDamageGuiTime) < 0.25
        and (_recentDamageGuiPos - endPos).Magnitude < 12 then
        isHit = true
    end
    local tracerColor = isHit
        and (V.tracers.hitColor or V.tracers.color)
        or  (V.tracers.missColor or V.tracers.color)

    local att0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
    att0.WorldPosition = startPos
    att0.Parent        = workspace.Terrain

    local att1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
    att1.WorldPosition = endPos
    att1.Parent        = workspace.Terrain

    local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
    beam.Attachment0    = att0
    beam.Attachment1    = att1
    beam.Texture        = style.texture or ""
    beam.TextureMode    = Enum.TextureMode[style.textureMode] or Enum.TextureMode.Stretch
    beam.TextureLength  = 1
local thick = (V.tracers.thickness or 1);
    beam.Width0         = (style.width0 or 0.25) * 3 * thick
    beam.Width1         = (style.width1 or 0.55) * 3 * thick
    beam.CurveSize0     = style.curveSize0 or 0
    beam.CurveSize1     = style.curveSize1 or 0
    beam.LightInfluence = 0
    beam.LightEmission  = 1
    beam.FaceCamera     = true
    beam.Color          = ColorSequence.new(tracerColor)
    beam.Transparency   = NumberSequence.new(0)
    beam.Enabled        = true
    beam.Parent         = workspace.Terrain

    table.insert(V.tracerState.active, {
        startPos     = startPos,
        endPos       = endPos,
        creationTime = tick(),
        style        = styleName,
        beam         = beam,
        att0         = att0,
        att1         = att1,
        tracerColor   = tracerColor,
        hitConfirmed  = isHit,
    })
end

                V.createTracer = createTracer;
                V.applyStyleToBeam = applyStyleToBeam;

                local function worldToScreen(pos)
                        local vp, on = _Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(pos);
                        return Vector2.new(vp.X, vp.Y), on, vp.Z;

_RegisterHeartbeat(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
                        local now = tick()
                        local cfg = V.tracers
                        if not cfg.enabled then
                                for i = #V.tracerState.active, 1, -1 do
                                        removeTracer(V.tracerState.active[i]);
                                        table.remove(V.tracerState.active, i);
                                end;
                                return;
                        end;

                        -- perf: nothing to animate this frame
                        if #V.tracerState.active == 0 then return end;

                        local i = #V.tracerState.active;
                        while i >= 1 do
                                local t = V.tracerState.active[i];
                                local elapsed = now - t.creationTime;

                                if elapsed >= cfg.duration then
                                        removeTracer(t);
                                        table.remove(V.tracerState.active, i);
                                        i -= 1;
                                        continue;
                                end;

                                local lifeRatio = elapsed / cfg.duration;
                                local trans = (lifeRatio > 0.7) and ((lifeRatio - 0.7) / 0.3) or 0;

                                if t.beam and t.beam.Parent then
                                        -- perf: color is constant for the beam's lifetime (set once at creation),
                                        -- only fade transparency — and only when the value actually changes,
                                        -- instead of allocating new sequences every frame
                                        if t._lastTrans ~= trans then
                                                t._lastTrans = trans;
                                                t.beam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                                                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, trans),
                                                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, trans),
                                                });
                                        end;
                                end;
                                i -= 1;
                        end;
                end));

                task.spawn(function()
                        pcall(function()
                                local PS = _LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts", 10);
                                if PS then
                                        local okCI, CI = pcall(function()
                                                return require(PS:WaitForChild("Modules")
                                                        :WaitForChild("ClientReplicatedClasses")
                                                        :WaitForChild("ClientFighter")
                                                        :WaitForChild("ClientItem"));
                                        end);
                                        if okCI and CI and CI._FireRaycast then
                                                local old = CI._FireRaycast;
                                                CI._FireRaycast = function(self, origin, direction, maxDist, ...)
                                                        _tracerLastShotTime = tick();
                                                        local result = old(self, origin, direction, maxDist, ...);
                                                        if V.tracers.enabled then
                                                                local endPos = result and result.Position
                                                                        or (origin + direction.Unit * (maxDist or 500));
                                                                task.defer(function()
                                                                        pcall(createTracer, origin, endPos);
                                                                end);
                                                        end;
                                                        return result;
                                                end;
                                        end;
                                end;

                                if not PS then return end;
                                local TracerEffectModule = nil;
                                for _, desc in pairs(PS:GetDescendants()) do
                                        if desc:IsA("ModuleScript") and desc.Name == "TracerEffect" then
                                                TracerEffectModule = desc;
                                                break;
                                        end;
                                end;
                                if not TracerEffectModule then return end;
                                local okTE, TracerEffect = pcall(require, TracerEffectModule);
                                if not okTE or not TracerEffect or not TracerEffect.Play then return end;

                                local oldPlay = TracerEffect.Play;
                                TracerEffect.Play = function(self, raycastResults, tracerData, verifyData)
                                        oldPlay(self, raycastResults, tracerData, verifyData);
                                        if not raycastResults or not V.tracers.enabled then return end;
                                        if raycastResults.IsLocal == false then return end;
                                        if raycastResults.IsEnemy == true then return end;
                                        if not raycastResults.RaycastResults then return end;

                                        _tracerLastShotTime = tick();

                                        for _, result in pairs(raycastResults.RaycastResults) do
                                                local startPos = result.StartPosition;
                                                if not startPos and verifyData and verifyData.MuzzlePosition then
                                                        startPos = verifyData.MuzzlePosition;
                                                end;
                                                local endPos = result.Position;
                                                if startPos and endPos
                                                        and typeof(startPos) == "Vector3"
                                                        and typeof(endPos) == "Vector3"
                                                        and (endPos - startPos).Magnitude > 0.1 then
                                                        task.defer(function()
                                                                pcall(createTracer, startPos, endPos);
                                                        end);
                                                end;
                                        end;
                                end;
                        end);
                end);

                        -- ===================================================================
                        -- Criminality game support
                        -- Hooks the GN_S (gun shot) and ZF_H (damage) remotes via
                        -- __namecall to drive bullet tracers, hit sounds, hit particles,
                        -- and damage numbers on the Criminality game.
                        --
                        -- Shot fired  -> GN_S.FireServer(_, tick, key, tool, "FDS9I83", origin, {dir}, false)
                        --              args[5] = muzzle origin (Vector3)
                        --              args[6] = { [1] = direction (Vector3) }
                        --              -> draw a tracer beam from origin to origin + dir.Unit * 1000
                        --
                        -- Shot landed -> ZF_H.FireServer(_, "<gopher>", tool, key, hitIndex, hitPart, hitPos, dir)
                        --              args[6] = hitPart (BasePart)
                        --              args[7] = hitPos (Vector3)
                        --              -> play hitsound + emit hit particles + spawn damage number
                        --
                        -- All wrapped in pcall. If the game isn't Criminality (remotes
                        -- don't exist), every lookup bails silently.
                        -- Guard against re-hooking on script re-execution.
                        if not _CRIM_HOOKS_INSTALLED then
                                _CRIM_HOOKS_INSTALLED = true;
                                task.spawn(function()
                                        pcall(function()
                                                local _RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage");
                                                -- Locate the remotes. WaitForChild with a short timeout so we
                                                -- don't hang forever on non-Criminality games.
                                                local _events = _RS:WaitForChild("Events", 5);
                                                if not _events then return end;
                                                local _gn_s = _events:FindFirstChild("GNX_S");
                                                local _zf_h = _events:FindFirstChild("ZFKLF__H");
                                                if not _gn_s and not _zf_h then return end;

                                                local _Players = game:GetService("Players");
                                                local _LocalPlayer = _Players.LocalPlayer;

                                                -- Helper: trigger the existing hitsound/particle/damage-number
                                                -- pipeline at a given world position. Reuses the same data
                                                -- structures the BillboardGui.DescendantAdded handler uses
                                                -- (lines ~12194-12252), so visual settings from the UI apply.
                                                local function _triggerHitFx(hitPos, hitPart)
                                                        if not hitPos then return end;
                                                        _recentDamageGuiTime = tick();
                                                        _recentDamageGuiPos  = hitPos;

                                                        -- Hit sound
                                                        if V.hit.hitsoundEnabled and not V.hitsoundDebounce then
                                                                V.hitsoundDebounce = true;
                                                                V.hitsoundSound.SoundId = V.hitsounds[V.hit.hitsoundSelected]
                                                                        or "rbxassetid://6534947869";
                                                                V.hitsoundSound.Volume = V.hit.hitsoundVolume;
                                                                V.hitsoundSound:Play();
                                                                task.delay(0.1, function() V.hitsoundDebounce = false end);
                                                        end;

                                                        -- Hit particles (re-uses the same hitParticleEmit function
                                                        -- defined later in this same do-block; forward-declared
                                                        -- via the V table so it's available at call time).
                                                        if V.hit.hitParticlesEnabled and not V.hitParticleDebounce
                                                                and V._hitParticleEmit then
                                                                V.hitParticleDebounce = true;
                                                                V._hitParticleEmit(hitPos);
                                                                task.delay(0.1, function() V.hitParticleDebounce = false end);
                                                        end;

                                                        -- Damage number. Criminality DOES NOT create a
                                                        -- "DamageGui" BillboardGui like RIVALS does (verified
                                                        -- from the dump — no BillboardGui named "DamageGui"
                                                        -- exists anywhere in the Criminality tree). The old
                                                        -- code passed "?" as the text and hoped the
                                                        -- BillboardGui handler would backfill a real number;
                                                        -- since Criminality never creates that BillboardGui,
                                                        -- the "?" stayed forever and damage numbers looked
                                                        -- broken.
                                                        --
                                                        -- Fix: snapshot the target's Humanoid.Health before
                                                        -- the hit, spawn the damage number with "?" initially,
                                                        -- then check Health again 0.18s later. The delta is
                                                        -- the actual damage dealt. Update the existing damage
                                                        -- number's accumulated value + label text in-place via
                                                        -- the damageNumByPart table.
                                                        if V.hit.damageNumbersEnabled and V._damageNumberSpawn then
                                                                -- Snapshot health BEFORE the server applies damage.
                                                                local _humBefore = nil;
                                                                local _char = hitPart and hitPart.Parent;
                                                                if _char then
                                                                        local _h = _char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                                                                                or (_char:FindFirstChild("EnemyHumanoid")
                                                                                        and _char.EnemyHumanoid:IsA("Humanoid") and _char.EnemyHumanoid);
                                                                        if _h then _humBefore = _h.Health end;
                                                                end;
                                                                -- Spawn with "?" — same as before, so the visual
                                                                -- appears immediately at the hit position.
                                                                V._damageNumberSpawn(hitPos, "?", hitPart);
                                                                -- Background poll: read Health AFTER the server
                                                                -- applies damage (~120-180ms latency) and update
                                                                -- the existing damage number with the real value.
                                                                if _humBefore ~= nil then
                                                                        task.spawn(function()
                                                                                task.wait(0.18);
                                                                                local _h2 = _char and (_char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                                                                                        or (_char:FindFirstChild("EnemyHumanoid")
                                                                                                and _char.EnemyHumanoid:IsA("Humanoid") and _char.EnemyHumanoid));
                                                                                if not _h2 then return end;
                                                                                local _delta = _humBefore - _h2.Health;
                                                                                if _delta > 0.5 then
                                                                                        -- Update the existing damage number for this hitPart.
                                                                                        local _existing = V.damageNumByPart and V.damageNumByPart[hitPart];
                                                                                        if _existing and _existing.gui and _existing.gui.Parent then
                                                                                                _existing.accumulated = (_existing.accumulated or 0) + _delta;
                                                                                                _existing.start = tick();
                                                                                                local _full = tostring(math.floor(_existing.accumulated + 0.5));
                                                                                                local _mid = math.ceil(#_full / 2);
                                                                                                if _existing.labelL then _existing.labelL.Text = _full:sub(1, _mid) end;
                                                                                                if _existing.labelR then _existing.labelR.Text = _full:sub(_mid + 1) end;
                                                                                        end;
                                                                                end;
                                                                        end);
                                                                end;
                                                        end;
                                                end;

                                                -- Expose helpers on V so the Visualize listener and the
                                                -- triggerbot's explicit fire path (which uses dot syntax
                                                -- that bypasses __namecall) can both call them.
