                                                V._triggerHitFx = _triggerHitFx;

                                                -- =========================================================
                                                -- WALLBANG CACHE
                                                -- Stores successful (origin, hit) pairs per target, keyed
                                                -- by rounded direction vector. Subsequent shots at the
                                                -- same target from a similar angle reuse the cached pair
                                                -- instantly, skipping the sphere scan.
                                                --
                                                -- LRU: max 8 entries per target. 5-second expiry.
                                                -- Reinforcement: when the __namecall hook confirms a hit
                                                -- (sees our "🧈" marker), it bumps that cache entry's
                                                -- timestamp so shots that genuinely deal damage stay
                                                -- cached longest.
                                                -- =========================================================
                                                local WB_HitCache = {}    -- { [targetName] = { [roundedKey] = { origin, hitPos, hitPart, lastUsed, confirmed } } }
                                                local WB_MAX_PER_TARGET = 8
                                                local WB_EXPIRY_SECS    = 5

                                                -- 24 direction vectors to sphere-scan around the player HRP.
                                                -- Radii match the ragebot's sphere-scan sizes.
                                                -- Origin radius = 18.5 studs around player HRP.
                                                -- Hit radius = 23.5 studs around target hitPos.
                                                -- These are large enough to find wallbang paths
                                                -- through thick walls, but small enough that the
                                                -- server still sees the shot as plausible.
                                                local WB_ORIGIN_RADIUS = 18.5
                                                local WB_HIT_RADIUS    = 23.5
                                                local WB_ScanVectors = {
                                                    Vector3.new( 0,  0,  0),
                                                    Vector3.new( 1,  0,  0), Vector3.new(-1, 0,  0),
                                                    Vector3.new( 0,  1,  0), Vector3.new( 0, -1, 0),
                                                    Vector3.new( 0,  0,  1), Vector3.new( 0,  0, -1),
                                                    Vector3.new( 1,  1,  0), Vector3.new(-1, 1,  0),
                                                    Vector3.new( 1, -1,  0), Vector3.new(-1,-1,  0),
                                                    Vector3.new( 1,  0,  1), Vector3.new(-1,  0,  1),
                                                    Vector3.new( 1,  0, -1), Vector3.new(-1,  0, -1),
                                                    Vector3.new( 0,  1,  1), Vector3.new( 0, -1,  1),
                                                    Vector3.new( 0,  1, -1), Vector3.new( 0, -1, -1),
                                                    Vector3.new( 1,  1,  1), Vector3.new(-1,  1,  1),
                                                    Vector3.new( 1,  1, -1), Vector3.new(-1,  1, -1),
                                                    Vector3.new( 1, -1,  1), Vector3.new(-1, -1,  1),
                                                    Vector3.new( 1, -1, -1), Vector3.new(-1, -1, -1),
                                                    -- Extra directions for finer coverage
                                                    Vector3.new( 0.5,  0.5,  0.5), Vector3.new(-0.5,  0.5,  0.5),
                                                    Vector3.new( 0.5, -0.5,  0.5), Vector3.new(-0.5, -0.5,  0.5),
                                                    Vector3.new( 0.5,  0.5, -0.5), Vector3.new(-0.5,  0.5, -0.5),
                                                    Vector3.new( 0.5, -0.5, -0.5), Vector3.new(-0.5, -0.5, -0.5),
                                                }

                                                local function WB_RoundVec(v)
                                                    -- round each component to 2 decimal places for the cache key
                                                    return Vector3.new(
                                                        math.floor(v.X * 100 + 0.5) / 100,
                                                        math.floor(v.Y * 100 + 0.5) / 100,
                                                        math.floor(v.Z * 100 + 0.5) / 100
                                                    )
                                                end

                                                local function WB_CheckWallbang(p1, p2)
                                                    -- returns true if the ray p1 -> p2 is clear OR hits a wall
                                                    -- within `wallbangTol` studs of p2 (i.e. thin-wall penetration)
                                                    -- Uses _G.WallbangTol because targetingCfg is declared later
                                                    -- in the file and isn't visible in this closure's scope.
                                                    local tol = tonumber(_G.WallbangTol) or 24
                                                    local params = RaycastParams.new()
                                                    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { _LocalPlayer.Character }
                                                    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
                                                    local dir = p2 - p1
                                                    local dist = dir.Magnitude
                                                    if dist < 0.01 then return true end
                                                    local r = workspace:Raycast(p1, dir.Unit * dist, params)
                                                    if not r then return true end
                                                    return (r.Position - p2).Magnitude <= tol
                                                end

                                                local function WB_Lookup(targetName, roundedVec)
                                                    local bucket = WB_HitCache[targetName]
                                                    if not bucket then return nil end
                                                    local key = tostring(roundedVec)
                                                    local entry = bucket[key]
                                                    if not entry then return nil end
                                                    -- expire stale entries
                                                    if (tick() - entry.lastUsed) > WB_EXPIRY_SECS then
                                                        bucket[key] = nil
                                                        return nil
                                                    end
                                                    return entry
                                                end

                                                local function WB_Store(targetName, roundedVec, origin, hitPos, hitPart)
                                                    if not targetName then return end
                                                    WB_HitCache[targetName] = WB_HitCache[targetName] or {}
                                                    local bucket = WB_HitCache[targetName]
                                                    local key = tostring(roundedVec)
                                                    -- LRU eviction: if we already have WB_MAX_PER_TARGET entries
                                                    -- and this is a new key, evict the oldest
                                                    if not bucket[key] then
                                                        local keys = {}
                                                        for k, v in pairs(bucket) do
                                                            table.insert(keys, { k = k, t = v.lastUsed })
                                                        end
                                                        if #keys >= WB_MAX_PER_TARGET then
                                                            table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return a.t < b.t end)
                                                            bucket[keys[1].k] = nil
                                                        end
                                                    end
                                                    bucket[key] = {
                                                        origin = origin,
                                                        hitPos = hitPos,
                                                        hitPart = hitPart,
                                                        lastUsed = tick(),
                                                        confirmed = tick(),
                                                    }
                                                end

                                                -- Exposed globally so the __namecall hook can reinforce
                                                -- cache entries on confirmed hits.
                                                _G.WB_Reinforce = function(targetName, hitPos)
                                                    if not targetName then return end
                                                    local bucket = WB_HitCache[targetName]
                                                    if not bucket then return end
                                                    -- bump lastUsed + confirmed for any entry whose hitPos is close
                                                    for _, entry in pairs(bucket) do
                                                        if entry.hitPos and (entry.hitPos - hitPos).Magnitude < 5 then
                                                            entry.lastUsed = tick()
                                                            entry.confirmed = tick()
                                                        end
                                                    end
                                                end

                                                -- Find a wallbangable (origin, hit) pair. Uses a
                                                -- Cartesian product of origin offsets × hit offsets
                                                -- (like the ragebot) with radii WB_ORIGIN_RADIUS / WB_HIT_RADIUS.
                                                -- Returns (origin, hitPos, hitPart) or nil if no valid path.
                                                local function WB_FindPath(myHRP, hitPos, hitPart)
                                                    if not myHRP then return nil end
                                                    local baseOrigin = myHRP.Position
                                                    -- direct path first (center-to-center)
                                                    if WB_CheckWallbang(baseOrigin, hitPos) then
                                                        return baseOrigin, hitPos, hitPart
                                                    end
                                                    -- Cartesian product: for each origin offset × each hit offset,
                                                    -- check if the ray passes through. This matches the ragebot's
                                                    -- approach and covers 35×35 = 1225 combinations per scan.
                                                    for _, oVec in ipairs(WB_ScanVectors) do
                                                        local tryOrigin = baseOrigin + oVec * WB_ORIGIN_RADIUS
                                                        for _, hVec in ipairs(WB_ScanVectors) do
                                                            local tryHit = hitPos + hVec * WB_HIT_RADIUS
                                                            if WB_CheckWallbang(tryOrigin, tryHit) then
                                                                return tryOrigin, tryHit, hitPart
                                                            end
                                                        end
                                                    end
                                                    return nil
                                                end

                                                -- =========================================================
                                                -- _fireSilentHit: redirects a bullet to the silent-aim target.
                                                --
                                                -- TWO MODES depending on _G.WallbangEnabled:
                                                --
                                                -- WALLBANG OFF (default, matches reference silent aim):
                                                --   • Uses the GAME's key from the Visualize event
                                                --   • Fires ONLY ZFKLF__H (NOT our own GNX_S)
                                                --   • Uses startPos (muzzle) as the lookVec origin
                                                --   • The game's own GNX_S (already in flight) provides the
                                                --     bullet record that our ZFKLF__H references
                                                --   • The __namecall hook blocks the game's ZFKLF__H so only
                                                --     our redirected hit registers
                                                --
                                                -- WALLBANG ON (ragebot technique):
                                                --   • Generates a SCRIPT-SIDE key (separate from game's)
                                                --   • Fires BOTH GNX_S + ZFKLF__H with matching key/origin/dir/hit
                                                --   • Sphere-scans for an offset origin that has LOS to target
                                                --   • The __namecall hook blocks BOTH the game's GNX_S AND ZFKLF__H
                                                --     so the server only sees our consistent (GN_S, ZF_H) pair
                                                -- =========================================================
                                                V._fireSilentHit = function(tool, key, hitIndex, hitPart, hitPos, startPos, targetPlayer)
                                                        if not _zf_h or not _gn_s or not hitPart or not hitPos then return false end;
                                                        if not tool or not tool.Parent then return false end;

                                                        local _lpChar = _LocalPlayer.Character;
                                                        local _hrp = _lpChar and _lpChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");
                                                        if not _hrp then return false end;

                                                        local wbOn = _G.WallbangEnabled;

                                                        -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                                                        -- MODE 1: WALLBANG OFF — match reference silent aim exactly.
                                                        -- Use game's key, fire only ZF_H, use muzzle as origin.
                                                        -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                                                        if not wbOn then
                                                                -- Use startPos (muzzle from Visualize) as origin.
                                                                -- Fall back to HRP if startPos is missing.
                                                                local origin = startPos or _hrp.Position;
                                                                local lookVec = (hitPos - origin).Unit;

                                                                -- Fire ONLY ZFKLF__H with the game's key.
                                                                -- The game's own GNX_S (with this key) is already in flight
                                                                -- and provides the bullet record. Our ZF_H references it.
                                                                pcall(_zf_h.FireServer, _zf_h, "🧈", tool, key, hitIndex, hitPart, hitPos, lookVec);

                                                                -- Tracer + hitmarker + FX
                                                                if V.tracers.enabled and createTracer then
                                                                        task.defer(function() pcall(createTracer, origin, hitPos) end);
                                                                end
                                                                if tool:FindFirstChild("Hitmarker") then
                                                                        pcall(function() tool.Hitmarker:Fire(hitPart) end);
                                                                end
                                                                if V._triggerHitFx then
                                                                        task.spawn(function() pcall(V._triggerHitFx, hitPos, hitPart) end);
                                                                end
                                                                return true;
                                                        end;

                                                        -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                                                        -- MODE 2: WALLBANG ON — ragebot technique.
                                                        -- Script-generated key + own GN_S + sphere-scanned origin.
                                                        -- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                                                        local targetName;
                                                        if targetPlayer then
                                                                targetName = targetPlayer.Name;
                                                        elseif hitPart and hitPart.Parent then
                                                                targetName = hitPart.Parent.Name;
                                                        end

                                                        local baseOrigin = _hrp.Position;
                                                        local curLook = (hitPos - baseOrigin).Unit;
                                                        local roundedKey = WB_RoundVec(curLook);

                                                        local fireOrigin, fireHitPos, fireHitPart = nil, nil, nil;

                                                        -- 1. Cache lookup
                                                        local cached = WB_Lookup(targetName, roundedKey);
                                                        if cached then
                                                                -- verify the cached pair is still wallbangable AND still in range
                                                                local originDist = (cached.origin - baseOrigin).Magnitude
                                                                local hitDist = (cached.hitPos - hitPos).Magnitude
                                                                if originDist <= WB_ORIGIN_RADIUS and hitDist <= WB_HIT_RADIUS
                                                                   and WB_CheckWallbang(cached.origin, cached.hitPos) then
                                                                        fireOrigin = cached.origin;
                                                                        fireHitPos = cached.hitPos;
                                                                        fireHitPart = cached.hitPart;
                                                                        cached.lastUsed = tick();
                                                                else
                                                                        WB_HitCache[targetName][tostring(roundedKey)] = nil;
                                                                end;
                                                        end;

                                                        -- 2. Fresh sphere scan if cache miss
                                                        if not fireOrigin then
                                                                local o, h, p = WB_FindPath(_hrp, hitPos, hitPart);
                                                                if o then
                                                                        fireOrigin = o;
                                                                        fireHitPos = h;
                                                                        fireHitPart = p;
                                                                        WB_Store(targetName, roundedKey, o, h, p);
                                                                end;
                                                        end;

                                                        -- No valid wallbang path found — skip this shot.
                                                        -- The game's own bullet goes to the wall (no redirect).
                                                        if not fireOrigin then return false end;

                                                        -- Generate a SCRIPT-SIDE key for the wallbang shot.
                                                        local saKey = "K" .. math.random(1000, 9999);
                                                        local lookVec = (fireHitPos - fireOrigin).Unit;

                                                        -- Fire BOTH GN_S and ZF_H with the script-side key.
                                                        -- The __namecall hook (when wallbang is ON) blocks the
                                                        -- game's own GN_S so the server only sees our pair.
                                                        pcall(_gn_s.FireServer, _gn_s, tick(), saKey, tool, "FDS9I83", fireOrigin, { lookVec }, false);
                                                        pcall(_zf_h.FireServer, _zf_h, "🧈", tool, saKey, hitIndex, fireHitPart, fireHitPos, lookVec);

                                                        -- Tracer: draw from muzzle/camera origin to the REAL target
                                                        -- hitPos (not the sphere-scanned offsets). The wallbang
                                                        -- offsets (fireOrigin/fireHitPos) are server-side constructs
                                                        -- that the player shouldn't see — visually the bullet
                                                        -- should appear to travel from gun to enemy.
                                                        if V.tracers.enabled and createTracer then
                                                                local _visOrigin = startPos or _hrp.Position;
                                                                local _visHit = hitPos;
                                                                task.defer(function() pcall(createTracer, _visOrigin, _visHit) end);
                                                        end
                                                        if tool:FindFirstChild("Hitmarker") then
                                                                pcall(function() tool.Hitmarker:Fire(fireHitPart) end);
                                                        end
                                                        if V._triggerHitFx then
                                                                task.spawn(function() pcall(V._triggerHitFx, hitPos, hitPart) end);
                                                        end
                                                        return true;
                                                end;

                                                -- need a Camera ref for the Visualize listener below
                                                local _Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera;

                                                -- =========================================================
                                                -- __namecall hook — the engine of tracers + hitsounds + silent aim.
                                                -- hookmetamethod IS allowed in Criminality (the old comment was
                                                -- wrong — the issue was lack of re-hook guard, now installed above).
                                                -- =========================================================
                                                local _oldNamecall;
                                                _oldNamecall = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", function(self, ...)
                                                        local method = getnamecallmethod();
                                                        -- Fast path: only do work on FireServer calls.
                                                        if method ~= "FireServer" then
                                                                return _oldNamecall(self, ...);
                                                        end;
                                                        local args = {...};

                                                        -- Hit remote -> trigger hitsound/particles/damage-numbers
                                                        -- for EVERY call (script's redirected call AND game's legit call).
                                                        if self == _zf_h then
                                                                local _hitPart = args[6];
                                                                local _hitPos  = args[7];
                                                                if typeof(_hitPos) == "Vector3" and V._triggerHitFx then
                                                                        task.spawn(function() pcall(V._triggerHitFx, _hitPos, _hitPart) end);
                                                                end;
                                                                -- Reinforce the wallbang cache: if this is one of our
                                                                -- script-originated "🧈" tagged calls, bump the matching
                                                                -- cache entry's timestamp so shots that land stay cached.
                                                                if args[1] == "🧈" and _G.WB_Reinforce and typeof(_hitPos) == "Vector3" then
                                                                        local _tool = args[3];
                                                                        local _targetName;
                                                                        if _hitPart and _hitPart.Parent then
                                                                                _targetName = _hitPart.Parent.Name;
                                                                        end;
                                                                        task.spawn(function() pcall(_G.WB_Reinforce, _targetName, _hitPos) end);
                                                                end;
                                                        end;

                                                        -- Caller filter: only the GAME's calls get filtered.
                                                        -- Script's own calls (via dot syntax) bypass __namecall entirely.
                                                        if not checkcaller() then
                                                                -- Block the game's own ZF_H calls (no "🧈" marker)
                                                                -- IF silent aim is on -- so only the script's redirected
                                                                -- hit registers. When SA is off, let legit hits through.
                                                                if self == _zf_h and args[1] ~= "🧈" then
                                                                        if _G.SilentAimEnabled then
                                                                                return nil;
                                                                        end;
                                                                end;
                                                                -- When WALLBANG is ON + SA is ON: also block the game's own
                                                                -- GN_S so the server only sees our (GN_S, ZF_H) pair with
                                                                -- the script-generated key. The game's GN_S (with the game's
                                                                -- key + camera-look direction) would conflict with our
                                                                -- redirected shot and cause "invalids".
                                                                if self == _gn_s then
                                                                        if _G.SilentAimEnabled and _G.WallbangEnabled then
                                                                                return nil;
                                                                        end;
                                                                        -- ── NO SPREAD (Criminality-specific) ──
                                                                        -- The gun's local code already applied spread to args[6][1]
                                                                        -- before calling GNX_S. We replace the spread-applied
                                                                        -- direction with the clean camera look direction so the
                                                                        -- bullet goes exactly where the camera is aimed, regardless
                                                                        -- of whether the gun cached Config.Spread at equip time.
                                                                        -- This works for ALL weapons because they all use GNX_S.
                                                                        local _wm = _G.WMState;
                                                                        if _wm and _wm.spread < 0.5
                                                                                and typeof(args[5]) == "Vector3"
                                                                                and type(args[6]) == "table"
                                                                                and typeof(args[6][1]) == "Vector3" then
                                                                                local _cam = workspace.CurrentCamera;
                                                                                if _cam then
                                                                                        args[6][1] = _cam.CFrame.LookVector;
                                                                                end;
                                                                        end;
                                                                        -- Otherwise (wallbang OFF or SA OFF): draw a tracer
                                                                        -- for the game's own GN_S calls (manual shots).
                                                                        -- Skip tracer if "no bullet tracers" is on.
                                                                        local _noTracers = _wm and _wm.tracers < 0.5;
                                                                        if V.tracers.enabled and not _noTracers then
                                                                                if typeof(args[5]) == "Vector3"
                                                                                        and type(args[6]) == "table"
                                                                                        and typeof(args[6][1]) == "Vector3" then
                                                                                        task.defer(function()
                                                                                                pcall(createTracer, args[5], args[5] + args[6][1].Unit * 1000);
                                                                                        end);
                                                                                end;
                                                                        end;
                                                                end;
                                                                -- Anti-aim MOVZREP rewrite: when anti-aim master toggle is on
                                                                -- and this is the MOVZREP remote, rewrite the animation bone
                                                                -- args to spoof the player's pose.
                                                                if self and self.Name == "MOVZREP" then
                                                                        local _aaS = _G.FrequencyAAState;
                                                                        local _pCFs = _G.FrequencyPoseCFs;
                                                                        if _aaS and _aaS.Master and _pCFs then
                                                                                if args[1] and type(args[1]) == "table" and args[1][1] then
                                                                                        pcall(function()
                                                                                                local _modes = _aaS.Modes or {}
                                                                                                -- Hide head + Ball both push the AntiDown vector
                                                                                                -- (forces head bone downward, away from the chest).
                                                                                                if _modes["Hide head"] or _modes["Ball"] then
                                                                                                        args[1][1][3] = _pCFs.AntiDown;
                                                                                                end;
                                                                                        end);
                                                                                end;
                                                                        end;
                                                                end;
                                                        end;

                                                        return _oldNamecall(self, ...);
                                                end);

                                                -- =========================================================
                                                -- Visualize BindableEvent listener -- Silent Aim trigger.
                                                -- Criminality's gun module fires this BindableEvent locally
                                                -- on every shot. We listen for it, pick the closest target
                                                -- inside the FOV, and fire ZF_H with the redirected hit.
                                                -- =========================================================
                                                local _events2 = _RS:FindFirstChild("Events2");
                                                local _visualize = _events2 and _events2:FindFirstChild("Visualize");
                                                if _visualize then
                                                        _visualize.Event:Connect(function(_, key, _, gun, _, startPos, bulletsPerShot)
                                                                if not _G.SilentAimEnabled then return end;
                                                                if not (gun and gun.Parent) then return end;
                                                                -- hit-chance roll
                                                                local hc = tonumber(_G.SilentAimHitChance) or 100;
                                                                if hc < 100 and math.random(1, 100) > hc then return end;
                                                                -- only redirect shots from our own equipped tool
                                                                local myTool = _LocalPlayer.Character
                                                                        and _LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool");
                                                                if not myTool or gun ~= myTool then return end;

                                                                local partName = _G.SilentAimTargetPart or "Head";

                                                                -- FOV centre: mouse by default, screen centre if configured
                                                                local center;
                                                                if _G.SilentAimPositionMode == "Centre" then
                                                                        center = Vector2.new(_Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, _Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2);
                                                                else
                                                                        local m = game:GetService("UserInputService"):GetMouseLocation();
                                                                        center = Vector2.new(m.X, m.Y);
                                                                end;

                                                                local target, shortestDist = nil, tonumber(_G.SilentAimFOVRadius) or 100;
                                                                -- STICKY AIM OVERRIDE: if sticky aim is on, active, and the
                                                                -- locked character is still valid (parented, alive, no FF),
                                                                -- bypass the FOV scan and target the locked player directly.
                                                                if _G.StickyAimEnabled and _G.StickyAimActive and _G.StickyAimLockedChar then
                                                                        local _sc = _G.StickyAimLockedChar;
                                                                        if _sc and _sc.Parent then
                                                                                local _sh = _sc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");
                                                                                if _sh and _sh.Health > 0 and not _sc:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then
                                                                                        for _, _p in ipairs(_Players:GetPlayers()) do
                                                                                                if _p.Character == _sc then
                                                                                                        target = _p;
                                                                                                        break;
                                                                                                end;
                                                                                        end;
                                                                                end;
                                                                        end;
                                                                end;
                                                                if not target then
                                                                for _, p in ipairs(_Players:GetPlayers()) do
                                                                        if p ~= _LocalPlayer and p.Character then
                                                                                local h = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");
                                                                                if h and h.Health > 0
                                                                                        and not p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then
                                                                                        local part = p.Character:FindFirstChild(partName)
                                                                                                or p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                                                                                                or p.Character.PrimaryPart
                                                                                                or p.Character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart");
                                                                                        if part then
                                                                                                local pos, onScreen = _Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position);
                                                                                                if onScreen then
                                                                                                        local d = (Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y) - center).Magnitude;
                                                                                                        if d < shortestDist then
                                                                                                                local blocked = false;
                                                                                                                if _G.SilentAimWallCheck then
                                                                                                                        local ignore = { _Camera, _LocalPlayer.Character, p.Character };
                                                                                                                        if #_Camera:GetPartsObscuringTarget({ part.Position }, ignore) > 0 then
                                                                                                                                blocked = true;
                                                                                                                        end;
                                                                                                                end;
                                                                                                                if not blocked then
                                                                                                                        target = p;
                                                                                                                        shortestDist = d;
                                                                                                                end;
                                                                                                        end;
                                                                                                end;
                                                                                        end;
                                                                                end;
                                                                        end;
                                                                end;
                                                                end;
                                                                if not target or not target.Character then return end;
                                                                local hitPart = target.Character:FindFirstChild(partName)
                                                                        or target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                                                                        or target.Character.PrimaryPart;
                                                                if not hitPart then return end;
                                                                local hitPos = hitPart.Position;

                                                                -- Fire one redirected ZF_H per bullet (shotguns = multiple pellets)
                                                                task.wait(0.005);
                                                                local nBullets = (type(bulletsPerShot) == "table") and #bulletsPerShot or 1;
                                                                for i = 1, nBullets do
                                                                        if V._fireSilentHit then
                                                                                -- pass the target player so _fireSilentHit can key
                                                                                -- the wallbang cache by target name
                                                                                V._fireSilentHit(gun, key, i, hitPart, hitPos, startPos, target);
                                                                        end;
                                                                end;
                                                        end);
                                                end;
                                        end)
                                end)
                        end;

                V.preview = {
                        viewport = nil,
                        camera   = nil,
                        worldModel = nil,
                        part     = nil,
                        att0     = nil,
                        att1     = nil,
                        beam     = nil,
                        styleName = nil,
                };

                V.buildTracerPreview = function(vpWidget)
                        if V.preview.beam then
                                pcall(function() V.preview.beam:Destroy() end);
                                pcall(function() V.preview.att0:Destroy() end);
                                pcall(function() V.preview.att1:Destroy() end);
                                pcall(function() V.preview.part:Destroy() end);
                        end;

                        local vp = vpWidget or V.preview.viewport;
                        if not vp then return end;
                        V.preview.viewport = vp;

                        local cam = V.preview.camera;
                        if not cam then
                                cam = Instance.new("Camera");
                                cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable;
                                cam.Parent = vp;
                                vp.CurrentCamera = cam;
                                V.preview.camera = cam;
                        end;
                        cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(0, 0, -8), Vector3.new(0, 0, 0));

                        local wm = V.preview.worldModel;
                        if not wm then
                                wm = Instance.new("WorldModel");
                                wm.Parent = vp;
                                V.preview.worldModel = wm;
                        end;

                        local part = Instance.new("Part");
                        part.Anchored = true;
                        part.CanCollide = false;
                        part.Transparency = 1;
                        part.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, 0.1);
                        part.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0);
                        part.Parent = wm;

                        local att0 = Instance.new("Attachment");
                        att0.WorldPosition = Vector3.new(-4, 0, 0);
                        att0.Parent = part;

                        local att1 = Instance.new("Attachment");
                        att1.WorldPosition = Vector3.new(4, 0, 0);
                        att1.Parent = part;

                        local beam = Instance.new("Beam");
                        beam.Attachment0 = att0;
                        beam.Attachment1 = att1;
                        beam.Parent = part;

                        V.preview.part = part;
                        V.preview.att0 = att0;
                        V.preview.att1 = att1;
                        V.preview.beam = beam;

                        V.refreshTracerPreview();
                end;

                V.refreshTracerPreview = function()
                        if not V.preview.beam then return end;
                        local styleName = V.tracers.style;
                        local style = V.tracerStyles[styleName] or V.tracerStyles["new_laser"];
                        if not style then return end;
                        applyStyleToBeam(V.preview.beam, style, V.tracers.color);
                        V.preview.styleName = styleName;
                end;
        end;

        do
                local crosshair_drawings = { lines = {} };
                for idx = 1, 8 do
                        crosshair_drawings.lines[idx] = Drawing.new("Line");
                end;

                local _defaultCrosshairHidden = false;
                local _cachedPlayerDataController = nil;
                local _originalCrosshairDisabled = nil;
                local function _getPDC()
                    if _cachedPlayerDataController ~= nil then return _cachedPlayerDataController end;
                    pcall(function()
                        _cachedPlayerDataController = require(_LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts", 5):WaitForChild("Controllers", 5):WaitForChild("PlayerDataController", 5));
                    end);
                    if _cachedPlayerDataController == nil then _cachedPlayerDataController = false end;
                    return _cachedPlayerDataController;
                end;
                local function SetDefaultCrosshairVisible(visible)
                    pcall(function()
                        local pdc = _getPDC();
                        if not pdc then return end;
                        local wantDisabled = not visible;
                        if _originalCrosshairDisabled == nil then
                            local ok, orig = pcall(function() return pdc:GetSetting("Crosshair Disabled") end);
                            _originalCrosshairDisabled = (ok and orig) or false;
                        end;
                        local ok, current = pcall(function() return pdc:GetSetting("Crosshair Disabled") end);
                        current = (ok and current) or false;
                        if current ~= wantDisabled then
                            pdc:SetSetting("Crosshair Disabled", wantDisabled);
                        end;
                    end);
                end;
                local function RestoreDefaultCrosshair()
                    pcall(function()
                        local pdc = _getPDC();
                        if not pdc then return end;
                        if _originalCrosshairDisabled ~= nil then
                            local ok, current = pcall(function() return pdc:GetSetting("Crosshair Disabled") end);
                            current = (ok and current) or false;
                            if current ~= _originalCrosshairDisabled then
                                pdc:SetSetting("Crosshair Disabled", _originalCrosshairDisabled);
                            end;
                        end;
                        _originalCrosshairDisabled = nil;
                    end);
                end;

                local function chSolve(angle, radius)
                        return Vector2.new(math.sin(math.rad(angle)) * radius, math.cos(math.rad(angle)) * radius);
                end;

                local function chGetMuzzlePosition()
                        -- ── Criminality: equipped tool's WeaponHandle.Muzzle ──
                        -- Criminality tools use the basic Tool system; the muzzle
                        -- is the "Muzzle" Attachment inside WeaponHandle. This works
                        -- for ALL guns because they all share the same WeaponHandle
                        -- + Muzzle attachment structure (verified from the dump:
                        -- AKS-74U, Deagle, G-17, G-18, M4A1-1, Sawn-Off, TEC-9, Uzi).
                        local _char = _LocalPlayer.Character;
                        if _char then
                                local _tool = _char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool");
                                if _tool then
                                        local _wh = _tool:FindFirstChild("WeaponHandle");
                                        if _wh and _wh:IsA("BasePart") then
                                                local _mz = _wh:FindFirstChild("Muzzle");
                                                if _mz and _mz:IsA("Attachment") then
                                                        return _mz.WorldPosition;
                                                end;
                                                local _fp = _wh:FindFirstChild("FirePos");
                                                if _fp and _fp:IsA("Attachment") then
                                                        return _fp.WorldPosition;
                                                end;
                                                return _wh.Position;
                                        end;
                                end;
                        end;

                        -- ── RIVALS: viewmodel muzzle (kept for cross-game) ──
                        local viewModels = workspace:FindFirstChild("ViewModels");
                        if not viewModels then return nil end;
                        local firstPerson = viewModels:FindFirstChild("FirstPerson");
                        if not firstPerson then return nil end;
                        for _, model in pairs(firstPerson:GetChildren()) do
                                if model:IsA("Model") and model.Name:find("^" .. _LocalPlayer.Name) then
                                        local iv = model:FindFirstChild("ItemVisual");
                                        if iv then
                                                local body = iv:FindFirstChild("Body");
                                                if body then
                                                        local bp = body:FindFirstChild("BodyPrimary");
                                                        if bp then
                                                        local muzzle = bp:FindFirstChild("_muzzle");
                                                                if muzzle and muzzle:IsA("Attachment") then
                                                                        return muzzle.WorldPosition;
                                                                end;
                                                        end;
                                                end;
                                        end;
                                end;
                        end;
                        return nil;
                end;

                local _last_render_ch = 0;
                local _chFollowX, _chFollowY = nil, nil;
                -- Wrap with LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE so Luraph doesn't pay
                -- virtualization overhead on every frame for this hot
                -- path (crosshair updates every PostSimulation tick).
                _RunService.PostSimulation:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
                        local _tick = tick();
                        local ch = V.crosshair;

                        if ch.enabled and ch.remove_default and not _defaultCrosshairHidden then
                                _defaultCrosshairHidden = true;
                                SetDefaultCrosshairVisible(false);
                        elseif (not ch.enabled or not ch.remove_default) and _defaultCrosshairHidden then
                                _defaultCrosshairHidden = false;
                                RestoreDefaultCrosshair();
                        end;

                        if _tick - _last_render_ch > ch.refreshrate then
                                _last_render_ch = _tick;

                                local vp = _Camera.ViewportSize;
                                local center = vp / 2;
                                local mousePos = _UserInputService:GetMouseLocation();

                                local position;
                                if ch.mode == "muzzle" then
                                        local mp = chGetMuzzlePosition();
                                        if mp then
                                                local sp, onScreen = _Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(mp);
                                                position = onScreen and Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) or center;
                                        else
                                                position = center;
                                        end;
                                elseif ch.mode == "center" then
                                        position = center;
                                else
                                        position = mousePos;
                                end;

                                -- follow ragebot target (visual only)
                                if ch.follow_rage then
                                        local _fn = getgenv()._RivalsRagebotTarget;
                                        local _okc, _tchar = false, nil;
                                        if _fn then _okc, _tchar = pcall(_fn); end;
                                        local _troot = (_okc and _tchar and _tchar.Parent)
                                                and (_tchar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or _tchar.PrimaryPart)
                                                or nil;
                                        if _troot then
                                                local _okp, _vp, _on = pcall(function()
                                                        local vv, onS = _Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(_troot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0));
                                                        return vv, onS;
                                                end);
                                                if _okp and _vp and _on and ((_vp.Z or 0) > 0) then
                                                        local _tp = Vector2.new(_vp.X, _vp.Y);
                                                        local _a = math.clamp(ch.follow_rage_lerp or 0.35, 0.01, 1);
                                                        if not _chFollowX then
                                                                _chFollowX, _chFollowY = _tp.X, _tp.Y;
                                                        else
                                                                _chFollowX = _chFollowX + (_tp.X - _chFollowX) * _a;
                                                                _chFollowY = _chFollowY + (_tp.Y - _chFollowY) * _a;
                                                        end;
                                                        position = Vector2.new(_chFollowX, _chFollowY);
                                                else
                                                        _chFollowX, _chFollowY = nil, nil;
                                                end;
                                        else
                                                _chFollowX, _chFollowY = nil, nil;
                                        end;
                                else
                                        _chFollowX, _chFollowY = nil, nil;
                                end;

                                for idx = 1, 4 do
                                        local outline = crosshair_drawings.lines[idx];
                                        local inline  = crosshair_drawings.lines[idx + 4];

                                        if not ch.enabled then
                                                outline.Visible = false;
                                                inline.Visible  = false;
                                        else
                                                local angle = (idx - 1) * 90;
                                                local length = ch.length;

                                                if ch.spin then
                                                        local spin_angle = -_tick * ch.spin_speed % ch.spin_max;
                                                        angle = angle + _TweenService:GetValue(spin_angle / 360, ch.spin_style, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut) * 360;
                                                end;

                                                if ch.resize then
                                                        local resize_length = _tick * ch.resize_speed % 180;
                                                        length = ch.resize_min + math.sin(math.rad(resize_length)) * ch.resize_max;
                                                end;

                                                local lineColor = ch["color_" .. idx] or Color3.fromRGB(199, 110, 255);

                                                inline.Visible   = true;
                                                inline.Color     = lineColor;
                                                inline.From      = position + chSolve(angle, ch.radius);
                                                inline.To        = position + chSolve(angle, ch.radius + length);
                                                inline.Thickness = ch.width;

                                                outline.Visible   = true;
                                                outline.Color     = Color3.new(0, 0, 0);
                                                outline.From      = position + chSolve(angle, ch.radius - 1);
                                                outline.To        = position + chSolve(angle, ch.radius + length + 1);
                                                outline.Thickness = ch.width + 1.5;
                                        end;
                                end;
                        end;
                end));
        end;

local _HITSOUND_GITHUB_BASE = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/j1scxx/bobhook-icons/main/hitsounds/";
local function LoadHitsoundsFromDisk(onDownloaded)
    local result = {};
    local folder = (Library and Library.Directory) or 'rivals';
    local dir = folder .. '/hitsounds';
    pcall(makefolder, dir);

    local function tryLoad(name, path)
        local ok, asset = pcall(getcustomasset, path);
        if ok and asset and asset ~= '' then
            result[name] = asset;
            return true;
        end;
        return false;
    end;

    local function splitExt(fname)
        local dot = fname:reverse():find("%.") or 0;
        if dot == 0 then return fname, "" end;
        local len = #fname;
        local cutAt = len - dot + 1;
        return fname:sub(1, cutAt - 1), fname:sub(cutAt + 1);
    end;

    local okList, fileList = pcall(function() return listfiles(dir) end);
    if okList and type(fileList) == "table" then
        for _, fullPath in ipairs(fileList) do
            local fname = fullPath;
            local lastSlash = math.max(
                fullPath:reverse():find("/") and (#fullPath - fullPath:reverse():find("/") + 1) or 0,
                fullPath:reverse():find("\\") and (#fullPath - fullPath:reverse():find("\\") + 1) or 0
            );
            if lastSlash > 0 and lastSlash < #fullPath then
                fname = fullPath:sub(lastSlash + 1);
            end;
            if not fname:match("%.wav$") and not fname:match("%.mp3$") then
            else
                local name, ext = splitExt(fname);
                local lower_ext = string.lower(ext);
                if (lower_ext == "wav" or lower_ext == "mp3") and name ~= "" then
                    tryLoad(name, fullPath);
                end;
            end;
        end;
    end;

    local missing = {};
    for name, ext in pairs(_HITSOUND_FILES) do
        if not result[name] then
            local path = dir .. '/' .. name .. '.' .. ext;
            if not tryLoad(name, path) then
                table.insert(missing, name .. '.' .. ext);
            end;
        end;
    end;

    if #missing > 0 then
        task.spawn(function()
            pcall(function()
                for _, fname in ipairs(missing) do
                    local name, ext = splitExt(fname);
                    local path = dir .. '/' .. fname;
                    if not isfile(path) then
                        local ok, data = pcall(function()
                            return game:HttpGet(_HITSOUND_GITHUB_BASE .. fname);
                        end);
                        if ok and data and #data > 0 then
                            pcall(writefile, path, data);
                        end;
                    end;
                    local loaded = tryLoad(name, path);
                    if loaded and onDownloaded then
                        pcall(onDownloaded, name, result[name]);
                    end;
                end;
            end);
        end);
    end;

    return result;
end;

        do
                local function refreshHitsoundNames()
                        local t = {};
                        for k in pairs(V.hitsounds) do table.insert(t, k) end;
                        table.sort(t);
                        V.hitsoundNames = t;
                end;

                V.hitsoundRefreshCallbacks = {};

                V.hitsounds = LoadHitsoundsFromDisk(function(name, asset)
                        refreshHitsoundNames();
                        for _, cb in ipairs(V.hitsoundRefreshCallbacks) do
                                pcall(cb, name, asset);
                        end;
                end);
                if not next(V.hitsounds) then
                    V.hitsounds['Default'] = 'rbxassetid://6534947869';
                end;
                refreshHitsoundNames();

                V.hitsoundSound = Instance.new("Sound");
                V.hitsoundSound.Parent = workspace;
                V.hitsoundSound.Volume = 1;
                V.hitsoundDebounce = false;

                V.damageNumbersActive = {};
                V.damageNumbersIdx = 0;
                V.damageNumByPart = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" });

                local function damageNumberSpawn(position, text, hitPart)
                        local dmgValue = tonumber(text);

                        if hitPart and dmgValue then
                                local existing = V.damageNumByPart[hitPart];
                                if existing and existing.gui and existing.gui.Parent then
                                        existing.accumulated = (existing.accumulated or 0) + dmgValue;
                                        existing.start = tick();
                                        -- update both split labels with the new accumulated text
                                        local full = tostring(existing.accumulated);
                                        local mid  = math.ceil(#full / 2);
                                        if existing.labelL then existing.labelL.Text = full:sub(1, mid) end;
                                        if existing.labelR then existing.labelR.Text = full:sub(mid + 1) end;
                                        return;
                                end;
                        end;

                        V.damageNumbersIdx = V.damageNumbersIdx + 1;
                        local idx = V.damageNumbersIdx;
                        V.damageNumbersActive[idx] = {
                                gui       = Instance.new("ScreenGui"),
                                start     = tick(),
                                pos       = position,
                                idx       = idx,
                                hitPart   = hitPart,
                                accumulated = dmgValue,
                        };
                        local data = V.damageNumbersActive[idx];
                        data.gui.Name        = "DamageNumber";
                        data.gui.ResetOnSpawn = false;
                        data.gui.Parent      = _LocalPlayer.PlayerGui;

                        -- Split the number into a left and right half for the snap animation.
                        -- e.g. "100" -> left="10", right="0"
                        --      "47"  -> left="4",  right="7"
                        --      "5"   -> left="5",  right=""  (single digit: only left label visible)
                        local full = text;
                        local mid  = math.ceil(#full / 2);
                        local leftText  = full:sub(1, mid);
                        local rightText = full:sub(mid + 1);

                        local fontObj = (getgenv().Fonts and getgenv().Fonts.Loaded
                                and getgenv().Fonts.Loaded[V.hit.damageNumbersFont]) or nil;

                        local function makeLabel(txt, anchorX)
                                local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel");
                                lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1;
                                lbl.Text = txt;
                                lbl.TextColor3 = V.hit.damageNumbersColor;
                                if fontObj then lbl.FontFace = fontObj;
                                else lbl.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold; end;
                                lbl.TextSize = V.hit.damageNumbersSize;
                                lbl.Size     = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 40);
                                lbl.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(anchorX, 0.5);
                                lbl.TextXAlignment = anchorX == 1
                                        and Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
                                        or  Enum.TextXAlignment.Left;
                                lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5;
                                lbl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0);
                                lbl.Parent = data.gui;
                                return lbl;
                        end;

                        -- anchorX=1 -> right-aligned, so it grows leftward from centre
                        -- anchorX=0 -> left-aligned, so it grows rightward from centre
                        data.labelL = makeLabel(leftText,  1);
                        data.labelR = makeLabel(rightText, 0);
                        -- keep .label pointing at labelL for the accumulation path above
                        data.label = data.labelL;

                        if hitPart then V.damageNumByPart[hitPart] = data end;

                        -- How quickly the halves snap together (seconds to fully merge)
                        local MERGE_TIME = 0.18;
                        -- Max pixel spread on each side at spawn
                        local SPREAD = 28;

                        data.conn = _RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
                                if not V.damageNumbersActive[idx] then return end;
                                local elapsed = tick() - data.start;
                                if elapsed >= V.hit.damageNumbersDuration then
                                        data.conn:Disconnect();
                                        pcall(function() data.gui:Destroy() end);
                                        V.damageNumbersActive[idx] = nil;
                                        if data.hitPart and V.damageNumByPart[data.hitPart] == data then
                                                V.damageNumByPart[data.hitPart] = nil;
                                        end;
                                        return;
                                end;

                                local sp = workspace.CurrentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(data.pos);
                                local screenX = sp.X;
                                local screenY = sp.Y - elapsed * 60;

                                -- Merge progress: goes 1->0 over MERGE_TIME using an ease-out curve
                                local mergeT  = math.max(0, 1 - (elapsed / MERGE_TIME));
                                local spread  = SPREAD * (mergeT * mergeT); -- ease-out: fast snap

                                -- Fade out over the back half of the duration
                                local fadeStart = V.hit.damageNumbersDuration * 0.5;
                                local alpha = elapsed > fadeStart
                                        and ((elapsed - fadeStart) / (V.hit.damageNumbersDuration - fadeStart))
                                        or 0;

                                local function applyLabel(lbl, offsetX)
                                        lbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(screenX + offsetX, screenY);
                                        lbl.TextTransparency = alpha;
                                        lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5 + 0.5 * alpha;
                                end;

                                applyLabel(data.labelL, -spread);  -- left half moves right
                                applyLabel(data.labelR,  spread);  -- right half moves left
                        end));
                end;
                V._damageNumberSpawn = damageNumberSpawn;

                V.hitParticleFolder = Instance.new("Folder");
                V.hitParticleFolder.Name = "HitParticles";
                V.hitParticleFolder.Parent = workspace;
                V.hitParticlePart = Instance.new("Part");
                V.hitParticlePart.Size = Vector3.new(0.01, 0.01, 0.01);
                V.hitParticlePart.Transparency = 1;
                V.hitParticlePart.CanCollide = false;
                V.hitParticlePart.Anchored = true;
                V.hitParticlePart.Parent = V.hitParticleFolder;

                end;

                hitParticleCreateEmitter("bubble1", {

                local function hitParticleEmit(position)
                        if not V.hit.hitParticleBehindWalls then
                                local ray = Ray.new(workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position, position - workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position);
                                local hitPart = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(ray, {_LocalPlayer.Character, V.hitParticleFolder});
                                if hitPart and (hitPart.Position - position).Magnitude > 5 then return end;
                        end;
                        local data = V.hitParticleMap[V.hit.hitParticleType];
                        if not data then return end;
                        V.hitParticlePart.CFrame = CFrame.new(position);
                        for _, name in ipairs(data[1]) do
                                local emitter = V.hitParticlePart:FindFirstChild(name);
                                if emitter then emitter:Emit(data[2]) end;
                        end;
                end;
