                workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(inst)
                        if inst.ClassName ~= "BillboardGui" or inst.Name ~= "DamageGui" then return end;
                        if not inst.Parent or not inst.Parent:IsA("BasePart") then return end;
                        local hitPart = inst.Parent;
                        local hitPos = hitPart.Position;

                        _recentDamageGuiTime = tick();
                        _recentDamageGuiPos  = hitPos;
                        if V.tracers and V.tracers.enabled
                                and V.tracerState and V.tracerState.active then
                                local now = tick();
                                for _, t in ipairs(V.tracerState.active) do
                                        if not t.hitConfirmed
                                                and (now - t.creationTime) < 0.4
                                                and t.endPos
                                                and (t.endPos - hitPos).Magnitude < 12 then
                                                t.hitConfirmed = true;
                                                t.tracerColor  = V.tracers.hitColor or V.tracers.color;
                                                if t.beam and t.beam.Parent then
                                                        t.beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(t.tracerColor);
                                                end;
                                        end;
                                end;
                        end;

                        if V.hit.hitsoundEnabled and not V.hitsoundDebounce then
                                V.hitsoundDebounce = true;
                                V.hitsoundSound.SoundId = V.hitsounds[V.hit.hitsoundSelected] or "rbxassetid://6534947869";
                                V.hitsoundSound.Volume = V.hit.hitsoundVolume;
                                V.hitsoundSound:Play();
                                task.delay(0.1, function() V.hitsoundDebounce = false end);
                        end;

                        if V.hit.hitParticlesEnabled and not V.hitParticleDebounce then
                                V.hitParticleDebounce = true;
                                hitParticleEmit(hitPos);
                                task.delay(0.1, function() V.hitParticleDebounce = false end);
                        end;

                        if V.hit.damageNumbersEnabled then
                                -- Helper: extract damage value from a BillboardGui.
                                -- Tries TextLabel children first, then scans all
                                -- attributes for any numeric value.
                                local function extractDamage(bbgui)
                                        -- 1. Look for a TextLabel with non-empty text
                                        for _, child in ipairs(bbgui:GetChildren()) do
                                                if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
                                                        local t = child.Text;
                                                        if t and t ~= "" and t ~= " " and tonumber(t) ~= nil then
                                                                return t;
                                                        end;
                                                end;
                                        end;
                                        -- 2. Try common attribute keys
                                        for _, key in ipairs({ "Value", "Amount", "Damage", "Dmg", "HitDamage", "DamageValue", "DamageAmount" }) do
                                                local attr = bbgui:GetAttribute(key);
                                                if attr ~= nil then
                                                        return tostring(attr);
                                                end;
                                        end;
                                        -- 3. Scan ALL attributes for any numeric value
                                        local allAttrs = bbgui:GetAttributes();
                                        for key, val in pairs(allAttrs) do
                                                if type(val) == "number" then
                                                        return tostring(val);
                                                end;
                                        end;
                                        return nil;
                                end;

                                -- Try immediately (synchronous)
                                local dmgText = extractDamage(inst);
                                if dmgText then
                                        damageNumberSpawn(hitPos, dmgText, hitPart);
                                else
                                        -- BillboardGui may be created empty and populated next frame.
                                        -- Wait a frame and try again.
                                        task.spawn(function()
                                                task.wait(0.05);
                                                if not inst.Parent then return end;
                                                local delayed = extractDamage(inst);
                                                if delayed then
                                                        damageNumberSpawn(hitPos, delayed, hitPart);
                                                end;
                                        end);
                                        -- Also listen for a TextLabel being added later
                                        inst.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
                                                if child:IsA("TextLabel") then
                                                        task.wait(0.02);
                                                        local t = child.Text;
                                                        if t and t ~= "" and t ~= " " then
                                                                damageNumberSpawn(hitPos, t, hitPart);
                                                        end;
                                                end;
                                        end);
                                end;
                        end;
                end);
        end;

        local function BuildTracerGrid()
                for _, c in _tracerGrid:GetChildren() do c:Destroy() end;
                local W = _tracerPreviewInside.AbsoluteSize.X;
                local H = _tracerPreviewInside.AbsoluteSize.Y;
                if W <= 0 or H <= 0 then return end;
                local GS = 20;
                for I = 0, math.ceil(W / GS) + 1 do
                        Library:CreateInstance("Frame", {
                                Parent                 = _tracerGrid;
                                Position               = UDim2.fromOffset(I * GS, 0);
                                Size                   = UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, 0);
                                BackgroundColor3       = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255);
                                BackgroundTransparency = 0.92;
                                BorderSizePixel        = 0;
                                ZIndex                 = 1;
                        });
                end;
                for I = 0, math.ceil(H / GS) + 1 do
                        Library:CreateInstance("Frame", {
                                Parent                 = _tracerGrid;
                                Position               = UDim2.fromOffset(0, I * GS);
                                Size                   = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1);
                                BackgroundColor3       = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255);
                                BackgroundTransparency = 0.92;
                                BorderSizePixel        = 0;
                                ZIndex                 = 1;
                        });
                end;
        end;
        _tracerPreviewInside:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
                BuildTracerGrid();
        end);

        V.refreshTracerPreview = function()
                local styleName = V.tracers.style;
                local style = V.tracerStyles[styleName] or V.tracerStyles["new_laser"];
                if not style then return end;

        -- table that the weapon-mods engine reads, so the same
        -- applyOverrides() pipeline applies them to every gun.
        -- =========================================================
        local SecGun = TabVisuals2:Section({ Name = "gun", Side = "Right" });

        -- No Muzzle Flash: directly disables ParticleEmitters on the
        -- equipped tool's WeaponHandle.Muzzle attachment (works for
        -- every Criminality gun because they all share that structure).
        SecGun:Toggle({
                Name = "no muzzle flash", Flag = "WM_NoMuzzle", Default = false,
                Callback = function(val)
                        local _wm = _G.WMState;
                        if _wm then
                                _wm.muzzle = val and 0 or 1;
                                -- Trigger re-apply by calling applyToAll via _G
                                local _fn = _G.WMApplyToAll;
                                if _fn then pcall(_fn) end;
                        end;
                end,
        });

        -- AND tells the __namecall hook to skip the tracer that the
        -- gun's fire remote would normally spawn.

                Callback = function(val)
                        local _wm = _G.WMState;
                        if _wm then
                                _wm.tracers = val and 0 or 1;
                                local _fn = _G.WMApplyToAll;
                                if _fn then pcall(_fn) end;
                        end;
                end,
        });

        -- module. Works for any gun whose equip code reads Config
        -- dynamically (most Criminality guns do).
        local _equipToggle = SecGun:Toggle({
                Name = "fast equip", Flag = "WM_FastEquip", Default = false,

                        end;
                end,
        });

        local LoadedSkyboxes = {};
        local function RefreshSkyboxes()
                table.clear(LoadedSkyboxes);
                if not isfolder(SkyboxFolder) then return end;
                for _, FilePath in listfiles(SkyboxFolder) do
                        FilePath = FilePath:gsub("\\", "/");
                        if string.find(FilePath, "%.json$") then
                                local Ok, Raw = pcall(readfile, FilePath);
                                if Ok and Raw then
                                        local Ok2, Data = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, Raw);
                                        if Ok2 and Data and Data.name then
                                                table.insert(LoadedSkyboxes, Data);
                                        end;
                                end;
                        end;
                end;
                table.sort(LoadedSkyboxes, function(A, B) return A.name < B.name end);
        end;
        RefreshSkyboxes();

        -- =========================================================
        -- SKYBOX TEXTURE PRELOAD
        -- The user reported that scrolling the skybox list takes AGES
        -- to load thumbnails, AND that applying a skybox doesn't go on
        -- instantly. Both symptoms have the same root cause: Roblox
        -- fetches the rbxassetid textures from the asset CDN on first
        -- use, so the first time you click a skybox (or scroll past a
        -- row whose thumbnail hasn't been seen yet) you wait for the
        -- HTTP fetch + GPU upload.
        --
        -- Fix: preload every skybox face texture + every preview
        -- thumbnail upfront via ContentProvider:PreloadAsync. After
        -- this runs, clicking a skybox applies instantly and scrolling
        -- the list shows thumbnails with zero perceptible delay.
        -- =========================================================
        task.spawn(function()
                pcall(function()
                        local _CP = game:GetService("ContentProvider");
                        local _toPreload = {};
                        for _, _sb in ipairs(LoadedSkyboxes) do
                                if _sb.preview and _sb.preview ~= "" then
                                        table.insert(_toPreload, _sb.preview);
                                end;
                                if _sb.faces then
                                        for _, _id in pairs(_sb.faces) do
                                                if _id and _id ~= "" then
                                                        table.insert(_toPreload, _id);
                                                end;
                                        end;
                                end;
                        end;
                        -- PreloadAsync takes a table; it yields until each
                        -- asset is fetched or fails. Run in a background
                        -- thread so it doesn't block the rest of the script.
                        _CP:PreloadAsync(_toPreload);
                end);
        end);

        local OriginalSky = nil;
        local CurrentSkybox = nil;

        local function GetSky()
                local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting");
                local Sky = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky");
                if not Sky then
                        Sky = Instance.new("Sky");
                        Sky.Parent = Lighting;
                end;
                return Sky;
        end;

        local function SaveOriginalSky()
                if OriginalSky then return end;
                local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting");
                local Sky = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Sky");
                if Sky then
                        OriginalSky = {
                                SkyboxBk = Sky.SkyboxBk; SkyboxDn = Sky.SkyboxDn; SkyboxFt = Sky.SkyboxFt;
                                SkyboxLf = Sky.SkyboxLf; SkyboxRt = Sky.SkyboxRt; SkyboxUp = Sky.SkyboxUp;
                                MoonTextureId = Sky.MoonTextureId; SunTextureId = Sky.SunTextureId;
                                StarCount = Sky.StarCount; SunAngularSize = Sky.SunAngularSize;
                        };
                end;
        end;

        local function ApplySkybox(Data)
                if not Data then return end;
                SaveOriginalSky();
                CurrentSkybox = Data;
                local Sky = GetSky();
                local F = Data.faces or {};
                Sky.SkyboxBk = F.Bk or "";
                Sky.SkyboxDn = F.Dn or "";
                Sky.SkyboxFt = F.Ft or "";
                Sky.SkyboxLf = F.Lf or "";
                Sky.SkyboxRt = F.Rt or "";
                Sky.SkyboxUp = F.Up or "";
                Sky.MoonTextureId   = Data.moonTextureId   or "";
                Sky.SunTextureId    = Data.sunTextureId    or "";
                Sky.StarCount       = Data.starCount       or 0;
                Sky.SunAngularSize  = Data.sunAngularSize  or 21;
                Sky.MoonAngularSize = Data.moonAngularSize or 11;
                local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting");
                local CelestialObj = Lighting:FindFirstChild("Atmosphere") or Sky;
                if Data.celestialBodiesShown == false then
                        Sky.SunTextureId  = "";
                        Sky.MoonTextureId = "";
                end;
        end;

        local function ResetSkybox()
                if not OriginalSky then return end;
                local Sky = GetSky();
                Sky.SkyboxBk       = OriginalSky.SkyboxBk;
                Sky.SkyboxDn       = OriginalSky.SkyboxDn;
                Sky.SkyboxFt       = OriginalSky.SkyboxFt;
                Sky.SkyboxLf       = OriginalSky.SkyboxLf;
                Sky.SkyboxRt       = OriginalSky.SkyboxRt;
                Sky.SkyboxUp       = OriginalSky.SkyboxUp;
                Sky.MoonTextureId  = OriginalSky.MoonTextureId;
                Sky.SunTextureId   = OriginalSky.SunTextureId;
                Sky.StarCount      = OriginalSky.StarCount;
                Sky.SunAngularSize = OriginalSky.SunAngularSize;
                CurrentSkybox = nil;
        end;

        local WeatherWorkspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
        local WeatherRunService = game:GetService("RunService")
        local WeatherEnv = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G

        -- Tear down any previous instance before installing this one.
        if WeatherEnv.__WeatherCleanup then
            pcall(WeatherEnv.__WeatherCleanup)
        end

        local WeatherToken = {}
        WeatherEnv.__WeatherToken = WeatherToken

        local WeatherState = {
            Part      = nil,
            Emitters  = {},
            Active    = nil,
        }

        local function weatherClearEmitters()
            for _, record in ipairs(WeatherState.Emitters) do
                if record.Emitter then
                    pcall(function() record.Emitter:Destroy() end)
                end
            end
            table.clear(WeatherState.Emitters)
            WeatherState.Active = nil
        end

        local function weatherEnsurePart()
            local part = WeatherState.Part
            if part and part.Parent then return part end
            part = Instance.new("Part")
            part.Anchored       = true
            part.CanCollide     = false
            part.CanQuery      = false
            part.CanTouch      = false
            part.CastShadow    = false
            part.Transparency  = 1
            part.Size          = Vector3.new(140, 1, 140)
            part.Parent        = WeatherWorkspace
            WeatherState.Part  = part
            WeatherState.Active = nil
            return part
        end

        local function weatherRebuild(presetName)
            local specs = WEATHER_PRESETS[presetName]
            weatherClearEmitters()
            local part = WeatherState.Part
            if not specs or not part then return end
            WeatherState.Active = presetName
            for _, spec in ipairs(specs) do
                local emitter = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
                emitter.Shape             = Enum.ParticleEmitterShape.Box
                emitter.EmissionDirection = Enum.NormalId.Bottom
                emitter.Enabled          = true
                emitter.Texture          = spec.Texture
                emitter.Transparency     = NumberSequence.new({
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.15, spec.TransparencyMax),
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.85, spec.TransparencyMax),
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
                })
                emitter.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(spec.LifetimeMin, spec.LifetimeMax)
                emitter.Rotation = NumberRange.new(spec.RotationMin, spec.RotationMax)
                emitter.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(spec.RotationSpeedMin, spec.RotationSpeedMax)
                emitter.LightInfluence = 0
                if spec.Orientation then
                    emitter.Orientation = spec.Orientation
                end
                emitter.Parent = part
                table.insert(WeatherState.Emitters, { Emitter = emitter, Spec = spec })
            end
        end

        local function weatherScaleSizeSequence(startValue, endValue, scale)
            return NumberSequence.new({
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, startValue * scale),
                NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, endValue * scale),
            })
        end

        local function weatherReconcile()
            local intensity = math.max(0, WeatherConfig.Intensity)
            local rate      = math.max(0, WeatherConfig.Rate)
            local speed     = math.max(0, WeatherConfig.Speed)
            local size      = math.max(0, WeatherConfig.Size)
            local spread    = math.max(0, WeatherConfig.Spread)
            local glow      = math.clamp(WeatherConfig.Glow, 0, 1)
            local color     = typeof(WeatherConfig.Color) == "Color3" and WeatherConfig.Color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            local angle     = math.rad(WeatherConfig.WindAngle)
            local windX     = math.sin(angle) * WeatherConfig.WindStrength
            local windZ     = math.cos(angle) * WeatherConfig.WindStrength
            for _, record in ipairs(WeatherState.Emitters) do
                local emitter, spec = record.Emitter, record.Spec
                if emitter and emitter.Parent and spec then
                    emitter.Rate          = spec.BaseRate * intensity * rate
                    emitter.Speed         = NumberRange.new(spec.SpeedMin * speed, spec.SpeedMax * speed)
                    emitter.Size          = weatherScaleSizeSequence(spec.SizeStart, spec.SizeEnd, size)
                    emitter.LightEmission = glow
                    local spreadAngle     = spec.BaseSpread * spread
                    emitter.SpreadAngle   = Vector2.new(spreadAngle, spreadAngle)
                    emitter.Color         = ColorSequence.new(color)
                    emitter.Acceleration  = Vector3.new(windX, spec.BaseAccelerationY, windZ)
                end
            end
        end

        local function weatherDestroy()
            weatherClearEmitters()
            local part = WeatherState.Part
            WeatherState.Part = nil
            if part then
                pcall(function() part:Destroy() end)
            end
        end

        local function weatherRefresh()
            if not WeatherConfig.Enabled then
                if WeatherState.Part then weatherDestroy() end
                return
            end
            local preset = WEATHER_PRESETS[WeatherConfig.Preset] and WeatherConfig.Preset or "Snow"
            weatherEnsurePart()
            if WeatherState.Active ~= preset then
                weatherRebuild(preset)
            end
            weatherReconcile()
        end

        local WeatherFollowConn = _RegisterHeartbeat(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if WeatherEnv.__WeatherToken ~= WeatherToken then return end
            local part = WeatherState.Part
            local camera = WeatherWorkspace.CurrentCamera
            if part and part.Parent and camera then
                part.Position = camera.CFrame.Position + Vector3.new(0, WeatherConfig.Height, 0)
            end
        end))

        task.spawn(function()
            while WeatherEnv.__WeatherToken == WeatherToken do
                local ok, err = pcall(weatherRefresh)
                if not ok then
                    warn("[Weather] " .. tostring(err))
                end
                task.wait(0.5)
            end
        end)

        WeatherEnv.__WeatherCleanup = function()
            WeatherEnv.__WeatherToken = nil
            pcall(function() WeatherFollowConn:Disconnect() end)
            weatherDestroy()
            WeatherEnv.__WeatherCleanup = nil
        end

            SetColor    = function(c) WeatherConfig.Color   = c end,
            SetIntensity= function(v) WeatherConfig.Intensity = tonumber(v) or 1 end,
            SetRate     = function(v) WeatherConfig.Rate      = tonumber(v) or 1 end,
            SetSpeed    = function(v) WeatherConfig.Speed     = tonumber(v) or 1 end,
            SetSize     = function(v) WeatherConfig.Size      = tonumber(v) or 1 end,
            SetSpread   = function(v) WeatherConfig.Spread    = tonumber(v) or 25 end,
        }

        local function GetOrMakeBloom()

                        or Lighting:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BlurEffect");
                if not E then
                        E = Instance.new("BlurEffect");
                        E.Parent = Lighting;
                end
                return E;
        end;

                return Lighting;
        end;

                        SetSelected(true);

        local function HoursToTimeString(H)
                local TotalSec = math.floor(H * 3600);
                local Hh = math.floor(TotalSec / 3600) % 24;
                local Mm = math.floor((TotalSec % 3600) / 60);
                local Ss = TotalSec % 60;
                return string.format("%02d:%02d:%02d", Hh, Mm, Ss);
        end;

        local CurrentHour = (function()
                local Parts = string.split(Lighting.TimeOfDay, ":");
                return (tonumber(Parts[1]) or 0) + (tonumber(Parts[2]) or 0) / 60;
        end)();

        local StripDragging = false;
        local function StripSetFromX(Px)
                local Ap = SkyStripInside.AbsolutePosition;
                local Sz = SkyStripInside.AbsoluteSize;
                if Sz.X <= 0 then return end;
                local T = math.clamp((Px - Ap.X) / Sz.X, 0, 1);
                CurrentHour = T * 24;
                TimeCursor.Position    = UDim2.new(T, 0, 0, 0);
                local TimeStr = HoursToTimeString(CurrentHour);
                TimeStripLbl.Text      = TimeStr;
                TimeDisplayLbl.Text    = "time of day  ·  " .. TimeStr;
                Lighting.TimeOfDay     = TimeStr;
        end;

        Library:Connection(SkyStripInside.InputBegan, function(Input)
                if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                or Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        StripDragging = true;
                        StripSetFromX(Input.Position.X);
                end;
        end);
        Library:Connection(game:GetService("UserInputService").InputEnded, function(Input)
                if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                or Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        StripDragging = false;
                end;
        end);
        Library:Connection(game:GetService("UserInputService").InputChanged, function(Input)
                if not StripDragging then return end;
                if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                or Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        StripSetFromX(Input.Position.X);
                end;
        end);

        local WVToggle = SecWorld:Toggle({
                Name = "enable world visuals";
                Default = false;
                Callback = function(V)
                        WorldVisualsEnabled = V;
                        if V then
                                if AmbientToggle:Get() then
                                        Lighting.Ambient        = CurrentAmbient;
                                        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = CurrentOutdoorAmb;
                                end;
                                if BloomToggle:Get() then
                                        GetOrMakeBloom().Enabled = true;
                                end;
                                if BlurToggle:Get() then
                                        local E = GetOrMakeBlur(); E.Enabled = true; E.Size = 24;
                                end;
                                if FogToggle:Get() then
                                        Lighting.FogEnd   = 500;
                                        Lighting.FogStart = 0;
                                        Lighting.FogColor = FogCurrentColor;
                                end;
                        else
                                if SkyboxChangerEnabled then ResetSkybox() end;
                                Lighting.Ambient        = OrigLighting.Ambient;
                                Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = OrigLighting.OutdoorAmbient;
                                Lighting.Brightness     = OrigLighting.Brightness;
                                Lighting.FogEnd         = OrigLighting.FogEnd;
                                Lighting.FogStart       = OrigLighting.FogStart;
                                Lighting.FogColor       = OrigLighting.FogColor;
                                local B = GetOrMakeBloom(); B.Enabled = OrigBloom and OrigBloom.Enabled or false;
                                local Bl = GetOrMakeBlur();
                                Bl.Enabled = OrigBlur and OrigBlur.Enabled or false;
                                Bl.Size    = OrigBlur and OrigBlur.Size or 0;
                                local CC = GetOrMakeCC();
                                CC.Enabled = OrigCC and OrigCC.Enabled or false;
                                CC.Brightness = OrigCC and OrigCC.Brightness or 0;
                                CC.Contrast = OrigCC and OrigCC.Contrast or 0;
                                CC.Saturation = OrigCC and OrigCC.Saturation or 0;
                                CC.TintColor = OrigCC and OrigCC.TintColor or Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255);
                                local SR = GetOrMakeSunRays();
                                SR.Enabled = OrigSunRays and OrigSunRays.Enabled or false;
                                SR.Intensity = OrigSunRays and OrigSunRays.Intensity or 0;
                                SR.Spread = OrigSunRays and OrigSunRays.Spread or 0;
                                Lighting.GlobalShadows = OrigLighting.GlobalShadows;
                        end;
                end;
        });
        WVToggle.Container.LayoutOrder = -4;

        local BrightnessSlider     = SecWorld:Slider({ Name = "brightness"; Min = 0; Max = 3; Step = 0.01; Decimals = 2; Default = Lighting.Brightness; Callback = function(V) if WorldVisualsEnabled then Lighting.Brightness = V end end });

        -- ============================================================
        -- WORLD VISUALS RE-APPLY LOOP (improved)
        -- The game updates Lighting/Sky properties every frame on map
        -- change, weather events, day/night cycle, etc. Our world visuals
        -- get overwritten.
        --
        -- A previous attempt used hookmetamethod on __newindex to block
        -- the game's writes. That was WRONG: hooking __newindex on `game`
        -- intercepts EVERY property write across the entire engine (not
        -- just Lighting), and the hook's `_oldNI(self, key, value)` call
        -- doesn't propagate cleanly to all instance types — the result
        -- was 200+ "attempt to call a nil value" errors per second across
        -- Sound, Camera, Crosshair, Backpack, Effects, ControlModule, etc.
        --
        -- Reverted to the re-apply loop, but tightened to 0.2s (down from
        -- 2s) so flicker is barely perceptible. Each iteration is a small
        -- fixed set of property assignments — cheap enough to run 5x/sec.
        -- ============================================================
        task.spawn(function()
                while true do
                        task.wait(0.2)
                        pcall(function()
                                if not WorldVisualsEnabled then return end
                                -- Re-apply skybox
                                if SkyboxChangerEnabled and CurrentSkybox then
                                        ApplySkybox(CurrentSkybox)
                                end
                                -- Re-apply ambient
                                if AmbientToggle:Get() then
                                        Lighting.Ambient        = CurrentAmbient
                                        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = CurrentOutdoorAmb
                                end
                                -- Re-apply brightness
                                if BrightnessSlider then
                                        Lighting.Brightness = BrightnessSlider:Get()
                                end
                                -- Re-apply fog
                                if FogToggle:Get() then
                                        Lighting.FogEnd   = 500
                                        Lighting.FogStart = 0
                                        Lighting.FogColor = FogCurrentColor
                                end
                                -- Re-apply bloom/blur/CC/sunrays
                                if BloomToggle:Get() then
                                        local B = GetOrMakeBloom()
                                        B.Enabled = true
                                        B.Intensity = BloomIntensitySlider:Get()
                                        B.Size      = BloomSizeSlider:Get()
                                        B.Threshold = BloomThresholdSlider:Get()
                                end
                                if BlurToggle:Get() then
                                        local Bl = GetOrMakeBlur()
                                        Bl.Enabled = true
                                end
                                if CCToggle:Get() then
                                        local CC = GetOrMakeCC()
                                        CC.Enabled = true
                                end
                                if SunRaysToggle:Get() then
                                        local SR = GetOrMakeSunRays()
                                        SR.Enabled = true
                                end
                                -- Re-apply weather
                                if WeatherToggle:Get() then
                                        local api = WeatherEnv.__WeatherAPI
                                        if api then api.SetEnabled(true) end
                                end
                        end)
                end
        end)

end

local TabMisc     = w:Tab({ Name = "misc" });


-- ============================================================
-- MISC TAB
-- ============================================================
do
    local _lp  = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local _UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local _cam = workspace.CurrentCamera

    local function _getChar() return _lp.Character end
    local function _getHum()
        local c = _getChar()
        return c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    end
    local function _getHRP()
        local c = _getChar()
        return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    end

    local SecMovement = TabMisc:Section({ Name = "movement", Side = "Left" })

    -- ── RAGDOLL FLY (new implementation via __newindex hook) ───
    -- The user's new code uses a __newindex hook on HumanoidRootPart
    -- to lock the CFrame while fly is active, plus a single Heartbeat
    -- loop that writes AssemblyLinearVelocity based on input. The Adonis
    -- bypass pcall that was at the top of the user's snippet is removed
    -- here because the main script already has it at the very top.
    local _ragFlyEnabled = false
    local RAG_FLY_SPEED   = 60

    local _RS  = game:GetService("RunService")
    local _Rep = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local _evtFolder  = _Rep:FindFirstChild("Events")
    local _evt2Folder = _Rep:FindFirstChild("Events2")

    local _ragFlyState = {
        Active    = false,
        DesiredCF = nil,
        AnimTrack = nil,
        PM        = nil,
        PC        = nil,
        RZDONL    = nil,
        NextSend  = 0,
        EvArgs    = { "-r__r3" },
    }

    local _ragFlyAnim = Instance.new("Animation")
    _ragFlyAnim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://507768375"

    local function _ragFlyOn()
        if _ragFlyState.Active then return end
        local char = _lp.Character
        if not (char and char.Parent) then return end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not (hrp and hum) then return end

        _ragFlyState.Active    = true
        _ragFlyState.DesiredCF = hrp.CFrame

        pcall(function() hum.PlatformStand = true end)

        pcall(function()
            local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or hum
            if _ragFlyState.AnimTrack then
                pcall(function() _ragFlyState.AnimTrack:Stop(0) end)
                _ragFlyState.AnimTrack = nil
            end
            _ragFlyState.AnimTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(_ragFlyAnim)
            _ragFlyState.AnimTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
            _ragFlyState.AnimTrack.Looped   = true
            _ragFlyState.AnimTrack:Play()
        end)
    end

    local function _ragFlyOff()
        if not _ragFlyState.Active then return end

        _ragFlyState.Active    = false
        _ragFlyState.DesiredCF = nil

        if _ragFlyState.AnimTrack then
            pcall(function() _ragFlyState.AnimTrack:Stop(0.3) end)
            _ragFlyState.AnimTrack = nil
        end

        local char = _lp.Character
        local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum and hum.Parent then
            pcall(function() hum.PlatformStand = false end)
            pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end)
        end
    end

    -- Install the __newindex hook ONCE. While the fly is active, any
    -- attempt to write CFrame/Position on the local HumanoidRootPart is
    -- redirected to our DesiredCF (which we update from the Heartbeat
    -- loop based on input). AllowNextSet is a one-shot bypass we can set
    -- when we want to actually write a new CFrame ourselves.
    if not getgenv()._RAGDOLL_FLY_NI_HOOKED then
        getgenv()._RAGDOLL_FLY_NI_HOOKED = true
        pcall(function()
            local oldNI
            oldNI = hookmetamethod(game, "__newindex", function(t, k, v)
                if _ragFlyState.Active
                   and not _ragFlyState.AllowNextSet
                   and t and t:IsA("BasePart")
                   and t.Name == "HumanoidRootPart"
                   and (k == "CFrame" or k == "Position") then
                    if _ragFlyState.DesiredCF then
                        return oldNI(t, k, _ragFlyState.DesiredCF)
                    end
                end
                return oldNI(t, k, v)
            end)
        end)
    end

    -- Single Heartbeat loop: refreshes PlatformStand, fires the
    -- __RZDONL keepalive remote (anti-ragdoll), reads input via the
    -- PlayerModule controls, writes velocity + DesiredCF.
    _RS.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        pcall(function()
            if not _ragFlyState.Active then return end

            local rchar = _lp.Character
            local rhrp  = rchar and rchar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local rhum  = rchar and rchar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not (rhrp and rhum) then return end

            if not rhum.PlatformStand then
                pcall(function() rhum.PlatformStand = true end)
            end

            if not _ragFlyState.RZDONL then
                pcall(function()
                    _ragFlyState.RZDONL = (_evtFolder  and _evtFolder:FindFirstChild("__RZDONL"))
                              or (_evt2Folder and _evt2Folder:FindFirstChild("__RZDONL"))
                end)
            end

            local now2 = os.clock()
            if _ragFlyState.RZDONL and now2 >= _ragFlyState.NextSend then
                pcall(function() _ragFlyState.RZDONL:FireServer(table.unpack(_ragFlyState.EvArgs)) end)
                _ragFlyState.NextSend = now2 + 0.05
            end

            if not _ragFlyState.PM then
                local ps = _lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
                local pm = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
                if pm then
                    local ok, r = pcall(require, pm)
                    if ok then _ragFlyState.PM = r end
                end
            end
            if _ragFlyState.PM and not _ragFlyState.PC then
                local ok, ctrl = pcall(function() return _ragFlyState.PM:GetControls() end)
                if ok then _ragFlyState.PC = ctrl end
            end

            local rdir = Vector3.zero
            if _ragFlyState.PC then
                local ok, mv = pcall(function() return _ragFlyState.PC:GetMoveVector() end)
                if ok and mv then
                    local fwd = _cam.CFrame.LookVector
                    local rgt = _cam.CFrame.RightVector
                    local d   = rgt * mv.X + fwd * -mv.Z
                    if d.Magnitude > 0 then rdir = d.Unit end
                end
            end

            pcall(function() rhrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity  = rdir * RAG_FLY_SPEED end)
            pcall(function() rhrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero end)

            _ragFlyState.DesiredCF = rhrp.CFrame
        end)
    end)

    -- Reset on respawn.
    _lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        _ragFlyState.Active    = false
        _ragFlyState.AnimTrack = nil
        _ragFlyState.DesiredCF = nil
    end)

    local _ragFlyToggle = SecMovement:Toggle({
        Name    = "ragdoll fly";
        Flag    = "MiscRagdollFly";
        Default = false;
        Callback = function(V)
            _ragFlyEnabled = V
            if V then _ragFlyOn() else _ragFlyOff() end
        end;
    }):AddKeybind({
        Default  = nil;
        Mode     = "Toggle";
        Callback = function(active)
            if not _ragFlyEnabled then return end
            if active then _ragFlyOn() else _ragFlyOff() end
        end;
    })



    do
        local dlg = _ragFlyToggle:AddDialog({ Name = "settings" })

        dlg:Slider({
            Name     = "fly speed";
            Flag     = "MiscRagdollFlySpeed";
            Min      = 10;
            Max      = 150;
            Default  = 60;
            Step     = 5;
            Callback = function(V)
                RAG_FLY_SPEED = V
            end;
        })
    end

    -- shared helpers (scoped to this do-block)
    local _RS   = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local _PS   = game:GetService("Players")
    local _WS   = game:GetService("Workspace")
    local _Run  = game:GetService("RunService")

    -- ─── ALWAYS SPRINT ──────────────────────────────────────────
    local _alwaysSprintOn    = false
    local _sprintHeld        = false
    local _alwaysSprintHeart = nil
    local function _setupAlwaysSprint()
        if _alwaysSprintHeart then _alwaysSprintHeart:Disconnect() _alwaysSprintHeart = nil end
        if not _alwaysSprintOn then
            if _sprintHeld then
                pcall(function() _VIM:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift, false, game) end)
                _sprintHeld = false
            end
            return
        end
        _alwaysSprintHeart = _RegisterHeartbeat(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            local hum = _getHum()
            if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return end
            local moving = hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.1
            if moving and not _sprintHeld then
                pcall(function() _VIM:SendKeyEvent(true, Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift, false, game) end)
                _sprintHeld = true
            elseif not moving and _sprintHeld then
                pcall(function() _VIM:SendKeyEvent(false, Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift, false, game) end)
                _sprintHeld = false
            end
            -- top up stamina backup
            local cs = _getCS()
            if cs then
                local stam = nil
                local cur = cs:FindFirstChild("Currents")
                if cur then stam = cur:FindFirstChild("Stamina") end
                stam = stam or cs:FindFirstChild("Stamina")
                if stam and stam:IsA("NumberValue") and stam.Value < 100 then
                    pcall(function() stam.Value = 100 end)
                end
            end
        end))
    end
    SecMovement:Toggle({
        Name = "always sprint", Flag = "MiscAlwaysSprint", Default = false,
        Callback = function(v) _alwaysSprintOn = v; _setupAlwaysSprint() end,
    })

    -- ─── SILENT WALK ────────────────────────────────────────────
    local _silentWalkOn       = false
    local _silentWalkREPMCon  = nil
    local _silentWalkHRPCon   = nil
    local _silentWalkCharConn = nil

    local function _muteHRP(hrp)
        if not hrp then return end
        for _, v in ipairs(hrp:GetChildren()) do
            if v:IsA("Sound") or v:IsA("AudioPlayer") or v:IsA("AudioEmitter") then
                pcall(function() v:Destroy() end)
            end
        end
        if _silentWalkHRPCon then pcall(function() _silentWalkHRPCon:Disconnect() end) end
        _silentWalkHRPCon = hrp.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
            if child:IsA("Sound") or child:IsA("AudioPlayer") or child:IsA("AudioEmitter") then
                pcall(function() child:Destroy() end)
            end
        end)
    end

    local function _setupSilentWalk()
        if _silentWalkREPMCon then pcall(function() _silentWalkREPMCon:Disconnect() end) _silentWalkREPMCon = nil end
        if _silentWalkCharConn then pcall(function() _silentWalkCharConn:Disconnect() end) _silentWalkCharConn = nil end
        if _silentWalkHRPCon then pcall(function() _silentWalkHRPCon:Disconnect() end) _silentWalkHRPCon = nil end
        if not _silentWalkOn then return end
        local events = _RS:FindFirstChild("Events")
        if events then
            local repm = events:FindFirstChild("REPMVMNTSND")
            if repm then
                _silentWalkREPMCon = repm.OnClientEvent:Connect(function() end)
            end
        end
        local function hookChar(char)
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hrp then _muteHRP(hrp) end
        end
        if _lp.Character then hookChar(_lp.Character) end
        _silentWalkCharConn = _lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
            task.wait(0.5)
            hookChar(char)
        end)
    end
    SecMovement:Toggle({
        Name = "silent walk", Flag = "MiscSilentWalk", Default = false,
        Callback = function(v) _silentWalkOn = v; _setupSilentWalk() end,
    })

    -- ─── NO FALL DAMAGE ─────────────────────────────────────────
    local _noFallOn         = false
    local _noFallFallTing   = nil
    local _noFallHeart       = nil
    local _noFallLastHP      = nil
    local _noFallHumConn     = nil
    local function _setupNoFall()
        if _noFallFallTing then pcall(function() _noFallFallTing:Disconnect() end) _noFallFallTing = nil end
        if _noFallHeart   then pcall(function() _noFallHeart:Disconnect() end)   _noFallHeart   = nil end
        if _noFallHumConn then pcall(function() _noFallHumConn:Disconnect() end) _noFallHumConn = nil end
        if not _noFallOn then return end
        local events = _RS:FindFirstChild("Events")
        if events then
            local ft = events:FindFirstChild("FallTing")
            if ft then
                _noFallFallTing = ft.OnClientEvent:Connect(function() end)
            end
        end
        local function attach(char)
            if _noFallHeart then pcall(function() _noFallHeart:Disconnect() end) end
            local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
            if not hum then return end
            _noFallLastHP = hum.Health
            _noFallHeart = _RegisterHeartbeat(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
                if not hum or not hum.Parent then return end
                local current = hum.Health
                if _noFallLastHP and (_noFallLastHP - current) > 10 and current > 0 then
                    pcall(function() hum.Health = hum.MaxHealth end)
                end
                _noFallLastHP = hum.Health
            end))
        end
        if _lp.Character then attach(_lp.Character) end
        _noFallHumConn = _lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) task.wait(0.5) attach(c) end)
    end
    SecMovement:Toggle({
        Name = "no fall damage", Flag = "MiscNoFallDamage", Default = false,
        Callback = function(v) _noFallOn = v; _setupNoFall() end,
    })

    -- ─── AUTO USE ENERGY DRINK ─────────────────────────────────
    local _autoEnergyOn        = false
    local _autoEnergyThreshold = 30
    local _autoEnergyHeart      = nil
    local _autoEnergyLastUse    = 0
    local _ENERGY_DRINKS = {
        "Cola_1","Cola_2","ChocBar_1","ChocBar_2","Chips_1","Chips_2",
        "Coco_1","MonsterMashPotion","WitchesBrew",
    }
    local function _findEnergyDrink()
        local bp = _lp:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
        local char = _lp.Character
        if not bp or not char then return nil end
        for _, n in ipairs(_ENERGY_DRINKS) do
            local t = bp:FindFirstChild(n) or char:FindFirstChild(n)
            if t then return t end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function _getStaminaVal()
        local cs = _getCS()
        if not cs then return nil end
        local cur = cs:FindFirstChild("Currents")
        if cur then
            local s = cur:FindFirstChild("Stamina")
            if s then return s end
        end
        return cs:FindFirstChild("Stamina")
    end
    local function _setupAutoEnergy()
        if _autoEnergyHeart then pcall(function() _autoEnergyHeart:Disconnect() end) _autoEnergyHeart = nil end
        if not _autoEnergyOn then return end
        _autoEnergyLastUse = 0
        _autoEnergyHeart = _RegisterHeartbeat(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if (tick() - _autoEnergyLastUse) < 3 then return end
            local stam = _getStaminaVal()
            if not stam then return end
            if stam.Value >= _autoEnergyThreshold then return end
            local hum = _getHum()
            if not hum then return end
            local drink = _findEnergyDrink()
            if not drink then return end
            pcall(function()
                if drink.Parent ~= _lp.Character then
                    hum:EquipTool(drink)
                    task.wait(0.15)
                end
                drink:Activate()
            end)
            _autoEnergyLastUse = tick()
        end))
    end
    local _autoEnergyToggle = SecMovement:Toggle({
        Name = "auto use energy drink", Flag = "MiscAutoEnergy", Default = false,
        Callback = function(v) _autoEnergyOn = v; _setupAutoEnergy() end,
    })
    do
        local dlg = _autoEnergyToggle:AddDialog({ Name = "energy threshold" })
        dlg:Slider({
            Name = "threshold", Flag = "MiscAutoEnergyThreshold",
            Min = 0, Max = 100, Default = 30, Step = 1,
            Callback = function(v) _autoEnergyThreshold = v end,
        })
    end

    -- ─── AUTO MED (health < threshold -> equip heal tool) ──────
    local _autoMedOn        = false
    local _autoMedThreshold = 50
    local _autoMedLastEquip = 0
    local _autoMedHumConn   = nil
    local _autoMedCharConn  = nil
    local _HEAL_PRIORITY = {
        "Medkit","Bandage","Cola_1","Cola_2",
        "ChocBar_1","ChocBar_2","Chips_1","Chips_2",
    }
    local function _findHealTool()
        local bp = _lp:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
        local char = _lp.Character
        if not bp or not char then return nil end
        for _, n in ipairs(_HEAL_PRIORITY) do
            local t = bp:FindFirstChild(n) or char:FindFirstChild(n)
            if t then return t end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local function _setupAutoMed()
        if _autoMedHumConn  then pcall(function() _autoMedHumConn:Disconnect() end)  _autoMedHumConn  = nil end
        if _autoMedCharConn then pcall(function() _autoMedCharConn:Disconnect() end) _autoMedCharConn = nil end
        if not _autoMedOn then return end
        local function hookChar(char)
            local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
            if not hum then return end
            _autoMedHumConn = hum.HealthChanged:Connect(function(hp)
                if hp <= 0 or hp >= _autoMedThreshold then return end
                if (tick() - _autoMedLastEquip) < 2 then return end
                -- skip if already holding a heal tool
                local cur = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
                if cur then
                    for _, n in ipairs(_HEAL_PRIORITY) do
                        if cur.Name == n then return end
                    end
                end
                local t = _findHealTool()
                if t and t.Parent ~= char then
                    pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(t) end)
                    _autoMedLastEquip = tick()
                end
            end)
        end
        if _lp.Character then hookChar(_lp.Character) end
        _autoMedCharConn = _lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) task.wait(0.5) hookChar(c) end)
    end
    local _autoMedToggle = SecMovement:Toggle({
        Name = "auto med", Flag = "MiscAutoMed", Default = false,
        Callback = function(v) _autoMedOn = v; _setupAutoMed() end,
    })
    do
        local dlg = _autoMedToggle:AddDialog({ Name = "health threshold" })
        dlg:Slider({
            Name = "threshold", Flag = "MiscAutoMedThreshold",
            Min = 0, Max = 115, Default = 50, Step = 1,
            Callback = function(v) _autoMedThreshold = v end,
        })
    end

    -- ─── AUTO UNLOCK DOORS (aggressive — flips BoolValues + fires events) ──
    local _autoUnlockDoorsOn    = false
    local _autoUnlockDoorsLoop = nil
    local function _startAutoUnlockDoors()
        if _autoUnlockDoorsLoop then task.cancel(_autoUnlockDoorsLoop) _autoUnlockDoorsLoop = nil end
        if not _autoUnlockDoorsOn then return end
        _autoUnlockDoorsLoop = task.spawn(function()
            while _autoUnlockDoorsOn do
                pcall(function()
                    local lp   = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
                    local char = lp.Character
                    local hrp  = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if not hrp then return end
                    local doors = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map") and workspace.Map:FindFirstChild("Doors")
                    if not doors then return end
                    for _, door in ipairs(doors:GetChildren()) do
                        if door:IsA("Model") then
                            -- (a) flip any BoolValue whose name mentions "Lock" or "Closed" to false
                            local vals = door:FindFirstChild("Values")
                            if vals and vals:IsA("Folder") then
                                for _, v in ipairs(vals:GetChildren()) do
                                    if v:IsA("BoolValue") then
                                        local ln = string.lower(v.Name)
                                        if (string.find(ln, "lock") or string.find(ln, "closed"))
                                           and not string.find(ln, "unlock") then
                                            pcall(function() v.Value = false end)
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                            -- (b) fire any Remote/Bindable event whose name
                            -- mentions "Unlock" or "Open"
                            local evs = door:FindFirstChild("Events")
                            if evs and evs:IsA("Folder") then
                                for _, e in ipairs(evs:GetChildren()) do
                                    local ln = string.lower(e.Name)
                                    if string.find(ln, "unlock") or string.find(ln, "open") then
                                        if e:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                                            pcall(function() e:FireServer() end)
                                        elseif e:IsA("BindableEvent") then
                                            pcall(function() e:Fire() end)
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
                task.wait(1.5)
            end
        end)
    end
    SecMovement:Toggle({
        Name = "auto unlock doors", Flag = "MiscAutoUnlockDoors", Default = false,
        Callback = function(v) _autoUnlockDoorsOn = v; _startAutoUnlockDoors() end,
    })

    -- ============================================================
    -- MISC-RIGHT GROUPBOXES
    -- ============================================================

    local SecCombat     = TabMisc:Section({ Name = "combat auto",  Side = "Right" })
    local SecAntiFX     = TabMisc:Section({ Name = "anti effects", Side = "Right" })

    -- ─── AUTO EQUIP BEST GUN / BEST MELEE ──────────────────────
    do
        local _autoBestGunOn   = false
        local _autoBestGunChar = nil
        local _ItemStats = _RS:FindFirstChild("Storage") and _RS.Storage:FindFirstChild("ItemStats")
        local _GunsFolder   = _ItemStats and _ItemStats:FindFirstChild("Guns")
        local _MeleesFolder = _ItemStats and _ItemStats:FindFirstChild("Melees")
        local _gunDmgCache, _meleeDmgCache = {}, {}
        local function _refreshGunCache()
            _gunDmgCache = {}
            if not _GunsFolder then return end
            for _, gs in ipairs(_GunsFolder:GetChildren()) do
                local bar = gs:FindFirstChild("Bars") and gs.Bars:FindFirstChild("Damage") and gs.Bars.Damage:FindFirstChild("Bar")
                if bar and bar:IsA("NumberValue") then _gunDmgCache[gs.Name] = bar.Value end
            end
        end
        local function _refreshMeleeCache()
            _meleeDmgCache = {}
            if not _MeleesFolder then return end
            for _, ms in ipairs(_MeleesFolder:GetChildren()) do
                local bar = ms:FindFirstChild("Bars") and ms.Bars:FindFirstChild("Damage") and ms.Bars.Damage:FindFirstChild("Bar")
                if bar and bar:IsA("NumberValue") then _meleeDmgCache[ms.Name] = bar.Value end
            end
        end
        _refreshGunCache()
        _refreshMeleeCache()
        local function _equipBestGun()
            local bp = _lp:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
            local char = _lp.Character
            if not bp or not char then return end
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hum then return end
            local best, bestDmg = nil, -1
            for _, t in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
                if t:IsA("Tool") then
                    local d = _gunDmgCache[t.Name]
                    if d and d > bestDmg then bestDmg = d best = t end
                end
            end
            if best then pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(best) end) end
        end
        local function _equipBestMelee()
            local bp = _lp:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
            local char = _lp.Character
            if not bp or not char then return end
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hum then return end
            local best, bestDmg = nil, -1
            for _, t in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
                if t:IsA("Tool") then
                    local d = _meleeDmgCache[t.Name]
                    if d and d > bestDmg then bestDmg = d best = t end
                end
            end
            if best then pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(best) end) end
        end
        local function _setupAutoBestGun()
            if _autoBestGunChar then pcall(function() _autoBestGunChar:Disconnect() end) _autoBestGunChar = nil end
            if not _autoBestGunOn then return end
            _refreshGunCache()
            if _lp.Character then task.spawn(function() task.wait(1) _equipBestGun() end) end
            _autoBestGunChar = _lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c)
                task.wait(1.5)
                _refreshGunCache()
                _equipBestGun()
            end)
        end
        SecCombat:Toggle({
            Name = "auto equip best gun", Flag = "MiscAutoBestGun", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) _autoBestGunOn = v; _setupAutoBestGun() end,
        })
        local _autoBestMeleeOn   = false
        local _autoBestMeleeChar = nil
        local function _setupAutoBestMelee()
            if _autoBestMeleeChar then pcall(function() _autoBestMeleeChar:Disconnect() end) _autoBestMeleeChar = nil end
            if not _autoBestMeleeOn then return end
            _refreshMeleeCache()
            if _lp.Character then task.spawn(function() task.wait(1) _equipBestMelee() end) end
            _autoBestMeleeChar = _lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c)
                task.wait(1.5)
                _refreshMeleeCache()
                _equipBestMelee()
            end)
        end
        SecCombat:Toggle({
            Name = "auto equip best melee", Flag = "MiscAutoBestMelee", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) _autoBestMeleeOn = v; _setupAutoBestMelee() end,
        })
    end

    -- ─── NO FLINCH ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    do
        local _noFlinchOn       = false
        local _noFlinchPoll     = nil
        local function _setupNoFlinch()
            if _noFlinchPoll then pcall(function() task.cancel(_noFlinchPoll) end) _noFlinchPoll = nil end
            if not _noFlinchOn then return end
            _noFlinchPoll = task.spawn(function()
                while _noFlinchOn do
                    pcall(function()
                        if _G.CheckIfFlinching then
                            _G.CheckIfFlinching = function() return false end
                        end
                    end)
                    task.wait(1)
                end
            end)
            -- immediate override
            pcall(function() _G.CheckIfFlinching = function() return false end end)
        end
        SecCombat:Toggle({
            Name = "no flinch", Flag = "MiscNoFlinch", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) _noFlinchOn = v; _setupNoFlinch() end,
        })

        -- ─── ANTI DOWN (instant disreset, ported + renamed) ────────
        -- Forces all CharStats ragdoll values to "not downed" + re-enables
        -- Motor6D joints every frame, so you instantly get back up if downed.
        local _antiDownOn   = false
        local _antiDownConn = nil
        local function _disresetApply()
            local lp    = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
            local char  = lp.Character
            if not char then return end
            local torso = char:FindFirstChild("Torso") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
            local hum   = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hrp   = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

            -- 1. Force all CharStats ragdoll values to "not downed"
            local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
            local stats = rs:FindFirstChild("CharStats")
            local pStats = stats and stats:FindFirstChild(lp.Name)
            if pStats then
                local rt = pStats:FindFirstChild("RagdollTime")
                if rt then
                    local s  = rt:FindFirstChild("RagdollSwitch")
                    local s2 = rt:FindFirstChild("RagdollSwitch2")
                    local sr = rt:FindFirstChild("SRagdolled")
                    local rt2 = rt:FindFirstChild("RagdollTime2")
                    if s  then pcall(function() s.Value  = false end) end
                    if s2 then pcall(function() s2.Value = false end) end
                    if sr then pcall(function() sr.Value = false end) end
                    pcall(function() rt.Value = 0 end)
                    if rt2 then
                        pcall(function() rt2.MaxValue = 0 end)
                        pcall(function() rt2.Value = 0 end)
                    end
                end
                local nr = pStats:FindFirstChild("NoRagdoll")
                if nr then pcall(function() nr.Value = true end) end
            end

            -- 2. Force Humanoid to GettingUp state
            if hum and hum.Parent then
                pcall(function()
                    if hum.PlatformStand then hum.PlatformStand = false end
                    if hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics
                    or hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown
                    or hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated then
                        hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
                    end
                end)
            end

            -- 3. Re-enable all Motor6D joints
            if torso then
                for _, jn in ipairs({ "Left Hip", "Right Hip", "Left Shoulder", "Right Shoulder", "Neck" }) do
                    local j = torso:FindFirstChild(jn)
                    if j and j:IsA("Motor6D") and not j.Enabled then
                        pcall(function() j.Enabled = true end)
                    end
                end
            end

            -- 4. Zero out velocity
            if hrp and hrp.Parent then
                pcall(function()
                    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity  = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                    hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end)
            end
        end
        local function _setupAntiDown()
            if _antiDownConn then pcall(function() _antiDownConn:Disconnect() end) _antiDownConn = nil end
            if not _antiDownOn then return end
            pcall(_disresetApply)
            _antiDownConn = _RegisterHeartbeat(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
                if not _antiDownOn then return end
                pcall(_disresetApply)
            end))
        end
        SecCombat:Toggle({
            Name = "anti down", Flag = "MiscAntiDown", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) _antiDownOn = v; _setupAntiDown() end,
        })
    end

    -- ─── AUTO UNLOCK SAFE ─────────────────────────────────────
    -- Picks the closest unopened safe in workspace.Map.BredMakurz,
    -- equips Lockpick, and fires its Remote to brute-force it.
    do
        local _autoSafeOn   = false
        local _autoSafeLoop = nil
        local function _startAutoSafe()
            if _autoSafeLoop then task.cancel(_autoSafeLoop) _autoSafeLoop = nil end
            if not _autoSafeOn then return end
            _autoSafeLoop = task.spawn(function()
                while _autoSafeOn do
                    pcall(function()
                        local lp   = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
                        local char = lp.Character
                        local hum  = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                        local hrp  = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        if not (char and hum and hrp) then task.wait(0.5) return end
                        local ws_map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
                        local bm     = ws_map and ws_map:FindFirstChild("BredMakurz")
                        if not bm then task.wait(1) return end
                        -- find closest unopened safe
                        local closest, minDist = nil, 12
                        for _, obj in ipairs(bm:GetChildren()) do
                            if obj:IsA("Model") and string.find(string.lower(obj.Name), "safe") then
                                local vals = obj:FindFirstChild("Values")
                                local broken = vals and (vals:FindFirstChild("Broken") or vals:FindFirstChild("Opened"))
                                if (not broken) or broken.Value == false then
                                    local part = obj.PrimaryPart or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                                    if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
                                        local d = (hrp.Position - part.Position).Magnitude
                                        if d <= minDist then
                                            minDist = d
                                            closest = obj
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        if not closest then task.wait(0.5) return end
                        -- equip lockpick
                        local lockpick = char:FindFirstChild("Lockpick")
                        if not lockpick then
                            local bp = lp:FindFirstChild("Backpack") and lp.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Lockpick")
                            if bp then
                                pcall(function() hum:EquipTool(bp) end)
                                lockpick = bp
                                task.wait(0.25)
                            end
                        end
                        if not lockpick then task.wait(0.5) return end
                        local remote = lockpick:FindFirstChild("Remote")
                        if not remote then task.wait(0.5) return end
                        -- brute-force unlock: 8 attempts
                        for attempt = 1, 8 do
                            if not _autoSafeOn then break end
                            local token = nil
                            pcall(function() token = remote:InvokeServer("S", closest, "s") end)
                            if token then
                                pcall(function() remote:InvokeServer("D", closest, "s", token) end)
                                pcall(function() remote:InvokeServer("C") end)
                                task.wait(0.1)
                                pcall(function() remote:InvokeServer("D", closest, "s", token) end)
                            end
                            task.wait(0.15)
                        end
                    end)
                    task.wait(0.5)
                end
            end)
        end
        SecMovement:Toggle({
            Name = "auto unlock safe", Flag = "MiscAutoSafe", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) _autoSafeOn = v; _startAutoSafe() end,
        })
    end

    -- ─── ANTI FLASHBANG ────────────────────────────────────────
    do
        local _antiFlashOn   = false
        local _antiFlashCon  = nil
        local function _setupAntiFlash()
            if _antiFlashCon then pcall(function() _antiFlashCon:Disconnect() end) _antiFlashCon = nil end
            if not _antiFlashOn then return end
            local events = _RS:FindFirstChild("Events")
            if not events then return end
            local fr = events:FindFirstChild("Flash")
            if not fr then return end
            _antiFlashCon = fr.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
                for _, e in ipairs(_Lighting:GetChildren()) do
                    if e:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") or e:IsA("BlurEffect") then
                        pcall(function()
                            if e:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then
                                e.Brightness = 0; e.Contrast = 0; e.Saturation = 0; e.TintColor = Color3.new(1,1,1)
                            elseif e:IsA("BlurEffect") then
                                e.Size = 0
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                end
                local fs = _RS:FindFirstChild("Storage")
                fs = fs and fs:FindFirstChild("FrameworkStuff")
                if fs then
                    local fe = fs:FindFirstChild("FlashbangEffect")
                    if fe then pcall(function() fe.Enabled = false end) end
                end
                local char = _lp.Character
                if char then
                    for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                        if d.Name == "FlashM" then pcall(function() d:Destroy() end) end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        SecAntiFX:Toggle({
            Name = "anti flashbang", Flag = "MiscAntiFlash", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) _antiFlashOn = v; _setupAntiFlash() end,
        })
    end

    -- ─── ANTI SHELLSHOCK ───────────────────────────────────────
    do
        local _antiShellOn   = false
        local _antiShellCon  = nil
        local _antiConcCon   = nil
        local function _setupAntiShell()
            if _antiShellCon then pcall(function() _antiShellCon:Disconnect() end) _antiShellCon = nil end
            if _antiConcCon  then pcall(function() _antiConcCon:Disconnect() end)  _antiConcCon  = nil end
            if not _antiShellOn then return end
            local events = _RS:FindFirstChild("Events")
            if not events then return end
            local ss = events:FindFirstChild("ShellShock")
            if ss then
                _antiShellCon = ss.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
                    local fs = _RS:FindFirstChild("Storage")
                    fs = fs and fs:FindFirstChild("FrameworkStuff")
                    if fs then
                        local sse = fs:FindFirstChild("ShellShockEffect")
                        if sse then pcall(function() sse.Enabled = false end) end
                    end
                    for _, e in ipairs(_Lighting:GetChildren()) do
                        if e:IsA("BlurEffect") then pcall(function() e.Size = 0 end) end
                    end
                    local char = _lp.Character
                    if char then
                        for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                            local ln = d.Name:lower()
                            if ln:match("shellshock") or ln:match("shellshocked") then
                                pcall(function()
                                    if d:IsA("BoolValue") then d.Value = false end
                                    if d:IsA("NumberValue") then d.Value = 0 end
                                end)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)
            end
            local ce = events:FindFirstChild("CONC_EF")
            if ce then
                _antiConcCon = ce.OnClientEvent:Connect(function()
                    local fs = _RS:FindFirstChild("Storage")
                    fs = fs and fs:FindFirstChild("FrameworkStuff")
                    if fs then
                        local con = fs:FindFirstChild("ConcussionEffect")
                        if con then pcall(function() con.Enabled = false end) end
                    end
                end)
            end
        end
        SecAntiFX:Toggle({
            Name = "anti shellshock", Flag = "MiscAntiShellshock", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) _antiShellOn = v; _setupAntiShell() end,
        })
    end

    -- ─── INSTANT PROX PROMPT ───────────────────────────────────
    do
        local _instantProxOn      = false
        local _instantProxAdded   = nil
        local _instantProxInsts   = {}
        local function _instantPrompt(prompt)
            if not prompt then return end
            pcall(function()
                prompt.HoldDuration = 0
                prompt.MaxActivationDistance = 30
                prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
            end)
        end
        local function _setupInstantProx()
            if _instantProxAdded then pcall(function() _instantProxAdded:Disconnect() end) _instantProxAdded = nil end
            -- undo on disable
            if not _instantProxOn then return end
            for _, p in ipairs(_CSvc:GetTagged("ProximityPrompt")) do
                _instantPrompt(p)
                _instantProxInsts[p] = true
            end
            _instantProxAdded = _CSvc:GetInstanceAddedSignal("ProximityPrompt"):Connect(function(p)
                _instantPrompt(p)
                _instantProxInsts[p] = true
            end)
        end
        SecAntiFX:Toggle({
            Name = "instant prox prompt", Flag = "MiscInstantProx", Default = false,
            Callback = function(v) _instantProxOn = v; _setupInstantProx() end,
        })
    end
