                                TextXAlignment         = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center;
                                TextYAlignment         = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center;
                        });
                        Library:RegisterAccent(Badge);
                        Library:CreateInstance("UICorner", { Parent = Badge; CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 2) });
                        if ProggyCleanFont then Badge.FontFace = ProggyCleanFont end;
                elseif LocalPlayer:IsFriendsWith(Player.UserId) then
                        Badge = Library:CreateInstance("TextLabel", {
                                Parent                 = Row;
                                AnchorPoint            = Vector2.new(1, 0.5);
                                Position               = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0.5, 0);
                                Size                   = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 12);
                                BackgroundColor3       = Library.Accent;
                                BackgroundTransparency = 0.78;
                                BorderSizePixel        = 0;
                                Text                   = "friend";
                                TextColor3             = Library.Accent;
                                TextSize               = 8;
                                TextXAlignment         = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center;
                                TextYAlignment         = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center;
                        });
                        Library:RegisterAccent(Badge, "TextColor3");
                        Library:CreateInstance("UICorner", { Parent = Badge; CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 2) });
                        if ProggyCleanFont then Badge.FontFace = ProggyCleanFont end;
                end;

                local SearchHay = Player.DisplayName .. " " .. Player.Name .. " " .. tostring(Player.UserId);

                local function SetSelected(State)
                        if State then
                                Library:Tween(Row,       SelectInfo, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.90 }):Play();
                                Row.BackgroundColor3 = Library.Accent;
                                Library:Tween(AccentBar, SelectInfo, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }):Play();
                        else
                                Library:Tween(Row,       SelectInfo, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play();
                                Library:Tween(AccentBar, SelectInfo, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play();
                        end;
                end;

                Row.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                        if SelectedPlayer == Player then return end;
                        Library:Tween(Row, HoverInfo, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.94 }):Play();
                        Row.BackgroundColor3 = Library.Accent;
                        Library:Tween(NameLbl, HoverInfo, { TextColor3 = Color3.fromHex("CCCCCC") }):Play();
                end);
                Row.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                        if SelectedPlayer == Player then return end;
                        Library:Tween(Row, HoverInfo, { BackgroundTransparency = 1 }):Play();
                        Library:Tween(NameLbl, HoverInfo, { TextColor3 = Color3.fromHex("FFFFFF") }):Play();
                end);
                Row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                        for _, R in pairs(PlayerRows) do
                                if R and R.SetSelected then R.SetSelected(false) end;
                        end;
                        SetSelected(true);
                        SelectedPlayer = Player;
                        ShowDetailsFor(Player);
                end);
                Row.MouseButton2Click:Connect(function()
                        SelectedPlayer = Player;
                        local M = game:GetService("UserInputService"):GetMouseLocation();
                        task.defer(function()
                                BindCtxToPlayer(Player);
                                OpenCtx(M.X, M.Y);
                        end);
                end);

                PlayerRows[Player] = {
                        Row       = Row,
                        Wrapper   = Wrapper,
                        AccentBar = AccentBar,
                        NameLbl   = NameLbl,
                        UserLbl   = UserLbl,
                        Badge     = Badge,
                        SearchHay = SearchHay,
                        SetSelected = SetSelected,
                };
        end;

        local function RemoveRow(Player)
                local R = PlayerRows[Player];
                if R and R.Wrapper and R.Wrapper.Parent then
                        R.Wrapper:Destroy();
                end;
                PlayerRows[Player] = nil;
                if SelectedPlayer == Player then
                        SelectedPlayer = nil;
                        ShowDetailsFor(nil);
                end;
        end;

        local SpectateConn = nil;
        local Spectating   = false;

        local function StopSpectate()
                Spectating = false;
                if SpectateConn then SpectateConn:Disconnect(); SpectateConn = nil end;
                local Cam = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Camera");
                if Cam then
                        Cam.CameraSubject = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");
                end;
        end;

        local function StartSpectate(Player)
                StopSpectate();
                if not Player or Player == LocalPlayer then return end;
                Spectating = true;
                local Cam = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Camera");
                local function Apply()
                        if not Cam then return end;
                        local Char = Player.Character;
                        local Hum  = Char and Char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");
                        if Hum then Cam.CameraSubject = Hum end;
                end;
                Apply();
                SpectateConn = Library:Connection(game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat, function()
                        if not Player or not Player.Parent then StopSpectate(); return end;
                        Apply();
                end);
        end;

        local CtxOpen  = false;
        local CtxToken = 0;
        local CtxInfo  = TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out);

        local function CloseCtx()
                if not CtxOpen then return end;
                CtxOpen = false;
                CtxToken = CtxToken + 1;
                local Mine = CtxToken;
                Library:Tween(CtxFrame, CtxInfo, { GroupTransparency = 1 }):Play();
                task.delay(CtxInfo.Time, function()
                        if CtxToken == Mine then CtxFrame.Visible = false end;
                end);
        end;

        local function OpenCtx(X, Y)
                CtxOpen = true;
                CtxToken = CtxToken + 1;
                CtxFrame.Position          = UDim2.fromOffset(X, Y);
                CtxFrame.GroupTransparency = 1;
                CtxFrame.Visible           = true;
                Library:Tween(CtxFrame, CtxInfo, { GroupTransparency = 0 }):Play();
        end;

        local function MakeCtxBtn(Text, Order, Callback)

                Btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()

        end;

        CtxSpectate.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() CloseCtx(); task.spawn(CtxCallbacks.Spectate) end);

        Library:Connection(game:GetService("UserInputService").InputBegan, function(Input)
                if not CtxOpen then return end;
                if Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                or Input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
                        local M  = game:GetService("UserInputService"):GetMouseLocation();
                        local Ap = CtxFrame.AbsolutePosition;
                        local Sz = CtxFrame.AbsoluteSize;
                        if M.X < Ap.X or M.Y < Ap.Y or M.X > Ap.X+Sz.X or M.Y > Ap.Y+Sz.Y then
                                CloseCtx();
                        end;
                end;
        end);

        local function BindCtxToPlayer(Player)
                CtxNameBtn.Text       = Player.DisplayName .. " (@" .. Player.Name .. ")";
                CtxNameBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromHex("8C8F99");
                CtxCallbacks.Teleport = function()
                        local Char  = Player.Character;
                        local Hrp   = Char and Char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");
                        local MyHrp = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");
                        if Hrp and MyHrp then
                                MyHrp.CFrame = Hrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0);
                                Library:Notify("Teleported to " .. Player.DisplayName, 2);
                        else
                                Library:Notify("Could not teleport", 2);
                        end;
                end;
                CtxCallbacks.CopyId = function()
                        local Fn = setclipboard or toclipboard or (Clipboard and Clipboard.set) or nil;
                        if Fn then pcall(Fn, tostring(Player.UserId)) else Library:Notify("Clipboard not supported", 2) end;
                        Library:Notify("Copied: " .. Player.UserId, 2);
                end;
                CtxCallbacks.CopyLink = function()
                        local Fn = setclipboard or toclipboard or (Clipboard and Clipboard.set) or nil;
                        if Fn then pcall(Fn, "https://www.roblox.com/users/" .. Player.UserId .. "/profile") else Library:Notify("Clipboard not supported", 2) end;
                        Library:Notify("Copied profile link", 2);
                end;
                CtxCallbacks.Spectate = function()
                        if Spectating and SelectedPlayer == Player then
                                StopSpectate();
                                Library:Notify("Stopped spectating", 2);
                        else
                                StartSpectate(Player);
                                Library:Notify("Spectating " .. Player.DisplayName, 2);
                        end;
                end;
        end;

        local _sc = function(Text)
                local Fn = setclipboard or toclipboard or (Clipboard and Clipboard.set) or nil;
                if Fn then pcall(Fn, Text) else Library:Notify("Clipboard not supported", 2) end;
        end;

        local AbTeleport, AbTeleportLbl = MakeActionBtn("Teleport To",   1, function()
                if not SelectedPlayer then return end;
                local Char  = SelectedPlayer.Character;
                local Hrp   = Char and Char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");
                local MyHrp = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");
                if Hrp and MyHrp then
                        MyHrp.CFrame = Hrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0);
                        Library:Notify("Teleported to " .. SelectedPlayer.DisplayName, 2);
                else
                        Library:Notify("Could not teleport", 2);
                end;
        end);
        local AbSpectate, AbSpectateLbl = MakeActionBtn("Spectate",      2, function()
                if not SelectedPlayer then return end;
                if Spectating then
                        StopSpectate();
                        AbSpectateLbl.Text = "Spectate";
                        Library:Notify("Stopped spectating", 2);
                else
                        StartSpectate(SelectedPlayer);
                        AbSpectateLbl.Text = "Stop Spectate";
                        Library:Notify("Spectating " .. SelectedPlayer.DisplayName, 2);
                end;
        end);
        local AbCopyId, AbCopyIdLbl = MakeActionBtn("Copy User ID",      3, function()
                if not SelectedPlayer then return end;
                _sc(tostring(SelectedPlayer.UserId));
                Library:Notify("Copied: " .. SelectedPlayer.UserId, 2);
        end);
        local AbCopyLink, AbCopyLinkLbl = MakeActionBtn("Copy Profile",  4, function()
                if not SelectedPlayer then return end;
                _sc("https://www.roblox.com/users/" .. SelectedPlayer.UserId .. "/profile");
                Library:Notify("Copied profile link", 2);
        end);

        ShowDetailsFor = function(Player)
                if DetailLiveConn then DetailLiveConn:Disconnect(); DetailLiveConn = nil end;
                if not Player then
                        Placeholder.Visible  = true;
                        DetailContent.Visible = false;
                        return;
                end;
                Placeholder.Visible  = false;
                DetailContent.Visible = true;

                BigAvatar.Image        = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. Player.UserId .. "&w=150&h=150";
                HeadDisplayName.Text   = Player.DisplayName;
                HeadUserName.Text      = "@" .. Player.Name;
                HeadUserId.Text        = "user id  ·  " .. tostring(Player.UserId);

                 InfoDist.Text      = "distance: —";
                InfoHealth.Text    = "health: —";
                InfoLevel.Text     = "level: —";
                InfoMoney.Text     = "money: —";
                InfoInventory.Text = "inventory: —";

                DetailLiveConn = Library:Connection(game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat, function()
                        if not Player or not Player.Parent or SelectedPlayer ~= Player then
                                if DetailLiveConn then DetailLiveConn:Disconnect(); DetailLiveConn = nil end;
                                return;
                        end;
                        local Char  = Player.Character;
                        local Hrp   = Char and Char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");
                        local Hum   = Char and Char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");
                        local MyHrp = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");
                        if Hrp and MyHrp then
                                InfoDist.Text = "distance: " .. math.floor((Hrp.Position - MyHrp.Position).Magnitude) .. " studs";
                        else
                                InfoDist.Text = "distance: —";
                        end;
                        if Hum then
                                InfoHealth.Text = "health: " .. math.floor(Hum.Health) .. " / " .. math.floor(Hum.MaxHealth);
                        else
                                InfoHealth.Text = "health: —";
                        end;

                        -- ── LEVEL ────────────────────────────────────
                        -- Criminality exposes Level as a standard IntValue
                        -- under Player.leaderstats.Level (confirmed from the
                        -- dump). The old code looked under CustomLeaderstats
                        -- which only exists in RIVALS — so for Criminality
                        -- the level row always showed "—". Try BOTH paths
                        -- so the same script works on either game.
                        local _ls = Player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
                                or Player:FindFirstChild("CustomLeaderstats");
                        local _lvl = _ls and (_ls:FindFirstChild("Level") or _ls:FindFirstChild("LevelNumber"));
                        if _lvl and _lvl:IsA("ValueBase") then
                                InfoLevel.Text = "level: " .. tostring(_lvl.Value);
                        else
                                InfoLevel.Text = "level: —";
                        end;

                        -- ── MONEY ────────────────────────────────────
                        -- Criminality does NOT replicate money/cash to other
                        -- clients (it's stored server-side). The ONLY way to
                        -- see cash is via the local player's own ATM GUI:
                        -- LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.CoreGUI.ATMFrame.Header.Cash
                        -- (a TextLabel whose .Text is the cash amount).
                        -- Confirmed from the dump — only the local player's
                        -- PlayerGui is replicated to us; other players' GUIs
                        -- are not. So: LocalPlayer shows their cash, everyone
                        -- else shows "—".
                        local _money = nil;
                        if Player == LocalPlayer then
                                -- 1) Try leaderstats first (some games DO
                                --    put Cash there as an IntValue).
                                if _ls then
                                        local _c = _ls:FindFirstChild("Cash")
                                                or _ls:FindFirstChild("Money")
                                                or _ls:FindFirstChild("Balance");
                                        if _c and _c:IsA("ValueBase") then
                                                _money = _c.Value;
                                        end;
                                end;
                                -- 2) Read the ATM Cash TextLabel. The game
                                --    updates this whenever the ATM is open OR
                                --    whenever the HUD refreshes it (kill rewards,
                                --    allowance claims, deposits, etc.). Parse
                                --    the text to extract a number.
                                if _money == nil then
                                        pcall(function()
                                                local _pg = Player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
                                                        or Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 3);
                                                if not _pg then return end;
                                                local _core = _pg:FindFirstChild("CoreGUI")
                                                        or _pg:FindFirstChild("CoreGui");
                                                if not _core then return end;
                                                local _atm = _core:FindFirstChild("ATMFrame");
                                                if not _atm then return end;
                                                local _header = _atm:FindFirstChild("Header")
                                                        or _atm:FindFirstChild("ATMFrame")
                                                                and _atm.ATMFrame:FindFirstChild("Header");
                                                if not _header then return end;
                                                local _cashLbl = _header:FindFirstChild("Cash");
                                                if not _cashLbl or not _cashLbl:IsA("TextLabel") then return end;
                                                local _txt = _cashLbl.Text or "";
                                                -- Strip "$", ",", spaces, "USD", etc. Extract the number.
                                                local _num = _txt:gsub("[%$%,%s%a]", "");
                                                _num = tonumber(_num);
                                                if _num then _money = _num end;
                                        end);
                                end;
                        else
                                -- Other players: try leaderstats in case the
                                -- game ever adds Cash there. Otherwise "—".
                                if _ls then
                                        local _c = _ls:FindFirstChild("Cash")
                                                or _ls:FindFirstChild("Money")
                                                or _ls:FindFirstChild("Balance");
                                        if _c and _c:IsA("ValueBase") then _money = _c.Value end;
                                end;
                        end;
                        if _money ~= nil then
                                InfoMoney.Text = "money: $" .. tostring(_money);
                        else
                                InfoMoney.Text = "money: —";
                        end;

                        -- ── INVENTORY ────────────────────────────────
                        -- List the names of the tools in the player's Backpack
                        -- (and any tool currently equipped in their Character).
                        -- Backpack IS replicated to other clients in Criminality
                        -- (confirmed from the dump — we can see every player's
                        -- Backpack contents), so this works for everyone.
                        local _bp = Player:FindFirstChild("Backpack");
                        local _names = {};
                        if _bp then
                                for _, _t in ipairs(_bp:GetChildren()) do
                                        if _t:IsA("Tool") then
                                                table.insert(_names, _t.Name);
                                        end;
                                end;
                        end;
                        if Char then
                                for _, _t in ipairs(Char:GetChildren()) do
                                        if _t:IsA("Tool") then
                                                table.insert(_names, _t.Name .. " (equipped)");
                                        end;
                                end;
                        end;
                        if #_names > 0 then
                                InfoInventory.Text = "inventory: " .. table.concat(_names, ", ");
                        else
                                InfoInventory.Text = "inventory: —";
                        end;
                end);
        end;

        for _, P in PlayersService:GetPlayers() do MakeRow(P) end;
        Library:Connection(PlayersService.PlayerAdded,   function(P) MakeRow(P)   end);
        Library:Connection(PlayersService.PlayerRemoving, function(P) RemoveRow(P) end);

        ShowDetailsFor(nil);
end;

task.wait();
do
local PlayersService     = game:GetService("Players");
local LocalPlayer        = PlayersService.LocalPlayer;


local SecRageGeneral  = TabRage:Section({ Name = "general",        Side = "Left"  });
local SecRageWeapon   = TabRage:Section({ Name = "weapon",         Side = "Left"  });
local SecPriority     = TabRage:Section({ Name = "prioritize",     Side = "Left"  });

-- ============================================================
-- RAGEBOT (Criminality)
-- Ported from the user's reference script. Auto-fire + wallbang
-- (no strafe, no "pos" groupbox). The fire loop fires the same
-- remotes the silent aim hook uses (GNX_S + ZFKLF__H) so it works
-- with the existing __namecall hook (which blocks the game's own
-- calls when wallbang is on).
-- ============================================================
local rageState = {
    enabled          = false,    -- master toggle (UI)
    active           = false,    -- actual run state (driven by keybind)
    wallCheck        = true,     -- sphere-scan wallbang on/off
    hitPart          = "Head",
    shootAttempts    = 1,        -- bullets per fire cycle (shotguns)
    maxDistance      = 1000,
    prioritize       = false,
    priorityPlayers  = {},       -- set of names (multi-select dropdown)
    priorityExploiters = false,
    targetSingle     = "None",   -- single-player lock ("None" = off)
    targetSort       = "nearest",
    targetAll        = true,       -- when true, target anyone hittable
    selectedTargets  = {},         -- set of player names (when targetAll is off)
    hittableCheck    = true,       -- only target players we can actually hit
    lastShot         = 0,
    lockedPath         = nil,      -- cached wallbang (origin, hit) pair
    currentTargetPlayer = nil,    -- the Player object of the current target
};

-- Expose the ragebot's current target so the existing FOV-follow +
-- crosshair-follow code can track the ragebot's pick. The reference
-- script's _RivalsRagebotTarget is what those systems already call.
-- Returns (char, player) so the TargetHUD can read UserId / DisplayName /
-- leaderstats. Falls back to GetPlayerFromCharacter if the player ref
-- isn't cached.
getgenv()._RivalsRagebotTarget = function()
    if not (rageState.enabled and rageState.active) then return nil, nil end;
    local char = rageState.currentTargetChar;
    if not char then return nil, nil end;
    local plr = rageState.currentTargetPlayer;
    if not plr or plr.Parent == nil then
        plr = PlayersService:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char);
        rageState.currentTargetPlayer = plr;
    end;
    return char, plr;
end;

-- ---- Wallbang helpers (self-contained; the silent aim hook's
-- WB_* helpers live in a nested closure scope we can't reach) ----
local RB_ORIGIN_RADIUS = 35.0;   -- max sweep radius for wallbang origin
local RB_HIT_RADIUS    = 38.0;   -- max hit acceptance radius
local RB_ScanVectors = {
    Vector3.new( 0,  0,  0),
    Vector3.new( 1,  0,  0), Vector3.new(-1, 0,  0),
    Vector3.new( 0,  1,  0), Vector3.new( 0, -1, 0),
    Vector3.new( 0,  0,  1), Vector3.new( 0,  0, -1),
    Vector3.new( 1,  1,  0), Vector3.new(-1, 1,  0),
    Vector3.new( 1, -1,  0), Vector3.new(-1,-1,  0),
    Vector3.new( 1,  0,  1), Vector3.new(-1,  0,  1),
    Vector3.new( 1,  0, -1), Vector3.new(-1,  0, -1),
    Vector3.new( 0,  1,  1), Vector3.new( 0, -1,  1),
    Vector3.new( 0,  1, -1), Vector3.new( 0, -1, -1),
    Vector3.new( 1,  1,  1), Vector3.new(-1,  1,  1),
    Vector3.new( 1,  1, -1), Vector3.new(-1,  1, -1),
    Vector3.new( 1, -1,  1), Vector3.new(-1, -1,  1),
    Vector3.new( 1, -1, -1), Vector3.new(-1, -1, -1),
};

-- Check if a point is in open space (not inside a wall). Casts a
-- short ray in 6 directions; if any ray hits something within 1
-- stud, the point is considered to be inside a wall and is rejected.
-- This prevents the server from seeing shots from inside geometry
-- (the invalids the user was seeing).
local RB_OPEN_PROBES = {
    Vector3.new( 1, 0, 0), Vector3.new(-1, 0, 0),
    Vector3.new( 0, 1, 0), Vector3.new( 0,-1, 0),
    Vector3.new( 0, 0, 1), Vector3.new( 0, 0,-1),
};
local function RB_IsOpenSpace(pos)
    if not pos then return false end;
    local params = RaycastParams.new();
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { LocalPlayer.Character };
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;
    for _, d in ipairs(RB_OPEN_PROBES) do
        local r = workspace:Raycast(pos, d * 2.5, params);
        if r and (r.Position - pos).Magnitude < 1.8 then
            return false;
        end;
    end;
    return true;
end;

local function RB_CheckWallbang(p1, p2)
    local tol = tonumber(_G.WallbangTol) or 6;
    local params = RaycastParams.new();
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { LocalPlayer.Character };
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude;
    local dir = p2 - p1;
    local dist = dir.Magnitude;
    if dist < 0.01 then return true end;
    local r = workspace:Raycast(p1, dir.Unit * dist, params);
    if not r then return true end;
    return (r.Position - p2).Magnitude <= tol;
end;

-- Find a wallbangable (origin, hit, hitPart) triple. Tries direct
-- LOS first, then sphere-scans around the player + target. BOTH
-- the origin AND the hit position must be in open space (not inside
-- a wall) or the server will reject the shot as an invalid.
local function RB_FindPath(myHRP, hitPos, hitPart)
    if not myHRP then return nil end;
    local baseOrigin = myHRP.Position;
    -- Direct LOS first (must also pass open-space check on hit).
    if RB_IsOpenSpace(baseOrigin) and RB_IsOpenSpace(hitPos)
        and RB_CheckWallbang(baseOrigin, hitPos) then
        return baseOrigin, hitPos, hitPart;
    end;
    -- Sphere scan: origin offsets x hit offsets. Skip any pair where
    -- either endpoint is inside a wall.
    for _, oVec in ipairs(RB_ScanVectors) do
        local tryOrigin = baseOrigin + oVec * RB_ORIGIN_RADIUS;
        if RB_IsOpenSpace(tryOrigin) then
            for _, hVec in ipairs(RB_ScanVectors) do
                local tryHit = hitPos + hVec * RB_HIT_RADIUS;
                if RB_IsOpenSpace(tryHit) and RB_CheckWallbang(tryOrigin, tryHit) then
                    return tryOrigin, tryHit, hitPart;
                end;
            end;
        end;
    end;
    return nil;
end;

-- Resolve the equipped gun's FireRate (shots per second) so we can
-- throttle ragebot shots to the gun's natural cadence. Falls back
-- to 5/sec (= 0.2s gap) if the gun module isn't loaded.
local function RB_GetGunFireInterval()
    local tool = LocalPlayer.Character
        and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool");
    if not tool then return 0.2 end;
    local cfg = tool:FindFirstChild("Config");
    if cfg and cfg:IsA("ModuleScript") then
        local ok, gs = pcall(require, cfg);
        if ok and gs and gs.FireRate then
            return 1 / tonumber(gs.FireRate);
        end;
    end;
    -- Fallback: use the cached GunModule if it has been exposed globally
    -- (the local `combatMods` is declared later in the source, so we can
    -- only safely reach it via _G if the script exposes it). At worst,
    -- we fall through to the default 5 shots/sec.
    local _cm = rawget(_G, "_RivalsCombatMods");
    if _cm and _cm.GunModule and _cm.GunModule.FireRate then
        return 1 / tonumber(_cm.GunModule.FireRate);
    end;
    return 0.2;
end;

-- Heuristic exploiter detection. A player is flagged as an exploiter
-- if their humanoid root part's velocity exceeds a sane human cap
-- (walk speed is ~16 studs/sec; we flag >= 80 as suspicious) or if
-- they have impossible HP (>= 200). Conservative on purpose so we
-- don't false-flag legitimate players.
local function RB_IsExploiter(p)
    if not p or not p.Character then return false end;
    local hrp = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");
    local hum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");
    if hrp and hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude >= 80 then return true end;
    if hum and hum.Health >= 200 then return true end;
    return false;
end;

-- Pick a hit part on the character based on the configured hit part.
-- "Closest" picks the part closest to my HRP; "Random" picks any
-- whitelisted part; anything else looks up the named part.
-- Uses only FindFirstChild (not _SafeFindFirstDescendant) because the
-- latter is defined later in the file (line ~18942) and would be a
-- forward reference at this point in the source.
local RB_PARTS = { "Head", "HumanoidRootPart", "UpperTorso", "LowerTorso", "Torso" };
local function RB_PickHitPart(char, myHRP)
    if not char then return nil end;
    local hp = rageState.hitPart;
    if hp == "Closest" and myHRP then
        local best, bestD = nil, math.huge;
        for _, pn in ipairs(RB_PARTS) do
            local part = char:FindFirstChild(pn);
            if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
                local d = (part.Position - myHRP.Position).Magnitude;
                if d < bestD then bestD = d; best = part; end;
            end;
        end;
        return best;
    elseif hp == "Random" then
        local candidates = {};
        for _, pn in ipairs(RB_PARTS) do
            local part = char:FindFirstChild(pn);
            if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(candidates, part); end;
        end;
        if #candidates == 0 then return nil end;
        return candidates[math.random(1, #candidates)];
    end;
    return char:FindFirstChild(hp)
        or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        or char.PrimaryPart;
end;

-- Check if a target is hittable: either visible (direct LOS) or
-- wallbangable (sphere-scan finds a valid path). Used by the target
-- selector to skip targets we cannot actually damage, so the ragebot
-- does not waste fire cycles on unhittable players behind thick walls.
local function RB_IsHittable(myHRP, hitPos)
    if not myHRP or not hitPos then return false end;
    -- Direct LOS first (cheap).
    if RB_CheckWallbang(myHRP.Position, hitPos) then return true end;
    -- Sphere-scan wallbang (expensive -- only if direct LOS fails).
    local o, h, p = RB_FindPath(myHRP, hitPos, nil);
    return o ~= nil;
end;

-- Pick the best target. Honors: target all / selected targets, priority
-- players, prioritize exploiters, hittable check, alive/FF filters,
-- and the target sort mode (nearest/farthest/lowest hp/highest hp/random).
local function RB_GetTarget()
    if not (rageState.enabled and rageState.active) then return nil end;
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character;
    local myHRP = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");
    if not myHRP then return nil end;
    local myPos = myHRP.Position;
    local best, bestMetric = nil, nil;
    local sortMode = rageState.targetSort or "nearest";
    local wantMin = (sortMode == "nearest") or (sortMode == "lowest hp");

    for _, p in ipairs(PlayersService:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
            -- Target filter: if targetAll is off, only consider selected players.
            local allowed = rageState.targetAll
                or (rageState.selectedTargets[p.Name] == true);
            if allowed then
                local char = p.Character;
                local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");
                if hum and hum.Health > 0 and not char:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then
                    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char.PrimaryPart;
                    if root then
                        -- Hittable check: skip targets we cannot damage.
                        local hittable = true;
                        if rageState.hittableCheck then
                            hittable = RB_IsHittable(myHRP, root.Position);
                        end;
                        if hittable then
                            local metric;
                            if sortMode == "nearest" or sortMode == "farthest" then
                                metric = (root.Position - myPos).Magnitude;
                            elseif sortMode == "lowest hp" or sortMode == "highest hp" then
                                metric = hum.Health;
                            else -- random
                                metric = math.random();
                            end;
                            -- Priority bias: priority players and flagged exploiters
                            -- always win against non-priority players. We do this by
                            -- subtracting a big constant from their metric so they
                            -- sort first regardless of distance/HP.
                            local isPrio = rageState.prioritize
                                and (rageState.priorityPlayers[p.Name] == true);
                            local isExp = rageState.prioritizeExploiters and RB_IsExploiter(p);
                            if isPrio or isExp then
                                metric = metric - 100000;
                            end;
                            if not best then
                                best, bestMetric = p, metric;
                            elseif wantMin and metric < bestMetric then
                                best, bestMetric = p, metric;
                            elseif (not wantMin) and metric > bestMetric then
                                best, bestMetric = p, metric;
                            end;
                        end;
                    end;
                end;
            end;
        end;
    end;
    return best;
end;

-- Cache the ragebot's current target character for the FOV-follow hook.
rageState.currentTargetChar = nil;

-- Resolve remotes once. These live under ReplicatedStorage.Events and
-- match the same names the silent aim hook uses.
local RB_Events = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Events");
local RB_GN_S = RB_Events and RB_Events:FindFirstChild("GNX_S");
local RB_ZF_H = RB_Events and RB_Events:FindFirstChild("ZFKLF__H");

-- Main ragebot fire step. Called every Heartbeat. Picks a target,
-- resolves a wallbangable (origin, hit) pair, fires GN_S + ZF_H for
-- each shoot attempt, and caches the path so the next shot is fast.
local function RB_Step()
    if not (rageState.enabled and rageState.active) then
        rageState.lockedPath = nil;
        rageState.currentTargetChar = nil;
        rageState.currentTargetPlayer = nil;
        return;
    end;
    if not (RB_GN_S and RB_ZF_H) then return end;

    -- Must have an equipped gun (Tool with IsGun child).
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character;
    if not myChar then return end;
    local tool = myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool");
    if not (tool and tool:FindFirstChild("IsGun")) then return end;

    -- Throttle to the gun's FireRate.
    local now = tick();
    local interval = RB_GetGunFireInterval();
    if now - rageState.lastShot < interval then return end;

    -- Must have ammo.
    local vals = tool:FindFirstChild("Values");
    local ammo = vals and vals:FindFirstChild("SERVER_Ammo");
    if not (ammo and ammo.Value > 0) then return end;

    -- Pick target.
    local target = RB_GetTarget();
    if not target or not target.Character then
        rageState.lockedPath = nil;
        rageState.currentTargetChar = nil;
        rageState.currentTargetPlayer = nil;
        return;
    end;
    rageState.currentTargetChar = target.Character;
    rageState.currentTargetPlayer = target;

    local myHRP = myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");
    local tChar = target.Character;
    if not (myHRP and tChar) then return end;

    -- Pick hit part + position.
    local hitPart = RB_PickHitPart(tChar, myHRP);
    if not hitPart then return end;
    local hitPos = hitPart.Position;

    -- Resolve fire origin + hit. If wallCheck is off, use direct LOS
    -- (sphere-scan skipped, fires straight from HRP to target). If on,
    -- use the sphere-scan wallbang path. Reuse cached path if still valid.
    local fireOrigin, fireHitPos, fireHitPart;
    if not rageState.wallCheck then
        -- Even without wallbang mode, verify the shot is geometrically valid
        -- before firing (prevents hitmarker-but-no-damage from blocked shots).
        local o, h, p2 = RB_FindPath(myHRP, hitPos, hitPart);
        if o then
            fireOrigin   = o;
            fireHitPos   = h;
            fireHitPart  = p2;
        end;
    else
        -- Cache check: if my pos + target pos haven't moved much, reuse.
        local tRoot = tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or tChar.PrimaryPart;
        local cached = rageState.lockedPath;
        if cached and cached.target == target
            and (myHRP.Position - cached.myPos).Magnitude < 2
            and tRoot and (tRoot.Position - cached.tPos).Magnitude < 2
            and RB_CheckWallbang(cached.origin, cached.hitPos) then
            fireOrigin = cached.origin;
            fireHitPos = cached.hitPos;
            fireHitPart = cached.hitPart;
        else
            local o, h, p2 = RB_FindPath(myHRP, hitPos, hitPart);
            if o then
                fireOrigin = o;
                fireHitPos = h;
                fireHitPart = p2;
                rageState.lockedPath = {
                    origin = o, hitPos = h, hitPart = p2,
                    target = target,
                    myPos = myHRP.Position,
                    tPos = tRoot and tRoot.Position or Vector3.zero,
                };
            end;
        end;
    end;

    if not (fireOrigin and fireHitPos and fireHitPart) then return end;

    -- Fire N bullets (shootAttempts = 1 for non-shotguns, >1 for
    -- shotguns / force-fire). Each gets its own key so the server sees
    -- them as separate shots.
    local dir = (fireHitPos - fireOrigin).Unit;
    local attempts = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(rageState.shootAttempts) or 1));
    for i = 1, attempts do
        local key = "K" .. math.random(1000, 9999);
        pcall(RB_GN_S.FireServer, RB_GN_S, tick(), key, tool, "FDS9I83", fireOrigin, { dir }, false);
        pcall(RB_ZF_H.FireServer, RB_ZF_H, "🧈", tool, key, i, fireHitPart, fireHitPos, dir);
        pcall(RB_ZF_H.FireServer, RB_ZF_H, "🧈", tool, key, i + 100, fireHitPart, fireHitPos, dir);
    end;

    -- Hitmarker / tracer (visual only).
    if tool:FindFirstChild("Hitmarker") then
        pcall(function() tool.Hitmarker:Fire(fireHitPart) end);
    end;
    -- Use the bullet tracer system if it's enabled.
    if V and V.tracers and V.tracers.enabled and V.createTracer then
        local visOrigin = myHRP.Position;
        local visHit = hitPos;
        task.defer(function() pcall(V.createTracer, visOrigin, visHit) end);
    end;

    rageState.lastShot = tick();
end;

-- Heartbeat fire loop. pcall-wrapped so a transient remote error
-- doesn't kill the loop.
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait();
        pcall(RB_Step);
    end;
end);

-- ---- UI ----
-- Enable toggle: master switch. Keybind uses Mode = "Hold" + Ghost
-- + self-managed toggle (same pattern as the aimbot / sticky aim
-- keybinds) because the library's "Toggle" mode + Ghost never fires
-- the release callback.
local _rageEnableToggle = SecRageGeneral:Toggle({
    Name = "enable", Flag = "RageEnable", Default = false,
    Callback = function(val)
        rageState.enabled = val;
        if not val then
            rageState.active = false;
            rageState.lockedPath = nil;
            rageState.currentTargetChar = nil;
            rageState.currentTargetPlayer = nil;
        end;
    end,
});

_rageEnableToggle:AddKeybind({
    Default = nil, Mode = "Hold", Ghost = true,
    Callback = function(state)
        if not rageState.enabled then
            rageState.active = false;
            rageState.lockedPath = nil;
            rageState.currentTargetChar = nil;
            rageState.currentTargetPlayer = nil;
            return;
        end;
        if not state then return end; -- ignore key releases
        -- Every key press flips the active state: on -> off, off -> on.
        rageState.active = not rageState.active;
        if not rageState.active then
            rageState.lockedPath = nil;
            rageState.currentTargetChar = nil;
            rageState.currentTargetPlayer = nil;
        end;
    end,
});

local _rageEnableDlg = _rageEnableToggle:AddDialog({ Name = "radius settings" })
_rageEnableDlg:Slider({
    Name = "origin radius", Flag = "RageOriginRadius",
    Min = 4, Max = 40, Default = 18, Rounding = 1,
    Callback = function(v) RB_ORIGIN_RADIUS = v; end,
});
_rageEnableDlg:Slider({
    Name = "hit radius", Flag = "RageHitRadius",
    Min = 4, Max = 40, Default = 22, Rounding = 1,
    Callback = function(v) RB_HIT_RADIUS = v; end,
});

SecRageGeneral:Toggle({
    Name = "wall check", Flag = "RageWallCheck", Default = true,
    Callback = function(val) rageState.wallCheck = val; end,
});

rageState.hittableCheck = false;

SecRageWeapon:Dropdown({
    Name = "hit part", Flag = "RageHitPart",
    Options = { "Head", "HumanoidRootPart", "Torso", "UpperTorso", "LowerTorso", "Closest", "Random" },
    Default = "Head",
    Callback = function(val) rageState.hitPart = val; end,
});

rageState.shootAttempts = 1;

local function getPlayerNames()
    local names = {};
    for _, p in ipairs(PlayersService:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer then table.insert(names, p.Name); end;
    end;
    return names;
end;

-- Target all: when ON, the ragebot targets anyone hittable. When OFF,
-- it only targets players selected in the "targets" listbox below.
SecPriority:Toggle({
    Name = "target all", Flag = "RageTargetAll", Default = true,
    Callback = function(val) rageState.targetAll = val; end,
});

-- Targets listbox (multi-select, like the part whitelist listbox in
-- the filters tab). When "target all" is OFF, only players selected
-- here are considered. When "target all" is ON, this list is ignored.
-- Build display entries: "DisplayName (@username)" label -> username value
local function getPlayerDisplayEntries()
    local labels = {};
    local labelToName = {};
    for _, p in ipairs(PlayersService:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer then
            local label = p.DisplayName .. " (@" .. p.Name .. ")";
            table.insert(labels, label);
            labelToName[label] = p.Name;
        end;
    end;
    return labels, labelToName;
end;

local _targetLabelToName = {};
local _targetLabels, _targetLabelMap = getPlayerDisplayEntries();
_targetLabelToName = _targetLabelMap;

local _targetList = SecPriority:List({
    Name = "targets", Flag = "RageTargetList",
    Multi = true,
    Options = _targetLabels,
    Default = {},
    Height = 100,
    Search = true,
    Callback = function(val)
        -- val is { [label] = true }; map labels back to real usernames
        local resolved = {};
        if val then
            for label, selected in pairs(val) do
                if selected then
                    local realName = _targetLabelToName[label];
                    if realName then resolved[realName] = true; end;
                end;
            end;
        end;
        rageState.selectedTargets = resolved;
    end,
});

local _prioToggle = SecPriority:Toggle({
    Name = "prioritize", Flag = "RagePrioritize", Default = false,
    Callback = function(val) rageState.prioritize = val; end,
});

local _prioList = SecPriority:Dropdown({
    Name = "priority players", Flag = "RagePriorityPlayers",
    Multi = true,
    Options = getPlayerNames(),
    Default = {},
    Callback = function(val)
        -- val is a { [name] = true } table when Multi = true
        rageState.priorityPlayers = val or {};
    end,
});

SecPriority:Toggle({
    Name = "prioritize exploiters", Flag = "RagePriorityExploiters", Default = false,
    Callback = function(val) rageState.priorityExploiters = val; end,
});

SecPriority:Dropdown({
    Name = "target sort", Flag = "RageTargetSort",
    Options = { "nearest", "farthest", "lowest hp", "highest hp", "random" },
    Default = "nearest",
    Callback = function(val) rageState.targetSort = val; end,
});

-- Refresh the player dropdowns / listbox every 5s so new joiners show up.
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(5);
        pcall(function()
            local names = getPlayerNames();
            if _prioList and _prioList.SetOptions then
                _prioList:SetOptions(names);
            end;
            if _targetList and _targetList.SetOptions then
                local newLabels, newMap = getPlayerDisplayEntries();
                _targetLabelToName = newMap;
                _targetList:SetOptions(newLabels);
            end;
        end);
    end;
end);

-- ============================================================
-- ANTI-AIM (ported from mangosense, renamed + reorganized)
-- Hijacks the MOVZREP remote + locally overrides character joints
-- so the player looks at a different direction than they're aiming.
-- ============================================================
local SecAntiAim = TabRage:Section({ Name = "anti aim", Side = "Right" })

do
    -- Pre-baked CFrame/Vector3 constants for joint overrides.
    local _poseCFs = {
        -- Head/neck (Hide head mode)
        NeckC0   = CFrame.new(0, 0.4, 0.3),
        NeckC1   = CFrame.new(0, -0.1, 0.4) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), math.rad(-180), 0),
        -- Arm overrides (Hands up / Arms behind / Arms out)
        LShoulder     = CFrame.new(-1, 0.5, 0,  0.020794034, -7.74860382e-07, -0.999783635, -0.000120058326, 0.99999994, -7.67241496e-07, 0.999783635, 0.000120058311, 0.020794034),
        RShoulder     = CFrame.new( 1, 0.5, 0,  0.020793736,  1.07288361e-06,  0.999783933,  0.00011997249, 0.99999994, -1.06704665e-06, -0.999783933, 0.000119972484, 0.020793736),
        LShoulderUp   = CFrame.new(-1, 0.5, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-150), 0, 0),
        RShoulderUp   = CFrame.new( 1, 0.5, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-150), 0, 0),
        LShoulderOut  = CFrame.new(-1, 0.5, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)),
        RShoulderOut  = CFrame.new( 1, 0.5, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-90)),
        -- Leg overrides (T-pose legs / Scissor legs)
        LHip      = CFrame.new(-1, -1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(-15)),
        RHip      = CFrame.new( 1, -1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad( 15)),
        LHipScissor = CFrame.new(-1, -1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(20), 0, 0),
        RHipScissor = CFrame.new( 1, -1, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-20), 0, 0),
        -- MOVZREP bone vectors
        AntiDown  = Vector3.new(0.006237113382667303, -6, -0.18136750161647797),
        OpenHands = Vector3.new(0.006237113382667303,  6,  0.18136750161647797),
        HandsUp1  = Vector3.new(-4237.62255859375,  9848.9267578125, -2292.4501953125),
        HandsUp2  = Vector3.new(-4264.8974609375,   0.9520299434661865, -556.17333984375),
        Mag6D     = CFrame.new(0.00922322646, 0.729015231, -1.10657895, 0.0304670143, -0.0899232552, -0.995470703, -0.0309824635, 0.994981587, -0.0908859149, 0.999057353, 0.0334882995, 0.0276200175),
        Tool6D    = CFrame.new(0.00922359806, 0.729012489, -1.10657847, 0.0304671406, -0.0899234265, -0.995470614, -0.0309824536, 0.994981587, -0.0908859149, 0.999057353, 0.0334882995, 0.0276200175),
    }

    local _aaState = {
        Master         = false,  -- master toggle (when off, no joint overrides)
        -- Modes is now a MULTI-SELECT set: { ["Ball"] = true, ["Hide head"] = true, ... }
        -- Multiple modes can be active simultaneously. Each enabled mode
        -- applies its joint / DoTweak override in sequence.
        Modes          = {},
        OrigNeckC0     = nil,
        OrigNeckC1     = nil,
        OrigLShoulder  = nil,
        OrigRShoulder  = nil,
        OrigLHip       = nil,
        OrigRHip       = nil,
        OrigRootC0     = nil,  -- RootJoint C0 (for Spinbot local-body spin)
        OrigHRP        = nil,  -- cached HumanoidRootPart ref for restoring
        DoTweakFn      = nil,
        YawAngle       = 30,
        RotSpeed       = 30,
        YawTime        = 0,
        CustomYaw      = 30,
        -- Spinbot local spin angle (accumulated across frames)
        SpinAngle      = 0,
    }

    -- Scrape the game's internal DoTweak function via gc lookup.
    task.spawn(function()
        pcall(function()
            for _, v in getgc(true) do
                if type(v) == "function" then
                    local info = debug.getinfo(v)
                    if info and info.name == "DoTweak" and info.numparams == 11 then
                        _aaState.DoTweakFn = v
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end)

    -- Expose _aaState + _poseCFs via _G so the existing silent-aim
    -- __namecall hook can rewrite MOVZREP args when anti-aim is active.
    _G.FrequencyAAState  = _aaState
    _G.FrequencyPoseCFs = _poseCFs

    -- Cache original joint C0 values so we can restore them when anti-aim
    -- is turned off OR when switching modes.
    local function _cacheOrigins(char)
        if not char then return end
        local torso = char:FindFirstChild("Torso") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        local head  = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local hrp   = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not _aaState.OrigNeckC0 and head then
            local neck = head:FindFirstChild("Neck") or (torso and torso:FindFirstChild("Neck"))
            if neck then
                _aaState.OrigNeckC0 = neck.C0
                _aaState.OrigNeckC1 = neck.C1
            end
        end
        if torso then
            if not _aaState.OrigLShoulder then
                local j = torso:FindFirstChild("Left Shoulder")
                if j then _aaState.OrigLShoulder = j.C0 end
            end
            if not _aaState.OrigRShoulder then
                local j = torso:FindFirstChild("Right Shoulder")
                if j then _aaState.OrigRShoulder = j.C0 end
            end
            if not _aaState.OrigLHip then
                local j = torso:FindFirstChild("Left Hip")
                if j then _aaState.OrigLHip = j.C0 end
            end
            if not _aaState.OrigRHip then
                local j = torso:FindFirstChild("Right Hip")
                if j then _aaState.OrigRHip = j.C0 end
            end
        end
        -- Cache HumanoidRootPart + RootJoint for Spinbot local-body spin
        -- (without this we can't spin the local character, only the
        -- server's view of it).
        if hrp and not _aaState.OrigRootC0 then
            _aaState.OrigHRP = hrp
            -- R6: "RootJoint" inside HRP; R15: "Root" inside LowerTorso
            local rj = hrp:FindFirstChild("RootJoint")
                    or (char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") and char.LowerTorso:FindFirstChild("Root"))
            if rj then
                _aaState.OrigRootC0 = rj.C0
            end
        end
    end

    -- Restore all joints back to originals (called when Master is off).
    -- Critical: this MUST restore every joint we ever modify, otherwise
    -- the user's body looks broken after disabling anti-aim (which was
    -- the bug: "when i use anti aim, then disable it, my parts dont go
    -- back to normal").
    local function _restoreJoints(char)
        if not char then return end
        local torso = char:FindFirstChild("Torso") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        local head  = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local hrp   = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        -- Restore RootJoint first (Spinbot) so the body orientation is back
        if hrp and _aaState.OrigRootC0 then
            local rj = hrp:FindFirstChild("RootJoint")
                    or (char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") and char.LowerTorso:FindFirstChild("Root"))
            if rj then rj.C0 = _aaState.OrigRootC0 end
        end
        if head and _aaState.OrigNeckC0 then
            local neck = head:FindFirstChild("Neck") or (torso and torso:FindFirstChild("Neck"))
            if neck then neck.C0 = _aaState.OrigNeckC0; neck.C1 = _aaState.OrigNeckC1 end
        end
        if torso then
            local j
            if _aaState.OrigLShoulder then j = torso:FindFirstChild("Left Shoulder");  if j then j.C0 = _aaState.OrigLShoulder end end
            if _aaState.OrigRShoulder then j = torso:FindFirstChild("Right Shoulder"); if j then j.C0 = _aaState.OrigRShoulder end end
            if _aaState.OrigLHip then j = torso:FindFirstChild("Left Hip");  if j then j.C0 = _aaState.OrigLHip end end
            if _aaState.OrigRHip then j = torso:FindFirstChild("Right Hip"); if j then j.C0 = _aaState.OrigRHip end end
        end
        -- Reset spin accumulator so a fresh enable starts at angle 0
        _aaState.SpinAngle = 0
        _aaState.YawTime = 0
    end

    -- Per-frame joint override + DoTweak call
    -- Multi-select: every enabled mode in _aaState.Modes is applied each
    -- frame, in a fixed order (head modes -> arm modes -> leg modes ->
    -- ball -> face down/up -> spinbot). Modes that share a joint are
    -- applied in sequence so the LAST enabled mode wins for that joint.
    -- Modes that use DoTweak (Face down/up, Spinbot) all stack because
    -- they send separate bone updates to the server.
    _RegisterRenderStepped(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(dt)
        if not _aaState.Master then return end
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char then return end
        local hrp   = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local head  = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
        local torso = char:FindFirstChild("Torso") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
        if not (hrp and torso) then return end

        -- Cache originals once so we can restore them later
        _cacheOrigins(char)

        local modes = _aaState.Modes or {};
        local _dt = dt or 0.016;

        -- ── HIDE HEAD ──────────────────────────────────────────
        if modes["Hide head"] then
            local neck = (head and head:FindFirstChild("Neck")) or (torso and torso:FindFirstChild("Neck"))
            if neck then
                neck.C0 = _poseCFs.NeckC0
                neck.C1 = _poseCFs.NeckC1
            end
        end

        -- ── BALL ───────────────────────────────────────────────
        -- All limbs collapse INTO the torso center, making the body
        -- look like one compact block. We zero out the limb-joint
        -- translations AND fold the limbs inward with a 90-degree
        -- rotation so they hug the torso on all sides. The head is
        -- also pulled down into the chest.
        if modes["Ball"] then
            local lS = torso:FindFirstChild("Left Shoulder")
            local rS = torso:FindFirstChild("Right Shoulder")
            local lH = torso:FindFirstChild("Left Hip")
            local rH = torso:FindFirstChild("Right Hip")
            -- Fold arms inward across the chest (rotate 90° around X
            -- so the arm lies flat against the torso, then translate
            -- to torso center on X).
            if lS then lS.C0 = CFrame.new(-0.3, 0.5, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, math.rad(30)) end
            if rS then rS.C0 = CFrame.new( 0.3, 0.5, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, math.rad(-30)) end
            -- Fold legs up against the torso (rotate -90° around X so
            -- the leg points up into the body, translate slightly inward).
            if lH then lH.C0 = CFrame.new(-0.3, -0.5, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0) end
            if rH then rH.C0 = CFrame.new( 0.3, -0.5, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0) end
            -- Tuck head down into the torso
            local neck = (head and head:FindFirstChild("Neck")) or (torso and torso:FindFirstChild("Neck"))
            if neck then
                neck.C0 = CFrame.new(0, -0.5, 0) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
            end
        end

        -- ── FACE DOWN ──────────────────────────────────────────
        -- Body folds forward at the waist so the head points at the
        -- floor. Hard to headshot from in front because the head
        -- hitbox is below the torso.
        if modes["Face down"] then
            if hrp and _aaState.DoTweakFn then
                local downRot = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
                pcall(_aaState.DoTweakFn,
                    char,
                    hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 10, 0),
                    hrp.Position,
                    downRot.LookVector,
                    true, false, true, true, true,
                    9e9, true)
            end
        end

        -- ── FACE UP ────────────────────────────────────────────
        -- Opposite of Face down: body bends backward so the head
        -- points at the ceiling. Hard to headshot from behind.
        if modes["Face up"] then
            if hrp and _aaState.DoTweakFn then
                local upRot = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)
                pcall(_aaState.DoTweakFn,
                    char,
                    hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 10, 0),
                    hrp.Position,
                    upRot.LookVector,
                    true, false, true, true, true,
                    9e9, true)
            end
        end

        -- ── SPINBOT ────────────────────────────────────────────
        -- Spins the WHOLE body around the Y axis at high speed by
        -- rotating the character's RootJoint locally (so the user
        -- sees their own body spinning in third person) AND by
        -- telling the server via DoTweak (so other players see it
        -- too). The previous version only sent DoTweak — the local
        -- body never visibly spun.
        if modes["Spinbot"] then
            _aaState.SpinAngle = (_aaState.SpinAngle or 0) + (_dt * _aaState.RotSpeed)
            local spinCF = CFrame.Angles(0, _aaState.SpinAngle, 0)
            -- 1) Local body spin via RootJoint C0
            if _aaState.OrigRootC0 and _aaState.OrigHRP then
                local rj = _aaState.OrigHRP:FindFirstChild("RootJoint")
                        or (char:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") and char.LowerTorso:FindFirstChild("Root"))
                if rj then
                    rj.C0 = _aaState.OrigRootC0 * spinCF
                end
            end
            -- 2) Server-side spin via DoTweak (so other clients see it)
            if hrp and _aaState.DoTweakFn then
                pcall(_aaState.DoTweakFn,
                    char,
                    hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 10, 0),
                    hrp.Position,
                    spinCF.LookVector,
                    true, false, true, true, true,
                    9e9, true)
            end
        end
    end))

    -- Restore joints when anti-aim is disabled.
    -- Polls every frame (cheap — just a bool check) instead of every
    -- 0.25s so the user's body snaps back to normal the instant they
    -- toggle anti-aim off. Also re-restores on CharacterAdded so the
    -- joints don't get stuck after a respawn.
    local _prevMaster = false
    _RegisterHeartbeat(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        if _prevMaster and not _aaState.Master then
            pcall(_restoreJoints, LocalPlayer.Character)
        end
        _prevMaster = _aaState.Master
    end))
    -- Reset cached originals on respawn so we re-cache fresh values
    -- for the new character (otherwise _restoreJoints would write the
    -- OLD character's C0 values onto the NEW character's joints).
    LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
        _aaState.OrigNeckC0    = nil
        _aaState.OrigNeckC1    = nil
        _aaState.OrigLShoulder = nil
        _aaState.OrigRShoulder = nil
        _aaState.OrigLHip      = nil
        _aaState.OrigRHip      = nil
        _aaState.OrigRootC0    = nil
        _aaState.OrigHRP       = nil
        _aaState.SpinAngle     = 0
        _aaState.YawTime       = 0
    end)

    -- =========================================================
    -- ANTI-AIM UI — master toggle with keybind picker
    -- =========================================================
    local _aaMasterToggle = SecAntiAim:Toggle({
        Name = "anti aim", Flag = "RageAAMaster", Default = false,
        Callback = function(v)
            _aaState.Master = v
            if not v then
                -- Restore joints immediately when toggled off via UI.
                -- Previously this only happened on the next keybind press
                -- or after a 0.25s poll, which made it feel broken.
                pcall(_restoreJoints, LocalPlayer.Character)
            end
        end,
    })
    _aaMasterToggle:AddKeybind({
        Default = nil,
        Mode = "Toggle",
        Callback = function(active)
            _aaState.Master = active
            if not active then
                pcall(_restoreJoints, LocalPlayer.Character)
            end
        end,
    })

    SecAntiAim:Dropdown({
        Name = "modes", Flag = "RageAAMode",
        Multi = true,  -- multi-select: user can enable several anti-aim modes at once
        Options = {
            "Ball", "Hide head", "Spinbot", "Face down", "Face up",
        },
        Default = { ["Hide head"] = true },  -- default to Hide head only
        Callback = function(v)
            -- v is a table { ["Ball"] = true, ["Hide head"] = false, ... }
            _aaState.Modes = v or {}
            _aaState.SpinAngle = 0
            _aaState.YawTime = 0
        end,
    })

    SecAntiAim:Slider({
        Name = "rotation speed", Flag = "RageAARotSpeed",
        Min = -50, Max = 50, Default = 30, Step = 0.1, Decimals = 1,
        Callback = function(v) _aaState.RotSpeed = v end,
    })
end;

-- ── MELEE BOT ───────────────────────────────────────────────
local SecMelee = TabRage:Section({ Name = "melee", Side = "Right" })

local MA = {
    Enabled    = false,
    TargetOnly = false,
    DownCheck  = false,
    ShowAnim   = true,
    Distance   = 20,
    TargetPart = "Random",
    LastHit    = 0,
    Loop       = nil,
    Parts      = {"Head","Torso","Left Arm","Right Arm","Left Leg","Right Leg"},
    Remote1    = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Events"):WaitForChild("XMHH.2"),
    Remote2    = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Events"):WaitForChild("XMHH2.2"),
}

local MA_WCDs = {
    ["Fists"]=0.05, ["Knuckledusters"]=0.05,
    ["Nunchucks"]=0.05, ["Shiv"]=0.05, ["Chainsaw"]=2.5,
}

local function StartMeleeLoop()
    if MA.Loop then return end
    MA.Loop = task.spawn(function()
        while MA.Enabled do
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            local tool = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
            if tool and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                local cd = 0.5
                if MA_WCDs[tool.Name] then
                    cd = MA_WCDs[tool.Name]
                else
                    local cfg = tool:FindFirstChild("Config")
                    if cfg and cfg:IsA("ModuleScript") then
                        pcall(function()
                            local m = require(cfg)
                            if m.Mains and m.Mains.S1 then
                                cd = (m.Mains.S1.SwingWait or 0.2) + (m.Mains.S1.SwingTime or 0.1) + 0.05
                            end
                        end)
                    end
                end
                if tick() - MA.LastHit >= cd then
                    for _, p in ipairs(PlayersService:GetPlayers()) do
                        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                            if true then
                                local tChar = p.Character
                                local tRoot = tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                                local myRoot = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                                local hum = tChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                                local dist = tRoot and myRoot and (tRoot.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
                                if dist <= MA_GetReach() and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                                    local ok, res = pcall(function()
                                        return MA.Remote1:InvokeServer("🍞", tick(), tool, "43TRFWX", "Normal", tick(), true)
                                    end)
                                    if ok and res then
                                        if MA.ShowAnim then
                                            pcall(function()
                                                char.Humanoid.Animator:LoadAnimation(tool.AnimsFolder.Slash1):Play(0.1, 1, 1.3)
                                            end)
                                        end
                                        local hitPart = MA.TargetPart == "Random"
                                            and tChar:FindFirstChild(MA.Parts[math.random(1, #MA.Parts)])
                                            or tChar:FindFirstChild(MA.TargetPart)
                                        if hitPart then
                                            local a = {"🍞", tick(), tool, "43TRFWX", "Normal", tick(), false, hitPart, hitPart.Position, Vector3.new(0,1,0)}
                                            if tool.Name == "Chainsaw" then
                                                for i = 1, 15 do MA.Remote2:FireServer(table.unpack(a)) end
                                            else
                                                MA.Remote2:FireServer(table.unpack(a))
                                            end
                                        end
                                        MA.LastHit = tick()
                                        break
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            task.wait(0.05)
        end
        MA.Loop = nil
    end)
end

SecMelee:Toggle({
    Name = "enable", Flag = "MeleeEnable", Default = false,
    Callback = function(val)
        MA.Enabled = val
        if val then StartMeleeLoop() end
    end,
}):AddKeybind({ Default = nil, Mode = "Toggle" })



SecMelee:Toggle({
    Name = "show animations", Flag = "MeleeShowAnim", Default = true,
    Callback = function(val) MA.ShowAnim = val end,
})

-- Auto reach: use the tool's actual swing range from its Config,
-- falling back to a tight 8-stud reach so it only fires when you're
-- genuinely next to someone. No slider needed.
local function MA_GetReach()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local tool = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    if not tool then return 8 end
    local cfg = tool:FindFirstChild("Config")
    if cfg and cfg:IsA("ModuleScript") then
        local ok, m = pcall(require, cfg)
        if ok and m and m.Mains and m.Mains.S1 and m.Mains.S1.Range then
            return tonumber(m.Mains.S1.Range) or 8
        end
    end
    return 8
end
MA.Distance = 999 -- internal sentinel; actual check uses MA_GetReach()

SecMelee:Dropdown({
    Name = "target part", Flag = "MeleeTargetPart",
    Options = { "Random", "Head", "Torso", "Left Arm", "Right Arm", "Left Leg", "Right Leg" },
    Default = "Random",
    Callback = function(val) MA.TargetPart = val end,
})

end;

-- ── UNDERGROUND DESYNC ──────────────────────────────────────
do
local _RunService       = game:GetService("RunService")
local _LocalPlayer      = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer

local _UG = {
    Enabled        = false,
    Height         = -10,
    Pitch          = 0,
    Yaw            = 0,
    Roll           = 0,
    RandomizePitch = false,
    RandomizeYaw   = false,
    RandomizeRoll  = false,
    VizEnabled     = false,
    VizColor       = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    ClientRoot     = nil,
    SavedCFrame    = nil,
    Hook           = nil,
    Connection     = nil,
}

local _ugVizModel = nil
local _ugVizParts = {}
local _ugVizHL    = nil
local _ugVizConn  = nil

local _UG_PARTS = {
    { "Torso",    Vector3.new(2, 2, 1), Vector3.new( 0,  0, 0) },
    { "Head",     Vector3.new(2, 2, 1), Vector3.new( 0,  2, 0) },
    { "LeftArm",  Vector3.new(1, 2, 1), Vector3.new(-1.5, 0, 0) },
    { "RightArm", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1), Vector3.new( 1.5, 0, 0) },
    { "LeftLeg",  Vector3.new(1, 2, 1), Vector3.new(-0.5,-2, 0) },
    { "RightLeg", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1), Vector3.new( 0.5,-2, 0) },
}

local function _ugDestroyViz()
    if _ugVizConn  then _ugVizConn:Disconnect()                    _ugVizConn  = nil end
    if _ugVizModel then pcall(function() _ugVizModel:Destroy() end) _ugVizModel = nil end
    _ugVizParts = {}
    _ugVizHL    = nil
end

local function _ugUpdateVizColor()
    if not _ugVizHL then return end
    _ugVizHL.FillColor    = _UG.VizColor
    _ugVizHL.OutlineColor = _UG.VizColor
end

local function _ugBuildViz()
    _ugDestroyViz()
    if not _UG.VizEnabled or not _UG.Enabled then return end
    local m = Instance.new("Model")
    m.Name   = "UGDesyncViz"
    m.Parent = workspace
    _ugVizModel = m
    for _, d in ipairs(_UG_PARTS) do
        local p = Instance.new("Part")
        p.Name        = d[1]
        p.Size        = d[2]
        p.Anchored    = true
        p.CanCollide  = false
        p.CastShadow  = false
        p.Color       = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        p.Transparency = 0
        p.Material    = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        p.Parent      = m
        _ugVizParts[d[1]] = { Part = p, Offset = d[3] }
    end
    _ugVizHL = Instance.new("Highlight")
    _ugVizHL.Adornee             = m
    _ugVizHL.FillTransparency    = 0
    _ugVizHL.OutlineTransparency = 0
    _ugVizHL.DepthMode           = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    _ugVizHL.Parent              = m
    _ugUpdateVizColor()

    _ugVizConn = _RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        local char = _LocalPlayer.Character
        local hrp  = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return end

        local pitch   = _UG.RandomizePitch and math.random(-180, 180) or _UG.Pitch
        local yaw     = _UG.RandomizeYaw   and math.random(-180, 180) or _UG.Yaw
        local roll    = _UG.RandomizeRoll  and math.random(-180, 180) or _UG.Roll
        local realCF  = _UG.SavedCFrame or hrp.CFrame
        local serverCF = CFrame.new(realCF.Position + Vector3.new(0, _UG.Height, 0))
            * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(pitch), math.rad(yaw), math.rad(roll))

        for _, e in pairs(_ugVizParts) do
            if e.Part and e.Part.Parent then
                e.Part.CFrame = serverCF
                    + serverCF.RightVector * e.Offset.X
                    + serverCF.UpVector    * e.Offset.Y
                    + serverCF.LookVector  * e.Offset.Z
            end
        end
    end))
end

local function _ugEnableHook()
    if _UG.Hook then return end
    local old
    old = hookmetamethod(game, "__index", LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function(self, index)
        if not checkcaller() and _UG.Enabled and _UG.SavedCFrame
            and index == "CFrame" and self == _UG.ClientRoot then
            return _UG.SavedCFrame
        end
        return old(self, index)
    end))
    _UG.Hook = old
end

local function _ugDisableHook()
    if not _UG.Hook then return end
    local h = _UG.Hook
    _UG.Hook = nil
    hookmetamethod(game, "__index", h)
end

local function _ugStart()
    if _UG.Connection then _UG.Connection:Disconnect() _UG.Connection = nil end
    if not _UG.Enabled then
        _ugDisableHook()
        task.wait(0.05)
        if _UG.ClientRoot and _UG.ClientRoot.Parent then
            if _UG.ClientRoot.Position.Y < -5 then
                _UG.ClientRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(
                    _UG.ClientRoot.Position.X, 5, _UG.ClientRoot.Position.Z)
            end
        end
        _UG.SavedCFrame = nil
        _ugDestroyViz()
        return
    end
    _ugEnableHook()
    _ugBuildViz()
    _UG.Connection = _RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        if not _UG.Enabled then
            if _UG.Connection then _UG.Connection:Disconnect() _UG.Connection = nil end
            if _UG.ClientRoot and _UG.ClientRoot.Parent then
                local cf = _UG.SavedCFrame or _UG.ClientRoot.CFrame
                _UG.ClientRoot.CFrame = cf
            end
            _RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
            _UG.SavedCFrame = nil
            _ugDisableHook()
            return
        end
        _UG.ClientRoot = _LocalPlayer.Character
            and _LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not _UG.ClientRoot then return end
        local pos = _UG.ClientRoot.Position
        _UG.SavedCFrame = _UG.ClientRoot.CFrame
        _UG.ClientRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, _UG.Height, 0))
            * (_UG.ClientRoot.CFrame - _UG.ClientRoot.Position)
        _RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
        _UG.ClientRoot.CFrame = _UG.SavedCFrame
    end))
end

_LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    if _UG.Enabled then task.wait(0.5) _ugStart() end
end)
_LocalPlayer.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function() _ugDestroyViz() end)

    fovRadius  = 100,
    followMuzzle = false,
    showFov    = false,
    followRage = false,
    followRageLerp = 0.35,
    -- NEW: silent aim fields read by the Visualize listener in the __namecall hook block.
    -- These mirror into _G.SilentAim* so the hook (which lives inside a task.spawn closure

-- ============================================================
-- STICKY AIM
-- A "press-to-lock" target lock that lives in the legit tab -> silent section.
-- Master toggle ("enable") gates whether the keybind can lock a target.
-- The keybind (Mode = "Toggle") does the actual locking / unlocking:
--   press once  -> find closest player in silent aim FOV, lock onto them
--   press again -> release the lock
-- While locked, silent aim will always redirect shots at the locked player
-- (bypassing the normal FOV scan) until the user releases the lock.
-- Optional 2D screen-space tracer (thin line + black outline, same look
-- as the silent/aimbot FOV circles) is drawn from the chosen origin
-- (cursor or local humanoid) to the sticky target's humanoid.
-- Optional "fov follow sticky target" makes the silent aim FOV circle
-- follow the sticky lock (same lerp pattern as "follow ragebot target").
-- ============================================================
local stickyAim = {
    enabled          = false,    -- master toggle (UI)
    active           = false,    -- is sticky currently locking someone (driven by keybind)
    lockedChar       = nil,      -- the locked Character instance
    -- tracer
    tracerEnabled    = false,
    tracerColor      = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    tracerOrigin     = "Cursor", -- "Cursor" or "Humanoid"
    -- fov follow
    followSticky     = false,
    followStickyLerp = 0.35,
};

local aimbotState = {

    aimCurve     = "Linear",

    advancedSmoothness = false,
    smoothnessX       = 2,
    smoothnessY       = 2,
    smoothnessJump    = 4,
    lockedTarget = nil,

    followRage = false,
    followRageLerp = 0.35,
};

    -- When OFF, silent aim won't redirect shots that would pass through
    -- walls — the bullet will go to the wall in front of you instead.
    wallbang     = true,

    -- partWhitelist: only these parts are ever considered.
    -- partBlacklist: even if whitelisted, these are skipped.
    partWhitelist = { Head = true },
    partBlacklist = {},
};
