local function weaponstricted(weaponName)
    if not weaponName then return false end;
    local restricted = {
        "Fists", "Knife", "Chainsaw", "Katana", "Scythe",
        "Battle Axe", "Riot Shield", "Trowel", "Maul", "Spear",
        "Glast Shard", "Grenade", "Molotov", "Flashbang",
        "Smoke Grenade", "Satchel", "Warpstone", "Elixir",
        "Medkit", "Subspace Tripmine", "Jump Pad", "War Horn",
        "Grappler", "RNG Dice", "Freeze Ray",
    };
    for _, w in ipairs(restricted) do
        if weaponName == w then return true end;
    end;
    return false;
end;

local function getAspectStretch()
    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera;
    if not cam then return 1 end;
    local vs = cam.ViewportSize;
    local ratio = vs.X / vs.Y;
    local target = 16 / 9;
    if ratio > target then return target / ratio end;
    return 1;
end;

local function applyAspectToViewport(vp, cam)
    cam = cam or Workspace.CurrentCamera;
    if not cam then return vp end;
    local vs = cam.ViewportSize;
    local ratio = vs.X / vs.Y;
    local target = 16 / 9;
    if ratio > target then
        local stretch = target / ratio;
        local centerY = vs.Y * 0.5;
        local y = centerY + (vp.Y - centerY) * stretch;
        return Vector2.new(vp.X, y);
    end;
    return Vector2.new(vp.X, vp.Y);
end;

local function worldToScreen(worldPos, cam)
    cam = cam or Workspace.CurrentCamera;
    if not cam or not worldPos then return nil, false end;
    local v, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(worldPos);
    if not onScreen or v.Z <= 0 then return v, false end;
    return applyAspectToViewport(v, cam), true;
end;

local function screenCenter(cam)
    -- DEFAULT: follow the mouse cursor. The user wants the FOV circle
    -- (and aimbot/silent-aim target acquisition) to track where the
    -- cursor is, not be locked to the screen center. This matches how
    -- most FPS cheats behave: your FOV circle sits on your cursor.
    -- If you enable "follow muzzle" / "follow ragebot target", those
    -- override this base.
    local _mp = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation();
    if _mp then return Vector2.new(_mp.X, _mp.Y) end;
    -- Fallback: screen center (only if mouse position unavailable,
    -- which basically never happens in practice).
    cam = cam or Workspace.CurrentCamera;
    if not cam then return Vector2.zero end;
    local vs = cam.ViewportSize;
    return Vector2.new(vs.X * 0.5, vs.Y * 0.5);
end;

local function muzzlepos()
    -- ── Criminality: equipped tool's WeaponHandle.Muzzle attachment ──
    -- Criminality tools use the basic Tool system. The equipped tool is
    -- LocalPlayer.Character's first Tool child, and its muzzle is the
    -- "Muzzle" Attachment inside WeaponHandle. Falls back to FirePos if
    -- Muzzle is missing. Works for every gun (AKS, Deagle, G-17, M4A1,
    -- Sawn-Off, TEC-9, Uzi, etc.).
    local _char = LocalPlayer.Character;
    if _char then
        local _tool = _char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool");
        if _tool then
            local _wh = _tool:FindFirstChild("WeaponHandle");
            if _wh and _wh:IsA("BasePart") then
                local _mz = _wh:FindFirstChild("Muzzle");
                if _mz and _mz:IsA("Attachment") then
                    return _mz.WorldPosition;
                end;
                local _fp = _wh:FindFirstChild("FirePos");
                if _fp and _fp:IsA("Attachment") then
                    return _fp.WorldPosition;
                end;
                -- Last resort: the WeaponHandle part itself.
                return _wh.Position;
            end;
        end;
    end;

    -- ── RIVALS: viewmodel muzzle (kept for cross-game support) ──
    local vm = Workspace:FindFirstChild("ViewModels");
    if not vm then return nil end;
    local fp = vm:FindFirstChild("FirstPerson");
    if not fp then return nil end;
    local pn = LocalPlayer.Name;
    for _, model in pairs(fp:GetChildren()) do
        if model:IsA("Model") and model.Name:find("^"..pn) then
            local iv = model:FindFirstChild("ItemVisual");
            if iv then
                local b = iv:FindFirstChild("Body");
                if b then
                    local bp = b:FindFirstChild("BodyPrimary");
                    if bp then
                        local mz = bp:FindFirstChild("_muzzle");
                        if mz and mz:IsA("Attachment") then
                            return mz.WorldPosition;
                        end;
                    end;
                end;
            end;
        end;
    end;
    return nil;
end;

local function screenpos3(pos3)
    if not pos3 then return nil end;
    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera;
    if not cam then return nil end;
    local v, on = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(pos3);
    if not on or v.Z <= 0 then return nil end;
    return applyAspectToViewport(v, cam);
end;

-- perf/follow: lerped "follow ragebot target" helpers — purely visual, aim logic untouched
local _fovFollowState = {
    silent = { x = nil, y = nil },
    aimbot = { x = nil, y = nil },
    silentSticky = { x = nil, y = nil }, -- sticky aim follow lerp state
};

-- follow ragebot target: shared resolver used by silent aim + aimbot FOV.
-- Returns the ragebot's current target CHARACTER (validated: parented, alive,
-- not forcefielded) so "follow ragebot target" can lock the same character the
-- ragebot is synced to — same source the (working) crosshair follow reads.
-- (kept as fields on _fovFollowState rather than extra locals: the enclosing
-- function is near Luau's 200-local-register compile limit)
_fovFollowState.rageChar = function()
    local fn = getgenv()._RivalsRagebotTarget;
    if not fn then return nil end;
    local okChar, char = pcall(fn);
    if not okChar or not char or not char.Parent then return nil end;
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");
    if not hum then
        local wrapper = char:FindFirstChild("EnemyHumanoid");
        if wrapper then
            if wrapper:IsA("Humanoid") then
                hum = wrapper;
            else
                hum = wrapper:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");
            end;
        end;
    end;
    if hum and hum.Health <= 0 then return nil end;
    if char:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then return nil end;
    return char;
end;

_fovFollowState.rageScreenPos = function()
    local char = _fovFollowState.rageChar();
    if not char then return nil end;
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char.PrimaryPart or char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart");
    if not root then return nil end;
    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera;
    if not cam then return nil end;
    local ok, vp, on = pcall(function()
        local vv, onS = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0));
        return vv, onS;
    end);
    if not ok or not vp or not on or ((vp.Z or 0) <= 0) then return nil end;
    return Vector2.new(vp.X, vp.Y);
end;

-- sticky aim target resolver: returns the locked character if it is still
-- parented, alive, and not forcefielded; nil otherwise. Used by both
-- the FOV follow (silentfovcenter) and the tracer render step.
_fovFollowState.stickyChar = function()
    if not stickyAim.enabled or not stickyAim.active then return nil end;
    local c = stickyAim.lockedChar;
    if not c or not c.Parent then return nil end;
    local hum = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");
    if not hum then
        local wrapper = c:FindFirstChild("EnemyHumanoid");
        if wrapper then
            if wrapper:IsA("Humanoid") then
                hum = wrapper;
            else
                hum = wrapper:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");
            end;
        end;
    end;
    if hum and hum.Health <= 0 then return nil end;
    if c:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then return nil end;
    return c;
end;

-- sticky aim screen position: project the sticky lock's root part to
-- screen, offset 3 studs up (same convention as rageScreenPos) so the
-- FOV circle follows roughly chest/upper-body height.
_fovFollowState.stickyScreenPos = function()
    local char = _fovFollowState.stickyChar();
    if not char then return nil end;
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char.PrimaryPart or char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart");
    if not root then return nil end;
    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera;
    if not cam then return nil end;
    local ok, vp, on = pcall(function()
        local vv, onS = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0));
        return vv, onS;
    end);
    if not ok or not vp or not on or ((vp.Z or 0) <= 0) then return nil end;
    return Vector2.new(vp.X, vp.Y);
end;

local function silentfovcenter()
    local base = screenCenter(Camera);
    -- STICKY FOLLOW: takes priority over rage follow because a sticky lock
    -- is more specific (a manual single-target lock vs ragebot's pick).
    if stickyAim.followSticky then
        local p = _fovFollowState.stickyScreenPos();
        if p then
            local a = math.clamp(stickyAim.followStickyLerp or 0.35, 0.01, 1);
            if not _fovFollowState.silentSticky.x then
                _fovFollowState.silentSticky.x, _fovFollowState.silentSticky.y = p.X, p.Y;
            else
                _fovFollowState.silentSticky.x = _fovFollowState.silentSticky.x + (p.X - _fovFollowState.silentSticky.x) * a;
                _fovFollowState.silentSticky.y = _fovFollowState.silentSticky.y + (p.Y - _fovFollowState.silentSticky.y) * a;
            end;
            return Vector2.new(_fovFollowState.silentSticky.x, _fovFollowState.silentSticky.y);
        end;
        _fovFollowState.silentSticky.x, _fovFollowState.silentSticky.y = nil, nil;
    end;
    if silentAim.followRage then
        local p = _fovFollowState.rageScreenPos();
        if p then
            local a = math.clamp(silentAim.followRageLerp or 0.35, 0.01, 1);
            if not _fovFollowState.silent.x then
                _fovFollowState.silent.x, _fovFollowState.silent.y = p.X, p.Y;
            else
                _fovFollowState.silent.x = _fovFollowState.silent.x + (p.X - _fovFollowState.silent.x) * a;
                _fovFollowState.silent.y = _fovFollowState.silent.y + (p.Y - _fovFollowState.silent.y) * a;
            end;
            return Vector2.new(_fovFollowState.silent.x, _fovFollowState.silent.y);
        end;
        _fovFollowState.silent.x, _fovFollowState.silent.y = nil, nil;
    end;
    if silentAim.followMuzzle then
        local s = screenpos3(muzzlepos());
        if s then return s end;
    end;
    return base;
end;

local function aimbotfovcenter()
    local base = screenCenter(Camera);
    if aimbotState.followRage then
        local p = _fovFollowState.rageScreenPos();
        if p then
            local a = math.clamp(aimbotState.followRageLerp or 0.35, 0.01, 1);
            if not _fovFollowState.aimbot.x then
                _fovFollowState.aimbot.x, _fovFollowState.aimbot.y = p.X, p.Y;
            else
                _fovFollowState.aimbot.x = _fovFollowState.aimbot.x + (p.X - _fovFollowState.aimbot.x) * a;
                _fovFollowState.aimbot.y = _fovFollowState.aimbot.y + (p.Y - _fovFollowState.aimbot.y) * a;
            end;
            return Vector2.new(_fovFollowState.aimbot.x, _fovFollowState.aimbot.y);
        end;
        _fovFollowState.aimbot.x, _fovFollowState.aimbot.y = nil, nil;
    end;
    if aimbotState.followMuzzle then
        local s = screenpos3(muzzlepos());
        if s then return s end;
    end;
    return base;
end;

_RegisterRenderStepped(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera;
    if not cam then return end;
    Camera = cam;

    -- pcall the .Visible access: some executor threads lack capability to
    -- read Instance properties directly, which would otherwise spam errors
    -- every frame.
    local _sVisible, _aVisible = false, false;
    pcall(function() _sVisible = silentFOVContainer.Visible end);
    pcall(function() _aVisible = aimbotFOVContainer.Visible end);
    if not _sVisible and not _aVisible then
        return;
    end;

    if _sVisible then
        local sc = silentfovcenter();
        local r  = silentAim.fovRadius;
        silentFOVContainer.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sc.X - r, sc.Y - r);
        silentFOVContainer.Size     = UDim2.fromOffset(r * 2, r * 2);
        if silentFOVCfg.SpinOn then
            silentFOVStrokeGrad.Rotation = silentFOVStrokeGrad.Rotation + silentFOVCfg.SpinSpd;
        end;
        if silentFOVCfg.FilledAnimated then
            silentFOVFillGrad.Rotation = silentFOVFillGrad.Rotation + silentFOVCfg.FilledSpeed;
        end;
    end;

    if _aVisible then
        local ac = aimbotfovcenter();
        local ar = aimbotState.fovRadius;
        aimbotFOVContainer.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(ac.X - ar, ac.Y - ar);
        aimbotFOVContainer.Size     = UDim2.fromOffset(ar * 2, ar * 2);
        if aimbotFOVCfg.SpinOn then
            aimbotFOVStrokeGrad.Rotation = aimbotFOVStrokeGrad.Rotation + aimbotFOVCfg.SpinSpd;
        end;
    if aimbotFOVCfg.FilledAnimated then
            aimbotFOVFillGrad.Rotation = aimbotFOVFillGrad.Rotation + aimbotFOVCfg.FilledSpeed;
        end;
    end;
end));

-- ============================================================
-- STICKY AIM TRACER (Frame-based, parented to fovScreenGui)
-- Two rotated Frames: a thicker black "outline" frame drawn behind,
-- a thinner coloured "inline" frame drawn in front. Same ScreenGui
-- as the silent aim / aimbot FOV circles, so it renders on any
-- executor that can render those (Drawing.new("Line") is unreliable
-- in some executors, so we use the Frame approach for parity with the
-- FOV circles).
-- Origin is either the cursor (mouse position) or the local player's
-- humanoid root part, depending on the dropdown.
-- Target is always the sticky lock's humanoid root part.
-- ============================================================
local stickyTracerOutline = Instance.new("Frame");
stickyTracerOutline.Name                   = "StickyTracerOutline";
stickyTracerOutline.AnchorPoint            = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5);
stickyTracerOutline.BackgroundColor3        = Color3.new(0, 0, 0);
stickyTracerOutline.BorderSizePixel        = 0;
stickyTracerOutline.Visible                = false;
stickyTracerOutline.ZIndex                 = 1;
stickyTracerOutline.Parent                 = fovScreenGui;

local stickyTracerInline = Instance.new("Frame");
stickyTracerInline.Name                    = "StickyTracerInline";
stickyTracerInline.AnchorPoint             = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5);
stickyTracerInline.BackgroundColor3        = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255);
stickyTracerInline.BorderSizePixel        = 0;
stickyTracerInline.Visible                 = false;
stickyTracerInline.ZIndex                  = 2;
stickyTracerInline.Parent                  = fovScreenGui;

-- Lua-side state tracker: avoids touching Instance .Visible every
-- frame (which the executor sandbox blocks with "lacking capability
-- Plugin"). We only write Instance properties when the desired state
-- differs from the last applied state.
local _stickyTracerShown = false;

local function _stickyTracerHide()
    if not _stickyTracerShown then return end; -- already hidden, no-op
    _stickyTracerShown = false;
    pcall(function() stickyTracerOutline.Visible = false; end);
    pcall(function() stickyTracerInline.Visible  = false; end);
end;

local function _stickyTracerSetLine(frame, fromPos, toPos, thickness, color)
    local dx = toPos.X - fromPos.X;
    local dy = toPos.Y - fromPos.Y;
    local length = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    if length < 1 then
        return false;
    end;
    local angle = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx));
    local midX = (fromPos.X + toPos.X) * 0.5;
    local midY = (fromPos.Y + toPos.Y) * 0.5;
    pcall(function()
        frame.Position    = UDim2.fromOffset(midX, midY);
        frame.Size        = UDim2.fromOffset(length, thickness);
        frame.Rotation    = angle;
        frame.BackgroundColor3 = color;
        frame.Visible     = true;
    end);
    return true;
end;

_RegisterRenderStepped(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
    -- Cheap bail-out: only do work when sticky aim is on, active, tracer
    -- enabled, and we have a valid lock. Crucially, when sticky aim is
    -- OFF, we never touch the Instance properties at all (the
    -- _stickyTracerShown gate ensures _stickyTracerHide is a no-op once
    -- the tracer has been hidden once).
    if not (stickyAim.enabled and stickyAim.active and stickyAim.tracerEnabled) then
        _stickyTracerHide();
        return;
    end;
    local char = _fovFollowState.stickyChar();
    if not char then
        _stickyTracerHide();
        return;
    end;
    local targetRoot = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        or char.PrimaryPart
        or char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart");
    if not targetRoot then
        _stickyTracerHide();
        return;
    end;
    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera;
    if not cam then
        _stickyTracerHide();
        return;
    end;

    -- Resolve origin screen position.
    local originScreen;
    if stickyAim.tracerOrigin == "Humanoid" then
        local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character;
        local myRoot = myChar and (myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            or myChar.PrimaryPart
            or myChar:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart"));
        if not myRoot then _stickyTracerHide(); return; end;
        local vp, on = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(myRoot.Position);
        if not on or vp.Z <= 0 then _stickyTracerHide(); return; end;
        originScreen = Vector2.new(vp.X, vp.Y);
    else -- "Cursor"
        local mp = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation();
        originScreen = Vector2.new(mp.X, mp.Y);
    end;

    -- Resolve target screen position.
    local tvp, ton = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(targetRoot.Position);
    if not ton or tvp.Z <= 0 then _stickyTracerHide(); return; end;
    local targetScreen = Vector2.new(tvp.X, tvp.Y);

    -- Draw the outline first (thicker black), then the inline (thinner
    -- colour) on top. If the outline draw failed (line too short), hide
    -- the inline too. Mark _stickyTracerShown so the next hide actually
    -- writes the Instance properties.
    local drewOutline = _stickyTracerSetLine(
        stickyTracerOutline, originScreen, targetScreen, 3, Color3.new(0, 0, 0));
    if drewOutline then
        _stickyTracerSetLine(
            stickyTracerInline, originScreen, targetScreen, 1, stickyAim.tracerColor);
        _stickyTracerShown = true;
    else
        _stickyTracerHide();
    end;
end));

local function isVisible(part)
    if not targetingCfg.visibleCheck then return true end;
    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera;
    if not cam or not part then return true end;
    local char = part.Parent;
    if not char then return false end;
    local origin = cam.CFrame.Position;
    local dir    = (part.Position - origin);
    if dir.Magnitude < 0.01 then return true end;
    local ray = Ray.new(origin, dir.Unit * (dir.Magnitude + 2));
    local hit = Workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(ray, { LocalPlayer.Character });
    if not hit then return false end;
    if hit == part then return true end;
    if hit:IsDescendantOf(char) then return true end;
    return false;
end;

local function _SafeFindFirstDescendant(parent, name)
    if not parent then return nil end;
    local ok, result = pcall(function() return parent:FindFirstDescendant(name) end);
    if ok and result then return result end;
    for _, d in ipairs(parent:GetDescendants()) do
        if d.Name == name then return d end;
    end;
    return nil;
end;

local function hitpartfromname(target, partName)
    if not target then return nil end;
    if partName == "Head" then
        return target:FindFirstChild("Head")
            or _SafeFindFirstDescendant(target, "Head");
    elseif partName == "HumanoidRootPart" then
        return target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            or _SafeFindFirstDescendant(target, "HumanoidRootPart");
    end;
    return target:FindFirstChild(partName)
        or _SafeFindFirstDescendant(target, partName);
end;

-- Returns a random whitelisted part from a character, excluding
-- blacklisted ones. Falls back to Head, then HumanoidRootPart, if
-- nothing whitelisted is present. Ported from older RIVALS.txt.
local _LEGIT_PARTS = { "Head", "HumanoidRootPart", "UpperTorso", "LowerTorso", "Torso" };
local function pickWhitelistedPart(char)
    if not char then return nil end;
    local candidates = {};
    for _, partName in ipairs(_LEGIT_PARTS) do
        if targetingCfg.partWhitelist[partName] and not targetingCfg.partBlacklist[partName] then
            local p = char:FindFirstChild(partName) or _SafeFindFirstDescendant(char, partName);
            if p then
                table.insert(candidates, p);
            end;
        end;
    end;
    if #candidates > 0 then
        return candidates[math.random(1, #candidates)];
    end;
    -- fallback: any non-blacklisted part
    return (not targetingCfg.partBlacklist["Head"] and (char:FindFirstChild("Head") or _SafeFindFirstDescendant(char, "Head")))
        or (not targetingCfg.partBlacklist["HumanoidRootPart"] and (char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or _SafeFindFirstDescendant(char, "HumanoidRootPart")))
        or nil;
end;

local localFighter = nil;

local camController = nil;

pcall(function()
local ctrl = LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("Controllers");
    if ctrl then
        local cm = ctrl:FindFirstChild("CameraController");
        if cm and cm:IsA("ModuleScript") then camController = require(cm) end;
        local fm = ctrl:FindFirstChild("FighterController");
        if fm and fm:IsA("ModuleScript") then
            local fc = require(fm);
            localFighter = fc.LocalFighter;
            combatMods._localFighter = localFighter;
        end;
    end;
end);
task.spawn(function()
    while not localFighter do
        task.wait(0.2);
        pcall(function()
            local fm = LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("Controllers")
                and LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Controllers:FindFirstChild("FighterController");
            if fm and fm:IsA("ModuleScript") then
                local fc = require(fm);
                if fc and fc.LocalFighter then
                    localFighter = fc.LocalFighter;
                    combatMods._localFighter = localFighter;
                end;
            end;
        end);
    end;
end);

local function clearAimbotLock()
    aimbotState.lockedTarget = nil;
    aimbotState.smoothCF     = nil;
end;

local function getAimbotScreenPoint()
    -- follow the same center the FOV circle is drawn around so the drawn
    -- FOV actually gates target selection (muzzle follow AND rage follow).
    if aimbotState.followMuzzle then
        local c = aimbotfovcenter();
        if c then return c end;
    elseif aimbotState.followRage and _fovFollowState.rageChar() then
        -- ragebot has a live target: gate selection around the following
        -- FOV center (same circle drawn on screen). Without a rage target
        -- the aimbot keeps its normal mouse-centered behavior.
        return aimbotfovcenter();
    end;
    local loc = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation();
    return Vector2.new(loc.X, loc.Y);
end;

local function closesttocursor()
    -- follow ragebot target: when enabled and the ragebot has a live target,
    -- aim directly at that target's aim part (same lock the ragebot uses).
    if aimbotState.followRage then
        local rageChar = _fovFollowState.rageChar();
        if rageChar then
            local ragePart = hitpartfromname(rageChar, aimbotState.targetPart)
                or rageChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                or rageChar.PrimaryPart
                or rageChar:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart");
            if ragePart and ragePart:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
                return ragePart;
            end;
        end;
    end;
    local best, bestDist = nil, aimbotState.fovRadius;
    local mp = getAimbotScreenPoint();
    if not mp then return nil end;
    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera;
    local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");
    for _, p in ipairs(PlayersService:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
            -- UNIVERSAL FILTERS — respect the filters tab toggles
            local char = p.Character;
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");
            -- dead check (skip corpses)
            if (not targetingCfg.deadCheck) or (hum and hum.Health > 0) then
                -- forcefield check
                local ff = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField");
                if (not targetingCfg.ffCheck) or (not ff) then
                    -- team check (skip if same team AND team ~= nil, i.e. not FFA)
                    local sameTeam = (LocalPlayer.Team ~= nil) and (p.Team == LocalPlayer.Team);
                    if (not targetingCfg.teamCheck) or (not sameTeam) then
                        -- pick target part — uses aimbotState.targetPart (the "hit part" dropdown)
                        -- with a sane fallback chain so it works on any rig.
                        local part = hitpartfromname(char, aimbotState.targetPart)
                            or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                            or char.PrimaryPart
                            or char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart");
                        if part and part:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
                            local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");
                            if myRoot and root and (root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude > targetingCfg.maxDistance then
                                continue;
                            end;
                            if not isVisible(part) then continue end;
                            local scr, on = worldToScreen(part.Position, cam);
                            if on then
                                local dx = scr.X - mp.X;
                                local dy = scr.Y - mp.Y;
                                local dist = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
                                if dist < bestDist then
                                    bestDist = dist;
                                    best = part;
                                end;
                            end;
                        end;
                    end;
                end;
            end;
        end;
    end;
    return best;
end;

local function getUnstretchedCameraCFrame(cam)
    local cf = cam.CFrame;
    local stretch = getAspectStretch();
    if stretch ~= 1 then
        local _, yaw, roll = cf:ToEulerAnglesYXZ();
        cf = CFrame.fromEulerAnglesYXZ(0, yaw, roll) * CFrame.new(cf.Position);
    end;
    return cf;
end;

local function getAimbotLerpAlphaForAxis(dt, smoothness, curve)
    smoothness = math.clamp(tonumber(smoothness) or 2, 0.1, 10);
    curve      = curve or "Linear";
    local speed = 6 / smoothness;
    if aimbotState.useCustomCurve and aimbotState.customCurveAlpha then
        local t = math.clamp(speed * dt, 0, 1);
        return aimbotState.customCurveAlpha(t);
    end;
    if curve == "Instant" then
        return 1;
    elseif curve == "Expo" then
        return 1 - math.exp(-(4 / smoothness) * dt);
    elseif curve == "EaseIn" then
        local t = math.clamp(speed * dt, 0, 1);
        return t * t;
    elseif curve == "EaseOut" then
        local t = math.clamp(speed * dt, 0, 1);
        return 1 - (1 - t) * (1 - t);
    elseif curve == "EaseInOut" then
        local t = math.clamp(speed * dt, 0, 1);
        if t < 0.5 then return 2 * t * t end;
        return 1 - ((-2 * t + 2) ^ 2) / 2;
    elseif curve == "Cubic" then
        local t = math.clamp(speed * dt, 0, 1);
        return t * t * t;
    end;
    return math.clamp(speed * dt, 0, 1);
end;

local function getAimbotLerpAlpha(dt)
    return getAimbotLerpAlphaForAxis(dt, aimbotState.smoothness, aimbotState.aimCurve);
end;

local function getEffectiveSmoothness(target)
    if not aimbotState.advancedSmoothness then
        return aimbotState.smoothness, aimbotState.smoothness;
    end;
    local sx = tonumber(aimbotState.smoothnessX) or 2;
    local sy = tonumber(aimbotState.smoothnessY) or 2;
    local sj = tonumber(aimbotState.smoothnessJump) or sy;
    if target and target.Parent then
        local char = target.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");
        if char then
            local st = char:GetState();
            if st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall
            or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping
            or st == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown
            or (char.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air) then
                return sj, sj;
            end;
        end;
    end;
    return sx, sy;
end;

local function wrapAngle(a)
    return (a + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi;
end;

local AIMBOT_RENDER_BIND = "MireaAimbotUpdate";
local aimbotConnection = nil;
local aimbotUsingBind  = false;

local stepAimbot = function(dt)
    dt = dt or (1 / 240);
    if not aimbotState.enabled then
        clearAimbotLock();
        return;
    end;
    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera;
    if not cam then return end;
    -- follow ragebot target: if the ragebot switched targets, drop the stale
    -- lock immediately so the aimbot re-acquires the NEW ragebot target on
    -- this same frame instead of staying glued to the previous character.
    if aimbotState.followRage and aimbotState.lockedTarget then
        local rageChar = _fovFollowState.rageChar();
        if rageChar and not aimbotState.lockedTarget:IsDescendantOf(rageChar) then
            clearAimbotLock();
        end;
    end;
    if not aimbotState.lockedTarget then
        aimbotState.lockedTarget = closesttocursor();
        if not aimbotState.lockedTarget then return end;
    end;
    if not aimbotState.lockedTarget.Parent or not aimbotState.lockedTarget:IsDescendantOf(Workspace) then
        clearAimbotLock();
        return;
    end;
    -- UNIVERSAL AIMLOCK — no game-specific modules required.
    -- We compute a per-frame yaw/pitch lerp toward the target and write
    -- cam.CFrame directly. The Criminality camController:MimicRotation call
    -- below is a bonus that keeps Criminality's module in sync, but is
    -- never required for the aim to work.
    local camPos  = cam.CFrame.Position;
    local curLook = cam.CFrame.LookVector;

    local targetPos = aimbotState.lockedTarget.Position;
    local dirVec    = targetPos - camPos;
    if dirVec.Magnitude < 1e-3 then
        return;
    end;
    local tgtLook = dirVec.Unit;

    local curYaw   = math.atan2(-curLook.X, -curLook.Z);
    local curPitch = math.asin(math.clamp(curLook.Y, -1, 1));
    local tgtYaw   = math.atan2(-tgtLook.X, -tgtLook.Z);
    local tgtPitch = math.asin(math.clamp(tgtLook.Y, -1, 1));

    local sx, sy = getEffectiveSmoothness(aimbotState.lockedTarget);
    local alphaX = getAimbotLerpAlphaForAxis(dt, sx, aimbotState.aimCurve);
    local alphaY = getAimbotLerpAlphaForAxis(dt, sy, aimbotState.aimCurve);

    local newYaw   = curYaw   + wrapAngle(tgtYaw   - curYaw)   * alphaX;
    local newPitch = curPitch + wrapAngle(tgtPitch - curPitch) * alphaY;

    local newLook = Vector3.new(
        -math.sin(newYaw) * math.cos(newPitch),
        math.sin(newPitch),
        -math.cos(newYaw) * math.cos(newPitch)
    );
    local newCF = CFrame.lookAt(camPos, camPos + newLook);
    aimbotState.smoothCF = newCF;

    -- Write the camera every frame. pcall in case the game denies it.
    pcall(function()
        cam.CFrame = newCF;
    end);
    -- Criminality-only bonus: keep the game's CameraController in sync so it
    -- doesn't fight us next frame. Safely guarded so other games skip this.
    if camController and camController.MimicRotation then
        pcall(function()
            camController:MimicRotation(newCF);
        end);
    end;
end;

local function updaimbot()
    if aimbotConnection then
        aimbotConnection:Disconnect();
        aimbotConnection = nil;
    end;
    if aimbotUsingBind then
        pcall(function()
            RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(AIMBOT_RENDER_BIND);
        end);
        aimbotUsingBind = false;
    end;
    aimbotFOVContainer.Visible = aimbotState.masterEnabled and aimbotState.showFov;
    if not aimbotState.enabled then
        clearAimbotLock();
        return;
    end;
    local ok = pcall(function()
        RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(AIMBOT_RENDER_BIND);
        -- Priority Camera.Value + 1 = right after the game's camera module.
        -- If a game runs its camera LATER than this, switch the +1 to +20
        -- or to Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value.
        RunService:BindToRenderStep(AIMBOT_RENDER_BIND, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, stepAimbot);
    end);
    if ok then
        aimbotUsingBind = true;
    else
        -- Wrap with LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE so Luraph doesn't pay virtualization
        -- overhead on every frame for this hot path. The centralized
        -- _RegisterRenderStepped dispatcher already wraps its handlers,
        -- but this fallback path (used when BindToRenderStep fails) was
        -- bypassing that and paying the cost directly.
        aimbotConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(stepAimbot));
    end;
end;

task.spawn(function()
    local success, GunModule = pcall(function()
        return require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Modules.ItemTypes.Gun);
    end);
    if success and GunModule then
        combatMods.GunModule = GunModule;
        -- hook kept only to timestamp real shots (used by the triggerbot)
        if GunModule.StartShooting then
            combatMods.OriginalGunStartShooting = GunModule.StartShooting;
            GunModule.StartShooting = function(self, p26, p27)
                local result = { combatMods.OriginalGunStartShooting(self, p26, p27) };
                if result and result[1] == true then
                    _lastRealShotTime = tick();
                end;
                return unpack(result);
            end;
        end;
    end;
end);

local function GetMechanicsController()
    if combatMods.MechanicsController then return combatMods.MechanicsController end;
    pcall(function()
        combatMods.MechanicsController = require(LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.Controllers.MechanicsController);
    end);
    return combatMods.MechanicsController;
end;

-- ============================================================
-- STICKY AIM (legit -> silent)
-- Master toggle gates the keybind. Keybind (Mode = "Toggle") does the
-- actual lock / unlock. Dialogue holds tracer settings + FOV follow.
-- ============================================================

-- Find the closest character inside the silent aim FOV. Mirrors the
-- silent aim __namecall hook's scan loop EXACTLY (same filters): no
-- team check, no max distance, no visible check — only alive + no
-- ForceField + on-screen + inside FOV + optional wall check (when
-- silentAim.wallCheck is on). Returns the CHARACTER so we can store
-- it directly as the sticky lock.
local function _stickyFindClosestInFOV()
    if not silentAim.enabled then return nil end;
    local center = silentfovcenter();
    if not center then return nil end;
    local radius = silentAim.fovRadius;
    local partName = silentAim.targetPart or "Head";
    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera;
    if not cam then return nil end;
    local bestChar, bestDist = nil, radius;
    for _, p in ipairs(PlayersService:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
            local char = p.Character;
            local h = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");
            if h and h.Health > 0 and not char:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then
                local part = char:FindFirstChild(partName)
                    or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    or char.PrimaryPart
                    or char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart");
                if part then
                    local pos, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position);
                    if onScreen then
                        local d = (Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y) - center).Magnitude;
                        if d < bestDist then
                            local blocked = false;
                            if silentAim.wallCheck then
                                local ignore = { cam, LocalPlayer.Character, char };
                                if #cam:GetPartsObscuringTarget({ part.Position }, ignore) > 0 then
                                    blocked = true;
                                end;
                            end;
                            if not blocked then
                                bestDist = d;
                                bestChar = char;
                            end;
                        end;
                    end;
                end;
            end;
        end;
    end;
    return bestChar;
end;

local function _stickyClearLock()
    stickyAim.active     = false;
    stickyAim.lockedChar  = nil;
    _G.StickyAimActive     = false;
    _G.StickyAimLockedChar = nil;
    _fovFollowState.silentSticky.x, _fovFollowState.silentSticky.y = nil, nil;
end;

local _stickyToggle = SecSilent:Toggle({
    Name = "sticky aim", Flag = "StickyAimEnabled", Default = false,
    Callback = function(val)
        stickyAim.enabled = val;
        _G.StickyAimEnabled = val;
        if not val then
            -- master toggle off: drop any active lock + reset lerp
            _stickyClearLock();
        end;
    end,
});

-- Keybind picker on the sticky aim toggle.
-- IMPORTANT: with the library's keybind API, `Mode = "Toggle"` + Ghost
-- only fires the callback with `true` on every press and NEVER fires
-- `false` (the InputEnded handler returns early for non-hold modes).
-- That makes unlocking impossible. The aimbot keybind works around
-- this by using `Mode = "Hold"` + Ghost, which fires `true` on press
-- and `false` on release, and self-managing the toggle in the callback
-- (ignore the release, flip the state on every press). We do the same.
-- The master toggle still gates whether the keybind does anything —
-- same as ragdoll fly.
_stickyToggle:AddKeybind({
    Default = nil, Mode = "Hold", Ghost = true,
    Callback = function(state)
        if not stickyAim.enabled then
            -- master off: keybind does nothing + ensure no stale lock
            _stickyClearLock();
            return;
        end;
        if not state then return end; -- ignore key releases
        -- Every key press flips the lock state: if locked, unlock;
        -- if unlocked, try to find a target and lock.
        if stickyAim.active then
            _stickyClearLock();
        else
            local c = _stickyFindClosestInFOV();
            if c then
                stickyAim.active     = true;
                stickyAim.lockedChar  = c;
                _G.StickyAimActive     = true;
                _G.StickyAimLockedChar = c;
            else
                -- nobody in FOV: leave the lock empty. Next press tries again.
                _stickyClearLock();
            end;
        end;
    end,
});

_aimbotToggle:AddKeybind({
    Default = nil, Mode = "Hold", Ghost = true,
    Callback = function(state)
        if not aimbotState.masterEnabled then
            aimbotState.enabled = false;
            clearAimbotLock();
            updaimbot();
            return;
        end;

        if aimbotState.keyMode == "hold" then
            if state == aimbotState.enabled then return end;
            aimbotState.enabled = state;
            if not state then clearAimbotLock() end;
            updaimbot();
        else
            if not state then return end;
            aimbotState.enabled = not aimbotState.enabled;
            if not aimbotState.enabled then clearAimbotLock() end;
            updaimbot();
        end;
    end,
});

local _PRESET_CURVES = {
    ["Custom"]    = { P1Y = 0.0, P2X = 0.5, P2Y = 0.5, P3Y = 1.0 };
    ["Linear"]    = { P1Y = 0.0, P2X = 0.5, P2Y = 0.5, P3Y = 1.0 };
    ["Expo"]      = { P1Y = 0.0, P2X = 0.75, P2Y = 0.4, P3Y = 1.0 };
    ["EaseIn"]    = { P1Y = 0.0, P2X = 0.7, P2Y = 0.25, P3Y = 1.0 };
    ["EaseOut"]   = { P1Y = 0.0, P2X = 0.3, P2Y = 0.75, P3Y = 1.0 };
    ["EaseInOut"] = { P1Y = 0.0, P2X = 0.5, P2Y = 0.25, P3Y = 1.0 };
    ["Cubic"]     = { P1Y = 0.0, P2X = 0.75, P2Y = 0.15, P3Y = 1.0 };
    ["Instant"]   = { P1Y = 1.0, P2X = 0.5, P2Y = 1.0, P3Y = 1.0 };
};
SecAimbot:Dropdown({
    Name = "aim curve (preset)", Flag = "AimbotCurve",
    Options = { "Custom", "Linear", "Expo", "EaseIn", "EaseOut", "EaseInOut", "Cubic", "Instant" },
    Default = "Custom",
    Callback = function(val)
        local pts = _PRESET_CURVES[val];
        if pts and _curveEditor then
            _curveEditor:Set(pts);
        end;
        if val == "Custom" then
            aimbotState.useCustomCurve = true;
            aimbotState.aimCurve = "Linear";
        else
            aimbotState.useCustomCurve = false;
            aimbotState.aimCurve = val;
        end;
    end,
});

    Name = "fov size", Flag = "AimbotFOVRadius",
    Min = 10, Max = 1000, Default = 500, Step = 1,
    Callback = function(val) aimbotState.fovRadius = val end,
});

    Min = 0.1, Max = 10, Default = 2, Step = 0.01, Decimals = 2,
    Callback = function(val) aimbotState.smoothness = math.clamp(val, 0.1, 10) end,
});

    -- ── Weapon mod state & logic ──────────────────────────────
    local Players    = game:GetService("Players")
    local lp         = Players.LocalPlayer

    local wmState = {
        spread    = 1, spreadAmt  = 0,
        recoil    = 1, recoilAmt  = 0,
        muzzle    = 1,
        tracers   = 1,
        reload    = 1, reloadAmt  = 0,
        equip     = 1, equipAmt   = 0,
        fullauto  = 0,
        -- rapid fire (kept for legacy UI; not exposed in Legit tab anymore)
        rapidfire   = 0, rapidfireAmt   = 999,
    }
    -- Expose wmState so the __namecall hook (set up earlier in the
    -- script) can read spread / tracer / recoil state at fire time.
    -- This makes "no spread" + "no bullet tracers" work on EVERY weapon
    -- regardless of whether the gun caches Config at equip time, because
    -- we intercept the actual FireServer call and rewrite the spread
    -- direction (or skip tracer drawing) at the remote layer.
    _G.WMState = wmState;

    local origCache = {}

    local function cacheOriginals(tool, cfg)
        if origCache[tool] then return end
        origCache[tool] = {
            Spread               = cfg.Spread,
            NFP_SPR_M            = cfg.NFP_SPR_M,
            WalkSpreadIncrease   = cfg.WalkSpreadIncrease,
            Accuracy             = cfg.Accuracy,
            SprayLerpAngleX      = cfg.SprayLerp and cfg.SprayLerp.AngleX,
            SprayLerpAngleY      = cfg.SprayLerp and cfg.SprayLerp.AngleY,
            SprayLerpAngleZ      = cfg.SprayLerp and cfg.SprayLerp.AngleZ,
            SprayLerpAngleY2     = cfg.SprayLerp and cfg.SprayLerp.AngleY2,
            Recoil               = cfg.Recoil,
            AngleX_Min           = cfg.AngleX_Min,
            AngleX_Max           = cfg.AngleX_Max,
            AngleY_Min           = cfg.AngleY_Min,
            AngleY_Max           = cfg.AngleY_Max,
            AngleZ_Min           = cfg.AngleZ_Min,
            AngleZ_Max           = cfg.AngleZ_Max,
            RecoilSpeed          = cfg.RecoilSpeed,
            MuzzleFlashEmitCount = cfg.MuzzleFlashEmitCount,
            ReloadTime           = cfg.ReloadTime,
            ReloadSlowDown       = cfg.ReloadSlowDown,
            EquipTime            = cfg.EquipTime,
            HolsterSpeed         = cfg.HolsterSpeed,
            FireMode             = cfg.FireModeSettings and cfg.FireModeSettings.FireMode,
            -- rapid fire / bullet vel / ext range
            FireRate             = cfg.FireRate,
            BurstRate            = cfg.FireModeSettings and cfg.FireModeSettings.BurstRate,
            DelayBeforeFiring    = cfg.DelayBeforeFiring,
            Range                 = cfg.Range,
            Dropoff               = cfg.Dropoff,
            DropoffDistance       = cfg.DropoffDistance,
            RangeModifier         = cfg.RangeModifier,
            BulletVelocity        = cfg.BulletSettings and cfg.BulletSettings.Velocity,
            BulletAcceleration    = cfg.BulletSettings and cfg.BulletSettings.Acceleration,
            BulletWindOffset      = cfg.BulletSettings and cfg.BulletSettings.WindOffset,
        }
    end

    local function applyOverrides(tool)
        local cfgModule = tool:FindFirstChild("Config")
        if not cfgModule then return end
        local isGunVal = tool:FindFirstChild("IsGun")
        if not isGunVal or not isGunVal.Value then return end
        local ok, cfg = pcall(require, cfgModule)
        if not ok or type(cfg) ~= "table" then return end
        cacheOriginals(tool, cfg)
        local o = origCache[tool]
        local sv = wmState.spread
        local rv = wmState.recoil
        local mv = wmState.muzzle
        local tv = wmState.tracers
        local rlv = wmState.reload
        local eqv = wmState.equip
        local fav = wmState.fullauto
        -- spread
        cfg.Spread             = (o.Spread             or 0) * sv
        cfg.NFP_SPR_M          = (o.NFP_SPR_M          or 0) * sv
        cfg.WalkSpreadIncrease = (o.WalkSpreadIncrease  or 0) * sv
        cfg.Accuracy           = (o.Accuracy            or 0) * sv
        if cfg.SprayLerp then
            cfg.SprayLerp.AngleX  = (o.SprayLerpAngleX  or 0) * sv
            cfg.SprayLerp.AngleY  = (o.SprayLerpAngleY  or 0) * sv
            cfg.SprayLerp.AngleZ  = (o.SprayLerpAngleZ  or 0) * sv
            cfg.SprayLerp.AngleY2 = (o.SprayLerpAngleY2 or 0) * sv
            cfg.SprayLerp.Enabled = (sv > 0.01)
        end
        if cfg.AimSettings then
            cfg.AimSettings.SpreadReductionP = 1 - sv
        end
        -- recoil
        cfg.Recoil             = (o.Recoil    or 0) * rv
        cfg.AngleX_Min         = (o.AngleX_Min or 0) * rv
        cfg.AngleX_Max         = (o.AngleX_Max or 0) * rv
        cfg.AngleY_Min         = (o.AngleY_Min or 0) * rv
        cfg.AngleY_Max         = (o.AngleY_Max or 0) * rv
        cfg.AngleZ_Min         = (o.AngleZ_Min or 0) * rv
        cfg.AngleZ_Max         = (o.AngleZ_Max or 0) * rv
        cfg.RecoilSpeed        = (o.RecoilSpeed or 0) * rv
        cfg.RecoilDamper       = 1
        cfg.RecoilRedution     = 1
        cfg.CameraRecoilingEnabled = (rv > 0.01)
        if cfg.AimSettings then
            cfg.AimSettings.RecoilReduction_X = 1 - rv
            cfg.AimSettings.RecoilReduction_Y = 1 - rv
            cfg.AimSettings.RecoilReduction_Z = 1 - rv
        end
        -- muzzle flash (Config side — also handled at particle level below)
        if cfg.FlashSettings then
            cfg.FlashSettings.Enabled = (mv > 0.5)
        end
        cfg.MuzzleFlashEmitCount = (o.MuzzleFlashEmitCount or 0) * mv
        -- tracers (Config side)
        if cfg.BulletSettings then
            cfg.BulletSettings.TracerEnabled   = (tv > 0.5)
            cfg.BulletSettings.ParticleEnabled = (tv > 0.5)
            cfg.BulletSettings.LightEnabled    = (tv > 0.5)
        end
        -- reload
        cfg.ReloadTime      = (o.ReloadTime    or 0) * rlv
        cfg.ReloadAnimSpeed = 1 / math.max(cfg.ReloadTime, 0.01)
        cfg.ReloadSlowDown  = (o.ReloadSlowDown or 0) * rlv
        -- equip
        cfg.EquipTime      = (o.EquipTime    or 0) * eqv
        cfg.EquipAnimSpeed = 1 / math.max(cfg.EquipTime, 0.01)
        cfg.HolsterSpeed   = (o.HolsterSpeed or 0) * eqv
        -- full-auto
        if cfg.FireModeSettings then
            if fav > 0.5 then
                cfg.FireModeSettings.FireMode = "Auto"
            else
                cfg.FireModeSettings.FireMode = o.FireMode or cfg.FireModeSettings.FireMode
            end
        end
        -- rapid fire (state.rapidfire: 0=off, 1=on)
        local rfv = wmState.rapidfire
        if rfv > 0.5 then
            cfg.FireRate = wmState.rapidfireAmt
            if cfg.FireModeSettings then
                cfg.FireModeSettings.BurstRate = wmState.rapidfireAmt
            end
            cfg.DelayBeforeFiring = 0
        else
            cfg.FireRate = o.FireRate
            if cfg.FireModeSettings then
                cfg.FireModeSettings.BurstRate = o.BurstRate
            end
            cfg.DelayBeforeFiring = o.DelayBeforeFiring
        end

        -- ── DIRECT PARTICLEMITTER DISABLE (Criminality-specific) ──
        -- Criminality guns mount real ParticleEmitters on the
        -- WeaponHandle.Muzzle attachment ("Muzzle Flash 1",
        -- "FlashEmitter", "Barrel smoke", "Gas", "Lens flare",
        -- "Sparkles", "SmokeEmitter"). Modifying cfg.MuzzleFlashEmitCount
        -- does NOTHING because the emitters fire directly. Toggle them
        -- here so muzzle flash actually disappears.
        local _wh = tool:FindFirstChild("WeaponHandle");
        if _wh and _wh:IsA("BasePart") then
            local _mzAtt = _wh:FindFirstChild("Muzzle");
            local _target = _mzAtt or _wh;
            for _, _child in ipairs(_target:GetChildren()) do
                if _child:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
                    -- Always force off when "no muzzle flash" is enabled.
                    -- Otherwise restore from the origCache so we don't
                    -- permanently break the gun after toggling off.
                    local _origEnabled = nil;
                    local _cache = origCache[tool];
                    if _cache and _cache._emitterStates then
                        _origEnabled = _cache._emitterStates[_child];
                    end;
                    if _origEnabled == nil then
                        _origEnabled = _child.Enabled;
                        if not _cache._emitterStates then
                            _cache._emitterStates = {};
                        end;
                        _cache._emitterStates[_child] = _origEnabled;
                    end;
                    if mv < 0.5 then
                        _child.Enabled = false;
                    else
                        _child.Enabled = _origEnabled;
                    end;
                end;
            end;
        end;
    end

    local function applyToAll()
        local char = lp.Character
        local bp   = lp.Backpack
        if bp then
            for _, tool in ipairs(bp:GetChildren()) do
                if tool:IsA("Tool") then applyOverrides(tool) end
            end
        end
        if char then
            for _, tool in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                if tool:IsA("Tool") then applyOverrides(tool) end
            end
        end
    end
    -- Expose applyToAll so the Visuals-tab gun toggles (which live in
    -- a different do-block) can trigger a re-apply of all weapon mods.
    _G.WMApplyToAll = applyToAll;

    applyToAll()

    local function hookContainer(container)
        container.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
            if child:IsA("Tool") then
                task.wait(0.05)
                applyOverrides(child)
            end
        end)
    end

    hookContainer(lp.Backpack)
    if lp.Character then hookContainer(lp.Character) end
    lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        hookContainer(char)
    end)

    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
            task.wait(0.5)
            applyToAll()
        end
    end)

    -- ============================================================
    -- AGGRESSIVE WEAPON MODS (getgc(true) fallback)
    -- The existing applyOverrides() modifies the Config ModuleScript
    -- of the player's tools. But the gun's fire code may cache the
    -- config values at equip time, so modifying the Config after equip
    -- does not take effect. This system walks getgc(true) to find ALL
    -- gun config tables in memory (identified by the EquipTime field)
    -- and modifies them directly. This catches configs the normal
    -- approach misses.
    -- ============================================================
    local _nrMem = {
        Enabled = false,
        Cache = {},
        OrigVals = {},
        RecoilVal = 0,
        SpreadVal = 0,
        RapidFire = false,
        RapidFireRate = 999,
        FullAuto = false,
        Conns = {},
    };

    local function _nrMemCache()
        _nrMem.Cache = {};
        for _, v in pairs(getgc(true)) do
            if type(v) == "table" and rawget(v, "EquipTime") then
                table.insert(_nrMem.Cache, v);
                        if not _nrMem.OrigVals[v] then
                            _nrMem.OrigVals[v] = {
                                Recoil = v.Recoil,
                                CameraRecoilingEnabled = v.CameraRecoilingEnabled,
                                AngleX_Min = v.AngleX_Min, AngleX_Max = v.AngleX_Max,
                                AngleY_Min = v.AngleY_Min, AngleY_Max = v.AngleY_Max,
                                AngleZ_Min = v.AngleZ_Min, AngleZ_Max = v.AngleZ_Max,
                                Spread = v.Spread,
                                NFP_SPR_M = v.NFP_SPR_M,
                                WalkSpreadIncrease = v.WalkSpreadIncrease,
                                FireRate = v.FireRate,
                                BurstRate = v.FireModeSettings and v.FireModeSettings.BurstRate,
                                DelayBeforeFiring = v.DelayBeforeFiring,
                                FireMode = v.FireModeSettings and v.FireModeSettings.FireMode,
                                CanSwitch = v.FireModeSettings and v.FireModeSettings.CanSwitch,
                            };
                end;
            end;
        end;
    end;

    local function _nrMemApply()
        for _, w in ipairs(_nrMem.Cache) do
            local o = _nrMem.OrigVals[w];
            if o then
                w.Recoil = (o.Recoil or 0) * _nrMem.RecoilVal;
                w.CameraRecoilingEnabled = _nrMem.RecoilVal > 0.01;
                w.AngleX_Min = (o.AngleX_Min or 0) * _nrMem.RecoilVal;
                w.AngleX_Max = (o.AngleX_Max or 0) * _nrMem.RecoilVal;
                w.AngleY_Min = (o.AngleY_Min or 0) * _nrMem.RecoilVal;
                w.AngleY_Max = (o.AngleY_Max or 0) * _nrMem.RecoilVal;
                w.AngleZ_Min = (o.AngleZ_Min or 0) * _nrMem.RecoilVal;
                w.AngleZ_Max = (o.AngleZ_Max or 0) * _nrMem.RecoilVal;
                w.Spread = (o.Spread or 0) * _nrMem.SpreadVal;
                w.NFP_SPR_M = (o.NFP_SPR_M or 0) * _nrMem.SpreadVal;
                w.WalkSpreadIncrease = (o.WalkSpreadIncrease or 0) * _nrMem.SpreadVal;
                if _nrMem.RapidFire then
                    w.FireRate = _nrMem.RapidFireRate;
                    if w.FireModeSettings then
                        w.FireModeSettings.BurstRate = _nrMem.RapidFireRate;
                    end;
                    w.DelayBeforeFiring = 0;
                else
                    w.FireRate = o.FireRate;
                    if w.FireModeSettings and o.BurstRate then
                        w.FireModeSettings.BurstRate = o.BurstRate;
                    end;
                    w.DelayBeforeFiring = o.DelayBeforeFiring;
                end;
                if w.FireModeSettings then
                    if _nrMem.FullAuto or _nrMem.RapidFire then
                        w.FireModeSettings.FireMode = "Auto";
                        w.FireModeSettings.CanSwitch = true;
                        w.DelayBeforeFiring = 0;
                    else
                        if o.FireMode then
                            w.FireModeSettings.FireMode = o.FireMode;
                        end;
                        if o.CanSwitch ~= nil then
                            w.FireModeSettings.CanSwitch = o.CanSwitch;
                        end;
                    end;
                end;
            end;
        end;
    end;

    local function _nrMemReset()
        for w, val in pairs(_nrMem.OrigVals) do
            w.Recoil = val.Recoil;
            w.CameraRecoilingEnabled = val.CameraRecoilingEnabled;
            w.AngleX_Min = val.AngleX_Min; w.AngleX_Max = val.AngleX_Max;
            w.AngleY_Min = val.AngleY_Min; w.AngleY_Max = val.AngleY_Max;
            w.AngleZ_Min = val.AngleZ_Min; w.AngleZ_Max = val.AngleZ_Max;
            w.Spread = val.Spread;
            w.NFP_SPR_M = val.NFP_SPR_M;
            w.WalkSpreadIncrease = val.WalkSpreadIncrease;
            w.FireRate = val.FireRate;
            if w.FireModeSettings and val.BurstRate then
                w.FireModeSettings.BurstRate = val.BurstRate;
            end;
            w.DelayBeforeFiring = val.DelayBeforeFiring;
            if w.FireModeSettings and val.FireMode then
                w.FireModeSettings.FireMode = val.FireMode;
            end;
        end;
    end;

    local function _nrMemOnChar(char)
        for _, c in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if c:IsA("Tool") then
                task.delay(0.1, function() _nrMemCache(); _nrMemApply(); end);
            end;
        end;
        table.insert(_nrMem.Conns, char.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
            if c:IsA("Tool") then
                task.delay(0.1, function() _nrMemCache(); _nrMemApply(); end);
            end;
        end));
        local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 2);
        if hum then
            table.insert(_nrMem.Conns, hum.Died:Connect(function()
                if _nrMem.Enabled then task.wait(1.5); _nrMemCache(); _nrMemApply(); end;
            end));
        end;
    end;

    local function _nrMemEnable()
        if _nrMem.Enabled then return end;
        _nrMem.Enabled = true;
        _nrMemCache(); _nrMemApply();
        table.insert(_nrMem.Conns, lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(_nrMemOnChar));
        if lp.Character then _nrMemOnChar(lp.Character); end;
        -- Re-apply every 2s so newly-loaded gun configs get caught.
        task.spawn(function()
            while _nrMem.Enabled do
                task.wait(2);
                _nrMemCache();
                _nrMemApply();
            end;
        end);
    end;

    local function _nrMemDisable()
        if not _nrMem.Enabled then return end;
        _nrMem.Enabled = false;
        _nrMemReset();
        for _, c in ipairs(_nrMem.Conns) do c:Disconnect(); end;
        _nrMem.Conns = {};
    end;

    -- ── Weapon mod controls ───────────────────────────────────
    local SecWM = TabLegit:Section({ Name = "weapon mods", Side = "Right" })

    -- Memory-based no spread / no recoil (uses getgc(true) to find
    -- all gun config tables and modify them directly). These work
    -- even when the normal Config-based approach fails because the
    -- gun's fire code caches values at equip time.
    -- No Recoil (memory): directly patches all cached gun configs via getgc
    SecWM:Toggle({
        Name = "no recoil", Flag = "WM_NRMem_Recoil", Default = false,
        Callback = function(val)
            _nrMem.RecoilVal = val and 0 or 1;
            if val and not _nrMem.Enabled then
                _nrMem.SpreadVal = _nrMem.SpreadVal or 1;
                _nrMemEnable();
            elseif _nrMem.Enabled then
                _nrMemApply();
            end;
            if not val and not _nrMem.RapidFire and not _nrMem.FullAuto
                and _nrMem.SpreadVal ~= 0 then
                -- still need memory system running for spread
            elseif not val and not _nrMem.RapidFire and not _nrMem.FullAuto
                and (_nrMem.SpreadVal == 0 or _nrMem.SpreadVal == 1) then
                -- check if anything else still needs it
            end;
            if _nrMem.Enabled then _nrMemApply(); end;
        end,
    });

    -- No Spread (memory): directly patches all cached gun configs via getgc
    SecWM:Toggle({
        Name = "no spread", Flag = "WM_NRMem_Spread", Default = false,
        Callback = function(val)
            _nrMem.SpreadVal = val and 0 or 1;
            if val and not _nrMem.Enabled then
                _nrMem.RecoilVal = _nrMem.RecoilVal or 1;
                _nrMemEnable();
            end;
            if _nrMem.Enabled then _nrMemApply(); end;
        end,
    });

    -- Rapid Fire (memory): sets FireRate to max on all cached gun configs
    local _nrRapidToggle = SecWM:Toggle({
        Name = "rapid fire", Flag = "WM_NRRapid", Default = false,
        Callback = function(val)
            _nrMem.RapidFire = val;
            if val and not _nrMem.Enabled then
                _nrMem.RecoilVal = _nrMem.RecoilVal or 1;
                _nrMem.SpreadVal = _nrMem.SpreadVal or 1;
                _nrMemEnable();
            end;
            if _nrMem.Enabled then _nrMemApply(); end;
        end,
    });
    do
        local dlg = _nrRapidToggle:AddDialog({ Name = "rapid fire settings" });
        dlg:Slider({
            Name = "fire rate", Flag = "WM_NRRapidRate",
            Min = 1, Max = 999, Default = 999, Step = 1,
            Callback = function(val)
                _nrMem.RapidFireRate = val;
                if _nrMem.Enabled then _nrMemApply(); end;
            end,
        });
    end;

    -- Force Full-Auto (memory): sets FireMode = "Auto" on all cached configs
    -- also enables force full-auto for pistols which are Semi by default
    SecWM:Toggle({
        Name = "force full-auto", Flag = "WM_NRFullAuto", Default = false,
        Callback = function(val)
            _nrMem.FullAuto = val;
            if val and not _nrMem.Enabled then
                _nrMem.RecoilVal = _nrMem.RecoilVal or 1;
                _nrMem.SpreadVal = _nrMem.SpreadVal or 1;
                _nrMemEnable();
            end;
            if _nrMem.Enabled then _nrMemApply(); end;
        end,
    });

    -- Auto Reload
    local _autoReloadEnabled  = false
    local _lastReloadAttempt  = 0
    local _RELOAD_THROTTLE    = 0.5
    local _reloadHeartbeatCon = nil

    local function _setupAutoReload()
        if _reloadHeartbeatCon then
            _reloadHeartbeatCon:Disconnect()
            _reloadHeartbeatCon = nil
        end
        if not _autoReloadEnabled then return end
        _lastReloadAttempt = 0
        _reloadHeartbeatCon = _RegisterHeartbeat(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
            if not _autoReloadEnabled then return end
            local now = tick()
            if now - _lastReloadAttempt < _RELOAD_THROTTLE then return end
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            if not char or not char.Parent then return end
            local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
            if not (tool and tool:FindFirstChild("IsGun")) then return end
            local vals = tool:FindFirstChild("Values")
            local sa   = vals and vals:FindFirstChild("SERVER_Ammo")
            local ssa  = vals and vals:FindFirstChild("SERVER_StoredAmmo")
            if not sa or not ssa then return end
            if sa.Value == 0 and ssa.Value > 0 then
                _lastReloadAttempt = now
                local GN_R = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Events.GNX_R
                pcall(function() GN_R:FireServer(now, "KLWE89U0", tool) end)
            end
        end))
    end

    SecWM:Toggle({
        Name = "auto reload", Flag = "WM_AutoReload", Default = false,
        Callback = function(val)
            _autoReloadEnabled = val
            _setupAutoReload()
        end,
    })

    -- No Muzzle Flash, No Bullet Tracers, Fast Equip moved to Visuals tab
    -- (gun section). They're visual modifications, not weapon-behavior
    -- mods. The wmState.muzzle / tracers / equip fields are still read
    -- by applyOverrides(); the Visuals-tab toggles write to them directly.

    -- Instant Reload: REMOVED per user request.
    -- Bullet Velocity: REMOVED per user request.
    -- Gun Extend Range: REMOVED per user request.

    -- (old Config-based rapid fire / full-auto removed; memory versions above are the real ones)

local function tbFovCenter()
    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera;
    if not cam then
        local mp = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation();
        return Vector2.new(mp.X, mp.Y);
    end;
    local vs = cam.ViewportSize;
    return Vector2.new(vs.X * 0.5, vs.Y * 0.5);
end;

local TB_PRECISION_PX = 8;

local _TB_HIT_PARTS = { "Head", "HumanoidRootPart", "Torso", "UpperTorso", "LowerTorso" };

local function _tbConsider(char, isPlayer, player, center, radius, cam, myRoot, closest, closestDist)
    if not char then return closest, closestDist end;
    if not char.Parent then return closest, closestDist end;
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");
    if not hum or hum.Health <= 0 then return closest, closestDist end;
    if char:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then return closest, closestDist end;
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");
    if not root then return closest, closestDist end;
    if myRoot and (root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude > targetingCfg.maxDistance then return closest, closestDist end;
    if targetingCfg.visibleCheck and not isVisible(root) then return closest, closestDist end;
    local bestPartDist = math.huge;
    for _, partName in ipairs(_TB_HIT_PARTS) do
        -- skip if blacklisted or not whitelisted (ported from RIVALS)
        if targetingCfg.partBlacklist[partName] then continue end;
        if not targetingCfg.partWhitelist[partName] then continue end;
        local p = char:FindFirstChild(partName);
        if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then
            local pos, onScreen = worldToScreen(p.Position, cam);
            if onScreen then
                local dx = pos.X - center.X;
                local dy = pos.Y - center.Y;
                local d = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
                if d < bestPartDist then bestPartDist = d end;
            end;
        end;
    end;
    if bestPartDist <= radius and bestPartDist < closestDist then
        return char, bestPartDist;
    end;
    return closest, closestDist;
end;

local function tbFindTarget()
    local center = tbFovCenter();
    local radius = TB_PRECISION_PX;
    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera;
    local myRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");
    local closest, closestDist = nil, math.huge;
    for _, player in ipairs(PlayersService:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer then
            closest, closestDist = _tbConsider(player.Character, true, player, center, radius, cam, myRoot, closest, closestDist);
        end;
    end;
    return closest;
end;

local function tbShouldFire()
    local hc = combatMods.TriggerbotHitChance or 100;
    if hc >= 100 then return true end;
    if hc <= 0 then return false end;
    return math.random(1, 100) <= hc;
end;



local function tbFire()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return false end
    local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    if not (tool and tool:FindFirstChild("IsGun")) then return false end
    local vals = tool:FindFirstChild("Values")
    local ammo = vals and vals:FindFirstChild("SERVER_Ammo")
    if not (ammo and ammo.Value > 0) then return false end
    local target = _tbCachedTarget
    if not target or not target.Parent then return false end
    local head = target:FindFirstChild("Head") or target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not head then return false end
    local myRoot = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return false end
    local origin = myRoot.Position
    local hitPos = head.Position
    local dir    = (hitPos - origin).Unit
    local key    = "K" .. math.random(1000, 9999)
    local rs     = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local GN_S   = rs.Events.GNX_S
    local ZF_H   = rs.Events.ZFKLF__H
    pcall(GN_S.FireServer, GN_S, tick(), key, tool, "FDS9I83", origin, {dir}, false)
    pcall(ZF_H.FireServer, ZF_H, "🧈", tool, key, 1, head, hitPos, dir)
    -- Dot syntax above bypasses __namecall, so we have to draw the tracer
    -- and trigger hit FX explicitly (the __namecall hook won't fire for these).
    if V.tracers.enabled then
        task.defer(function()
            pcall(createTracer, origin, hitPos);
        end);
    end;
    if V._triggerHitFx then
        task.spawn(function() pcall(V._triggerHitFx, hitPos, head) end);
    end;
    if tool and tool:FindFirstChild("Hitmarker") then
        pcall(function() tool.Hitmarker:Fire(head) end);
    end;
    return true
end;

local _lastTBShot        = 0;
local _tbBurstCounter    = 0;
local _tbCooldownUntil   = 0;
local _tbLastTargetHum   = nil;
local _tbCachedTarget    = nil;
local _tbCacheValid      = false;
local _tbCacheExpiry     = 0;
local _TB_CACHE_TTL      = 0.05;
local function _triggerbotFrame()
    local now = tick();
    if now < _tbCooldownUntil then
        _tbCachedTarget = nil;
        _tbCacheValid   = false;
        return;
    end;
    if now - _lastTBShot < (combatMods.TriggerbotDelay or 0) + 0.01 then
        return;
    end;
    local target;
    if _tbCacheValid and now < _tbCacheExpiry then
        target = _tbCachedTarget;
        if target and not target.Parent then
            target = nil;
            _tbCacheValid = false;
        end;
    else
        target = tbFindTarget();
        _tbCachedTarget = target;
        _tbCacheValid   = true;
        _tbCacheExpiry  = now + _TB_CACHE_TTL;
    end;
    if not target then
        _tbBurstCounter = 0;
        return;
    end;
    local targetHum = target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");
    if not tbShouldFire() then return end;
    if combatMods.TriggerbotBurst then
        local max = math.max(2, math.min(5, combatMods.TriggerbotBurstCount or 3));
        if _tbBurstCounter >= max then
            _tbBurstCounter = 0;
            _tbCooldownUntil = now + (combatMods.TriggerbotDelay or 0.05);
            return;
        end;
    end;
    local fired = tbFire();
    if not fired then return end;
    _lastTBShot = tick();
    _tbCachedTarget = nil;
    _tbCacheValid   = false;
    _tbCacheExpiry  = 0;
    _tbBurstCounter = _tbBurstCounter + 1;
    _tbLastTargetHum = targetHum;
    if combatMods.TriggerbotCooldownKill and targetHum then
        task.delay(0.05, function()
            if targetHum and targetHum.Health <= 0 then
                _tbCooldownUntil = tick() + (combatMods.TriggerbotCooldownKillMs or 250) / 1000;
                _tbBurstCounter = 0;
            end;
        end);
    end;
end;
_RegisterHeartbeat(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
    if not combatMods.Triggerbot then
        _tbCachedTarget = nil;
        _tbCacheValid   = false;
        return;
    end;
    pcall(_triggerbotFrame);
end));

        _lastTBShot      = 0;

        _tbCacheExpiry   = 0;
    end,
});

local PreviewAssetCache = {};

local PreviewMode = "character rig";

local function LoadPreviewUrl(Mode, Url)
        if PreviewAssetCache[Mode] then
                PreviewImageLabel.Image = PreviewAssetCache[Mode];
                return;
        end;
        task.spawn(function()
                local Ok, Data = pcall(function()
                        return game:HttpGet("https://wsrv.nl/?url=" .. game:GetService("HttpService"):UrlEncode(Url))
                end);
                if not Ok or not Data then
                        Library:Notify("Failed to fetch image", 3);
                        return;
                end;
                local _PreviewCharFolder = "frequency.lol/esp preview char";
                pcall(makefolder, _PreviewCharFolder);
                local FileName = _PreviewCharFolder .. "/esp_preview_char_" .. tostring(Mode) .. ".png";
                local WriteOk = pcall(writefile, FileName, Data);
                if not WriteOk then
                        Library:Notify("Failed to write image", 3);
                        return;
                end;
                local Asset;
                local AssetOk = pcall(function()
                        Asset = getcustomasset(FileName);
                end);
                if AssetOk and Asset then
                        PreviewAssetCache[Mode] = Asset;
                        PreviewImageLabel.Image = Asset;
                        Library:Notify("Preview loaded!", 2);
                else
                        Library:Notify("Failed to load asset", 3);
                end;
        end);
end;

local function ApplyPreviewMode(Mode)
                PreviewMode = Mode;
                if PreviewSizeMap[Mode] then
                        local S = PreviewSizeMap[Mode];
                        PreviewImageLabel.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(S.X, S.Y);
                end;
                if Mode == "character rig" then
                        PreviewImageFrame.Visible = false;
                        local M = Preview:GetModel();
                        if M then
                                for _, Part in M:GetDescendants() do
                                        if Part:IsA("BasePart") and Part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                                                pcall(function() Part.Transparency = 0 end);
                                        end;
                                end;
                        end;
                else
                        PreviewImageFrame.Visible = true;
                        local M = Preview:GetModel();
                        if M then
                                for _, Part in M:GetDescendants() do
                                        if Part:IsA("BasePart") then
                                                pcall(function() Part.Transparency = 1 end);
                                        end;
                                end;
                        end;
                        local Url = PreviewUrls[Mode];
                        if Url then
                                LoadPreviewUrl(Mode, Url);
                        end;
                end;
        end;

task.spawn(function()

                        local _PreviewCharFolder = "frequency.lol/esp preview char";
                pcall(makefolder, _PreviewCharFolder);

                        pcall(writefile, FileName, Data);
                        local Asset;
                        if pcall(function() Asset = getcustomasset(FileName) end) and Asset then
                                PreviewAssetCache[Mode] = Asset;
                        end;
                end);
        end;
end);

do
        local VpFrame = Preview.Viewport;
        local GridGui = Library:CreateInstance("Frame", {
                Name                   = "GridOverlay";
                Parent                 = VpFrame.Parent;
                Size                   = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0);
                BackgroundTransparency = 1;
                BorderSizePixel        = 0;
                ZIndex                 = 0;
                ClipsDescendants       = true;
        });
        local GridSize = 20;
        local function BuildGrid(Frame, GridFrame)
                for _, C in GridFrame:GetChildren() do C:Destroy() end;
                local W = Frame.AbsoluteSize.X;
                local H = Frame.AbsoluteSize.Y;
                if W <= 0 or H <= 0 then return end;
                local ColsX = math.ceil(W / GridSize) + 1;
                local ColsY = math.ceil(H / GridSize) + 1;
                for I = 0, ColsX do
                        Library:CreateInstance("Frame", {
                                Parent                 = GridFrame;
                                Position               = UDim2.fromOffset(I * GridSize, 0);
                                Size                   = UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, 0);
                                BackgroundColor3       = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255);
                                BackgroundTransparency = 0.92;
                                BorderSizePixel        = 0;
                                ZIndex                 = 1;
                        });
                end;
                for I = 0, ColsY do
                        Library:CreateInstance("Frame", {
                                Parent                 = GridFrame;
                                Position               = UDim2.fromOffset(0, I * GridSize);
                                Size                   = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1);
                                BackgroundColor3       = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255);
                                BackgroundTransparency = 0.92;
                                BorderSizePixel        = 0;
                                ZIndex                 = 1;
                        });
                end;
        end;
        VpFrame:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
                BuildGrid(VpFrame, GridGui);
        end);
        task.defer(function() BuildGrid(VpFrame, GridGui) end);
end;
