local function SyncEsp(Path, Value)
        local function ApplyTo(Node)
                if not Node then return end;
                local Cur = Node;
                for I = 1, #Path - 1 do
                        Cur = Cur[Path[I]];
                        if not Cur then return end;
                end;
                Cur[Path[#Path]] = Value;
        end;
        local Settings = (getgenv() and getgenv().ESP and getgenv().ESP.Settings) or nil;
        if not Settings then return end;
        ApplyTo(Settings.Players);
end;

local ESPToggle = SecESP:Toggle({ Name = "enable esp", Default = false });
ESPToggle:OnChange(function(V)
        ESPState.Enabled = V;
        SyncEsp({ "Enabled" }, V);
        if not V then
                for _, Targets in pairs(ESP.Targets) do
                        for _, TargetInfo in pairs(Targets) do
                                if TargetInfo.Objects then
                                        local Holder = TargetInfo.Objects["TargetHolder"];
                                        local Highlight = TargetInfo.Objects["Highlight"];
                                        if Holder then Holder.Visible = false end;
                                        if Highlight then Highlight.Enabled = false end;
                                end;
                        end;
                end;
        end;
end);

do
        local dlg = ESPToggle:AddDialog({ Name = "esp options" })
        dlg:Toggle({ Name = "show local player", Default = false, Callback = function(V)
                SyncEsp({ "LocalPlayer" }, V);
        end });
end;

ESPState.ActiveFlags = { moving = false, jumping = false, falling = false };

do
        local dlg = FlagsToggle:AddDialog({ Name = "visible flags" });
         dlg:Dropdown({
                Name    = "visible flags";
                Multi   = true;
                Options = {
                        "moving", "jumping", "falling", "sprinting", "crouching",
                        "climbing", "DOWNED", "grabbed", "handcuffed", "jailed",
                        "safe zone", "ragdolled", "grabbing", "blocking", "EXECUTING", "slashing"
                };
                Default = {};
                Callback = function(V)
                        ESPState.ActiveFlags = V;
                end;
        });
end;

do
        local Node = (getgenv() and getgenv().ESP and getgenv().ESP.Settings and getgenv().ESP.Settings.Players) or nil;
        if Node and Node.Flags then
                Node.Flags.Type = function(Player, CharacterObjects)
                        local Flags = {};
                        if not Player or typeof(Player) ~= "Instance" or not Player:IsA("Player") then return Flags end;
                        if not game:GetService("Players"):FindFirstChild(Player.Name) then return Flags end;
                        local Humanoid = CharacterObjects.Humanoid;
                        if not Humanoid then return Flags end;
                        local V = ESPState.ActiveFlags;

                        if V["moving"] and Humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then table.insert(Flags, "moving") end;
                        if V["jumping"] and Humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air and Humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then table.insert(Flags, "jumping") end;
                        if V["falling"] and Humanoid.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air and Humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude == 0 then table.insert(Flags, "falling") end;

                        local _cs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("CharStats");
                        local _stat = _cs and _cs:FindFirstChild(Player.Name);
                        if _stat then
                                local _sprint = _stat:FindFirstChild("Sprinting");
                                if V["sprinting"] and _sprint and _sprint.Value then table.insert(Flags, "sprinting") end;
                                local _crouch = _stat:FindFirstChild("Crouching");
                                if V["crouching"] and _crouch and _crouch.Value then table.insert(Flags, "crouching") end;
                                local _climb = _stat:FindFirstChild("Climbing");
                                if V["climbing"] and _climb and _climb.Value then table.insert(Flags, "climbing") end;
                                local _downed = _stat:FindFirstChild("Downed");
                                if V["DOWNED"] and _downed and _downed.Value then table.insert(Flags, "DOWNED") end;
                                local _grabbed = _stat:FindFirstChild("Grabbed");
                                if V["grabbed"] and _grabbed and _grabbed.Value then table.insert(Flags, "grabbed") end;
                                local _cuffed = _stat:FindFirstChild("Handcuffed");
                                if V["handcuffed"] and _cuffed and _cuffed.Value then table.insert(Flags, "handcuffed") end;
                                local _jailed = _stat:FindFirstChild("Jailed");
                                if V["jailed"] and _jailed and _jailed.Value then table.insert(Flags, "jailed") end;
                                local _safezone = _stat:FindFirstChild("SafeZone");
                                local _safeEnabled = _safezone and _safezone:FindFirstChild("Enabled");
                                if V["safe zone"] and _safeEnabled and _safeEnabled.Value then table.insert(Flags, "safe zone") end;
                                local _ragtime = _stat:FindFirstChild("RagdollTime");
                                local _srag = _ragtime and _ragtime:FindFirstChild("SRagdolled");
                                if V["ragdolled"] and _srag and _srag.Value then table.insert(Flags, "ragdolled") end;
                                local _grabbing = _stat:FindFirstChild("Grabbing");
                                if V["grabbing"] and _grabbing and _grabbing.Value then table.insert(Flags, "grabbing") end;
                        end;

                        local _temp = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("Storage");
                        _temp = _temp and _temp:FindFirstChild("Temp");
                        local _tempChar = _temp and _temp:FindFirstChild(Player.Name);
                        if _tempChar then
                                for _, item in ipairs(_tempChar:GetChildren()) do
                                        local vals = item:FindFirstChild("Values");
                                        if vals then
                                                local _block = vals:FindFirstChild("Blocking");
                                                if V["blocking"] and _block and _block.Value then table.insert(Flags, "blocking") end;
                                                local _exec = vals:FindFirstChild("Executing");
                                                if V["EXECUTING"] and _exec and _exec.Value then table.insert(Flags, "EXECUTING") end;
                        local _slash = vals:FindFirstChild("Slashing1");
                                                if V["slashing"] and _slash and _slash.Value then table.insert(Flags, "slashing") end;
                                        end;
                                end;
                        end;

                        -- Level
                        if V["level"] then
                                local _ls = game:GetService("Players"):FindFirstChild(Player.Name);
                                local _stats = _ls and _ls:FindFirstChild("leaderstats");
                                local _lvl = _stats and _stats:FindFirstChild("Level");
                                if _lvl then table.insert(Flags, "lvl " .. tostring(_lvl.Value)); end;
                        end;

                        -- Armored flag
                        if V["armored"] then
                                local _CS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("CharStats");
                                local _gvf = _CS and _CS:FindFirstChild(Player.Name);
                                local _aHP = _gvf and _gvf:FindFirstChild("ArmorHP");
                                if _aHP then
                                        local _b = _aHP:FindFirstChild("Body");
                                        local _h = _aHP:FindFirstChild("Head");
                                        if (_b and _b.Value > 0) or (_h and _h.Value > 0) then
                                                table.insert(Flags, "armored");
                                        end;
                                end;
                        end;

                        -- Ammo flag
                        if V["ammo"] then
                                local _char2 = CharacterObjects.Character;
                                local _bp = Player:FindFirstChild("Backpack");
                                local _t2 = nil;
                                if _char2 then for _, v in _char2:GetChildren() do if v:IsA("Tool") and v:FindFirstChild("Values") then _t2 = v; break; end; end; end;
                                if not _t2 and _bp then for _, v in _bp:GetChildren() do if v:IsA("Tool") and v:FindFirstChild("Values") then _t2 = v; break; end; end; end;
                                if _t2 then
                                        local _vals2 = _t2:FindFirstChild("Values");
                                        local _am = _vals2 and _vals2:FindFirstChild("Ammo");
                                        local _st = _vals2 and _vals2:FindFirstChild("StoredAmmo");
                                        if _am and _st then
                                                table.insert(Flags, "[" .. tostring(_am.Value) .. "/" .. tostring(_st.Value) .. "]");
                                        end;
                                end;
                        end;

                        return Flags;
                end;
        end;
end;

local HealthTextColor  = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255);

local GlowChamsColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255);
local GlowChamsTrans = 0.5;

local GlowChamsToggle = SecESP:Toggle({ Name = "glow chams", Default = false })
        :AddColorpicker({
                Default  = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255);
                Alpha    = 0.5;
                Callback = function(C, A)
                        GlowChamsColor = C;
                        GlowChamsTrans = 1 - A;
                end;

local GlowChamsAdornments = {};
local GlowChamsCharFor = {};

local function RemoveGlowChams(Player)
        if GlowChamsAdornments[Player] then
                for _, Ad in GlowChamsAdornments[Player] do
                        pcall(function() Ad:Destroy() end);
                end;
                GlowChamsAdornments[Player] = nil;
        end;
        GlowChamsCharFor[Player] = nil;
end;

local _BodyPartNames = {
        Head = true, Torso = true,
        UpperTorso = true, LowerTorso = true,
        -- R15 body parts (no spaces):
        LeftArm = true, RightArm = true,
        LeftLeg = true, RightLeg = true,
        LeftUpperArm = true, LeftLowerArm = true, LeftHand = true,
        RightUpperArm = true, RightLowerArm = true, RightHand = true,
        LeftUpperLeg = true, LeftLowerLeg = true, LeftFoot = true,
        RightUpperLeg = true, RightLowerLeg = true, RightFoot = true,
        UpperTorsoHandle = true,
        -- R6 body parts (WITH spaces — Criminality uses R6 character rigs,
        -- so without these entries glow chams only renders head + torso
        -- and the arms/legs are invisible. This was the bug.)
        ["Left Arm"]  = true,
        ["Right Arm"] = true,
        ["Left Leg"]  = true,
        ["Right Leg"] = true,
};
local function _IsBodyPart(Part)
        if not Part:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
        if not _BodyPartNames[Part.Name] then return false end
        return true
end

local function BuildGlowChams(Player, Char)
        RemoveGlowChams(Player);
        if not Char then return end;
        local Ads = {};
        for _, Part in Char:GetDescendants() do
                if _IsBodyPart(Part) and Part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                        local Ad = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment");
                        Ad.Adornee      = Part;
                        Ad.Size         = Part.Size * 0.98;
                        Ad.AlwaysOnTop  = true;
                        Ad.ZIndex       = 10;
                        Ad.Shading      = Enum.AdornShading.XRayShaded;
                        Ad.Color3       = Color3.new(
                                GlowChamsColor.R * 5,
                                GlowChamsColor.G * 5,
                                GlowChamsColor.B * 5
                        );
                        Ad.Transparency = -0.5;
                        Ad.Parent       = gethui();
                        table.insert(Ads, Ad);
                end;
        end;
        GlowChamsAdornments[Player] = Ads;
        GlowChamsCharFor[Player]    = Char;
end;

local function HookPlayerChar(Player)
        if not Player or not Player.CharacterAdded then return end;
        Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                if not Library.Flags["_glow chams"] then return end;
                if not ESPState.Enabled then return end;
                local _ShowLocal = (_G_ESP_ForGlow and _G_ESP_ForGlow.Settings and
                        _G_ESP_ForGlow.Settings.Players and
                        _G_ESP_ForGlow.Settings.Players.LocalPlayer) or false;
                if Player == _G_LocalPlayer and not _ShowLocal then
                        RemoveGlowChams(Player);
                        return;
                end;
                task.defer(function()
                        local Targets = ESP.Targets and ESP.Targets.Players;
                        local Info = Targets and Targets[Player];
                        local Char = Info and Info.CharacterObjects and Info.CharacterObjects.Character;
                        if Char then BuildGlowChams(Player, Char) end;
                end);
        end);
end
for _, P in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do HookPlayerChar(P) end
game:GetService("Players").PlayerAdded:Connect(HookPlayerChar);

Library:Connection(game:GetService("Players").PlayerRemoving, function(Player)
        RemoveGlowChams(Player);
end);

GlowChamsToggle:OnChange(function(V)
        if not V then
                for Player in pairs(GlowChamsAdornments) do
                        RemoveGlowChams(Player);
                end;
                return;
        end;
        if not ESPState.Enabled then return end;
        local _LP = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer;
        local _ShowLocal = (_G_ESP_ForGlow and _G_ESP_ForGlow.Settings and
                _G_ESP_ForGlow.Settings.Players and
                _G_ESP_ForGlow.Settings.Players.LocalPlayer) or false;
        for _, Targets in pairs(ESP.Targets or {}) do
                for Target, TargetInfo in pairs(Targets) do
                        if Target == _LP and not _ShowLocal then
                                RemoveGlowChams(Target);
                                continue;
                        end;
                        local Char = TargetInfo.CharacterObjects and TargetInfo.CharacterObjects.Character;
                        BuildGlowChams(Target, Char);
                end;
        end;
end);

local _GlowAcc = 0;
local _GlowChamsESPOffCleaned = false;
local _G_ESP_ForGlow = getgenv().ESP;
local _G_LocalPlayer = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer;
Library:Connection(game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat, function(Dt)
        if not Library.Flags["_glow chams"] then return end;
        if not ESPState.Enabled then
                if not _GlowChamsESPOffCleaned then
                        _GlowChamsESPOffCleaned = true;
                        for Player in pairs(GlowChamsAdornments) do
                                RemoveGlowChams(Player);
                        end;
                end;
                return;
        end;
        _GlowChamsESPOffCleaned = false;
        _GlowAcc = _GlowAcc + Dt;
        if _GlowAcc < 0.066 then return end;
        _GlowAcc = 0;
        local _LP = _G_LocalPlayer;
        local _ShowLocal = (_G_ESP_ForGlow and _G_ESP_ForGlow.Settings and
                _G_ESP_ForGlow.Settings.Players and
                _G_ESP_ForGlow.Settings.Players.LocalPlayer) or false;
        local C = Color3.new(
                GlowChamsColor.R * 5,
                GlowChamsColor.G * 5,
                GlowChamsColor.B * 5
        );
        for _, Targets in pairs(ESP.Targets or {}) do
                for Target, TargetInfo in pairs(Targets) do
                        if Target == _LP and not _ShowLocal then
                                if GlowChamsAdornments[Target] then
                                        RemoveGlowChams(Target);
                                end;
                                continue;
                        end;
                        local Char = TargetInfo.CharacterObjects and TargetInfo.CharacterObjects.Character;
                        local Ads  = GlowChamsAdornments[Target];
                        if not Ads then
                                BuildGlowChams(Target, Char);
                                continue;
                        end;
                        if GlowChamsCharFor[Target] ~= Char then
                                BuildGlowChams(Target, Char);
                                continue;
                        end;
                        local _Orphaned = false;
                        for _, Ad in Ads do
                                if not Ad or not Ad.Parent or not Ad.Adornee or not Ad.Adornee.Parent then
                                        _Orphaned = true;
                                        break;
                                end;
                                if not Ad.Adornee:IsDescendantOf(Char) then
                                        _Orphaned = true;
                                        break;
                                end;
                        end;
                        if _Orphaned then
                                BuildGlowChams(Target, Char);
                                continue;
                        end;
                        for _, Ad in Ads do
                                if Ad and Ad.Parent and Ad.Adornee and Ad.Adornee.Parent then
                                        Ad.Color3 = C;
                                        Ad.Size         = Ad.Adornee.Size * 0.98;
                                        Ad.Transparency = -0.5;
                                end;
                        end;
                end;
        end;
end);

local _LPChamsAdornments = {};
local _LPChamsCharFor    = nil;

local function _RemoveLPChams()
        for _, Ad in ipairs(_LPChamsAdornments) do
                pcall(function() Ad:Destroy() end);
        end;
        _LPChamsAdornments = {};
        _LPChamsCharFor = nil;
end;

local function _BuildLPChams(Char)
        _RemoveLPChams();
        if not Char then return end;
        local FillColor = ChamsFillColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255);
        local FillTrans = ChamsFillAlpha or 0.5;
        local OutlineColor = ChamsOutlineColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255);
        local OutlineTrans = ChamsOutlineAlpha or 0;
        local WantOutline = (OutlineTrans < 1);
        for _, Part in Char:GetDescendants() do
                if _IsBodyPart(Part) and Part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
                        if WantOutline then
                                local Out = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment");
                                Out.Adornee      = Part;
                                Out.Size         = Part.Size * 1.04;
                                Out.AlwaysOnTop  = true;
                                Out.ZIndex       = 9;
                                Out.Shading      = Enum.AdornShading.XRayShaded;
                                Out.Color3       = OutlineColor;
                                Out.Transparency = OutlineTrans;
                                Out.Parent       = gethui();
                                table.insert(_LPChamsAdornments, Out);
                        end;
                        local Fill = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment");
                        Fill.Adornee      = Part;
                        Fill.Size         = Part.Size * 0.98;
                        Fill.AlwaysOnTop  = true;
                        Fill.ZIndex       = 10;
                        Fill.Shading      = Enum.AdornShading.XRayShaded;
                        Fill.Color3       = FillColor;
                        Fill.Transparency = FillTrans;
                        Fill.Parent       = gethui();
                        table.insert(_LPChamsAdornments, Fill);
                end;
        end;
        _LPChamsCharFor = Char;
end;

local _LP = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer;
if _LP.CharacterAdded then
        _LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                if not Library.Flags["_chams"] then return end;
                local _ShowLocal = (_G_ESP_ForGlow and _G_ESP_ForGlow.Settings and
                        _G_ESP_ForGlow.Settings.Players and
                        _G_ESP_ForGlow.Settings.Players.LocalPlayer) or false;
                if not _ShowLocal then return end;
                task.defer(function()
                        local Targets = ESP.Targets and ESP.Targets.Players;
                        local Info = Targets and Targets[_LP];
                        local Char = Info and Info.CharacterObjects and Info.CharacterObjects.Character;
                        if Char then _BuildLPChams(Char) end;
                end);
        end);
end;

local _LPChamsAcc = 0;
Library:Connection(game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat, function(Dt)
        if not Library.Flags["_chams"] then
                if #_LPChamsAdornments > 0 then _RemoveLPChams() end;
                return;
        end;
        local _ShowLocal = (_G_ESP_ForGlow and _G_ESP_ForGlow.Settings and
                _G_ESP_ForGlow.Settings.Players and
                _G_ESP_ForGlow.Settings.Players.LocalPlayer) or false;
        if not _ShowLocal then
                if #_LPChamsAdornments > 0 then _RemoveLPChams() end;
                return;
        end;
        _LPChamsAcc = _LPChamsAcc + Dt;
        if _LPChamsAcc < 0.066 then return end;
        _LPChamsAcc = 0;
        local Targets = ESP.Targets and ESP.Targets.Players;
        local Info    = Targets and Targets[_LP];
        local Char    = Info and Info.CharacterObjects and Info.CharacterObjects.Character;
        if not Char then
                if #_LPChamsAdornments > 0 then _RemoveLPChams() end;
                return;
        end;
        if _LPChamsCharFor ~= Char then
                _BuildLPChams(Char);
                return;
        end;
        local _LP_Orphaned = false;
        for _, Ad in ipairs(_LPChamsAdornments) do
                if not Ad or not Ad.Parent or not Ad.Adornee or not Ad.Adornee.Parent then
                        _LP_Orphaned = true;
                        break;
                end;
        end;
        if _LP_Orphaned then
                _BuildLPChams(Char);
                return;
        end;
        local FillColor       = ChamsFillColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255);
        local FillTrans       = ChamsFillAlpha or 0.5;
        local OutlineColor    = ChamsOutlineColor or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255);
        local OutlineTrans    = ChamsOutlineAlpha or 0;
        local WantOutline     = (OutlineTrans < 1);
        for _, Ad in ipairs(_LPChamsAdornments) do
                if Ad and Ad.Parent and Ad.Adornee and Ad.Adornee.Parent then
                        Ad.Size = Ad.Adornee.Size * (Ad.ZIndex == 9 and 1.04 or 0.98);
                        if Ad.ZIndex == 9 then
                                if not WantOutline then
                                        Ad.Transparency = 1;
                                else
                                        Ad.Color3       = OutlineColor;
                                        Ad.Transparency = OutlineTrans;
                                end;
                        else
                                Ad.Color3       = FillColor;
                                Ad.Transparency = FillTrans;
                        end;
                end;
        end;
end);

do
        local dlg = ImageFillToggle:AddDialog({ Name = "image box fill" })
        dlg:Textbox({
                Name        = "image asset id / image address";
                Placeholder = "e.g. 6319951718";
                Default     = "";
                Callback    = function(Raw)
                        Raw = tostring(Raw or ""):gsub("%s+", "");
                        local Id = string.match(Raw, "rbxassetid://(%d+)")
                                or string.match(Raw, "asset/?id=(%d+)")
                                or string.match(Raw, "^(%d+)$");
                        if Id then
                                ESPState.ImageFillId = "rbxassetid://" .. Id;
                                getgenv().ESPImageFill.Id = Id;
                                getgenv().ESPImageFill.UseCustom = false;
                        elseif string.match(Raw, "^https?://") then
                                task.spawn(function()
                                        -- URL-encode the user's URL before appending it as a
                                        -- query parameter, otherwise any '&' inside it becomes
                                        -- a separate wsrv.nl param and the upstream fetch fails.
                                        -- Matches the pattern used at lines 17144 and 17218.
                                        local Encoded = game:GetService("HttpService"):UrlEncode(Raw);
                                        local Ok, Body = pcall(function()
                                                return game:HttpGet("https://wsrv.nl/?url=" .. Encoded);
                                        end);
                                        if not Ok or not Body or Body == "" then
                                                Library:Notify("Failed to fetch image (upstream may be blocking wsrv.nl)", 4);
                                                return;
                                        end;
                                        local FileName = "esp_imagefill.jpg";
                                        local WriteOk, WriteErr = pcall(writefile, FileName, Body);
                                        if not WriteOk then
                                                Library:Notify("Failed to write image: " .. tostring(WriteErr), 4);
                                                return;
                                        end;
                                        local AssetOk, Asset = pcall(getcustomasset, FileName);
                                        if AssetOk and Asset and Asset ~= "" then
                                                ESPState.ImageFillId = Asset;
                                                getgenv().ESPImageFill.Id = Asset;
                                                getgenv().ESPImageFill.UseCustom = true;
                                                Library:Notify("Image fill loaded", 2);
                                        else
                                                Library:Notify("Failed to load image asset (getcustomasset failed)", 4);
                                        end;
                                end);
                        else
                                ESPState.ImageFillId = "";
                                getgenv().ESPImageFill.Id = "";
                                getgenv().ESPImageFill.UseCustom = false;
                        end;
                end;
        });
        dlg:Slider({
                Name     = "image fill opacity";
                Min      = 0; Max = 1; Step = 0.05; Decimals = 2; Default = 0.8;
                Callback = function(V)
                        ESPState.ImageFillAlpha = V;
                        getgenv().ESPImageFill.Alpha = V;
                end;
        });
end;

local function Project(WorldPos)
                        local Cam    = Preview.Camera;
                        local VpSize = Preview.Viewport.AbsoluteSize;
                        if VpSize.X <= 0 or VpSize.Y <= 0 then return nil, false end;
                        local CamCFrame = Cam.CFrame;
                        local LocalPos  = CamCFrame:PointToObjectSpace(WorldPos);
                        if LocalPos.Z >= -0.01 then return nil, false end;
                        local Depth      = -LocalPos.Z;
                        local TanHalfFOV = math.tan(math.rad(Cam.FieldOfView or 70) / 2);
                        local Aspect     = VpSize.X / VpSize.Y;
                        local NDC_X      = (LocalPos.X / Depth) / (TanHalfFOV * Aspect);
                        local NDC_Y      = (LocalPos.Y / Depth) / TanHalfFOV;
local ScreenX = (NDC_X * 0.5 + 0.5) * VpSize.X;
local ScreenY = (0.5 - NDC_Y * 0.5) * VpSize.Y;
return Vector2.new(ScreenX, ScreenY), true;
                end;

        local function GetBoundingBox(M)
                local MinX, MinY = math.huge, math.huge;
                local MaxX, MaxY = -math.huge, -math.huge;
                local Found = false;
                for _, Inst in M:GetDescendants() do
                        if Inst:IsA("BasePart") and Inst.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" and Inst.Transparency ~= 1 then
                                local Cf = Inst.CFrame;
                                local Sz = Inst.Size;
                                local Corners = {
                                        Cf * Vector3.new( Sz.X/2,  Sz.Y/2,  Sz.Z/2),
                                        Cf * Vector3.new(-Sz.X/2,  Sz.Y/2,  Sz.Z/2),
                                        Cf * Vector3.new( Sz.X/2, -Sz.Y/2,  Sz.Z/2),
                                        Cf * Vector3.new(-Sz.X/2, -Sz.Y/2,  Sz.Z/2),
                                        Cf * Vector3.new( Sz.X/2,  Sz.Y/2, -Sz.Z/2),
                                        Cf * Vector3.new(-Sz.X/2,  Sz.Y/2, -Sz.Z/2),
                                        Cf * Vector3.new( Sz.X/2, -Sz.Y/2, -Sz.Z/2),
                                        Cf * Vector3.new(-Sz.X/2, -Sz.Y/2, -Sz.Z/2),
                                };
                                for _, Corner in Corners do
                                        local Sp, On = Project(Corner);
                                        if Sp and On then
                                                Found = true;
                                                if Sp.X < MinX then MinX = Sp.X end;
                                                if Sp.Y < MinY then MinY = Sp.Y end;
                                                if Sp.X > MaxX then MaxX = Sp.X end;
                                                if Sp.Y > MaxY then MaxY = Sp.Y end;
                                        end;
                                end;
                        end;
                end;
                if not Found then return nil end;
                return MinX, MinY, MaxX, MaxY;
        end;

local function HideAll()
                        BoxGlowFrame.Visible    = false;
                        BoxOutlineFrame.Visible = false;
                        BoxInlineFrame.Visible  = false;
                        BoxFillFrame.Visible    = false;
                        ImageFillFrame.Visible  = false;

                        FlagsLbl.Visible        = false;
                        ToolLbl.Visible         = false;
                        HealthHolder.Visible    = false;
                        HealthTextLbl.Visible   = false;
                end;

local function GetImageBoundingBox()
                if not PreviewImageLabel then return nil end;
                if not PreviewImageFrame.Visible then return nil end;
                if PreviewImageLabel.Image == "" then return nil end;
                local VpAp = Preview.Viewport.AbsolutePosition;
                local VpSz = Preview.Viewport.AbsoluteSize;
                if VpSz.X <= 0 or VpSz.Y <= 0 then return nil end;
                local ImgAp = PreviewImageLabel.AbsolutePosition;
                local ImgSz = PreviewImageLabel.AbsoluteSize;
                local CenterX = (ImgAp.X - VpAp.X) + ImgSz.X * 0.5;
                local CenterY = (ImgAp.Y - VpAp.Y) + ImgSz.Y * 0.5;
                local S = PreviewBoxSize;
                local MinX = CenterX - S.X * 0.5;
                local MaxX = CenterX + S.X * 0.5;
                local MinY = CenterY - S.Y * 0.5;
                local MaxY = CenterY + S.Y * 0.5;
                return MinX, MinY, MaxX, MaxY;
        end;

        Library:Connection(RunService.RenderStepped, function()
if not ESPState.Enabled or not Library:IsEffectivelyVisible(Preview.Viewport) then
                        OverlayGui.Enabled = false;
                        HideAll();
                        return;
                end;
OverlayGui.Enabled = Library.Flags["_enable esp preview"] ~= false;

                if Overlay.Parent ~= Preview.Viewport then
                        Overlay.Parent = Preview.Viewport;
                end;

                local MinX, MinY, MaxX, MaxY;

if PreviewMode ~= "character rig" then
                        MinX, MinY, MaxX, MaxY = GetImageBoundingBox();
                        if not MinX then HideAll(); return; end;
                else
                        local M = Preview:GetModel();
                        if not M or not M.Parent then HideAll(); return; end;
                        MinX, MinY, MaxX, MaxY = GetBoundingBox(M);
                        if not MinX then HideAll(); return; end;
                end;

                local BoxW   = MaxX - MinX;
                local BoxH   = MaxY - MinY;

                else
                        BoxGlowFrame.Visible = false;
                end;

if ESPState.Box then
                        if ESPState.BoxType == "Corner" then
                                BoxOutlineFrame.Visible = false;
                                BoxInlineFrame.Visible  = false;
local CornerLen = math.min(BoxW, BoxH) * 0.3;
                                local Corners2D = {
                                        { UDim2.fromOffset(MinX - 1, MinY - 1),             UDim2.fromOffset(CornerLen, 1) },
                                        { UDim2.fromOffset(MinX - 1, MinY - 1),             UDim2.fromOffset(1, CornerLen) },
                                        { UDim2.fromOffset(MaxX - CornerLen + 1, MinY - 1), UDim2.fromOffset(CornerLen, 1) },
                                        { UDim2.fromOffset(MaxX, MinY - 1),                 UDim2.fromOffset(1, CornerLen) },
                                        { UDim2.fromOffset(MinX - 1, MaxY),                 UDim2.fromOffset(CornerLen, 1) },
                                        { UDim2.fromOffset(MinX - 1, MaxY - CornerLen + 1), UDim2.fromOffset(1, CornerLen) },
                                        { UDim2.fromOffset(MaxX - CornerLen + 1, MaxY),     UDim2.fromOffset(CornerLen, 1) },
                                        { UDim2.fromOffset(MaxX, MaxY - CornerLen + 1),     UDim2.fromOffset(1, CornerLen) },
                                };
                                if not Overlay:FindFirstChild("_Corner1") then
                                        for I = 1, 8 do
                                                local F = Library:CreateInstance("Frame", {
                                                        Name             = "_Corner" .. I;
                                                        Parent           = Overlay;
                                                        BackgroundColor3 = ESPState.BoxColor;
                                                        BorderSizePixel  = 0;
                                                        ZIndex           = 6;
                                                        Visible          = false;
                                                });
                                        end;
                                end;
                                for I = 1, 8 do
                                        local F = Overlay:FindFirstChild("_Corner" .. I);
                                        if F then
                                                F.Visible          = true;
                                                F.Position         = Corners2D[I][1];
                                                F.Size             = Corners2D[I][2];
                                                F.BackgroundColor3 = ESPState.BoxColor;
                                        end;
                                end;
                        else
                                for I = 1, 8 do
                                        local F = Overlay:FindFirstChild("_Corner" .. I);
                                        if F then F.Visible = false end;
                                end;
                                BoxOutlineFrame.Visible  = true;
                                BoxOutlineFrame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(MinX, MinY);
                                BoxOutlineFrame.Size     = UDim2.fromOffset(BoxW, BoxH);
                                BoxInlineFrame.Visible   = true;
                                BoxInlineFrame.Position  = UDim2.fromOffset(MinX - 1, MinY - 1);
                                BoxInlineFrame.Size      = UDim2.fromOffset(BoxW + 2, BoxH + 2);
                                BoxInlineStroke.Color    = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255);
                                BoxInlineGradient.Color  = ColorSequence.new({
                                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, ESPState.BoxColor),
                                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, ESPState.BoxColor2);
                                });
                        end;
                else
                        BoxOutlineFrame.Visible = false;
                        BoxInlineFrame.Visible  = false;
                        for I = 1, 8 do
                                local F = Overlay:FindFirstChild("_Corner" .. I);
                                if F then F.Visible = false end;
                        end;
                end;

                local Cfg = _G_ESPImageFill;
                if ESPState.ImageFill and Cfg and Cfg.Id ~= "" then
                        ImageFillFrame.Visible           = true;
                        ImageFillFrame.Position          = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(MinX), math.floor(MinY));
                        ImageFillFrame.Size              = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(BoxW), math.floor(BoxH));
                        ImageFillFrame.ImageTransparency = 1 - ESPState.ImageFillAlpha;
                        if Cfg.UseCustom then
                                ImageFillFrame.Image = Cfg.Id;
                        else
                                ImageFillFrame.Image = "rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=" .. Cfg.Id .. "&w=420&h=420";
                        end;
                else
                        ImageFillFrame.Visible = false;
                end;

                if ESPState.BoxFill then
                        BoxFillFrame.Visible    = true;
                        BoxFillFrame.Position   = UDim2.fromOffset(MinX, MinY);
                        BoxFillFrame.Size       = UDim2.fromOffset(BoxW, BoxH);
                        local _fillAlpha = ESPState.BoxFillAlpha or 0.5;
                        if ESPState.BoxFillMode == "fill" then
                                -- solid fill: opaque at both endpoints
                                BoxFillGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, ESPState.BoxFillColor),
                                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, ESPState.BoxFillColor);
                                });
                                BoxFillGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1 - _fillAlpha),
                                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1 - _fillAlpha);
                                });
                        else
                                -- gradient fill: transparent at top, opaque at bottom
                                BoxFillGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
                                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, ESPState.BoxFillColor),
                                        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, ESPState.BoxFillColor);
                                });
                                BoxFillGradient.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
                                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1 - _fillAlpha);
                                });
                        end;
                else
                        BoxFillFrame.Visible = false;
                end;

if ESPState.Name then
                        NameLbl.Visible    = true;
                        NameLbl.Text       = (PreviewMode == "character rig") and "bob" or PreviewMode;
                        NameLbl.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1);
                        NameLbl.Position    = UDim2.new(0, MinX + BoxW/2, 0, MinY - 2);
                        NameLbl.Size        = UDim2.new(0, LabelW, 0, 12);
                        NameGrad.Color      = MakeGradSeq(ESPState.NameColor, ESPState.NameColor2);
                else
                        NameLbl.Visible = false;
                end;

                -- Calculate how far below the box bottom labels should start,
                -- accounting for armor bar and ammo bar only if they are visible (non-zero).
                local _bottomY = MaxY + 2;
                do
                    local _ah = Overlay:FindFirstChild("_ArmorBarHolder");
                    if ESPState.ArmorBar and _ah and _ah.Visible then _bottomY = _bottomY + 4; end;
                    local _mh = Overlay:FindFirstChild("_AmmoBarHolder");
                    if ESPState.AmmoBar and _mh and _mh.Visible then _bottomY = _bottomY + 4; end;
                end;

                if ESPState.Studs then
                        StudsLbl.Visible    = true;
                        local S3 = _G_ESPState;
                        local DUnit = (S3 and S3.DistanceUnit == "meters") and "m" or "st";
                        local DVal  = (S3 and S3.DistanceUnit == "meters") and math.floor(42 * 0.28) or 42;
                        StudsLbl.Text = tostring(DVal) .. " " .. DUnit;
                        StudsLbl.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0);
                        StudsLbl.Position    = UDim2.new(0, MinX + BoxW/2, 0, _bottomY);
                        StudsLbl.Size        = UDim2.new(0, LabelW, 0, 12);
                        StudsGrad.Color      = MakeGradSeq(ESPState.StudsColor, ESPState.StudsColor2);
                else
                        StudsLbl.Visible = false;
                end;

                if ESPState.Tool then
                        ToolLbl.Visible    = true;
                        ToolLbl.Text       = "ak-47";
                        local YOff = _bottomY;
                        if ESPState.Studs then YOff = _bottomY + 12; end;
                        ToolLbl.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0);
                        ToolLbl.Position    = UDim2.new(0, MinX + BoxW/2, 0, YOff);
                        ToolLbl.Size        = UDim2.new(0, LabelW, 0, 12);
                        ToolGrad.Color      = MakeGradSeq(ESPState.ToolColor, ESPState.ToolColor2);
                else
                        ToolLbl.Visible = false;
                end;

                if ESPState.Flags then
                        local PreviewFlags = {};
                        local AF = ESPState.ActiveFlags or {};
                        if AF["moving"]    then table.insert(PreviewFlags, "moving")    end;
                        if AF["jumping"]   then table.insert(PreviewFlags, "jumping")   end;
                        if AF["falling"]   then table.insert(PreviewFlags, "falling")   end;
                        if AF["sprinting"] then table.insert(PreviewFlags, "sprinting") end;
                        if AF["crouching"] then table.insert(PreviewFlags, "crouching") end;
                        if AF["climbing"]  then table.insert(PreviewFlags, "climbing")  end;
                        if AF["DOWNED"]    then table.insert(PreviewFlags, "DOWNED")    end;
                        if AF["grabbed"]   then table.insert(PreviewFlags, "grabbed")   end;
                        if AF["handcuffed"] then table.insert(PreviewFlags, "handcuffed") end;
                        if AF["jailed"]    then table.insert(PreviewFlags, "jailed")    end;
                        if AF["safe zone"] then table.insert(PreviewFlags, "safe zone") end;
                        if AF["ragdolled"] then table.insert(PreviewFlags, "ragdolled") end;
                        if AF["reloading"] then table.insert(PreviewFlags, "reloading") end;
                        if AF["aiming"]    then table.insert(PreviewFlags, "aiming")    end;
                        if AF["reviving"]  then table.insert(PreviewFlags, "reviving")  end;
                        if AF["EXECUTING"] then table.insert(PreviewFlags, "EXECUTING") end;
                        if AF["grabbing"]  then table.insert(PreviewFlags, "grabbing")  end;
                        if AF["blocking"]  then table.insert(PreviewFlags, "blocking")  end;
                        if AF["slashing"]  then table.insert(PreviewFlags, "slashing")  end;
                        FlagsLbl.Visible  = #PreviewFlags > 0;
                        FlagsLbl.Text     = table.concat(PreviewFlags, "\n");
                        FlagsLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, MaxX + 4, 0, MinY - 4);
                        FlagsLbl.Size     = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, #PreviewFlags * 12);
                        FlagsGrad.Color   = MakeGradSeq(ESPState.FlagsColor, ESPState.FlagsColor2);
                else
                        FlagsLbl.Visible = false;
                end;

                local S2 = getgenv().ESPState;
                if ESPState.HealthText and ESPState.Health then
                        local Ratio = (math.sin(tick() * 0.8) + 1) / 2;
                        local HpVal = math.floor(Ratio * 100);
                        HealthTextLbl.Visible    = true;
                        HealthTextLbl.Text       = tostring(HpVal);
                        HealthTextLbl.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0);
HealthTextLbl.Position    = UDim2.new(0, MinX - 28, 0, MinY - 2);
                        HealthTextLbl.Size        = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 12);
                        HealthTextLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right;
                        HealthTextGrad.Color      = MakeGradSeq(
                                (S2 and S2.HealthTextColor)  or Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255),
                                (S2 and S2.HealthTextColor2) or Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
                        );
                else
                        HealthTextLbl.Visible = false;
                end;

                if ESPState.Health then
                        local Ratio = (math.sin(tick() * 0.8) + 1) / 2;
HealthHolder.Visible   = true;
HealthHolder.Position  = UDim2.fromOffset(MinX - 6, MinY - 2);
                        HealthHolder.Size      = UDim2.fromOffset(3, BoxH + 5);
                        HealthFill.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1);
                        HealthFill.Position    = UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, -1);
                        HealthFill.Size        = UDim2.new(1, -2, Ratio, -2);
                        HealthGradient.Rotation = 90;
                        HealthGradient.Offset   = Vector2.new(0, Ratio - 1);
                        HealthGradient.Color    = ColorSequence.new({
                                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0,   ESPState.HealthA);
                                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, ESPState.HealthB);
                                ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1,   ESPState.HealthC);
                        });
                else
                        HealthHolder.Visible = false;
                end;

                -- Armor bar preview
                do
                        local _barY = MaxY + 3;
                        if not Overlay:FindFirstChild("_ArmorBarHolder") then
                                local _h = Library:CreateInstance("Frame", { Name = "_ArmorBarHolder", Parent = Overlay, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0), BackgroundTransparency = 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false });
                                Library:CreateInstance("Frame", { Name = "_ArmorBarFill", Parent = _h, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0,0), Position = UDim2.new(0,1,0,1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80,180,255), BorderSizePixel = 0 });
                                Library:CreateInstance("UIGradient", { Name = "_ArmorGrad", Parent = _h:FindFirstChild("_ArmorBarFill"), Rotation = 0 });
                        end;
                        local _ah = Overlay:FindFirstChild("_ArmorBarHolder");
                        local _af = _ah and _ah:FindFirstChild("_ArmorBarFill");
                        local _ag = _af and _af:FindFirstChild("_ArmorGrad");
                        if _ah then
                                if ESPState.ArmorBar then
                                        local _arRatio = (math.sin(tick() * 0.6 + 1.2) + 1) / 2;
                                        local _aA = ESPState.ArmorBarA or Color3.fromRGB(80,180,255);
                                        local _aB = ESPState.ArmorBarB or Color3.fromRGB(160,220,255);
                                        local _aC = ESPState.ArmorBarC or Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255);
                                        _ah.Visible = true;
                                        _ah.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(MinX - 1, _barY);
                                        _ah.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(BoxW + 2, 3);
                                        if _af then
                                                _af.Size = UDim2.new(_arRatio, -2, 1, -2);
                                                _af.Position = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0, 1);
                                        end;
                                        if _af then _af.BackgroundColor3 = _aA; end;
                                        if _ag then
                                                _ag.Color = ColorSequence.new({ ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, _aA), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, _aB), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, _aC) });
                                        end;
                                        _barY = _barY + 4;
                                else
                                        _ah.Visible = false;
                                end;
                        end;

                        -- Ammo bar preview
                        if not Overlay:FindFirstChild("_AmmoBarHolder") then
                                local _h2 = Library:CreateInstance("Frame", { Name = "_AmmoBarHolder", Parent = Overlay, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,0,0), BackgroundTransparency = 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false });
                                Library:CreateInstance("Frame", { Name = "_AmmoBarFill", Parent = _h2, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0,0), Position = UDim2.new(0,1,0,1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,210,60), BorderSizePixel = 0 });
                                Library:CreateInstance("UIGradient", { Name = "_AmmoGrad", Parent = _h2:FindFirstChild("_AmmoBarFill"), Rotation = 0 });
                        end;
                        local _mh = Overlay:FindFirstChild("_AmmoBarHolder");
                        local _mf = _mh and _mh:FindFirstChild("_AmmoBarFill");
                        local _mg = _mf and _mf:FindFirstChild("_AmmoGrad");
                        if _mh then
                                if ESPState.AmmoBar then
                                        local _amRatio = (math.sin(tick() * 1.1 + 0.5) + 1) / 2;
                                        local _mA = ESPState.AmmoBarA or Color3.fromRGB(255,210,60);
                                        local _mB = ESPState.AmmoBarB or Color3.fromRGB(255,140,30);
                                        local _mC = ESPState.AmmoBarC or Color3.fromRGB(220,50,50);
                                        _mh.Visible = true;
                                        _mh.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(MinX - 1, _barY);
                                        _mh.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(BoxW + 2, 3);
                                        if _mf then
                                                _mf.Size = UDim2.new(_amRatio, -2, 1, -2);
                                                _mf.Position = UDim2.new(0, 1, 0, 1);
                                        end;
                                        if _mf then _mf.BackgroundColor3 = _mA; end;
                                        if _mg then
                                                _mg.Color = ColorSequence.new({ ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, _mA), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, _mB), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, _mC) });
                                        end;
                                else
                                        _mh.Visible = false;
                                end;
                        end;
                end;
        end);
end;

-- Misc ESP (world objects)
do
    local _MiscESP_enabled   = false
    local _MiscESP_showName  = false
    local _MiscESP_showDist  = false
    local _MiscESP_selected  = {}  -- set of selected category strings

    -- Dealer cache: scan once, then refresh every ~1.5s OR on workspace.Map
    -- children changes. Replaces per-frame GetDescendants() that was killing FPS.
    -- Hoisted to top of the do-block so the render loop sees it from frame 1.
    local _dealerCache = {}
    local function _refreshDealers()
        _dealerCache = {}
        local ok, workspace_map = pcall(function() return workspace.Map end)
        if not ok or not workspace_map then return end
        for _, model in ipairs(workspace_map:GetChildren()) do
            local lname = string.lower(model.Name or "")
            if string.find(lname, "dealer", 1, true) then
                local part = model:IsA("Model")
                    and (model.PrimaryPart or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart"))
                    or model
                if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    table.insert(_dealerCache, part)
                end
            end
        end
        -- Also scan one level deeper (some dealers are nested inside a Folder)
        for _, child in ipairs(workspace_map:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("Folder") or child:IsA("Model") then
                for _, model in ipairs(child:GetChildren()) do
                    local lname = string.lower(model.Name or "")
                    if string.find(lname, "dealer", 1, true) then
                        local part = model:IsA("Model")
                            and (model.PrimaryPart or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart"))
                            or model
                        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
                            table.insert(_dealerCache, part)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    _refreshDealers()
    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
            task.wait(1.5)
            pcall(_refreshDealers)
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        workspace.Map.ChildAdded:Connect(function() task.wait(0.5) pcall(_refreshDealers) end)
    end)

    -- Safe cache: same pattern — scan once, refresh every 2s.
    -- Safes live in workspace.Map.BredMakurz and match "safe" in their name.
    local _safeCache = {}
    local function _refreshSafes()
        _safeCache = {}
        local ok, workspace_map = pcall(function() return workspace.Map end)
        if not ok or not workspace_map then return end
        local bm = workspace_map:FindFirstChild("BredMakurz")
        if bm then
            for _, obj in ipairs(bm:GetChildren()) do
                if obj:IsA("Model") and string.find(string.lower(obj.Name), "safe") then
                    local vals = obj:FindFirstChild("Values")
                    local broken = vals and (vals:FindFirstChild("Broken") or vals:FindFirstChild("Opened") or vals:FindFirstChild("Looted"))
                    if not broken or broken.Value == false then
                        local part = obj.PrimaryPart or obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
                            table.insert(_safeCache, part)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    _refreshSafes()
    task.spawn(function()
        while true do
            task.wait(2)
            pcall(_refreshSafes)
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        workspace.Map.ChildAdded:Connect(function() task.wait(0.5) pcall(_refreshSafes) end)
    end)

    -- Label pool
    local _miscHolder = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    _miscHolder.Name = "FrequencyMiscESP"
    _miscHolder.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    _miscHolder.ResetOnSpawn = false
    _miscHolder.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
    _miscHolder.DisplayOrder = 9997
    _miscHolder.Parent = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

    local _miscLabels = {}
    local function _getLabel(i)
        if not _miscLabels[i] then
            local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            lbl.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.6
            lbl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
            lbl.TextSize = 11
            lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
            lbl.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
            lbl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 14)
            lbl.Visible = false
            lbl.Parent = _miscHolder
            _miscLabels[i] = lbl
        end
        return _miscLabels[i]
    end
    local function _hideFrom(i)
        for j = i, #_miscLabels do _miscLabels[j].Visible = false end
    end

    local function _getFont()
        return (getgenv().Fonts and getgenv().Fonts.Loaded and getgenv().Fonts.Loaded["Tahoma"])
            or Font.new(Enum.Font.Code, Enum.FontWeight.Regular)
    end

    local _cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local _lp  = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local _rs  = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

    local function _dist(pos)
        local char = _lp.Character
        local hrp  = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return math.huge end
        return (hrp.Position - pos).Magnitude
    end

    local function _drawAt(idx, worldPos, line1, line2, colorName, colorDist)
        local sp, onScreen = _cam:WorldToViewportPoint(worldPos)
        if not onScreen then return idx end
        local font = _getFont()
        -- Draw name label
        if line1 then
            local lbl = _getLabel(idx)
            lbl.FontFace   = font
            lbl.TextColor3 = colorName
            lbl.Text       = line1
            lbl.Position   = UDim2.fromOffset(sp.X, sp.Y)
            lbl.Visible    = true
            idx = idx + 1
        end
        -- Draw distance label (offset down slightly if name also shown)
        if line2 then
            local lbl = _getLabel(idx)
            lbl.FontFace   = font
            lbl.TextColor3 = colorDist
            lbl.Text       = line2
            lbl.Position   = UDim2.fromOffset(sp.X, sp.Y + (line1 and 14 or 0))
            lbl.Visible    = true
            idx = idx + 1
        end
        if not line1 and not line2 then return idx end
        return idx
    end

    local _ESPColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)  -- default; synced below
    local _MiscNameColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    local _MiscDistColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

    _RegisterRenderStepped(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        if not _MiscESP_enabled then _hideFrom(1) return end
        if not _MiscESP_showName and not _MiscESP_showDist then _hideFrom(1) return end

        local idx = 1
        local showName = _MiscESP_showName
        local showDist = _MiscESP_showDist

        -- Dropped Tools
        if _MiscESP_selected["Dropped Tools"] then
            local ok, container = pcall(function() return workspace.Filter.SpawnedTools end)
            if ok and container then
                for _, item in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
                    local ok2, pp = pcall(function() return item.PrimaryPart end)
                    if ok2 and pp then
                        local d = math.floor(_dist(pp.Position))
                        local n1 = showName and item.Name or nil
                        local n2 = showDist and (d .. "m") or nil
                        idx = _drawAt(idx, pp.Position, n1, n2, _MiscNameColor, _MiscDistColor)
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        -- Cash Drops
        if _MiscESP_selected["Cash Drops"] then
            local ok, container = pcall(function() return workspace.Filter.SpawnedBread end)
            if ok and container then
                for _, item in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
                    local ok2, pos = pcall(function() return item.Position end)
                    if ok2 then
                        local d = math.floor(_dist(pos))
                        local valObj = item:FindFirstChild("Value")
                        local cashStr = valObj and ("cash ($" .. tostring(valObj.Value) .. ")") or "cash"
                        local n1 = showName and cashStr or nil
                        local n2 = showDist and (d .. "m") or nil
                        idx = _drawAt(idx, pos, n1, n2, _MiscNameColor, _MiscDistColor)
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        -- Scrap Piles
        if _MiscESP_selected["Scrap Piles"] then
            local ok, container = pcall(function() return workspace.Filter.SpawnedPiles end)
            if ok and container then
                for _, item in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
                    if not item:GetAttribute("IsLocked") then
                        local ok2, pp = pcall(function() return item.PrimaryPart end)
                        if ok2 and pp then
                            local d = math.floor(_dist(pp.Position))
                            local n1 = showName and "scrap" or nil
                            local n2 = showDist and (d .. "m") or nil
                            idx = _drawAt(idx, pp.Position, n1, n2, _MiscNameColor, _MiscDistColor)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        -- ATMs
        if _MiscESP_selected["ATMs"] then
            local ok, container = pcall(function() return workspace.Map.ATMz end)
            if ok and container then
                for _, item in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
                    local mp = item:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
                    if mp then
                        local d = math.floor(_dist(mp.Position))
                        local n1 = showName and "ATM" or nil
                        local n2 = showDist and (d .. "m") or nil
                        idx = _drawAt(idx, mp.Position, n1, n2, _MiscNameColor, _MiscDistColor)
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        -- Vending Machines
        if _MiscESP_selected["Vending Machines"] then
            local ok, container = pcall(function() return workspace.Map.VendingMachines end)
            if ok and container then
                for _, item in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
                    local mp = item:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
                    if mp then
                        local d = math.floor(_dist(mp.Position))
                        local n1 = showName and "vending machine" or nil
                        local n2 = showDist and (d .. "m") or nil
                        idx = _drawAt(idx, mp.Position, n1, n2, _MiscNameColor, _MiscDistColor)
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        -- Mystery Boxes
        if _MiscESP_selected["Mystery Boxes"] then
            local ok, container = pcall(function() return workspace.Map.MysteryBoxes end)
            if ok and container then
                for _, item in ipairs(container:GetChildren()) do
                    local mp = item:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
                    if mp then
                        local d = math.floor(_dist(mp.Position))
                        local n1 = showName and "mystery box" or nil
                        local n2 = showDist and (d .. "m") or nil
                        idx = _drawAt(idx, mp.Position, n1, n2, _MiscNameColor, _MiscDistColor)
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        -- Dealers — CACHED list, refreshed every ~1s via ChildAdded signal,
        -- NOT per-frame GetDescendants() (that caused the 2 FPS bug).
        if _MiscESP_selected["Dealers"] then
            for _, part in ipairs(_dealerCache) do
                if part and part.Parent then
                    local d = math.floor(_dist(part.Position))
                    local n1 = showName and "Dealer" or nil
                    local n2 = showDist and (d .. "m") or nil
                    idx = _drawAt(idx, part.Position, n1, n2, _MiscNameColor, _MiscDistColor)
                end
            end
        end

        -- Safes — CACHED list (unopened safes in workspace.Map.BredMakurz),
        -- refreshed every 2s. Rendered same way as other misc objects.
        if _MiscESP_selected["Safes"] then
            for _, part in ipairs(_safeCache) do
                if part and part.Parent then
                    local d = math.floor(_dist(part.Position))
                    local n1 = showName and "Safe" or nil
                    local n2 = showDist and (d .. "m") or nil
                    idx = _drawAt(idx, part.Position, n1, n2, _MiscNameColor, _MiscDistColor)
                end
            end
        end

        _hideFrom(idx)
    end))

    -- (dealer cache declared at top of do-block now — see lines above)

    -- Safes ESP — uses the _safeCache declared at top of do-block.
    -- Rendered same way as other misc objects (respects name esp colorpicker
    -- and distance esp colorpicker).

    -- UI inside SecESP — master toggle now has a dialog attached
    local _miscESPToggle = SecESP:Toggle({
        Name    = "misc esp";
        Flag    = "MiscESPEnabled";
        Default = false;
        Callback = function(V) _MiscESP_enabled = V end;
    })

    do
        local dlg = _miscESPToggle:AddDialog({ Name = "customize" });

        dlg:Toggle({
            Name    = "misc name esp";
            Flag    = "MiscNameESPEnabled";
            Default = false;
            Callback = function(V) _MiscESP_showName = V end;
        }):AddColorpicker({
            Flag    = "MiscNameESPColor";
            Default = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255);
            Callback = function(C)
                _MiscNameColor = C;
            end;
        })

        dlg:Toggle({
            Name    = "misc distance esp";
            Flag    = "MiscDistESPEnabled";
            Default = false;
            Callback = function(V) _MiscESP_showDist = V end;
        }):AddColorpicker({
            Flag    = "MiscDistESPColor";
            Default = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255);
            Callback = function(C)
                _MiscDistColor = C;
            end;
        })

        dlg:Dropdown({
            Name     = "misc esp objects";
            Flag     = "MiscESPObjects";
            Options  = { "Dropped Tools", "Cash Drops", "Scrap Piles", "ATMs", "Vending Machines", "Mystery Boxes", "Dealers", "Safes" };
            Default  = {};
            Multi    = true;
            Callback = function(V)
                _MiscESP_selected = {}
                for k, selected in pairs(V) do
                    if selected then _MiscESP_selected[k] = true end
                end
            end;
        })
    end


end

local SecESPSettings = TabPlayers:Section({ Name = "esp settings", Side = "Left" });

SecESPSettings:Dropdown({
        Name    = "box type";
        Options = { "2D", "Corner" };
        Default = "2D";
        Callback = function(V)
                ESPState.BoxType = V;
                SyncEsp({ "BoundingBox", "Type" }, V);
                for _, Targets in pairs(ESP.Targets or {}) do
                        for Target, TargetInfo in pairs(Targets) do
                                local Objs = TargetInfo.Objects;
                                if not Objs then continue end;
                                if Objs["BoxOutlineHolder"] then Objs["BoxOutlineHolder"].Visible = false end;
                                if Objs["BoxInlineHolder"]  then Objs["BoxInlineHolder"].Visible  = false end;
                                if Objs["CornerHolder"]     then Objs["CornerHolder"].Visible     = false end;
                                for I = 1, 8 do
                                        if Objs["Line_" .. I] then Objs["Line_" .. I].Visible = false end;
                                end;
                        end;
                end;
        end;
});

  Risk = "warning",
