TabSettings:ApplySettings();

Library:KeystrokeOverlay();

Library:KeybindList({ Title = "Keybinds" });

Library:TargetHUD();
do
        local _ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage");
        local _Players           = game:GetService("Players");
        local _LocalPlayer       = _Players.LocalPlayer;

        local _ItemLib = nil;
        local function _GetItemLib()
                if _ItemLib ~= nil then return _ItemLib end;
                local ok, lib = pcall(function()
                        return require(_ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Modules"):WaitForChild("ItemLibrary"));
                end);
                _ItemLib = ok and lib or false;
                return _ItemLib;
        end;

        local _FC = nil;
        local function _GetFC()
                if _FC ~= nil then return _FC end;
                local ok, fc = pcall(function()
                        return require(_LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts"):WaitForChild("Controllers"):WaitForChild("FighterController"));
                end);
                _FC = ok and fc or false;
                return _FC;
        end;

        local function _GetEquippedWeaponName(player)
                if not player then return nil end;
                local fc = _GetFC();
                if not fc then return nil end;
                local fighter;
                local ok = pcall(function() fighter = fc:GetFighter(player) end);
                if not ok or not fighter then return nil end;
                local item;
                pcall(function() item = fighter.EquippedItem end);
                if not item then return nil end;
                local name;
                pcall(function() name = item.Name end);
                return (name and name ~= "") and name or nil;
        end;

        local function _GetWeaponIcon(weaponName)
                if not weaponName or weaponName == "" then return nil end;
                local lib = _GetItemLib();
                if lib and lib.ViewModels then
                        local vm = lib.ViewModels[weaponName];
                        if vm then
                                return vm.ImageHighResolution or vm.Image;
                        end;
                        if lib.Items and lib.Items[weaponName] then
                                local baseName;
                                pcall(function() baseName = lib.Items[weaponName].Base end);
                                if baseName and lib.ViewModels[baseName] then
                                        return lib.ViewModels[baseName].ImageHighResolution or lib.ViewModels[baseName].Image;
                                end;
                        end;
                end;
                local _fallback = {
                        ["Knife"]          = "rbxassetid://86335100734691";
                        ["Assault Rifle"]  = "rbxassetid://101393097640802";
                        ["Sniper"]         = "rbxassetid://132853334508822";
                        ["Handgun"]        = "rbxassetid://113347796650411";
                        ["Shotgun"]        = "rbxassetid://113217458668564";
                        ["SMG"]            = "rbxassetid://113347796650411";
                        ["RPG"]            = "rbxassetid://95169761396387";
                        ["Katana"]         = "rbxassetid://94254432866649";
                        ["Flare Gun"]      = "rbxassetid://113217458668564";
                        ["Fists"]          = "rbxassetid://99106504223200";
                        ["Medkit"]         = "rbxassetid://113536105409271";
                        ["Grenade"]        = "rbxassetid://132057045886696";
                        ["Flashbang"]      = "rbxassetid://129373270164561";
                        ["Molotov"]        = "rbxassetid://72190971541032";
                };
                local lowerName = weaponName:lower();
                for name, id in pairs(_fallback) do
                        if name:lower() == lowerName then
                                return id;
                        end;
                end;
                return nil;
        end;

        local function _ResolveTarget(wantRagebot, wantLegitbot)
                if wantRagebot then
                        local fn = getgenv()._RivalsRagebotTarget;
                        if fn then
                                local char, plr = fn();
                                if char then
                                        return char, plr, "ragebot";
                                end;
                        end;
                end;
                if wantLegitbot then
                        local aim = getgenv()._RivalsAimbotState;
                        if aim and aim.enabled and aim.lockedTarget then
                                -- lockedTarget is a Part (e.g. Head), not the character Model.
                                -- Walk up the hierarchy until we find the Model that a Player owns.
                                local part = aim.lockedTarget;
                                local char = nil;
                                local plr  = nil;
                                local obj = part;
                                while obj and obj ~= workspace do
                                        if obj:IsA("Model") then
                                                local p = _Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(obj);
                                                if p then
                                                        char = obj;
                                                        plr  = p;
                                                        break;
                                                end;
                                        end;
                                        obj = obj.Parent;
                                end;
                                -- fallback: if walk failed, treat the part's parent as char
                                if not char then
                                        char = part.Parent or part;
                                end;
                                if char then
                                        return char, plr, "aimbot";
                                end;
                        end;
                end;
                return nil, nil, nil;
        end;

        local function _GetDistance(char)
                if not char then return nil end;
                local myChar = _LocalPlayer.Character;
                local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");
                local tRoot  = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");
                if not tRoot then
                        local wrapper = char:FindFirstChild("EnemyHumanoid");
                        if wrapper then
                                tRoot = wrapper:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart");
                        end;
                end;
                if not myRoot or not tRoot then return nil end;
                return (tRoot.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude;
        end;

        local _targetHudConn = nil;
        local _targetHudAcc = 0;
        local _hudFollowX, _hudFollowY = nil, nil;
        Library._TargetHUD_StartUpdate = function()
                if _targetHudConn then return end;
                local RunService = game:GetService("RunService");
                _targetHudConn = _RegisterHeartbeat(function(dt)
                        _targetHudAcc = _targetHudAcc + dt;
                        if _targetHudAcc < 0.05 then return end;
                        _targetHudAcc = 0;
                        pcall(function()
                                local hud = Library._TargetHUD;
                                if not hud then return end;
                                if not Library.Flags["TargetHUDEnabled"] then return end;
                                -- perf: cache the TargetHUDSources table once instead of
                                -- indexing Library.Flags twice per HUD update (each index
                                -- is a wrapped table access under Luraph)
                                local _srcs = Library.Flags["TargetHUDSources"] or {};
                                local wantRagebot  = _srcs["ragebot"] == true;
                                local wantLegitbot = _srcs["legitbot"] == true;
                                if not (wantRagebot or wantLegitbot) then
                                        wantRagebot  = true;
                                        wantLegitbot = true;
                                end;
                                local char, player, source = _ResolveTarget(wantRagebot, wantLegitbot);
                                if not char then
                                        hud:ClearTarget();
                                        return;
                                end;
                                hud:SetTarget();
                                local isDummy = (player == nil);

                                -- follow ragebot target (visual only): lerp the HUD next to the target
                                if Library.Flags["TargetHUDFollowRage"] then
                                        local _troot = nil;
                                        pcall(function()
                                                _troot = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char.PrimaryPart;
                                        end);
                                        local _vp, _on;
                                        if _troot then
                                                pcall(function()
                                                        _vp, _on = workspace.CurrentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(_troot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0));
                                                end);
                                        end;
                                        if _vp and _on and ((_vp.Z or 0) > 0) then
                                                local _a = math.clamp(Library.Flags["TargetHUDFollowRageLerp"] or 0.35, 0.01, 1);
                                                local _tpx, _tpy = _vp.X + 90, _vp.Y;
                                                if not _hudFollowX then
                                                        _hudFollowX, _hudFollowY = _tpx, _tpy;
                                                else
                                                        _hudFollowX = _hudFollowX + (_tpx - _hudFollowX) * _a;
                                                        _hudFollowY = _hudFollowY + (_tpy - _hudFollowY) * _a;
                                                end;
                                                local _hw = (hud.Frame and hud.Frame.AbsoluteSize.X) or 260;
                                                pcall(function()
                                                        hud.Frame.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(_hudFollowX - _hw * 0.5, _hudFollowY);
                                                end);
                                        else
                                                _hudFollowX, _hudFollowY = nil, nil;
                                        end;
                                else
                                        _hudFollowX, _hudFollowY = nil, nil;
                                end;

                                if not isDummy then
                                        -- try bust shot first (more reliable in executors), fall back to headshot
                                        local _thumbOk = pcall(function()
                                                hud.Avatar.Image = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarBust&id=" .. player.UserId .. "&w=150&h=150";
                                        end);
                                        if not _thumbOk then
                                                hud.Avatar.Image = "rbxthumb://type=AvatarHeadShot&id=" .. player.UserId .. "&w=48&h=48";
                                        end;
                                else
                                        hud.Avatar.Image = "";
                                end;

                                if not isDummy then
                                        hud.Header.Text = player.DisplayName .. "\n@" .. player.Name;
                                else
                                        hud.Header.Text = (char.Name and char.Name ~= "") and char.Name or "Dummy";
                                end;

                                local levelStr = ""
                                local deviceStr = ""
                                local streakNum = 0
                                if not isDummy then
                                        pcall(function()
                                                -- Criminality uses leaderstats.Level (not CustomLeaderstats)
                                                local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats");
                                                if ls then
                                                        local lv = ls:FindFirstChild("Level") or ls:FindFirstChild("LevelNumber");
                                                        if lv then levelStr = tostring(lv.Value) end;
                                                        local ws = ls:FindFirstChild("Win Streak") or ls:FindFirstChild("WinStreak");
                                                        if ws then
                                                                local n = tonumber(ws.Value);
                                                                if n then streakNum = n end;
                                                        end;
                                                end;
                                                -- fallback: CustomLeaderstats
                                                if levelStr == "" then
                                                        local cl = player:FindFirstChild("CustomLeaderstats");
                                                        if cl then
                                                                local lv = cl:FindFirstChild("Level");
                                                                if lv then levelStr = tostring(lv.Value) end;
                                                        end;
                                                end;
                                        end);
                                        pcall(function()
                                                local fc = _GetFC();
                                                if fc then
                                                        local fighter = fc:GetFighter(player);
                                                        if fighter then
                                                                local dev = nil;
                                                                pcall(function() dev = fighter:Get("Controls") end);
                                                                if dev then
                                                                        deviceStr = tostring(dev):lower();
                                                                else
                                                                        pcall(function() dev = fighter:Get("Device") end);
                                                                        if dev then deviceStr = tostring(dev):lower() end;
                                                                end;
                                                        end;
                                                end;
                                        end);
                                else
                                        levelStr = "-";
                                        deviceStr = "-";
                                end;
                                hud.MetaLine.Text = (levelStr ~= "" and ("lvl " .. levelStr) or "lvl ?") .. "  [" .. (source or "") .. "]";

                                if streakNum > 0 then
                                        hud.StreakBadge.Text = "";
                                else
                                        hud.StreakBadge.Text = "";
                                end;

                                local weaponName = ""
                                local ammoStr = "-"
                                if not isDummy then
                                        -- Criminality: weapon name = equipped Tool.Name
                                        pcall(function()
                                                local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool");
                                                if tool then weaponName = tool.Name or ""; end;
                                        end);
                                        if weaponName == "" then
                                                weaponName = _GetEquippedWeaponName(player) or "";
                                        end;
                                else
                                        weaponName = "Assault Rifle"
                                end;
                                hud.WeaponValue.Text = weaponName ~= "" and weaponName or "—"

                                if not isDummy then
                                        pcall(function()
                                                -- Criminality: find the equipped tool, read Values.Ammo + Values.StoredAmmo
                                                local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool");
                                                if tool then
                                                        local vals = tool:FindFirstChild("Values");
                                                        if vals then
                                                                local cur  = vals:FindFirstChild("Ammo");
                                                                local stor = vals:FindFirstChild("StoredAmmo");
                                                                if cur then
                                                                        local curV  = tonumber(cur.Value) or 0;
                                                                        local storV = stor and tonumber(stor.Value) or nil;
                                                                        if storV then
                                                                                ammoStr = curV .. " | " .. storV;
                                                                        else
                                                                                ammoStr = tostring(curV);
                                                                        end;
                                                                end;
                                                        end;
                                                end;
                                        end);
                                else
                                        ammoStr = "30 / 30";
                                end;
                                hud.AmmoValue.Text = "";

                                -- Weapon icon: try the equipped tool's TextureId
                                -- first (most reliable -- grabs the actual icon the
                                -- inventory uses), then fall back to _GetWeaponIcon
                                -- (Items library), then the generic placeholder.
                                local icon = nil;
                                if not isDummy then
                                        pcall(function()
                                                local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool");
                                                if tool then
                                                        -- Tool.TextureId is the inventory icon
                                                        if tool.TextureId and tool.TextureId ~= "" then
                                                                icon = tool.TextureId;
                                                        end;
                                                        -- Some tools put the icon on a child Decal
                                                        -- named "Icon" or "Texture".
                                                        if not icon then
                                                                for _, c in ipairs(tool:GetChildren()) do
                                                                        if c:IsA("Decal") and c.Texture ~= "" then
                                                                                icon = c.Texture;
                                                                                break;
                                                                        end;
                                                                end;
                                                        end;
                                                end;
                                        end);
                                end;
                                if not icon then
                                        icon = _GetWeaponIcon(weaponName);
                                end;
                                hud.WeaponIcon.Image = "";

                                local dist = _GetDistance(char);
                                hud.StudsValue.Text = dist and ("studs: " .. math.floor(dist) .. "s") or "";

                                local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");
                                if not humanoid then
                                        local wrapper = char:FindFirstChild("EnemyHumanoid");
                                        if wrapper then
                                                if wrapper:IsA("Humanoid") then
                                                        humanoid = wrapper;
                                                else
                                                        humanoid = wrapper:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid");
                                                end;
                                        end;
                                end;
                                -- for dummies, try reading HP from the fighter object directly
                                -- since the Humanoid.Health is always 0 on dummy models
                                local _resolvedHp, _resolvedMaxHp = nil, nil;
                                if isDummy then
                                        pcall(function()
                                                -- try humanoid first (most reliable for Rivals dummies)
                                                local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid", true);
                                                if hum and hum.MaxHealth > 0 and hum.Health > 0 then
                                                        _resolvedHp    = hum.Health;
                                                        _resolvedMaxHp = hum.MaxHealth;
                                                end;
                                                -- if humanoid gave nothing, scan for NumberValues named HP/Health
                                                if not _resolvedHp then
                                                        local function findVal(parent, names)
                                                                for _, n in ipairs(names) do
                                                                        local v = parent:FindFirstChild(n, true);
                                                                        if v and (v:IsA("NumberValue") or v:IsA("IntValue")) then
                                                                                return tonumber(v.Value);
                                                                        end;
                                                                end;
                                                                return nil;
                                                        end;
                                                        local hp    = findVal(char, {"HP","Health","CurrentHealth","Hp"});
                                                        local maxHp = findVal(char, {"MaxHP","MaxHealth","MaxHp"});
                                                        if hp and maxHp then
                                                                _resolvedHp    = hp;
                                                                _resolvedMaxHp = maxHp;
                                                        end;
                                                end;
                                        end);
                                end;
                                if not _resolvedHp and humanoid then
                                        local mh = humanoid.MaxHealth;
                                        if mh > 0 then
                                                _resolvedHp    = humanoid.Health;
                                                _resolvedMaxHp = mh;
                                        end;
                                end;
                                -- Criminality fallback: scan character for HP NumberValues
                                if not _resolvedHp then
                                        pcall(function()
                                                local hpV  = char:FindFirstChild("Health", true) or char:FindFirstChild("HP", true);
                                                local mhpV = char:FindFirstChild("MaxHealth", true) or char:FindFirstChild("MaxHP", true);
                                                if hpV and mhpV then
                                                        local h  = tonumber(hpV.Value);
                                                        local mh = tonumber(mhpV.Value);
                                                        if h and mh and mh > 0 then
                                                                _resolvedHp    = h;
                                                                _resolvedMaxHp = mh;
                                                        end;
                                                end;
                                        end);
                                end;
                                if _resolvedHp and _resolvedMaxHp and _resolvedMaxHp > 0 then
                                        local hp = _resolvedHp;
                                        local maxHp = _resolvedMaxHp;
                                        local ratio = math.clamp(hp / maxHp, 0, 1);
                                        local targetSize = UDim2.new(ratio, 0, 1, 0);
                                        if not hud._lastHpTween then
                                                hud.HealthBarFill.Size = targetSize;
                                        else
                                                if not hud._lastTargetRatio or math.abs(ratio - hud._lastTargetRatio) > 0.001 then
                                                        pcall(function()
                                                                if hud._hpTween then hud._hpTween:Cancel() end;
                                                                hud._hpTween = TweenService:Create(
                                                                        hud.HealthBarFill,
                                                                        TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                                                                        { Size = targetSize }
                                                                );
                                                                hud._hpTween:Play();
                                                        end);
                                                        hud._lastTargetRatio = ratio;
                                                end;
                                        end;
                                        hud._lastHpTween = true;
                                        hud.HealthValue.Text = math.floor(hp) .. " / " .. math.floor(maxHp);
                                        hud.HealthValue.TextColor3 = Color3.fromHex("FFFFFF");
                                else
                                        pcall(function()
                                                if hud._hpTween then hud._hpTween:Cancel() end;
                                        end);
                                        hud.HealthBarFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0);
                                        hud._lastTargetRatio = nil;
                                        hud._lastHpTween = nil;
                                        hud.HealthValue.Text = "";
                                end;
                        end);
                end);
        end;
        Library._TargetHUD_StopUpdate = function()
                if _targetHudConn then
                        pcall(function() _targetHudConn:Disconnect() end);
                        _targetHudConn = nil;
                end;
                if Library._TargetHUD then
                        Library._TargetHUD:ClearTarget();
                end;
        end;
end;

do
        local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService");
        local CameraInput = require(game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.PlayerScripts.PlayerModule.CameraModule.CameraInput);

local _MenuOpen = false;
local _RunService = game:GetService("RunService");

local function SetMenuCursor(Open)
                _MenuOpen = Open;
                if Open then
                        UIS.MouseIconEnabled = true;
                        UIS.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default;
                else
                        UIS.MouseIconEnabled = true;
                end;
        end;

        _RunService:BindToRenderStep(
                "MenuCursorEnforcer",
                Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value + 1,
                function()
                        if _MenuOpen then
                                UIS.MouseBehavior    = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default;
                                UIS.MouseIconEnabled = true;
                        end;
                end
        );

        UIS:GetPropertyChangedSignal("MouseBehavior"):Connect(function()
                if _MenuOpen and UIS.MouseBehavior ~= Enum.MouseBehavior.Default then
                        UIS.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default;
                end;
        end);
        UIS:GetPropertyChangedSignal("MouseIconEnabled"):Connect(function()
                if _MenuOpen and not UIS.MouseIconEnabled then
                        UIS.MouseIconEnabled = true;
                end;
        end);
        _RegisterHeartbeat(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
                -- perf: redundant with the MenuCursorEnforcer BindToRenderStep above;
                -- only run while the menu is actually open.
                if not _MenuOpen then return end
                if UIS.MouseBehavior ~= Enum.MouseBehavior.Default then
                        UIS.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default;
                end;
                if not UIS.MouseIconEnabled then
                        UIS.MouseIconEnabled = true;
                end;
        end));

        local _LocalPlayer = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer;
        pcall(function()
                _LocalPlayer:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CameraMode"):Connect(function()
                        if _MenuOpen then
                                task.delay(0, function()
                                        if not _MenuOpen then return end;
                                        UIS.MouseBehavior    = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default;
                                        UIS.MouseIconEnabled = true;
                                end);
                                task.delay(0.05, function()
                                        if not _MenuOpen then return end;
                                        UIS.MouseBehavior    = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default;
                                        UIS.MouseIconEnabled = true;
                                end);
                                task.delay(0.15, function()
                                        if not _MenuOpen then return end;
                                        UIS.MouseBehavior    = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default;
                                        UIS.MouseIconEnabled = true;
                                end);
                        end;
                end);
        end);
        pcall(function()
                local _cam = workspace.CurrentCamera;
                if _cam then
                        _cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CameraType"):Connect(function()
                                if _MenuOpen then
                                        task.delay(0, function()
                                                if not _MenuOpen then return end;
                                                UIS.MouseBehavior    = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default;
                                                UIS.MouseIconEnabled = true;
                                        end);
                                end;
                        end);
                end;
        end);

        local function SinkInput(Input, GameProcessed)
                if not _MenuOpen then return end;
                if GameProcessed then return end;
                local T = Input.UserInputType;
                local K = Input.KeyCode;
                if K == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then return end;
                if T == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                or T == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2
                or T == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3
                or T == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
                end;
        end;

        local ContextActionService = game:GetService("ContextActionService");
        local function MenuSink(ActionName, InputState, InputObject)
                if not _MenuOpen then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end;
                local T = InputObject.UserInputType;
                local K = InputObject.KeyCode;
                if K == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass end;
                if K == Enum.KeyCode.Space or K == Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl then
                        return Enum.ContextActionResult.Pass;
                end;
                return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink;
        end;

ContextActionService:BindActionAtPriority(
                "MenuInputSink",
                MenuSink,
                false,
                Enum.ContextActionPriority.High.Value,
                Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1,
                Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2,
                Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton3,
                Enum.KeyCode.Q,
                Enum.KeyCode.E,
                Enum.KeyCode.R,
                Enum.KeyCode.F,
                Enum.KeyCode.G,
                Enum.KeyCode.Z,
                Enum.KeyCode.X,
                Enum.KeyCode.C,
                Enum.KeyCode.V,
                Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift
        );

        local _OrigSetVisible = w.SetVisible;
        function w:SetVisible(State)
                _OrigSetVisible(self, State);
                SetMenuCursor(State);
        end;
end;

do
    local _autoloadWin = Library.CurrentlyOpen;
    local _wasEnabled = nil;
    if _autoloadWin and _autoloadWin.Gui then
        _wasEnabled = _autoloadWin.Gui.Enabled;
        _autoloadWin.Gui.Enabled = false;
    end;

    pcall(function()
        local ThemeAutoloadFile = Library.Directory .. "/themes/autoload.txt";
        if isfile and isfile(ThemeAutoloadFile) then
            local Nm = (readfile(ThemeAutoloadFile) or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "");
            if Nm ~= "" then
                local Path = Library.Directory .. "/themes/" .. Nm .. ".json";
                if isfile and isfile(Path) then
                    local Ok, Data = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, readfile(Path));
                    if Ok and Data then
                        if Data.Accent then
                            Library:SetAccent(Color3.fromHex(Data.Accent));
                        end;
                        if Data.Background    then Library:SetTheme({ Background    = Color3.fromHex(Data.Background) }) end;
                        if Data.SubBackground then Library:SetTheme({ SubBackground = Color3.fromHex(Data.SubBackground) }) end;
                        if Data.Outline       then Library:SetTheme({ Outline       = Color3.fromHex(Data.Outline) }) end;
                        Library:Notify("Auto-loaded theme: " .. Nm, 3);
                    end;
                end;
            end;
        end;
    end);

    Library._Autoloading = true;
    -- Auto-load: file reading and JSON parsing are protected by pcall (they don't
    -- need Instance access). But LoadConfigFlags MUST run on the main thread —
    -- under Luraph, pcall(function() ... end) creates a restricted coroutine
    -- that lacks Plugin capability, causing all toggle setters to fail.
    local _autoloadDecoded = nil;
    local _autoloadName = nil;
    pcall(function()
        -- Use per-game folder so autoload doesn't load the wrong game's config.
        local _gf = _G.FrequencyGameFolder or "default"
        local CfgAutoLoadFile = Library.Directory .. "/configs/" .. _gf .. "/autoload.txt";
        if isfile and isfile(CfgAutoLoadFile) then
            local Nm = (readfile(CfgAutoLoadFile) or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "");
            if Nm ~= "" then
                local Path = Library.Directory .. "/configs/" .. _gf .. "/" .. Nm .. ".json";
                if isfile and isfile(Path) then
                    local Ok, Data = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, readfile(Path));
                    if Ok and Data then
                        local Decoded = {};
                        for K, V in Data do
                            if typeof(V) == "table" and V._t == "Color3" then
                                Decoded[K] = Color3.fromHex(V.v);
                            elseif typeof(V) == "table" then
                                Decoded[K] = V;
                            else
                                Decoded[K] = V;
                            end;
                        end;
                        _autoloadDecoded = Decoded;
                        _autoloadName = Nm;
                    end;
                end;
            end;
        end;
    end);
    -- LoadConfigFlags runs DIRECTLY on the main thread (no pcall wrapper)
    -- so toggle setters can access Instance objects under Luraph.
    if _autoloadDecoded then
        local _res = Library:LoadConfigFlags(_autoloadDecoded, "autoload");
        if _res then
            pcall(function() Library:Notify("Auto-loaded config: " .. _autoloadName .. " (" .. _res.applied .. " applied, " .. _res.failed .. " errors)", 3); end);
        end;
    end;
    Library._Autoloading = false;
    -- Schedule visual refresh on Heartbeat thread (same as manual load)
    local _autoRefreshed = false;
    _RegisterHeartbeat(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        if _autoRefreshed then return end;
        _autoRefreshed = true;
        Library._ConfigRefreshing = true;
        for _flag, _setter in pairs(Library._FlagSetters) do
            local _val = Library.Flags[_flag];
            if type(_val) == "boolean" and type(_setter) == "function" then
                _setter(_val, true);
            end;
        end;
        Library._ConfigRefreshing = false;
    end));

    Library._MenuBindReady = true;
    local _menuBindApplied = false;
    _RegisterHeartbeat(LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE(function()
        if _menuBindApplied then return end;
        if not Library._SavedMenuKeybind then return end;
        _menuBindApplied = true;
        pcall(function()
            local MenuBindFile = Library.Directory .. "/menubind.txt";
            if not (isfile and isfile(MenuBindFile)) then return end;
            local Raw = (readfile(MenuBindFile) or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "");
            local EnumType, ValueName = Raw:match("^([A-Za-z]+):([A-Za-z0-9_]+)$");
            if not (EnumType and ValueName) then return end;
            local okET, ET = pcall(function() return Enum[EnumType] end);
            if not (okET and ET) then return end;
            local okItem, Item = pcall(function() return ET[ValueName] end);
            if not (okItem and Item) then return end;
            Library._SavedMenuKeybind:SetKey(Item);
            Library._MenuBindPrevKey = Item;
        end);
    end));

    if _autoloadWin and _autoloadWin.Gui then
        local _win = _autoloadWin;
        task.spawn(function()
            pcall(function()
                RunService.RenderStepped:Wait();
                _win.Gui.Enabled = (_wasEnabled ~= false);
            end);
        end);
    end;
end;

Library:Log("Library ready");
end) -- close task.spawn
